name: Family spring cleaning before the Spring Festival
description: Starting on the 24th day of the twelfth lunar month (January 23), Ma Xiulan led the whole family in a traditional year-end cleaning. She wiped windows, swept rooms, and washed bedding; her husband was responsible for cleaning the light fixtures; the children helped organize toys and books. After two days, the house was spotless and ready to welcome the New Year.

subevent.name: First day of deep cleaning: initial cleanup.
subevent.description: On the 24th day of the twelfth lunar month, Ma Xiulan led the whole family in the year-end deep cleaning according to traditional customs. She was responsible for wiping windows, sweeping dust from the ceilings, and washing the bedding. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang used a ladder to take down and wipe the light fixtures in each room one by one. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan organized the books and stationery on the desk and bookshelves, the second son Ma Mingzhe tidied up his toy box, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin helped put small toys into storage bins. The whole family worked from morning until evening, basically completing the difficult high-up cleaning tasks.
subevent.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Second day of spring cleaning: deep cleaning and finishing touches.
subevent.description: On the 25th day of the twelfth lunar month, Ma Xiulan led the family to continue the big cleaning. She used a mop and cleaner to thoroughly scrub the floors in every room, wiped down furniture surfaces and windowsills, and remade the beds with washed and dried bedding. Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for removing grease in the kitchen and bathroom and checking and cleaning cobwebs in the corners. Under their mother's guidance, the children put away the items that had not been returned to their places the day before and sorted the discarded old things into categories for disposal. By evening, the whole house was bright and clean, tidy and orderly, fully prepared for the New Year.
subevent.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Grid worker Zheng Xiuying came by for a chat and mentioned the 'Most Beautiful Family' nomination, which motivated her to tidy up.
description: On the afternoon of September 27, community grid worker Zheng Xiuying dropped by for a chat and told Ma Xiulan that the subdistrict would be selecting the Most Beautiful Family at the end of the year and that she had recommended her family. Xiulan quickly waved her hands and said, 'We don't qualify,' but Zheng Xiuying encouraged her: 'Your children are well-behaved, you and your husband get along well, and your yard is clean—you qualify!' The two sat beside the roses in the yard and chatted for half an hour. Xiulan also asked Zheng Xiuying about the evaluation criteria. After seeing Zheng Xiuying off, she looked at the slightly messy yard and living room, silently resolved to make the flowers and the home tidier, and quietly picked up a broom to start cleaning from the corner.

subevent.name: Zheng Xiuying came by to chat and revealed information
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 27, 2025, Zheng Xiuying, a community grid worker, came to Ma Xiulan's home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to drop by and chat. The two sat beside the blooming roses in the yard. Zheng Xiuying told her that the subdistrict would select a "Most Beautiful Family" at the end of the year and that she had already recommended her family. Ma Xiulan quickly waved her hands and said, "I'm not qualified." Zheng Xiuying then encouraged her, praising her children for being sensible, her family for being harmonious, and her yard for being clean.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-home courtyard

subevent.name: Ask Zheng Xiuying about the evaluation criteria.
subevent.description: While chatting in the courtyard, Ma Xiulan asked Zheng Xiuying in detail about the selection criteria for the “Most Beautiful Family,” including specific requirements for environmental hygiene, family harmony, neighborly relations, and so on. Zheng Xiuying answered patiently and gave some suggestions, such as keeping the flowers and plants in the courtyard neater and storing away the clutter in the living room. The two chatted for about half an hour.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-home courtyard

subevent.name: After seeing Zheng Xiuying off, she began tidying up the home.
subevent.description: After seeing Zheng Xiuying off, Ma Xiulan looked at the somewhat messy courtyard and living room and silently resolved to make the plants and the home more orderly. She quietly picked up a broom and began sweeping fallen leaves and debris from the corner of the courtyard, then put away the scattered toys and books in the living room and simply wiped the surfaces of the furniture. She spent the whole afternoon doing preliminary cleaning, preparing for a thorough tidying up later.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home courtyard and living room

name: Warm family celebration for Father's Day
description: On June 15, Father’s Day, Ma Xiulan quietly prepared the sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin and gravy noodles her husband loved. The three children made cards from colored paper: the eldest son wrote “Dad, you’ve worked hard,” the second son drew a big truck, and the youngest daughter stuck shiny stickers on hers. During dinner, the children gave the cards to their father. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang’s eyes turned slightly red, and he murmured, “Our family is really wonderful.” After the meal, Ma Xiulan suggested taking a family photo. Her husband’s right arm still had a medicated patch on it, but he smiled with particular warmth and contentment.

subevent.name: Preparing ingredients and cooking for Father's Day dinner
subevent.description: On the morning of Father's Day, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District and bought fresh pork, flour, vegetables, and other ingredients from the familiar stall owner Sun Guifang. After returning to her home kitchen, she carefully cooked sweet and sour pork tenderloin and noodles with gravy, which her husband Ma Zhiqiang loved, to prepare for the evening celebration.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: The children made Father's Day cards.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan's three children — the eldest son Ma Mingxuan, the second son Ma Mingzhe, and the youngest daughter Ma Yuxin — made greeting cards by hand in the living room using colored paper, markers, and stickers. Ma Mingxuan wrote "Dad, you've worked hard" in neat handwriting, Ma Mingzhe drew a big truck, and Ma Yuxin added shiny stickers. When they finished, the three put the cards away to give at dinner.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Having dinner together as a family and presenting greeting cards
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan brought the prepared sweet-and-sour pork and noodles with gravy to the table, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work. The whole family sat around the table, and the three children together gave their father the greeting cards they had made by hand. Ma Zhiqiang took the cards, his eyes slightly red, and said in a low voice, 'Our family is truly wonderful.' Then the family enjoyed a warm dinner together.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home dining room

subevent.name: Taking a family photo as a memento
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan suggested taking a family photo to commemorate this warm Father's Day. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang had a medicinal patch on his right arm, but he still smiled and cooperated. The family gathered in the living room, and Ma Xiulan used her phone to take a group photo, capturing this moment of steadiness and happiness.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: First yoga class experience, trying to relax body and mind.
description: On June 28, her younger sister Ma Xiufen dragged Ma Xiulan to a free trial class at the newly opened Hehe Yoga Studio in Jinghai Town. Ma Xiulan was reluctant at first, but after changing into borrowed sportswear she still seriously followed the teacher in Hatha yoga. Her hands and feet were trembling in Downward-Facing Dog, but the Cat Stretch made her think of Dr. Wang's advice, so she did it with extra care. During the final Corpse Pose she actually fell asleep, and her sister joked that she was snoring. Although she didn't fall in love with yoga, the experience made her realize the benefits of active exercise for her body. After returning home, she also recommended that her neighbor Chunmei try it when she had time.

subevent.name: Ma Xiufen persuaded Ma Xiulan to go to the yoga studio
subevent.description: Younger sister Ma Xiufen came to Ma Xiulan's home and persuaded her to go to the newly opened Hehe Yoga Studio in Jinghai Town for a free trial class. Ma Xiulan was reluctant at first, but gave in to her sister's persuasion and finally agreed to go. The two set off together on foot at the agreed time and walked to the yoga studio.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Ma Xiulan's home

subevent.name: Change into sportswear and get ready for class.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan and Ma Xiufen arrived at Hehe Yoga Studio, they changed into the sportswear borrowed from the studio in the locker room. Although Ma Xiulan was not accustomed to the outfit, she cooperated actively, carefully arranged her clothes, and prepared to enter the classroom for class.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hehe Yoga Studio - Changing Room

subevent.name: Experience a Hatha Yoga class.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan practiced Hatha yoga seriously under the yoga teacher's guidance. During Downward-Facing Dog her hands and legs trembled, but during the Cat Stretch she was especially attentive because it reminded her of Community Doctor Wang's advice. In the final relaxation pose, she fell asleep on the mat from being too relaxed, and was found by her younger sister Ma Xiufeng, who laughed and said she was snoring. The whole class lasted about 60 minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hehe Yoga Studio - Yoga Room

subevent.name: Share thoughts after class
subevent.description: After the yoga class ended, Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen changed back into their own clothes in the locker room and shared their thoughts on the class. Her sister teased her about falling asleep and snoring during the relaxation pose. Although Ma Xiulan felt a bit embarrassed, she honestly said that this experience made her realize the benefits of active exercise for the body. She had not yet fallen in love with yoga, but was willing to try other forms of exercise.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hehe Yoga Studio - Changing Room

subevent.name: Recommend the yoga class to neighbors after returning home
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan recalled her yoga trial experience and contacted her neighbor Liu Chunmei via WeChat voice. She told Chunmei that the newly opened Hehe Yoga Studio in Jinghai Town offered free trial classes, and recommended that Chunmei go try it if she had time. After briefly chatting about exercise, they ended the call.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Ma Xiulan's home - living room

name: Had a video call with fellow craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to discuss persimmon trees and embroidery.
description: On the evening of March 13, Ma Xiulan had a video call with Zhou Xiuqin in a WeChat group. She excitedly showed the newly planted persimmon sapling in the yard and asked for advice on how to use embroidery to record this moment. Zhou Xiuqin suggested she embroider a "Persimmons Bring Good Luck" picture, and the two agreed to design the pattern together at their next in-person meeting, deepening their friendship with laughter and joyful conversation.

subevent.name: Video call with Zhou Xiuqin to show the persimmon tree and discuss embroidery
subevent.description: On the evening of March 13, 2025, Ma Xiulan had a WeChat video call with her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin. She excitedly showed her the newly planted persimmon sapling in the courtyard and asked how to record this moment with embroidery. Zhou Xiuqin suggested she embroider a "Persimmons Bring Good Fortune" design, and the two exchanged embroidery techniques in depth with laughter and cheerful conversation.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Agreed to meet offline to design the patterns
subevent.description: At the end of the video call, Ma Xiulan and Zhou Xiuqin agreed to meet in person next time to design embroidery patterns together, and arranged the specific time and place, further strengthening their friendship.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Social security subsidy approved and included in the education fund.
description: On May 12, Ma Xiulan received a notice from the community service station that her application for flexible employment social security subsidies, which she had submitted last month, had been approved. Starting in June, a monthly subsidy of 200 yuan would be paid directly into her social security-linked account. On the spot, she wrote “education fund” in the family ledger and decided to use the money specifically for that purpose, preparing early for the children's future tuition. That evening she shared the news with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Although they did not say much, both felt more confident about holding the family's financial bottom line.

subevent.name: Go to the community service station to confirm the subsidy has been approved.
subevent.description: On the morning of May 12, Ma Xiulan went to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and received from community grid worker Zheng Xiuying the official notice that her flexible-employment social security subsidy had been approved. She confirmed that starting in June, a monthly subsidy of 200 yuan would be deposited into her social security-linked account. She carefully checked the contents of the notice and kept it in a safe place.

participant.name: Zheng Xiuying
participant.relation: Part-time job referral contact / community service worker

subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Service Center

subevent.name: Mark the education fund in the family ledger
subevent.description: After returning home from the community service station, Ma Xiulan took out the family account book, solemnly wrote the words 'Education Fund' next to the day's income and expense records, and set the monthly 200 yuan subsidy as dedicated funds, making early preparations for the children's future tuition. While keeping accounts, she was mentally calculating the education expenses for the three children.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road, home - study

subevent.name: Share the good news of the approved subsidy with her husband
subevent.description: That evening, after Ma Zhiqiang finished his transport run and got home, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to share with him at dinner that the social security subsidy had been approved and credited to the education fund. The two sat at the dinner table and briefly discussed their family financial planning. Although her husband spoke little, he nodded in approval, which gave Ma Xiulan more confidence in maintaining the family's financial bottom line.
subevent.location: Dining room at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Watch an outdoor movie with a childhood friend.
description: On the evening of July 30, Ma Xiulan received a call from her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, who said there was a free open-air movie screening of Liu Sanjie at Jinghai Plaza. Remembering how the two of them used to watch black-and-white movies together when they were young, Ma Xiulan readily agreed. They brought small stools and a handful of sunflower seeds, sat among the crowd in the plaza, and quietly discussed the plot while watching. Although the speakers had some static, the two laughed happily. After the movie ended, Chunmei said she would invite her again next time there was such an event. Ma Xiulan nodded, feeling as if she had returned to her girlhood.

subevent.name: Prepared movie-watching items and went out.
subevent.description: After finishing the phone call, Ma Xiulan found two small stools from the storage room and put a small bag of sunflower seeds into a cloth bag. She told her family she was going out, then carried the things and walked to Jinghai Square. Along the way, she felt happy, thinking she would soon see Chunmei, and savored the joy of her girlhood.
subevent.location: On the way from home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Jinghai Square

subevent.name: Watching an open-air movie with a childhood friend
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan arrived at Jinghai Square, she found Liu Chunmei. The two found a suitable spot in the crowd, set down their small stools, and sat down. The movie Liu Sanjie began to screen. Although the audio had some static, the two chatted softly about the plot while cracking sunflower seeds, recalling fun stories from their youth and laughing happily. Immersed in the nostalgic atmosphere, they spent a pleasant evening.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jinghai Square

subevent.name: After the event ended, said goodbye and agreed on the next activity
subevent.description: After the movie ended, Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei packed up their small stools and trash and walked out of the square together. Liu Chunmei said she would invite her again if there was another event like this, and Ma Xiulan nodded in agreement, feeling as if she had returned to her girlhood. The two said goodbye at the intersection and went home separately. Ma Xiulan walked home carrying her stool, her heart full of warmth and contentment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - near the exit of Jinghai Square

name: Cost accounting and preliminary pricing for pickled vegetables
description: On February 20, based on the cost of ingredients such as radishes, soy sauce, and sugar used in the trial batch, plus the price of sealed glass jars purchased online, Ma Xiulan calculated that each jar of pickled radish cost about 4.5 yuan to make. Referring to prices of similar products at the market, she initially set the price at 10 yuan per jar and estimated the profit margin for the first batch of 50 jars.

subevent.name: Compile the trial production materials list and costs
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, in the kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, recorded and compiled the actual quantities and unit prices of the materials used in the trial batch of pickled radish—radish, soy sauce, sugar, and so on—and put together an itemized list of material costs to prepare for cost accounting.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Looking up prices for airtight glass jars online
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used her mobile phone to go online in the living room at home, browsing prices of sealed glass jars on e-commerce platforms. She noted down the unit price and shipping cost of jars that met the size and quality requirements, as a reference for packaging costs.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Calculate the cost per jar of pickled radish.
subevent.description: At the kitchen table, Ma Xiulan added the calculated total material cost to the total glass jar cost, divided by the number of finished jars from the trial production, and found that the raw material and packaging cost per jar of pickled radish was about 4.5 yuan.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - by the dining table at home

subevent.name: Reference the prices of similar products at the market and set initial prices.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan recalled the prices of similar pickled vegetable products she had recently seen at the handicraft market and the local vegetable market. Based on the cost of 4.5 yuan, she decided to price each jar of pickled radish at 10 yuan, and at home at her desk she used a notebook to estimate the gross profit and net profit potential for the first batch of 50 jars.
subevent.location: By the desk at home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Accompanying her father to his first community health recheck after being discharged from the hospital
description: On March 20, which was her father's first comprehensive follow-up after being discharged from the hospital, Ma Xiulan took her father to queue up early. They measured his blood pressure, blood sugar, and electrocardiogram. Dr. Wang said it was well controlled. She smiled and said to her father, ‘See, I told you so.’ Her father rarely smiled. She decided to incorporate regular check-ups into the family health management.

subevent.name: Prepare materials for the follow-up check-up and remind father
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan prepared her father's medical records, discharge summary, and medical insurance card at home in advance, and reminded her father Ma Jianguo to fast after getting up, in preparation for the community health follow-up check.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Accompany father to the community clinic
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan helped her father Ma Jianguo walk to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, telling him along the way to relax and not be nervous.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Queueing for registration and waiting for the examination
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan registered for a general practice appointment for her father at the community health service center, and accompanied her father in the waiting area, soothing his mood and chatting about everyday matters.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Completed blood pressure, blood sugar, and ECG checks
subevent.description: Guided by the nurse, Ma Xiulan helped her father complete, in turn, blood pressure measurement, fingertip blood glucose testing, and an electrocardiogram. The examination went smoothly, and her father cooperated well.
subevent.location: Examination Room, Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Doctor Wang explained the results and gave health advice.
subevent.description: General practitioner Dr. Wang told Ma Xiulan and her father based on the examination results that all the indicators were well controlled, and advised them to continue taking medication on time, maintain a low-salt diet, and exercise moderately. Ma Xiulan said to her father with a smile, 'See, I told you so,' and her father rarely showed a smile.
subevent.location: Consulting room, Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Established a regular follow-up plan and returned home
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her father agreed that he would come to the community clinic for routine follow-up visits around the 20th of each month from now on, and she recorded the plan on the family calendar. She then helped her father walk home, and his mood clearly improved along the way.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community and home

name: Complete February's savings and bookkeeping
description: After her husband received his salary on February 15, Ma Xiulan deposited 150 yuan into the education savings account as planned, and recorded the month's income and expenses in the family ledger. She found that her husband's cigarette spending was kept within 10 yuan per day, and the savings goal was smoothly achieved.

subevent.name: Preparing savings and bookkeeping tools.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 15, Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger and bankbook from the drawer at home and checked the balance information of the education savings account, preparing for subsequent deposits and bookkeeping.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Go to the bank to deposit into the education savings account
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took 150 yuan in cash, set aside from the living expenses her husband gave her, and walked to the China Construction Bank branch in Jinghai District. At the counter, she deposited 150 yuan into an education savings account and kept the deposit receipt.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - China Construction Bank Jinghai Sub-branch

subevent.name: Record the family's income and expenses for the month.
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan put away the bankbook and receipt, took out the family ledger, and recorded each expense for the first half of February item by item, including food costs, children's pocket money, daily necessities, her husband's cigarette money, and so on. At the same time, she entered the 150 yuan deposit into the savings expenditure column.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Check cigarette expenses and confirm that the savings target was met.
subevent.description: When keeping accounts, Ma Xiulan specifically calculated her husband Ma Zhiqiang's cigarette expenses for the first half of February and found that the average daily cost was within 10 yuan, in line with the family budget plan. She then confirmed that the 150 yuan education savings goal for February was successfully achieved, and noted this completion in the account book.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: The idea of a pickled-vegetable side business emerges.
description: On the evening of February 1, 2025, after returning from New Year's visits, Ma Xiulan lay in her bedroom thinking repeatedly about her relatives' praise for her pickled vegetables and began to have the idea of a side business. The next day, while chatting in the living room of her mother Li Xiuying's home, the mother and daughter discussed it in depth and formally decided to make handmade pickled vegetables a side business, starting to systematically think about recipe improvements and sales channels.

subevent.name: After returning home from New Year's visits, she pondered the matter of the pickled vegetables alone.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 1, 2025, after returning from paying New Year's visits at her parents' home, Ma Xiulan lay restlessly in bed in her bedroom, repeatedly recalling how her relatives had praised her homemade pickled vegetables during the day. A thought began to stir in her heart: whether she could turn handmade pickled vegetables into a side business. She thought alone about preliminary directions for recipe improvement and possible sales channels.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: While chatting with her mother, the idea of starting a sideline business formally took shape.
subevent.description: On February 2, 2025, while helping with housework at her mother Li Xiuying's home (No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District), Ma Xiulan mentioned again in casual conversation how relatives had praised her pickled vegetables during the New Year visits the day before. The mother and daughter discussed in depth the possibility of making handmade pickled vegetables a side business. Ma Xiulan formally made up her mind and began systematically thinking about recipe optimization (such as adding spicy varieties) and sales channels (local markets, acquaintances' networks, etc.), and planned to conduct market research later.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - mother's home living room

name: Family lunch after accompanying father to his follow-up visit
description: After her father's follow-up visit on February 11, Ma Xiulan took him home; her mother had already prepared lunch. The family sat around the table to eat. Xiulan reminded her father to take his medicine on time and to eat less salt and oil. Her father joked that she was getting more and more naggy, but his eyes showed contentment. After the meal, Xiulan helped her mother clear the dishes, and the mother and daughter chatted about the pickled vegetable sideline.

subevent.name: Accompanying father to the hospital for a follow-up visit
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan accompanied her father Ma Jianguo to Jinghai District Hospital for a routine follow-up visit. In the consultation room, her father described how he had been feeling recently to the doctor. The doctor reviewed the previous examination reports and wrote a new prescription and medication recommendations. Ma Xiulan carefully took notes on the doctor's advice and asked about dietary precautions. The whole follow-up visit lasted about an hour.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jinghai District Hospital

subevent.name: Bring father home and prepare lunch.
subevent.description: After the follow-up visit, Ma Xiulan accompanied her father Ma Jianguo on the walk home. When they arrived, her mother Li Xiuying had already prepared a simple and tasty lunch, including light seasonal vegetables, noodles with gravy, and a serving of sweet and sour pork tenderloin. Ma Xiulan helped her mother set the dishes on the table and called her father and the three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to sit down for the meal.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Family lunch and reminding father
subevent.description: The family sat around the table for lunch. While putting food on her father's plate, Ma Xiulan reminded him again to take his medicine on time as prescribed and to follow a low-salt, low-oil diet. Her father, Ma Jianguo, laughed and said she was getting more and more naggy, but his eyes were full of gratification. The three children also ate obediently at the side, and her mother, Li Xiuying, kept adding food to their bowls. The atmosphere at the table was warm and harmonious, and the meal ended in about half an hour.
subevent.location: Family dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: After-dinner cleanup and mother-daughter talk
subevent.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to help her mother Li Xiuying clear the dishes, wipe the table, and wash the dishes. While working, the mother and daughter talked about her mother's recent idea of trying to make pickled vegetables and discussed whether it could be developed into a family sideline business. Her father Ma Jianguo rested with the children in the living room. After cleaning up, Ma Xiulan chatted with her parents for a while and did not return home with the children until the afternoon.
subevent.location: Home kitchen and living room, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Photograph the flowers blooming in the courtyard and share them in the family group chat.
description: On the morning of April 25, while tending the courtyard, Ma Xiulan noticed that the moss roses and impatiens were blooming for the first time. She took out her old digital camera and took more than twenty photos of the courtyard flowers. She chose nine and made a nine-grid collage to post in the family WeChat group, earning likes from relatives and friends. Her elder sister commented, ‘Your courtyard is so much prettier than my balcony.’

subevent.name: Checking the courtyard flowers in the early morning
subevent.description: While tending the courtyard in the morning, Ma Xiulan noticed that the portulaca and impatiens she had previously planted were blooming for the first time. She also noticed the persimmon tree was lush with new green leaves, and the whole courtyard was full of spring. This gave her the idea of recording the flowers in bloom.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Taking out the old digital camera to photograph the courtyard
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out an old digital camera from home and took more than twenty photos in the courtyard of the blooming sunflowers, impatiens, the fresh green of the persimmon tree, and the overall courtyard layout, capturing the beautiful moments of the flowers just beginning to bloom.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Selected photos and curated a nine-grid layout.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went back inside, browsed the photos she had taken on the camera, selected nine of the most representative shots of the flowers and courtyard scenery, and prepared to share them in the family WeChat group.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

subevent.name: Post the nine-grid photo to the family WeChat group.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully selected nine photos of the courtyard flowers and sent them as a nine-grid collage to the family WeChat group via her phone, along with a short message, sharing the joy of the blooming flowers with her family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

subevent.name: Reply to likes and comments from relatives and friends
subevent.description: Relatives and friends in the family WeChat group liked and commented one after another. Her sister commented, "The yard is much prettier than my balcony." Ma Xiulan replied to each one with thanks and interacted with her family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

name: Phone call to discuss the eldest son's studies.
description: On January 16, after her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's final grades were released, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to call the head teacher, Teacher Han Mei, to thank her for her teaching and ask about her son's performance at school and holiday study advice. Teacher Han praised Ma Mingxuan for his improvement in math and suggested reading more extracurricular books. Ma Xiulan took careful notes and told Xuanxuan about the teacher's praise, encouraging him to keep working hard. This call strengthened the home-school connection and also gave Ma Xiulan more direction in her son's education.

subevent.name: Check eldest son's final exam scores.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan learned about her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's final exam results through a text message sent by the school or a parent group notice, and prepared to communicate with the class teacher. She checked the scores on her phone in the living room and noticed that his math score had improved.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Proactively call homeroom teacher Han Mei.
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan called her class teacher, Han Mei, using her mobile phone. She first thanked the teacher for her dedicated teaching over the semester, then asked in detail about her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's overall performance at school, his classroom participation, and how he got along with classmates, and also asked for advice on holiday study. The call lasted about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Relay praise and encouragement to the eldest son.
subevent.description: In the evening, after Ma Mingxuan came home from school, Ma Xiulan called him over and gently told him that Teacher Han had praised his progress in math, and relayed the teacher's suggestion to read more extracurricular books. She encouraged Xuanxuan to keep up the effort and worked with the child to make a plan to read for half an hour every day during the vacation. The mother-son interaction went well and boosted the child's confidence in learning.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Handmade patchwork chair cushions were ordered by neighbors, increasing her odd-job income.
description: On August 19, Ma Xiulan dug out old floral fabrics she had accumulated over the years at home, carefully selecting pieces with suitable texture and coordinated colors. The next day, using an old-fashioned sewing machine, she cut and pieced the fabric into four sturdy, durable handmade chair cushions with even stitches and traditional patchwork patterns. On the morning of August 21, her neighbor Wang Guilan dropped by, saw the cushions, and loved them. She immediately ordered all four at 15 yuan each, 60 yuan in total, and praised, "Practical items have more market than fancy ones — you're really skillful." After receiving the money, Ma Xiulan realized that practical fabric crafts could become a steady source of small income and began considering taking more custom orders.

subevent.name: Search through and organize old fabric scraps.
subevent.description: At her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan dug out old floral fabric scraps accumulated over the years, selected several pieces with suitable texture and matching colors, and prepared to make chair cushions.
subevent.location: Own residence in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Cutting and sewing chair cushions
subevent.description: In the living room at home, Ma Xiulan used her old-fashioned sewing machine to carefully cut sorted old fabric into chair cushion sizes, followed traditional patchwork patterns, and sewed four sturdy handmade chair cushions with even stitches.
subevent.location: Own residence in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Neighbor came over and ordered chair cushions
subevent.description: On the morning of August 21, neighbor Wang Guilan dropped by Ma Xiulan's home. Seeing the four newly made handmade chair cushions in the living room, she liked them very much and immediately ordered all of them, at 15 yuan each, 60 yuan in total. Wang Guilan was full of praise for Ma Xiulan's craftsmanship, saying practical fabric art had good market prospects.
subevent.location: Own residence in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Follow up on the custom embroidered round fan order.
description: On July 21, Ma Xiulan found the contact information left by three interested customers at the market and called or texted them one by one. The first, Ms. Li, wanted an embroidered lotus fan face; the two settled on the pattern size and a price of 60 yuan over the phone, agreeing to deliver in three days. The second, Mr. Zhang, was still hesitating, so she offered to embroider a sample first for him to look at, and Mr. Zhang agreed. The third number was a dead line. She sighed but was not discouraged, prepared Ms. Li's order materials, and planned to start work the next day.

subevent.name: Organize customer contact information
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan dug out the slips of paper left from the market with the contact information of three interested customers, including names and phone numbers. She got her phone ready to contact them one by one.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Contact Ms. Li to confirm the order.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan called Ms. Li to discuss details of the custom embroidered round fan, finalized the lotus pattern on the fan face, its dimensions, and the 60 yuan price, agreed to deliver in three days, and noted down the customer's requirements.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Contact Mr. Zhang to propose the sample.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan called the hesitant Mr. Zhang and offered to embroider a sample first so he could see the effect. Mr. Zhang agreed to this plan and said he would decide after seeing the sample.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Tried to contact the customer whose phone number was out of service.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan dialed the phone number left by the third customer. The system said it was an invalid number. She sighed but did not lose heart, and discarded the note left by that customer.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Prepare all materials for Ms. Li's order
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan prepared the materials needed for Ms. Li's confirmed order (plain round fans, embroidery thread, embroidery needles, lotus pattern drawings, etc.) and placed them in her handicraft work area, ready to begin work the next day.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: End-of-month financial review and next month's budget
description: On the evening of February 28, Ma Xiulan took out her ledger in the study at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, to summarize February expenses. She confirmed that the education savings had been deposited, that tobacco spending had dropped significantly, and that overall expenses were within budget. She set a March budget and reserved a sum for materials to trial-produce pickled vegetables.

subevent.name: Organize the February expense records.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 28, Ma Xiulan took out her account book in the study at her home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin. She went through and checked all the daily expense records for February, including household food, daily necessities, and children's pocket money, in preparation for a financial summary.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Check education savings account and cigarette spending.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan specifically looked at the education savings page in her accounting book and confirmed that 300 yuan had been deposited into the education reserve fund this month. She also tallied her husband Ma Zhiqiang's cigarette spending in February and found it had decreased by about 120 yuan compared with January. Cigarette expenses had dropped significantly, and overall household spending stayed within the 3,800 yuan budget set at the beginning of the month.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Make the March budget and reserve funds for pickle ingredients.
subevent.description: Based on the February summary, Ma Xiulan drew up a family budget for March in her ledger, planning the major expense items such as food, utilities, and children's school fees and miscellaneous expenses; she also deliberately set aside 50 yuan in the miscellaneous category for the ingredient costs needed to try making pickled vegetables (including vegetables, salt, sauces, etc.), to encourage herself to develop a side business.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: First yogurt making and recipe adjustment
description: On May 22, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared yogurt-making ingredients in the kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and that evening fermented yogurt for the first time according to the instructions. The finished yogurt was too sour, and her three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, all shook their heads after tasting it. Ma Xiulan was not discouraged. That evening in the living room, she used her phone to search for information and decided to adjust the ratio of milk to starter powder. The next day (May 23), she made a second batch in the kitchen, increasing the amount of milk. After fermentation, she added honey and fresh fruit pieces, and after chilling, the texture was noticeably silky. On the morning of May 24, the children drank up all the improved yogurt and said they loved it.

subevent.name: Prepare the materials for making yogurt
subevent.description: In her kitchen at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan took out milk, yogurt starter powder, sugar, and honey, and prepared the yogurt maker, bowls, spoons, and other tools, getting ready to make yogurt for the first time.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: First yogurt fermentation and tasting feedback
subevent.description: On the evening of May 22, Ma Xiulan mixed pure milk with yogurt starter powder according to the yogurt maker instructions, put it in the yogurt maker to ferment for about 8 hours, then took it out. The finished yogurt was too sour. She had the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, taste it separately. After a single taste, the children shook their heads and said it didn't taste good.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home

subevent.name: Searching online for information on adjusting the yogurt recipe
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan was not discouraged by the first failed batch of yogurt. That evening, in the living room of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, she used her phone to search online for ways to improve the texture of yogurt, and found that she could adjust the ratio of milk to starter culture powder and add honey and fresh fruit pieces to improve the taste.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Second yogurt-making session, with honey and fruit added
subevent.description: On May 23, following an adjustment method she found online, Ma Xiulan adjusted the ratio of milk to starter culture in the kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin (increasing the amount of milk). After fermentation, she added an appropriate amount of honey and cut fresh fruit pieces (such as strawberries and mangoes), stirred evenly, and put it in the refrigerator to chill. The finished product had a noticeably silky texture and a moderate sweet-and-sour taste.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: The children drank all the improved yogurt
subevent.description: On the morning of May 24, Ma Xiulan took the yogurt she had made for the second time out of the refrigerator. Her three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, each tasted it and loved it so much that they drank it all in no time, saying it tasted better than store-bought. Ma Xiulan was very happy and satisfied.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home

name: Lantern Festival family reunion activity
description: On the evening of February 12, the 15th day of the first lunar month and the Lantern Festival, Ma Xiulan cooked tangyuan in the kitchen. She then joined her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin for a tangyuan dinner in the home dining room. After dinner, the three children played with lanterns in the courtyard while Ma Xiulan captured the warm scene with her camera, and her husband stayed by their side.

subevent.name: Preparing to cook yuanxiao
subevent.description: On the evening of the Lantern Festival, Ma Xiulan took the frozen tangyuan she had bought in advance out of the refrigerator, boiled a pot of water in the kitchen, and prepared to cook the tangyuan.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Family gathering to eat yuanxiao
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin sat around the dining table, eating tangyuan and chatting, enjoying the warm moment of family reunion.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: The children are playing in the yard with lanterns.
subevent.description: After dinner, the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin, ran and played in the yard with small lanterns, chasing each other with laughter. Ma Xiulan and her husband watched them play from the side.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Took heartwarming photos with the camera.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out the family's digital camera and stood in the yard taking photos of the children playing with lanterns, recording the happy and warm scenes of the Lantern Festival night, and also captured some candid moments of family interaction.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

name: Apply spring fertilizer to the persimmon tree; the second son helps water and observe.
description: On the afternoon of April 27, Ma Xiulan took out the composted soybean cake fertilizer and tools from the storage room, dug shallow trenches around the roots of the persimmon tree, and buried the fertilizer. Her second son volunteered to carry water to irrigate, and then the mother and son observed the new tender leaves together. Ma Xiulan taught her second son to identify leaf buds, and the two chatted under the tree for a long time.

subevent.name: Prepare the composted soybean cake fertilizer and tools.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took the pre-composted soybean cake fertilizer out of the storage room at home and fetched the tools needed for applying spring fertilizer, including a shovel, a small trowel, and a bucket, to prepare for fertilizing.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin — home storage room and courtyard

subevent.name: Digging a shallow trench around the roots of the persimmon tree and burying soybean cake fertilizer
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan dug a shallow trench around the roots of the persimmon tree in the courtyard with a spade, evenly scattered the composted soybean cake fertilizer into the trench, then covered it with soil and leveled it, completing the spring fertilizing.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - under the persimmon tree in the home courtyard

subevent.name: The second son helped carry water to water the persimmon tree.
subevent.description: Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, volunteered to fetch a bucket of water and thoroughly watered the persimmon tree that had just been fertilized, so the fertilizer could soak into the soil better.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - under the persimmon tree in the home courtyard

subevent.name: Mother and son observed the persimmon tree and talked about the leaf buds growing.
subevent.description: After watering, the second son carefully observed the newly sprouted tender leaves and said to Ma Xiulan, 'Mom, the trunk seems to have gotten a bit thicker.' Ma Xiulan smiled and taught him to identify the structure of the leaf buds. Mother and son chatted for a long time under the tree about how trees grow.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - under the persimmon tree in the home courtyard

name: Calculate this month's part-time income and cost accounting.
description: On the evening of May 31, Ma Xiulan took out her accounting book and the records of pickle sales, handicraft market, and embroidery orders at home, carefully calculated her May part-time income and costs, and found that the total income was 285 yuan and material costs were about 70 yuan.

subevent.name: Prepare the account book and materials
subevent.description: In the evening at home, Ma Xiulan took out the account book and a pen from the drawer, and prepared the materials she had recorded earlier, including pickled vegetable sales, craft market stall fees, and embroidery order records, to prepare for calculating her part-time income and costs for May.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Calculating part-time income and costs
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully went through the account book and, item by item, calculated the total income for May from the sale of pickled vegetables, the craft market stall, and embroidery orders, arriving at 285 yuan. She then calculated the material costs, including ingredients for the pickled vegetables and craft materials, for a total cost of 70 yuan.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Set up a special savings plan for the Beijing trip.
description: On July 20, seeing her younger daughter win an award for her painting, Ma Xiulan became even more determined to take the whole family to Beijing for a trip. She opened a new page in her ledger and wrote the title 'Beijing Travel Fund' with a target of 2,000 yuan. She planned to deposit 300 yuan from her husband's income and 100 yuan from her own part-time income every month. She deposited the 180 yuan earned from the market as the first deposit and told the children: if everyone behaved well, they would be able to go to Tiananmen to watch the flag-raising ceremony next summer vacation. The children cheered and jumped with joy.

subevent.name: Seeing her youngest daughter win an art award sparked the idea of saving
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan saw the kindergarten painting award certificate her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (6 years old) had brought back and felt deeply inspired. Combined with her long-held wish to take the whole family on a trip to Beijing, she decided to set up a dedicated travel savings plan. Sitting on the living room sofa, she carefully looked through the certificate and began mulling over the family income and expenses and savings goals in her mind.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

subevent.name: Set travel savings rules and record them in the account book
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out the family ledger, turned to a new page, and neatly wrote the heading 'Beijing Travel Fund' with a pen. She then made detailed savings rules: a target amount of 2,000 yuan, with a fixed monthly deposit of 300 yuan from her husband Ma Zhiqiang's salary and 100 yuan from her own part-time odd-job income. She wrote the rules one by one in the ledger and added the motivational line at the bottom: 'Go to Tiananmen to watch the flag-raising ceremony during next summer vacation.'
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home study

subevent.name: Deposit the first savings of 180 yuan
subevent.description: After setting the savings rules, Ma Xiulan took out 180 yuan in cash from her wallet that she had earned earlier from her stall at the handicraft market, as the first deposit for the Beijing travel fund. She neatly put the 180 yuan away and wrote in the Deposit Record column on that page of the ledger: First deposit of 180 yuan (from handicraft market income), dated July 20, 2025.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home study

subevent.name: Announced the travel savings plan to the whole family and encouraged the children
subevent.description: After finishing her ledger, Ma Xiulan called the three children — Ma Mingxuan (13), Ma Mingzhe (10), and Ma Yuxin (6) — into the living room. She solemnly announced a savings plan to set up a Beijing travel fund and told them that if they behaved well at school and listened at home, the family would use the fund next summer to go to Tiananmen Square in Beijing to watch the flag-raising ceremony. Hearing this, the children cheered and jumped for joy, each saying they would behave well. A gratified smile appeared on Ma Xiulan's face.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

name: The youngest daughter drew a picture to express her love.
description: On January 18, 2025, Ma Yuxin, who was not yet six years old, drew a crayon drawing titled 'Mom Cooking' in the living room at home. Ma Xiulan happily stuck it on the kitchen refrigerator door. That afternoon, the neighbor Wang Guilan came over, and Ma Xiulan proudly showed it to her in front of the refrigerator and praised her daughter's drawing.

subevent.name: Xinxin drew a crayon drawing, "Mom Cooking."
subevent.description: The youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) carefully drew a crayon drawing titled Mom Cooking on the coffee table in the living room of their home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, using the crayons and drawing paper she brought back from kindergarten. The lines are childish but the colors are bright, depicting her mother busy in the kitchen and expressing the daughter's love for her mother.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Show neighbor Wang Guilan her daughter's painting and praise it
subevent.description: That afternoon, Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hall, came over to Ma Xiulan's home for a chat. Ma Xiulan warmly led Wang Guilan to the refrigerator in the kitchen, pointed at the crayon drawing "Mom Cooking" drawn by her younger daughter Xinxin, and proudly said that Xinxin, who was not yet six, had drawn it specially for her. She also described the adorable way her daughter had drawn the picture. Wang Guilan praised it again and again, and Ma Xiulan's face beamed with a happy smile.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: After morning exercise with Aunt Zhao, learn acupoint massage.
description: On the morning of July 16, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Zhao went to the community square as planned to practice Baduanjin. Afterward, Aunt Zhao took her to the shade and personally taught her to massage the Zusanli and Hegu acupoints, saying they were helpful for back soreness and headaches. Ma Xiulan carefully remembered the locations and tried them on the spot, feeling warmth in her legs. The two sat on a bench drinking the hawthorn tea they had brought, chatting about their grandchildren and health-preserving tips, and agreed to meet again next Wednesday.

subevent.name: Doing Baduanjin morning exercises with Aunt Zhao
subevent.description: Around 6 in the morning, Ma Xiulan came as promised to the community square in Jinghai District to practice Baduanjin with her neighbor Aunt Zhao. The two first did warm-up exercises, then followed the commands to complete two full rounds of Baduanjin with slow, precise movements. After finishing, both felt their bodies slightly warm and their spirits refreshed.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District Community Square

subevent.name: Aunt Zhao taught Ma Xiulan acupoint massage
subevent.description: After morning exercises, Aunt Zhao took Ma Xiulan to the shade under the trees beside the square and taught her hand by hand to massage the Zusanli and Hegu acupoints. Aunt Zhao explained in detail the exact locations, massage techniques, and pressure requirements for these two acupoints, and said that Zusanli helps relieve lower back soreness and Hegu helps relieve headaches. Ma Xiulan followed along carefully, trying it immediately on her own legs and hands. She felt a warm sensation in her legs and found the method very effective.
subevent.location: Under the tree shade at the community square in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Resting and chatting with Aunt Zhao and agreeing on the next activity
subevent.description: After the massage lesson, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Zhao sat on the bench beside the square and took out the hawthorn tea each had brought to drink together. As they drank, they chatted about fun stories about their grandchildren and their daily health tips, and the atmosphere was relaxed and pleasant. In the end, Aunt Zhao suggested continuing their morning exercise and massage lesson together next Wednesday. Ma Xiulan gladly agreed, and they made an appointment to meet again at the same time and place.
subevent.location: Bench at the community square in Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Save 100 yuan from the grocery money and deposit it into education savings
description: On the afternoon of April 15, Ma Xiulan carefully squeezed 100 yuan out of the week's grocery money, walked to the Postal Savings Bank counter on Jingwen Road, and deposited it into her children's education savings account. The teller, Sister Zhang, smiled and praised her, 'You come every month, so persistent.' She felt warm inside. After returning home, she wrote neatly in her account book, 'April 15, education deposit 100 yuan,' and calculated that at this pace she could save 2,400 yuan in two years. Although it was half of her original plan, the reassuring feeling of holding the line tempered the lingering mood from the quarrel with her husband the previous day.

subevent.name: Prepare 100 yuan in cash at home.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan rummaged through the kitchen drawer at home for loose change, carefully counted the leftover grocery money for the week, counted out 100 yuan in cash, wrapped it in an envelope, and planned to go to the bank to deposit it into the education savings account.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: Walk to the Postal Savings Bank on Jingwen Road.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took 100 yuan in cash and her bankbook, and set off on foot from home toward the Postal Savings Bank on Jingwen Road, a walk of about 10 minutes along familiar streets.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road (walking)

subevent.name: Deposit education savings at the Postal Savings Bank counter.
subevent.description: At the Postal Savings Bank on Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan handed 100 yuan in cash and her passbook to the teller, Sister Zhang, who processed her education savings deposit and praised her with a smile for coming every month without fail. Ma Xiulan felt a warmth in her heart.
subevent.location: Postal Savings Bank counter on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: After returning home, record the deposit in the ledger.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned home, took the account book out of the drawer, and neatly wrote in the April 15 column: "April 15, save 100 yuan for education." She calculated that at this pace she could save 2,400 yuan in two years. Although it was half of the original plan, she felt grounded, which eased the lingering unease from the quarrel with her husband the day before.
subevent.location: Home study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: A late-night long talk with childhood friend Chunmei, regaining confidence in making pickled vegetables
description: On the evening of April 2, feeling low after the pickle return incident, Ma Xiulan sent a WeChat message to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to vent. Chunmei immediately rode her e-bike to Jingwen Road Street Park. The two sat on a park bench, and Chunmei shared her experience of being retrained after her supermarket received a complaint, encouraging her: “Failure is common. Your food tastes good; just adjust and it will be fine.” They chatted late into the night, and Ma Xiulan felt warmed and decided to attend the training the next day.

subevent.name: Chunmei hurried over on her e-bike to comfort her.
subevent.description: After receiving Ma Xiulan's WeChat message, Liu Chunmei immediately put down what she was doing, rode her electric bike from her home to Jingwen Road, and met Ma Xiulan at the Jingwen Road street park, planning to comfort her in person.
subevent.location: Entrance to Jingwen Road Street Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Late-night heart-to-heart talk with Chunmei on a park bench
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei sat on a bench in the Jingwen Road neighborhood park. Chunmei shared her experience of being retrained after receiving a complaint at her supermarket job, and encouraged Ma Xiulan, saying, “Failure is common. Your taste is good, so just make adjustments.” The two chatted until late at night, and Ma Xiulan’s mood gradually improved.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bench at Jingwen Road Street Park.

name: Officially trial-produce pickled vegetables and record the recipe
description: From February 16 to 18, in the kitchen of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan officially trial-produced the first batch of soy-pickled radish using the recipe her mother had passed down, combined with flavors she had improved. On the 16th, she prepared the ingredients and did the initial pickling, carefully recording the amounts of seasonings and the start time. On the 17th, she turned the pickles, observed the changes, and added notes. On the 18th, she invited her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin to taste them. After collecting feedback, she fine-tuned the saltiness and sweetness and wrote out the final recipe.

subevent.name: Preparing ingredients and initial pickling of vegetables
subevent.description: In her kitchen at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan prepared fresh white radish, salt, sugar, soy sauce, spices, and other ingredients according to the recipe her mother taught her, combined with her own improved taste. She washed the radishes and cut them into strips, mixed the seasonings according to the proportions, and carried out the first pickling, carefully recording the amount of each seasoning and the start time of pickling.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Turn over the pickles and observe and record
subevent.description: In her kitchen, Ma Xiulan checked the pickled radishes she had made the day before, turning the container so the seasonings would penetrate evenly, and observed changes in the radishes' color and smell. Based on experience, she added a little saltwater as appropriate and wrote down her observations from the pickling process in her recipe notebook.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Invite family to taste-test and fine-tune the recipe
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out the prepared pickled radish, arranged it on a plate, and invited her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin to taste it at the dining table at home. She gathered everyone's feedback on the taste, especially their opinions on saltiness and sweetness, then fine-tuned the ratio of sugar and soy sauce in the recipe based on their comments, and wrote out the final recipe clearly.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Month-end household financial review
description: On the evening of April 30, after putting the children to sleep, Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table, took out her account book, and item by item checked April household income (her husband's salary of 5,800 yuan, pickled vegetable income of 360 yuan, and odd-job income of 200 yuan) and expenses (mortgage of 2,300 yuan, food expenses of 1,480 yuan, water, electricity, and gas of 205 yuan, children's school fees of 300 yuan, parental support of 200 yuan, education savings of 100 yuan, pickled vegetable costs and return losses of 350 yuan, and other miscellaneous expenses of 215 yuan). She calculated the monthly balance of 1,210 yuan and neatly transcribed it into the financial statement.

subevent.name: Prepare bookkeeping tools
subevent.description: After the children were asleep, Ma Xiulan came alone to the dining table in the living room, took the family ledger and a ballpoint pen from the drawer, and prepared to do a month-end financial review.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining table

subevent.name: Check April income item by item
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan opened her account book and went through the family income for April item by item: her husband’s salary of 5,800 yuan, her own income of 360 yuan from selling pickled vegetables, and 200 yuan earned from embroidering pillowcases for a neighbor. She confirmed each amount was accurate.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining table

subevent.name: Check April expenses item by item.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully checked the itemized household expenses for April: mortgage 2,300 yuan, food 1,480 yuan, water/electricity/gas 205 yuan, children's school fees 300 yuan, parental support 200 yuan, education savings 100 yuan, preserved vegetable costs and return losses 350 yuan, and other miscellaneous items 215 yuan, confirming nothing was missing.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining table

subevent.name: Calculate the monthly balance and record it
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used a calculator to add up total income and expenses, found that the month's balance was 1210 yuan, and copied the number neatly into the monthly summary column of the household financial sheet.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining table

name: Enjoying the cool air with neighbor Wang Guilan and sharing pickled vegetables.
description: On the evening of July 18, Ma Xiulan was cooling off at her door, and Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the street, also brought out a small stool. The two fanned themselves with palm-leaf fans and chatted about children and neighborhood gossip. Ma Xiulan brought out the freshly pickled sweet garlic and pickled cucumbers. Wang Guilan tasted them and praised them repeatedly, then shared the good news that her daughter-in-law was pregnant. The two agreed to make tomato sauce together next time, and each went back inside only after dark.

subevent.name: Prepare pickled vegetables
subevent.description: During the day on July 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan put the previously pickled sweet garlic and soy-sauce cucumbers into small dishes in her home kitchen, preparing to share them with her neighbor Wang Guilan that evening. She specially chose the best-looking pickles and rinsed the dishes to make sure they were clean and tidy.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - home kitchen

subevent.name: Chat with Wang Guilan while enjoying the cool air.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan was cooling off at the entrance of her home (at 156 Jingwen Road). Wang Guilan, a neighbor from across the street, also brought out a small stool and sat down beside her. The two fanned themselves with palm-leaf fans, chatting about their children's studies and neighborhood gossip. Ma Xiulan brought out prepared sweet garlic and pickled cucumber. Wang Guilan tasted them and praised them repeatedly, then shared the happy news that her daughter-in-law was pregnant. The two chatted until dark.
subevent.location: At the entrance of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Agreed to make tomato sauce together.
subevent.description: In the evening of July 18, 2025, near the end of their chat, Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan agreed to make tomato sauce together next time. They decided that Ma Xiulan would prepare the tomatoes and glass jars, and Wang Guilan would provide the recipe and tools, with the specific time to be arranged later. After the agreement, each packed up their stools and went back inside.
subevent.location: At the entrance of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making a family photo album
description: On Sunday, January 12, Ma Xiulan found old photos and colored paper from the drawer and made a family album with her three children in the living room. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was in charge of cutting; her second son, Ma Mingzhe, pasted the photos; and her youngest daughter, Xinxin, drew decorative borders. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also joined in, helping write dates and captions. The family worked all afternoon, and the album recorded bits and pieces of last year's outings and holidays. Ma Xiulan said they would make one every year from now on.

subevent.name: Prepare the materials for making.
subevent.description: Before the afternoon of January 12, Ma Xiulan rummaged through drawers at home for old photos, colored paper, scissors, glue, and other materials needed to make a family album, and laid them out on the living room coffee table, preparing for the whole family to make it together.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: The whole family making a photo album together
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 12, Ma Xiulan and her three children started making a family album in the living room. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was responsible for cutting photos and colored paper; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, was responsible for pasting photos onto the album pages; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, used colored pens to draw decorative borders on the page edges. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, also joined in voluntarily, writing the date and a short note next to each photo. The family divided the work and cooperated, chatting about fun memories from last year's trips and holidays while working, and were busy for the whole afternoon.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Complete the album and display it
subevent.description: In the evening, the family photo album was finished. The whole family looked through the final result together, recalling memories from last year's outings and holidays. Ma Xiulan said she would make one every year from now on, and put the album in a prominent spot in the living room for display. Afterward, she put away the remaining colored paper and tools and tidied up the table.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: New Year's Day family reunion dinner
description: On New Year's Day 2025, Ma Xiulan walked from her own home to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin. She prepared ingredients with her mother Li Xiuying and cooked sweet and sour pork tenderloin and hand-rolled noodles with gravy. At noon, the whole family (father Ma Jianguo, mother Li Xiuying, sons Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin) sat around the table for a reunion dinner. Her father praised the taste of home, and Ma Xiulan felt deeply warmed. After the meal, Ma Xiulan chatted with her mother while cleaning up, and her mother told her not to work too hard. In the afternoon, the three children played in the yard, and Ma Xiulan watched them play, her heart full of the happiness of reunion.

subevent.name: Went to her parents' home and prepared the ingredients.
subevent.description: On the morning of New Year's Day, Ma Xiulan brought the previously purchased pork tenderloin for sweet and sour pork, ingredients for handmade noodles, and other items, and walked from her own home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) to her parents' home (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin). After arriving, she chatted briefly with her mother Li Xiuying and began preparations such as washing vegetables, thawing the meat, and kneading dough, in preparation for making sweet and sour pork and handmade noodles with gravy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - parents' home kitchen

subevent.name: Cooking a family reunion dinner
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen at her parents’ home, cooking two signature dishes in succession: sweet and sour pork tenderloin and hand-rolled noodles with gravy. The sweet and sour pork went through marinating, frying, preparing the sauce, and stir-frying, while the hand-rolled noodles were made entirely by hand, from kneading, rolling, and cutting the dough to making the gravy. Her mother, Li Xiuying, helped by handing over seasonings and watching the heat. The whole process took about two hours, and the kitchen was filled with the rich aroma of home-style cooking.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - parents' home kitchen

subevent.name: The whole family shares a reunion dinner
subevent.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan brought the cooked sweet and sour pork tenderloin and hand-rolled noodles with sauce to the table. Her father Ma Jianguo, mother Li Xiuying, Ma Xiulan's three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin), and Ma Xiulan herself sat around eating together. During the meal, her father Ma Jianguo tasted the food and was very happy, praising, 'the taste of home is truly different.' Ma Xiulan felt warm at heart hearing this. Everyone ate and chatted, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Parents' home dining room, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After-dinner cleanup and mother-daughter talk
subevent.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to clear the dishes, wash the utensils, and wipe the table. Her mother, Li Xiuying, helped alongside her, and the two chatted while they worked. Ma Xiulan told her mother about her plans for the new year, such as taking on more small handicraft jobs to supplement the family income. Her mother, Li Xiuying, advised her not to overwork herself and to take care of her health. The mother and daughter talked for about half an hour, growing even closer.
subevent.location: Kitchen and living room of parents' home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Children playing in the courtyard and family happiness
subevent.description: In the afternoon, the three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) ran and jumped around the yard of their parents' home. Ma Mingzhe played hide-and-seek with his younger sister Ma Yuxin, while Ma Mingxuan sat quietly nearby reading a comic. Ma Xiulan moved a chair over and sat under the eaves, watching the children play, feeling happy and fulfilled, and sensing the warmth of family reunion. She took out her phone and snapped a few photos to record this warm moment.
subevent.location: Courtyard of the parents' home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Back-to-school preparations
description: From February 14 to 16, as school was about to start, Ma Xiulan checked the three children's winter vacation homework one by one, took them to the stationery store to buy supplies for the new semester, organized their schoolbags and uniforms, and communicated with her eldest son's homeroom teacher, Han Mei, on WeChat about matters to note for the new semester.

subevent.name: Check the three children's winter vacation homework
subevent.description: On the morning of February 14, in the living room and study of her home in Jinghai District, Ma Xiulan checked the winter vacation homework of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan (13 years old), second son Ma Mingzhe (10 years old), and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (6 years old) in turn. She flipped through the exercise books, checked against the homework list, marked errors and omissions, guided the children to correct and supplement them, and encouraged the children to prepare for the new semester.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

subevent.name: Buy school supplies for the new semester.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of February 15, Ma Xiulan took her three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, to Shufen Convenience Store on Jingwen Road and a nearby stationery store to pick out school supplies for the new semester. They bought backpacks, pens, erasers, rulers, notebooks, colored markers, and more. Ma Xiulan budgeted carefully according to the children's grade needs, making sure everything was complete and reasonably priced.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, Jingwen Road Stationery Store

subevent.name: Tidy up schoolbag and school uniform
subevent.description: On the morning of February 16, Ma Xiulan led her three children at home in organizing their schoolbags and uniforms. She checked the schoolbags for damage, washed and ironed the uniforms, folded and stored them neatly, and guided the children in arranging their books and stationery according to the class schedule, ensuring everything was complete for the first day of the new semester.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home bedroom

subevent.name: Communicate with the homeroom teacher via WeChat about reminders for the start of school
subevent.description: On the evening of February 16, Ma Xiulan contacted Han Mei, the head teacher of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, via WeChat at home to ask about the registration time, schedule changes, items to prepare, and class management requirements for the new semester. Han Mei patiently answered her questions and reminded her about the parents' meeting at the beginning of the semester. Ma Xiulan said she would cooperate with the school to ensure her child made a smooth transition into the new semester.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

name: Take the children to the library
