description: On Sunday, January 19, Ma Xiulan took the three children to the Jinghai District Library to apply for library cards for them and encouraged them to read more during the winter vacation. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, chose popular science books; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, picked comics; and the youngest daughter, Xinxin, looked through picture books in the children's area. Watching the children's quiet figures, she felt very reassured.

subevent.name: Getting ready to head to the library.
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, January 19, Ma Xiulan prepared at home the items her three children needed for their trip to the Jinghai District Library, including the children's ID documents (such as household registration books for library cards), water bottles, and snacks. She told the children to dress neatly and checked that the doors and windows were closed.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Walk to Jinghai District Library.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the three children from home at No. 156 Jingwen Road and walked to Jinghai District Library. The walk took about 15 minutes. Along the way, the children excitedly discussed which books they wanted to read at the library, and Ma Xiulan reminded them to stay safe and keep quiet.
subevent.location: The section from Jingwen Road to Jinghai District Library in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Apply for library cards at the library and help the children choose books
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took her three children to Jinghai District Library. First, she went to the service desk to apply for a library card for each child, providing the required documents and filling out application forms. Then she guided her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to the popular science section to choose books he was interested in, her second son Ma Mingzhe to the comics section to pick comic books, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to browse picture books in the children's picture book area. Ma Xiulan helped nearby and encouraged them to read more.
subevent.location: Jinghai District Library, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Read quietly in the library
subevent.description: After getting the library cards and choosing books, Ma Xiulan and the children sat down in the library's reading area and each read quietly. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, focused on popular science books; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, snickered from time to time while reading comics; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, carefully flipped through picture books. Ma Xiulan also picked up a lifestyle magazine to browse. Watching the children's quiet backs, she felt very grounded and satisfied.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jinghai District Library Reading Area

name: Discovered that the second son was nearsighted and took him to have his vision tested and glasses fitted
description: On the morning of June 30, Ma Xiulan noticed that her second son, Ma Mingzhe, kept his head very low while writing. She took him to the hospital for an eye exam with pupil dilation, and he was diagnosed with myopia of 150 degrees in both eyes. She blamed herself for not noticing earlier; the doctor reassured her that this was common school-age myopia. That afternoon, she took her son to an optical shop in town, picked out a pair of lightweight plastic-frame glasses, and after bargaining paid 350 yuan. When her son put them on, he exclaimed, "So the teacher's handwriting is this clear!" She smiled wryly and said, "Now you'll depend on me even more."

subevent.name: Discovered that her second son's writing posture was unusual.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 30, 2025, while Ma Xiulan was organizing clothes in the study of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, she noticed that her second son Ma Mingzhe (10 years old) was writing at his desk, his head bowed very low, almost touching his homework notebook. She immediately went over to remind him to sit up straight and carefully observed his eye habits, feeling worried and suspecting the child might be nearsighted.
subevent.location: Home study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Take her second son to the hospital's ophthalmology department.
subevent.description: After noticing the abnormality in the morning, Ma Xiulan immediately decided to take Ma Mingzhe to the ophthalmology department of Jinghai District People's Hospital for an eye examination. She quickly packed her personal belongings and walked with Ma Mingzhe to the hospital. The two arrived at the hospital around 10 a.m. After reaching the ophthalmology clinic, Ma Xiulan explained the purpose of her visit to the nurse and registered and queued up.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Ophthalmology Department, Jinghai District People's Hospital

subevent.name: Mydriatic refraction examination
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe into the consultation room. After asking about the situation, the doctor arranged for cycloplegic refraction. Ma Mingzhe cooperated with the dilating eye drops, waited about 30 minutes, and then underwent computerized refraction and manual retinoscopy. The examination lasted about 40 minutes, and he was ultimately diagnosed with myopia of 150 degrees in both eyes. The doctor reassured Ma Xiulan, telling her that this is common myopia in school-age children and that she needn't blame herself too much, and advised wearing glasses and regular checkups.
subevent.location: Ophthalmology clinic, Jinghai District People's Hospital, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Went to the optical shop to choose glasses.
subevent.description: At about 2 p.m., Ma Xiulan left the hospital with Ma Mingzhe and walked to Mingshi Glasses Shop on Shengli Street, Jinghai District. She told the clerk about her son's myopia prescription and had Ma Mingzhe try on several lightweight plastic-frame glasses. Ma Mingzhe chose a pair of blue half-frame glasses. Ma Xiulan bargained with the clerk, finally settling at 350 yuan. After putting on his new glasses, Ma Mingzhe said in surprise, 'So the characters the teacher writes are this clear!' Ma Xiulan gave a wry smile and replied, 'Now he'll rely on me even more.'
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Shengli Street Mingshi Optical Shop

subevent.name: Return home to organize and inform the family
subevent.description: In the afternoon after finishing the eyeglass fitting, Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingzhe home. She put the new glasses away properly and told Ma Mingzhe to wear them and maintain proper posture when doing homework in the future. In the evening, when her husband Ma Zhiqiang and eldest son Ma Mingxuan came home, Ma Xiulan explained the situation to them and blamed herself for not discovering it earlier. Her husband comforted her and reminded her to let the children spend less time on their phones in the future. The family had a brief discussion on how to protect their eyesight.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road, home living room.

name: Ma Xiulan bought accident insurance for her husband and delivered the policy
description: On June 5, Ma Xiulan, worried about the high risk of her husband's job as a truck driver, decided to use her earlier savings from embroidery to buy accident insurance for her husband. After making the decision at home in the morning, she went to the insurance company without telling her husband. In the afternoon, at an insurance company business hall in Jinghai District, she took out an accident insurance policy with an annual premium of 150 yuan and a coverage amount of 100,000 yuan, paid the premium, and received the policy. When she got home in the evening, she handed the policy to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who no longer objected and silently accepted it. Ma Xiulan felt that this added financial protection to the family and felt much more at ease.

subevent.name: Decided to buy accident insurance for her husband.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 5, at home, Ma Xiulan thought about the high risk of her husband being a truck driver and worried that one accident could wipe out the family's savings. She decided to use the savings she had accumulated from embroidery to buy accident insurance for her husband, and went to the insurance company alone without telling him.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Went to the insurance company to handle accident insurance.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 5, Ma Xiulan went to the business hall of an insurance company in Jinghai District. After consulting, she bought an accident insurance policy for her husband Ma Zhiqiang with an annual premium of 150 yuan and a sum insured of 100,000 yuan. She paid the premium with her embroidery savings and received the policy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Insurance company business hall

subevent.name: Handing the insurance policy to her husband
subevent.description: On the evening of June 5, Ma Xiulan returned home and handed the accident insurance policy to her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Ma Zhiqiang no longer objected and silently accepted the policy. Ma Xiulan felt she had put a lock on the family finances and felt much more at ease.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Repair the kitchen faucet.
description: On January 8, Ma Xiulan found that the kitchen faucet was dripping continuously. She had planned to ask Master Liu to fix it, but her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to disassemble the faucet and check it after coming home in the evening. He tightened the valve core with a wrench and also cleaned the filter screen. After the repair, the dripping sound disappeared. Ma Xiulan smiled and praised him for being handy, saving 50 yuan in repair costs. The family talked about it over dinner, and the children all said Dad was amazing.

subevent.name: Discovered the faucet was dripping and planned to contact maintenance.
subevent.description: While cooking in the kitchen, Ma Xiulan noticed the faucet was dripping steadily. She tried to tighten it with a rag for grip, but it kept dripping, so she planned to contact Liu Jianguo, a familiar handyman in the community, to come and fix the leak.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Husband Takes the Initiative to Fix the Faucet
subevent.description: When Ma Zhiqiang came home from work in the evening and learned that the faucet was dripping, he decided to fix it himself. He took a wrench and other tools from the household toolbox, disassembled the faucet valve core, tightened the internal screw with the wrench, and carefully cleaned the limescale from the filter screen, successfully fixing the dripping problem. Ma Xiulan helped hand him tools on the side while watching him work skillfully.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: At dinner, the whole family praised her husband for being so handy
subevent.description: During dinner, the family sat around the table. Ma Xiulan smiled and told the children that Dad was really handy and had saved 50 yuan in repair costs. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan, the second son Ma Mingzhe, and the daughter Ma Yuxin all praised Dad for being amazing. Ma Zhiqiang also showed a proud smile. The family happily chatted about this small event in life while eating.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home dining room

name: Husband returns from a long trip; evening talk around the stove.
description: On February 15, her husband Ma Zhiqiang finished a long-distance transport run and brought back Hebei smoked sausage. That evening the family sat around the stove, the husband told amusing stories from the road, the children giggled, the table gained flavors from another place, and family affection flowed in the warm light.

subevent.name: Fireside evening chat and sharing flavors from afar.
subevent.description: That evening, Ma Xiulan sliced and heated the Hebei smoked sausage her husband had brought back, and prepared a home-style meal. The whole family sat around the dining table, warming themselves by the stove. Ma Zhiqiang told interesting stories and anecdotes from his transport journey, and the children listened with great interest, laughing from time to time. The table featured flavors from another region, and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Sharing handmade creations with her childhood friend
description: On the afternoon of January 24, after finishing the big cleaning, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei over for tea. Before Liu Chunmei arrived, Ma Xiulan prepared tea, melon seeds, and other tea snacks in the living room, and placed the just-finished embroidered handkerchief and several newly learned pattern samples on the tea table. When Liu Chunmei arrived, the two chatted over tea. Ma Xiulan showed the handkerchief, and Liu Chunmei was full of praise, complimenting the fine stitches and exquisite patterns. The two then studied the newly learned patterns together. Liu Chunmei suggested that Ma Xiulan could take on more handmade orders. Ma Xiulan smiled and nodded, saying she would look for more opportunities after the New Year.

subevent.name: Prepare tea snacks and handcraft display
subevent.description: Before Liu Chunmei arrived in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan prepared tea, melon seeds, and other refreshments in the living room, and placed the hand-embroidered handkerchiefs she had just finished and several newly learned pattern samples on the coffee table for display and exchange.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Sharing handmade crafts and exchanging thoughts
subevent.description: Liu Chunmei came to Ma Xiulan's home, and the two chatted over tea in the living room. Ma Xiulan took out an embroidered handkerchief to show her. Liu Chunmei looked at it closely and was full of praise, complimenting the delicate stitches and the beautiful pattern. The two then studied the newly learned pattern together. Liu Chunmei suggested that Ma Xiulan take on more handmade orders, and Ma Xiulan nodded with a smile, saying she would look for more opportunities after the New Year.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Learn WeChat marketing skills and build a pickle customer group.
description: On April 14, after her first stall, Ma Xiulan realized the importance of online promotion. She asked her neighbor Zhang Shufen for tips on creating WeChat groups and posting on Moments, used her phone to record short videos showing how the pickled vegetables were made, and tried sharing them in the community mothers' group. That evening, she set up a customer group called [Xiulan Handmade Pickles], inviting early customers such as Chunmei and Wang Guilan to join. She posted new product previews and healthy eating tips in the group. She also carefully recorded each customer's taste preferences, preparing to offer customized services later.

subevent.name: Ask neighbor Zhang Shufen for advice on WeChat marketing
subevent.description: On the morning of April 14, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to go to the Shufen Convenience Store run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen, who lived diagonally across the way, to ask Zhang Shufen for tips on how to create WeChat groups, post on Moments, and record short videos. Zhang Shufen warmly took out her phone and demonstrated step by step how to create a group chat, set a group announcement, and share photos and videos on Moments, and suggested that Ma Xiulan first share tasting information in the community mothers' group.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Shufen Convenience Supermarket

subevent.name: Record a short video of making pickles
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 14, Ma Xiulan returned to her home kitchen and used her smartphone to record a short video of about 2 minutes, showing the finished pickled vegetables she had just made and briefly introducing the ingredients used (such as cucumber, chili peppers, and garlic) and the key steps in the process (selecting, washing, cutting, and pickling). She narrated as she worked, and the video looked natural and authentic.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Shared information about the pickled vegetables in the community moms' group.
subevent.description: After recording, Ma Xiulan followed the method Zhang Shufen had taught her and posted the short video to her WeChat Moments, with the caption ‘Homemade pickled vegetables, clean and hygienic, neighbors welcome to taste.’ She then forwarded the video to several community mom groups she usually joined (such as the ‘Jingwen Road Parent-Child Exchange Group’), and left a message inviting interested neighbors to place orders by private message or come for a taste. Within a short time she received likes and inquiries from several group members.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Create a customer group for Xiulan's handmade pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: On the evening of April 14, based on feedback from during the day, Ma Xiulan created a customer group on WeChat called "Xiulan Handmade Pickles." Through private chats, she invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, her neighbor across the hall Wang Guilan, and several mothers who had shown interest in the community mothers' group during the day to join the group chat. After they joined, she posted an announcement telling the group members that she would regularly share new product previews, promotions, and healthy eating tips, and asked them to offer suggestions for improvement.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Record customers' taste preferences and prepare for customized services.
subevent.description: On the evening the group was created, Ma Xiulan took out a notebook and, based on her impressions from the day's stall selling and the group discussions, carefully recorded the taste preferences of Liu Chunmei (prefers mild spice), Wang Guilan (prefers salty and savory), and several other first-batch customers. She planned to adjust the spiciness and saltiness of the pickled vegetables in later batches, providing customized small portions for each regular customer to increase customer loyalty.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Collaborate with Chunmei Supermarket to launch a pickled vegetables promotion
description: On June 22, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to find Liu Chunmei (a childhood friend), a stockist at Chunmei Supermarket, and proposed setting up a pickled vegetable tasting station on the weekend and launching a buy-two-get-one-free promotion. Liu Chunmei approved the idea, agreed to try it out the next Saturday (June 28), and initially discussed the promotional details. That afternoon, Ma Xiulan pickled an extra ten jin of pickled cucumbers at home and prepared about 200 small packaged samples. On June 28, Ma Xiulan brought the samples to the supermarket and, with Liu Chunmei's help, set up a tasting station in the dried goods area and put up posters. During the promotion, customers responded enthusiastically; within half a day, pickled vegetable sales quadrupled compared with usual. Liu Chunmei expressed willingness to cooperate on promotions long-term.

subevent.name: Discuss the promotion plan with Liu Chunmei
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan proactively went to Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District and found her childhood friend Liu Chunmei (a supermarket stocker). She proposed setting up a pickled vegetable tasting station on the weekend and launching a buy-two-get-one-free promotion. The two discussed for about half an hour in the supermarket rest area. Liu Chunmei approved the idea and agreed to try it out next Saturday (June 28), and they initially discussed promotional details such as the tasting station location, pricing, and promotional methods.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hualian Supermarket

subevent.name: Pickling promotional pickled vegetables and preparing tasting samples
subevent.description: That afternoon, Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, and pickled an extra ten jin of soy sauce cucumbers according to the family recipe. At the same time, she divided them into about 200 small sample packs using small food bags, each about 30 grams, and attached simple labels indicating the product name and promotional date. The entire preparation took about 3 hours. After finishing, she put the samples in the refrigerator for cold storage, ready to take to the supermarket on June 28.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Carrying out a pickled vegetables promotional activity at Chunmei Supermarket
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on June 28, Ma Xiulan arrived at Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District with the prepared cucumber pickle samples and promotional materials (such as small table cards). Liu Chunmei helped set up a tasting table in the dried goods section and put up a Buy Two, Get One Free poster. The promotion officially started at 9:30. Ma Xiulan was responsible for cutting the pickled cucumbers on site, inviting customers to taste, and explaining the making method. Customers responded enthusiastically, and within half a day sales of pickled vegetables quadrupled compared with usual. After the event, Liu Chunmei expressed her willingness to establish a long-term promotional cooperation with Ma Xiulan, and they agreed to discuss further cooperation details later.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hualian Supermarket

name: Reward the eldest son and encourage the second son.
description: On January 15, the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, received his final exam results from the previous semester, ranking 12th in the class. To encourage him, Ma Xiulan specially bought a set of new stationery as a reward. During dinner, she said in front of the whole family that progress is victory. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, pouted enviously. Ma Xiulan noticed this and, after the meal, said to him alone, "You are also great, and I am equally proud of you. As long as you work hard, you can improve next time too." She deliberately told him a story before bedtime to care for his feelings. This reward not only encouraged the eldest son but also maintained the bond between the brothers.

subevent.name: Buying stationery as a reward.
subevent.description: During the daytime on January 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to a stationery store near Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and carefully selected a set of new stationery for her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, including pens, notebooks, and a pencil case, as a reward for his improvement in final exam scores. She carefully compared prices and styles, and finally bought a cost-effective set of stationery, spending about 30 yuan.
subevent.location: Stationery store, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Rewarding the eldest son during dinner.
subevent.description: That evening, Ma Xiulan's family of five—husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin—had dinner together in the dining room of their home at 156 Jingwen Road. During the meal, Ma Xiulan handed the new pencil case she had bought during the day to her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, and praised him in front of the whole family: "You ranked 12th in your class on this final exam, which is an improvement over last semester. Improvement is victory." The eldest son happily took the gift. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, pouted on the side with envy, and the youngest daughter also joined in the excitement. The whole family enjoyed dinner together in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: After the meal, she privately encouraged her second son.
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan noticed that her second son, Ma Mingzhe, was feeling down because he envied his elder brother's reward, so she specially called him over to the sofa in the living room and said to him alone, "ZheZhe, you are also great, and I am equally proud of you. As long as you work as hard as your brother, you can improve next time too." She gently touched his head, bringing him closer to her. The second son's mood improved after hearing this, and he nodded.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Before bed, told her second son a story to soothe his mood.
subevent.description: Before going to bed that night, Ma Xiulan deliberately went to the bedroom of her second son, Ma Mingzhe. Sitting on the edge of his bed, she picked out one of his favorite fairy tale books and told him a story about a little animal working hard to improve. She took the opportunity to encourage her second son again, telling him that she loved him just as much and affirming his strengths. After hearing the story, her son was in a good mood and fell asleep peacefully. Through this action, Ma Xiulan protected her second son's self-esteem and also strengthened the bond between the brothers.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - second son's bedroom at home

name: Contacted the community supermarket to sell pickled vegetables on consignment.
description: On May 21, 2025, Ma Xiulan successfully made a sample bottle of kimchi in her home kitchen. The next day (May 22), she took the sample to the Shufen Convenience Store run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen to discuss consignment. After tasting it, Zhang Shufen approved it. The two agreed on a selling price of 28 yuan per bottle, a 15% commission, monthly settlement, and signed a written agreement. Ma Xiulan then went home, packed five bottles of stock, and delivered them to the store for display.

subevent.name: Prepare spicy cabbage samples
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, in her home kitchen, following her own developed recipe, used Chinese cabbage, chili flakes, garlic, ginger and other ingredients to make a bottle of new-flavor kimchi sample for consignment discussions. She carefully controlled the pickling time and seasoning to ensure the sample tasted satisfactory.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket for consignment negotiation
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took a jar of spicy pickled cabbage as a sample and walked to Shufen Convenience Store (154 Jingwen Road), run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen. She explained the purpose of her visit, introduced the flavor and production process of the pickled vegetables, and asked Zhang Shufen to taste the sample. After tasting it, Zhang Shufen expressed approval, and the two began discussing consignment details.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Shufen Convenience Supermarket

subevent.name: Discuss and sign the consignment agreement
subevent.description: In the supermarket, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen reached an agreement on consignment details: the selling price is 28 yuan per bottle, the commission is 15% of the selling price, and settlement is monthly. The two then signed a simple written consignment agreement, clarifying the consignment period, settlement method, and responsibilities of both parties. The agreement was made in duplicate, with each party keeping one copy.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Shufen Convenience Supermarket

subevent.name: Go home to sort out inventory and deliver goods.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned home from the supermarket, immediately counted her existing spicy cabbage stock, selected five bottles with intact packaging and relatively recent production dates, and packed them in a clean cloth bag. She then went to Shufen Convenience Supermarket again, handed the five bottles of pickled vegetables to Zhang Shufen, and Zhang Shufen put them on the shelf to begin selling on consignment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Ma Xiulan's home and Shufen Convenience Store

name: Attend the handicraft market at the folk culture festival.
description: On Saturday, July 19, Ma Xiulan took her pickled vegetables and embroidery works to the handicraft market at the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival. She arranged her stall cozily, displaying pickled cucumbers, sweet garlic, and several embroidered fan panels. Many residents stopped to sample the goods, and she enthusiastically introduced the low-salt recipe. By the end of the day, she had sold 16 jars of pickled vegetables and received 3 intention orders for custom embroidered round fans. Zhou Xiuqin also came to help, and the two agreed to attend future markets together. When packing up, she carefully counted the income; after deducting the stall fee, she had made a net profit of 180 yuan, bringing her one step closer to her goal of traveling to Beijing.

subevent.name: Prepare items for the market fair
subevent.description: On the morning of July 19, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen and living room at home. She put the pre-pickled soy cucumbers and sweet garlic into clean glass jars separately and attached homemade labels. At the same time, she carefully wrapped the recently completed embroidered fan faces, counted them, and packed them into a cloth bag, preparing all the items for the handicraft market at the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Going to the market and setting up the stall
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carried her pickled vegetables and embroidery pieces and walked or rode her electric bike to the market site of the Jinghai District Folk Culture Festival. After arriving, she spread a handmade tablecloth on her designated stall, neatly arranged the jars of pickled vegetables and embroidered fan faces, and set up homemade price signs and introduction cards, creating a warm handicraft atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Folk Culture Festival Market Venue

subevent.name: Market selling and promotional exchange
subevent.description: After the market opened, Ma Xiulan stood in front of her stall and warmly welcomed the shoppers. She proactively introduced the low-salt formula and fully handmade process of the pickled vegetables and invited people to taste them. At the same time, she displayed embroidered fan-face designs and answered customers’ questions. By the end of the day, she had sold 16 jars of pickled vegetables and received 3 potential orders for custom embroidered round fans.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Folk Culture Festival Market Venue

subevent.name: Helped each other with Zhou Xiuqin and agreed on future cooperation.
subevent.description: Craft friend Zhou Xiuqin came to the market to help. The two received customers and tidied the stall together, using breaks to exchange handicraft insights. Before packing up, they agreed to attend similar market events together in the future and jointly promote handmade craft products.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Folk Culture Festival Market Venue

subevent.name: Packing up the stall, settling accounts, and reviewing income
subevent.description: After the market ended, Ma Xiulan and Zhou Xiuqin cleaned up the stall together and packed up the remaining items. Ma Xiulan carefully counted the day's income and, after deducting the stall fee, made a net profit of 180 yuan. She put the cash away safely, feeling happy that her goal of traveling to Beijing was about to come true.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Folk Culture Festival Market Venue

name: The second batch of pickled vegetables was returned because it was too salty. We adjusted the recipe overnight and apologized, winning another chance.
description: On April 1, the community supermarket notified her that the second batch of "Xiulan's Homemade Pickled Vegetables" had been complained about by customers for being too salty, "so salty that it tastes bitter," and demanded a return and suspension of cooperation. Ma Xiulan lost 200 yuan in ingredients and labor. Chunmei blamed her for being careless over the phone, and she lay awake all night. On April 2, she took out The Complete Guide to Home Pickling and, against her notes, precisely remeasured the salt ratio, finding out where the problem lay. On April 3, she made a small trial batch with the new formula and tasted it repeatedly to make sure the saltiness was just right. On April 4, she took the new samples to the supermarket to apologize to Chunmei. After tasting them, Chunmei sighed and said, "Let's give it one more try." The two of them agreed to a small-batch trial sale.

subevent.name: Received a return notification and handled the loss.
subevent.description: On April 1, 2025, the community supermarket notified Ma Xiulan that the second batch of “Xiulan's Handmade Pickled Vegetables” had been complained about by customers for being “salty to the point of bitterness” due to excessive salt, and demanded a return and suspension of cooperation. After calculating, Ma Xiulan found that she had a net loss of 200 yuan in ingredients and labor. Liu Chunmei, her childhood friend and a supermarket employee, blamed her for negligence over the phone. Tormented by guilt and financial loss, Ma Xiulan tossed and turned all night in her bedroom at her home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Consult materials to analyze the salt problem.
subevent.description: On April 2, 2025, in the living room of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan took out "The Complete Guide to Home Pickling" and compared it with her own production notes. She carefully recalled the process of the second batch and discovered that the salt ratio had been miscalculated because of carelessness. She re-measured the proportions of salt and other seasonings precisely, wrote down the new formula in detail on paper, and thoroughly identified the core problem that caused the pickled vegetables to be too salty.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Making a small trial batch of pickled vegetables with the new recipe
subevent.description: On April 3, 2025, Ma Xiulan made a trial batch of pickled vegetables in her own kitchen using a small amount of fresh vegetables and the newly adjusted salt ratio. She carefully weighed each seasoning and controlled the pickling time. After finishing, she tasted them repeatedly to confirm the saltiness was just right and the flavors were balanced. She also asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to taste and evaluate them, making sure the taste would be widely accepted.
subevent.location: Home kitchen on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Take samples to the supermarket to apologize and regain the cooperation opportunity
subevent.description: On April 4, 2025, Ma Xiulan brought newly made pickled vegetable samples to the community supermarket and sincerely apologized to Liu Chunmei, explaining in detail how she had adjusted the recipe. After tasting the new samples, Liu Chunmei felt the saltiness was just right and the flavor was good. She sighed and said, "Let's try once more." The two agreed to resume cooperation through small-batch trial sales, and Ma Xiulan promised to strictly control quality.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community Supermarket

name: New Year's Eve reunion and sister's heartfelt gesture
description: On January 28, Chinese New Year's Eve, Ma Xiulan, Li Xiuyun, and Ma Xiufen, three sisters, gathered with their families at their parents' home for a reunion. Li Xiuyun brought back Peking roast duck, Ma Xiufen brought new fabric, and the three of them made dumplings and watched the Spring Festival Gala together, laughing until tears came. On January 29, Li Xiuyun quietly slipped Ma Xiulan 500 yuan, telling her to buy the children some new clothes and not to let our dad know. Ma Xiulan carefully recorded this in the "sisters' kindness" column of her ledger.

subevent.name: New Year's Eve reunion dinner for the three sisters.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan reunited with her elder sister Li Xiuyun, who brought roast duck from Beijing, and her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who brought new fabric, at their parents' home in Jinghai District. The three of them made dumplings together and spent time with their parents and children. In the evening, they watched the Spring Festival Gala together. The atmosphere was warm and joyful, and Ma Xiulan laughed until she cried.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Parents' home living room

subevent.name: Older sister secretly gave money to buy new clothes
subevent.description: On January 29, her elder sister Li Xiuyun secretly slipped Ma Xiulan 500 yuan in cash, telling her that the money was to buy new clothes for the children and not to tell their father Ma Jianguo. After accepting it, Ma Xiulan carefully recorded the money under the "Sister's Kindness" column in her family ledger, her heart full of gratitude.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - parents' home bedroom

name: Going to her parents' home for a weekend meal
description: On the weekend of June 7, Ma Xiulan took her three children to her parents' home on Shengli Street in Jinghai District. Her mother Li Xiuying had already prepared flour and pork filling. The whole family sat together making dumplings. At lunch, her father kept saying, “A family together is a blessing.” Ma Xiulan took a family photo with her phone. When they left in the evening, her mother handed her a bag of homemade pickled vegetables and a bunch of scallions.

subevent.name: Getting ready to leave for her parents' home
subevent.description: On the weekend morning of June 7, at her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan prepared the going-out items for her three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, told them to mind their manners and safety, and then they set off together to her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, for a meal.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Arrived at her parents' home to make dumplings together
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan arrived with her three children at her parents' home at No. 45 Shengli Street. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already prepared flour and pork filling in advance. Ma Xiulan and her mother kneaded the dough, rolled out wrappers, and made dumplings together in the kitchen. After washing their hands, the children also joined in shaping the dough. Her father, Ma Jianguo, sat by the side drinking tea and watching. The whole family was harmonious and happy.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - No. 45 Shengli Street - kitchen at parents' home

subevent.name: Lunch, chatting, and taking a family portrait
subevent.description: At noon the family sat around the dining table, enjoying freshly boiled hot dumplings and several home-style dishes. At the table, her father Ma Jianguo kept saying that a family together is a blessing. Ma Xiulan was deeply moved, took out her phone and took a family photo of everyone, including herself, her parents, and her three children, recording the warm moment.
subevent.location: Parents' home dining room, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Evening farewell and receiving gifts.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan and the children were getting ready to leave. Her mother, Li Xiuying, took out from the kitchen a bag of homemade pickled vegetables and a bunch of fresh scallions, pressed them into Ma Xiulan's hands, and urged her to take good care of herself and the children. Ma Xiulan accepted the gifts, said goodbye to her parents with the children, and then took the children back home on Jingwen Road.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - No. 45 Shengli Street - outside the parents' home

name: The second son's math improved; on the way to buy groceries, Ma Xiulan accompanied her son and had a heart-to-heart talk; the whole family had a warm celebration.
description: On the evening of April 23, homeroom teacher Yang Jianguo called to say that the second son had improved by 15 points on his midterm math exam, and his tone was full of relief and pride. Ma Xiulan hung up the phone and immediately took her second son to the vegetable market. Along the way, she put her arm around his shoulder and talked with him for a while, praising him: “You've grown up, and you're learning to work hard on your own.” The second son, unusually, didn't dodge and whispered, “I wanted to make you happy.” Ma Xiulan bought pork belly and potatoes, and at home made a dish of red-braised pork and a plate of tomatoes with sugar. At the dinner table, her husband Ma Zhiqiang made an exception and put two pieces of meat in the second son's bowl; the little daughter joined in the teasing, and laughter filled the small room.

subevent.name: Received a call from homeroom teacher Yang Jianguo.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan received a call at home from Yang Jianguo, the head teacher of her second son Ma Mingzhe. In a gratified tone, he told her that Mingzhe's math score in the midterm exam had improved by 15 points.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Accompany the second son and have a heart-to-heart talk on the way to the vegetable market.
subevent.description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan immediately took her second son Ma Mingzhe by the hand and headed to the nearby vegetable market. Along the way, she put her arm around his shoulder and praised him, saying he had 'grown up and learned to work hard on his own.' For once, her son did not shy away and whispered in reply, 'I want to make you happy.' The atmosphere between mother and son was warm.
subevent.location: Along the route from Jingwen Road to Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Buy ingredients for dinner at the vegetable market.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her second son arrived at Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. At the stall of the familiar vendor Sun Guifang, she specially bought pork belly and potatoes to make the braised pork that her children loved, and additionally bought tomatoes for making tomato slices with sugar.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: A warm family dinner to celebrate.
subevent.description: During dinner, the whole family sat around the table. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang made an exception and put two pieces of braised pork belly into his second son Ma Mingzhe's bowl. His little daughter Ma Yuxin also joined in the fun, and laughter filled the small house. Watching her happy family, Ma Xiulan felt very gratified.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

name: Attend the agricultural products trade fair and follow up on subsequent business
description: On April 25, reminded by her neighbor Zheng Xiuying, Ma Xiulan registered for the Jinghai District Spring Agricultural Products Fair and prepared 15 jars each of low-salt pickled vegetables and pickled wild vegetables, as well as embroidered tablecloths. On April 26, she sold pickled vegetables at the fair, selling 28 jars in all for 560 yuan. She also received expressions of interest from three community supermarkets in stocking her products, and a suggestion from a District Agriculture Committee staff member about applying for the “Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products” label. On April 27, she called the purchasing representatives of the three supermarkets to arrange meetings and consulted the Agriculture Committee about the application requirements and procedures to prepare for the next step of cooperation.

subevent.name: Register and prepare items for the exhibition.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, reminded by her neighbor and part-time job referral contact Zheng Xiuying, completed the registration for the Jinghai District Spring Agricultural Products Fair on April 25 by phone or online. Then, in the kitchen and living room at home, she counted and packed 15 jars each of the improved low-salt pickled vegetables and wild-vegetable pickles, and took out her hand-embroidered tablecloth to decorate the booth. She put everything into two large shopping bags and confirmed everything was ready.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen and living room

subevent.name: Sales and display on the day of the trade fair
subevent.description: On the morning of April 26, Ma Xiulan brought the prepared pickled vegetables and the embroidered tablecloth to the Jinghai District Spring Agricultural Products Fair. She set up her booth, spread the embroidered tablecloth, and neatly arranged the jars of pickled vegetables. Throughout the day she enthusiastically greeted customers, introduced the features of the low-salt pickled vegetables and wild-vegetable pickled vegetables, and let customers taste them. By the time the fair ended in the afternoon, she had sold 28 jars of pickled vegetables, earning 560 yuan. During the event, purchasing staff from three community supermarkets left their contact information to express interest in supplying, and a staff member from the district agricultural committee suggested after tasting that she apply for the 'Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Product' label. Ma Xiulan carefully noted all this information and felt uplifted.

participant.name: Staff member of the District Agriculture Committee

subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Spring Agricultural Products Trade Fair venue.

subevent.name: Following up on supply intentions and searching for distinctive labels
subevent.description: The day after the trade fair, Ma Xiulan called the purchasing representatives of three community supermarkets from home on her mobile phone to arrange times and places for later face-to-face meetings about supply details. Then she searched online and called the public number of the Jinghai District Agricultural Committee to ask about the materials, procedures, and conditions required to apply for the 'Jinghai Specialty Agricultural Products' label, and she took careful notes. She felt that there was a new way to increase her income in the future and planned to discuss next steps with her husband.

participant.name: Staff member of the District Agriculture Committee

subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Monthly household expense review
description: On August 30, Ma Xiulan took out the ledger and worked with her husband Ma Zhiqiang to calculate the month's income and expenses. Because her husband's salary had been cut, the total spending for the month exceeded the budget by about 120 yuan. The two decided to reduce non-essential expenses starting next month, such as pausing the purchase of new fabric.

subevent.name: Preparing bookkeeping and receipts.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out the family account book from the drawer at home, gathered all of this month's supermarket receipts, water and electricity bills, her husband's pay slips and other income and expense vouchers, and neatly laid them out on the living room dining table to prepare for the accounting.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Couple jointly calculating income and expenses
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat at the dining table. Ma Xiulan flipped through the account book and read out this month's various expenses while Ma Zhiqiang used his phone calculator to add them up item by item. The two checked the receipt amounts against each other and confirmed that this month's total income had decreased because of Ma Zhiqiang's pay cut, while total expenses had increased due to school supplies for the children and daily miscellaneous costs.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Make a plan to reduce expenses next month
subevent.description: In response to the overspending, Ma Xiulan and Ma Zhiqiang discussed together and listed non-essential expenses that could be cut next month: pausing purchases of new embroidery fabric, reducing the number of meals eaten out, and halving the monthly snack budget. Ma Xiulan wrote down these plans on a blank page in the ledger, and they both promised to supervise each other's implementation.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Joined the Baduanjin class, met Auntie Zhao, and came home to share the experience
description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan set out from home to the community fitness square to attend the morning Baduanjin class. During the break, she made the acquaintance of Auntie Zhao Sufen. The two exchanged ideas about TCM health preservation. Auntie Zhao demonstrated an acupressure technique to relieve lower back soreness, and they agreed to exercise together in the future. After returning home, Xiulan shared this new friendship with her husband and children.

subevent.name: Set off for the Baduanjin class.
subevent.description: On the morning of July 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan set out from home and walked to the community center square in Jinghai District to attend the Baduanjin morning exercise class. She wore comfortable sportswear, brought her water bottle, and got ready to exercise with the elderly neighbors in the community.
subevent.location: From home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to the community fitness square

subevent.name: Attend the Baduanjin class.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan attended the Baduanjin morning exercise class on time at the community fitness plaza, followed the leading instructor through the full set of Baduanjin movements, and felt her body stretch out. During the session, she noticed an older woman in the front row whose movements were precise and whose bearing was elegant.
subevent.location: Community Fitness Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Met Aunt Zhao during the break between classes.
subevent.description: During the break, Aunt Zhao in the front row (Zhao Sufen, 65, retired teacher) struck up a conversation with Ma Xiulan and shared homemade hawthorn tea to help cool off. The two hit it off chatting about traditional Chinese medicine wellness. When Aunt Zhao learned that Ma Xiulan often suffered from lower back soreness, she demonstrated a few acupressure techniques to relieve it on a nearby bench. Ma Xiulan tried them on the spot and felt her lower back much more relaxed. They praised each other, agreed to exercise together every day from then on, and exchanged contact information.
subevent.location: Rest area beside the community fitness square, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: After returning home, sharing the new friend with the family
subevent.description: After finishing her morning exercise and returning home, Ma Xiulan told her husband and children about meeting Aunt Zhao in the Baduanjin class while preparing breakfast, and demonstrated the acupressure technique Aunt Zhao taught. Her daughter Ma Yuxin curiously followed along, and the family was happy that she had made a new friend.
subevent.location: Home kitchen on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: After the husband's salary arrives, completing the loan repayment, support payment transfer, and allocation of household expenses
description: On the evening of April 15, her husband Ma Zhiqiang received a text message from the logistics company about his April salary: 5,800 yuan had been deposited. After dinner, the couple sat in the living room and used mobile banking to pay this month's mortgage of 2,300 yuan, then transferred 200 yuan to Ma Xiulan's parents as support. Ma Xiulan allocated the remaining money according to her spending plan: 1,500 yuan for food, 300 yuan for the children's school fees, 200 yuan for utilities, and 300 yuan as emergency reserve. She recorded each item in the account book. Her husband teased her, saying she was “more careful than an accountant,” and she replied, “How can we run a household without being careful?”

subevent.name: Husband received a text message about his salary being credited
subevent.description: At about 18:00 in the evening on April 15, 2025, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was checking his phone in the living room and received a text message from the logistics company saying that his April salary had been credited, notifying him that the month's salary of 5,800 yuan had been deposited into his bank card. Ma Xiulan heard her husband mention that the salary had arrived, and the two immediately began planning the evening's financial matters.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Couple Jointly Repaying Mortgage and Transferring Parental Support
subevent.description: On the evening of April 15, 2025, after dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat side by side on the sofa in the living room and used the banking app on Ma Zhiqiang's phone to make payments: first repaying the month's mortgage of 2,300 yuan, then transferring 200 yuan to the account of Ma Xiulan's parents (Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying) as this month's support payment. Ma Xiulan checked on the side that the payee account information was correct, and after the operation was completed, her husband told her the remaining balance.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Allocate remaining funds and record the accounts
subevent.description: After paying the mortgage and transferring the support payments, Ma Xiulan took out the family account book and a pen, and on the living room coffee table planned out the remaining funds for the month item by item: food expenses 1,500 yuan, children's school supplies and miscellaneous fees 300 yuan, water, electricity, and gas fees 200 yuan, and emergency reserve fund 300 yuan. She carefully recorded each amount and purpose in the account book, and verbally explained the allocation plan to her husband. Her husband smiled and praised her for being more meticulous than an accountant, and she replied, 'If I weren't careful, how could we get by?' The whole process lasted about 15 minutes, and then the account book was put back in the drawer.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Adjusting her mindset, recording the pickle improvement process on WeChat Moments, and gaining encouragement from neighbors
description: On April 10, after the pickled vegetables were put back on the shelves, Ma Xiulan posted a beautifully styled photo of the new-recipe pickles to her Moments. At first, the sparse likes made her a little disappointed. But then her neighbor Wang Guilan commented, “They look like they go well with rice,” and Zhang Shufen also privately messaged her for two jars. Ma Xiulan realized that the real recognition came from the taste that the neighbors had tried, so she put aside her disappointment, treated her Moments as a space to record her own progress, and replied to every commenter, thanking them for their support.

subevent.name: Put the pickled vegetables back on the shelf and arranged the display.
subevent.description: In her kitchen, Ma Xiulan packed the newly made pickles with the improved recipe into clean glass jars, arranged them neatly on the dining table, and prepared to take photos to post on Moments.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - home kitchen

subevent.name: Carefully take photos and edit a WeChat Moments post
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took multiple photos of the pickled vegetable jars from different angles with her phone, chose the most satisfying one, and edited a post in WeChat Moments introducing the new recipe, attaching the photo and preparing to publish.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home Dining Room

subevent.name: Checked the likes and felt disappointed.
subevent.description: After posting, Ma Xiulan refreshed Moments several times over a period of time, only to find the number of likes was very low, far below expectations, and she felt a wave of disappointment and dejection.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - home living room

subevent.name: Neighbor Wang Guilan commented on a Moments post.
subevent.description: Wang Guilan, the neighbor across the hallway, saw Ma Xiulan's pickle photos in her Moments and commented, "Looks like it goes great with rice," expressing her approval and appetite for the pickles.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home (mobile)

subevent.name: Neighbor Zhang Shufen sent a private message asking for two jars.
subevent.description: Zhang Shufen, the neighbor diagonally across, saw Ma Xiulan's Moments post and contacted her via WeChat private message, saying she wanted to buy two jars of the newly formulated pickled vegetables and praising her cooking skills.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home (mobile)

subevent.name: Adjusting her mindset and replying to all comments
subevent.description: After receiving the neighbor's affirmation, Ma Xiulan realized that real recognition came from the familiar neighbors who had tasted her food. She set aside her disappointment, pulled herself together, and replied one by one on Moments to all the friends who had liked and commented, expressing her gratitude.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - home living room

subevent.name: Positioned Moments as a space for recording progress.
subevent.description: After this psychological adjustment, Ma Xiulan decided to use Moments from now on as a space to record her pickled vegetable improvement process and daily life, no longer paying too much attention to the number of likes, but focusing on her own progress and the real feedback from her neighbors.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home

name: Learning new Su embroidery stitches online
description: On the evening of July 20, Ma Xiulan saw a video tutorial on Suzhou embroidery stitches shared by a group member in the embroidery exchange group, so she followed the video to learn the “rolling needle” and “seed stitch” techniques. She took out her unused embroidery hoop and silk thread, practiced while watching, and reworked it three times before embroidering a complete small flower. On the 22nd, she photographed her work and posted it in the group, earning Aunt Wu's approval, and they agreed that the next video call would cover more complex patterns. This learning session helped her master two new stitches, making her embroidery pieces richer in detail.

subevent.name: Watch the tutorial and practice the new stitch technique
subevent.description: On the evening of July 20, while browsing an embroidery exchange group on her phone at home, Ma Xiulan saw a tutorial video on Suzhou embroidery stitches shared by a group member and was immediately drawn to it. She found an unused embroidery frame and silk thread at home, and learned two new stitches, rolling needle and seed stitch, while following the video. Since it was her first attempt, she undid and re-sewed the threads three times. After nearly two hours of focused practice, she finally succeeded in embroidering a complete small flower and initially mastered the essentials of both stitches.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Shared her work and received online guidance.
subevent.description: On July 22, Ma Xiulan photographed the little flower piece she had embroidered the day before, uploaded it to the embroidery exchange group, and added her learning reflections. Aunt Wu, a group member, saw it and immediately liked it, praising her for learning quickly and embroidering delicately. She also offered to guide her further via video call in learning more complex Suzhou embroidery patterns. Ma Xiulan gladly accepted, and they agreed to have a video lesson one evening the following week. This online exchange filled her with confidence about improving her embroidery skills.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Completed the first trial batch of low-salt pickles and adjusted the recipe based on tasting feedback from family and friends.
description: On April 8, after her father's blood pressure follow-up was stable, Ma Xiulan decided to develop low-salt pickled vegetables. Referring to her training notes and her father's suggestions, she designed a recipe and went to the vegetable market to buy sea salt, vegetables, and spices. On April 9, she pickled vegetables in the kitchen according to the new recipe, controlling the salt amount and recording the ingredients, then sealed them for pickling. On April 10, she invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, neighbor Wang Guilan, and her mother to taste them. Everyone thought the saltiness was just right and the flavor was good. Her mother suggested adding rock sugar to balance the slight bitterness. Ma Xiulan adopted the suggestion and recorded the final recipe, preparing it as a premium product line.

subevent.name: Confirm the recipe and purchase ingredients
subevent.description: On April 8, 2025, after her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure recheck results were stable, Ma Xiulan, at her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, resolved to use the pickling techniques she learned in the training class to develop low-salt pickled vegetables. Referring to her training notes and incorporating her father's nutritional advice on a low-salt diet, she designed an improved recipe using sea salt to replace part of the regular salt and adding celery juice for extra freshness. She then made a list of ingredients, went alone to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, and bought sea salt, fresh celery, cucumbers, radishes and other vegetables and necessary spices from the stall owner Sun Guifang, preparing for the trial production.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road and Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Making low-salt pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: On April 9, 2025, Ma Xiulan began making her first batch of low-salt pickled vegetables in her home kitchen. She washed, cut, and air-dried the vegetables she had purchased, and prepared the pickling liquid according to a new recipe: mixing sea salt and regular salt in a certain ratio, adding celery juice, Sichuan peppercorns, star anise, and other spices, boiling it and letting it cool, then pouring it into a clean jar containing the vegetables and sealing it to pickle. During the process, she strictly controlled the salt ratio and recorded the amount of each ingredient used at every step. She planned to pickle them for 24 hours so that she could open the jar and taste them the next day.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Invite relatives and friends to taste-test and adjust the recipe
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, neighbor Wang Guilan, and her mother Li Xiuying to her home to taste the newly made low-salt pickled vegetables. She put the pickles into small dishes, one for each person, and served them with steamed buns for tasting. Liu Chunmei praised the moderate saltiness and crisp texture. Wang Guilan felt the flavor was no less than traditional pickles. Her mother Li Xiuying, after tasting, suggested adding a small amount of rock sugar to neutralize the slight bitterness of the sea salt and enhance the sweet aftertaste. Ma Xiulan listened carefully to the feedback, adopted her mother's suggestion, and recorded the final recipe (sea salt, celery juice, rock sugar, etc.) in her notebook, planning to launch this low-salt pickle as a future high-end product line.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road, home living room.

name: Dragged into the community square dance friendship competition to make up the numbers
description: On August 2, the community square dance friendship match was short-handed, and Wang Guilan dragged Ma Xiulan in to make up the numbers. She originally feared dancing in public most, but Wang Guilan said, 'Just copy the moves, no one will laugh at you.' The competition song was 'Good Luck Comes.' Wearing the uniformly issued pink T-shirt, she imitated the moves of the person in front and nearly bumped into people beside her several times. In the end, the team won a participation award, and everyone received a bag of laundry detergent. After getting off the stage, she wiped her sweat and said to Wang Guilan, 'Spare me next time.' Wang Guilan laughed, 'Your hand-foot coordination is pretty good, keep practicing.' Although she felt awkward, the competition photos were posted in the community group and drew teasing from the neighbors. Ma Xiulan chased Wang Guilan, pretending to hit her, but later quietly saved the photo into the family album as 'a rare bit of fun.'

subevent.name: Wang Guilan invited Ma Xiulan to make up the numbers.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 2, 2025, neighbor Wang Guilan found Ma Xiulan at the Jingwen Road Community Square as she was returning from buying groceries, and told her that the community square dance friendship competition was short of hands, begging her to temporarily help fill in. Ma Xiulan was afraid of dancing in public and waved her hands again and again, but Wang Guilan assured her, 'It's just making some movements; no one will laugh at you.' In the end, Ma Xiulan reluctantly agreed.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Square

subevent.name: Pick up and put on the uniforms
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went with Wang Guilan to the community activity center to pick up the uniform for the competition - a pink T-shirt - and changed into it on the spot in the temporary changing area. Ma Xiulan adjusted her clothes in front of the mirror, felt the color was too bright, but there was nothing to do about it.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Community Activity Center

subevent.name: Participating in the square dance competition 'Good Luck Comes'
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 2, 2025, Ma Xiulan took part in a square dance friendship competition at the community square with Wang Guilan's team. The competition piece was "Good Luck Comes." Ma Xiulan stood at the edge of the second row, nervously following the movements of the person in front, nearly bumping into the people beside her several times, but in the end she still made it through the entire dance.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Square

subevent.name: Won a participation prize and collected the award
subevent.description: After the competition, the hastily assembled team, formed due to a shortage of participants, won the "Participation Award". Ma Xiulan and her teammates went on stage together to receive the award, and each person got a bag of laundry detergent. Holding the detergent, Ma Xiulan felt that although it was awkward, at least it was something.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Community Square Stage

subevent.name: Post-match interaction with Wang Guilan
subevent.description: After stepping off the stage, Ma Xiulan wiped her sweat and said to Wang Guilan, "Spare me next time." But Wang Guilan smiled and encouraged her, "Your coordination is pretty good. Keep practicing." Ma Xiulan complained outwardly but felt a bit proud inside.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Community Square

subevent.name: The competition photos were posted in the community group and sparked some teasing.

Ma Xiulan's pose while dancing in a pink T-shirt drew good-natured teasing from neighbors. After seeing it, Ma Xiulan chased Wang Guilan, pretending to hit her, and the two of them laughed and played around.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Square

subevent.name: Quietly save photos to the family album
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan said she felt embarrassed, but she secretly saved the contest photos from the group chat to her phone, planning to put them in the family album later as a memory of 'a rare bit of fun'.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Making soy sauce cucumbers for mother's birthday and receiving thanks
description: Ma Xiulan prepared in advance for her mother Li Xiuying's birthday. On August 14, she pickled soy sauce cucumbers at home, and on August 16 she delivered them to her mother's home. On August 17, her mother called to express her birthday joy, praised that the pickled cucumbers tasted even better, and told her not to overwork herself, which made Ma Xiulan feel warm.

subevent.name: Making soy-pickled cucumbers
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan prepared pickled cucumbers in her home kitchen for her mother's birthday. Using cucumbers she had grown and a traditional pickling recipe, she carefully blended the seasonings to make a batch of pickled cucumbers with an even better taste, and jarred some to give to her mother.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: Deliver pickled cucumbers to mother
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan brought the pickled cucumbers made the day before and walked to the home of her mother Li Xiuying at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. She personally handed the pickled cucumbers to her mother, exchanged simple greetings and chatted; her mother was very happy to receive them.
subevent.location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin - mother's home

subevent.name: Mother called to express her joy about the birthday
subevent.description: On August 17, her mother Li Xiuying called Ma Xiulan and happily said she had a very enjoyable birthday. She especially mentioned that Xiulan's soy-pickled cucumbers tasted even better than last time, and urged her not to work too hard and to speak up if she had any difficulties. Ma Xiulan was moved and replied, 'I know, Mom.' The call restored some warmth and lifted her from the frustration of the earlier argument about savings.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home

name: Monthly financial review: June income and expenditure accounting and education fund contribution.
description: On the evening of June 30, Ma Xiulan opened her accounting book and carefully reconciled the month's finances. This month's part-time income: 250 yuan from consignment sales of pickled cucumbers, 250 yuan net from embroidery orders, and 200 yuan in social security subsidy, totaling 700 yuan. Major expenses: 400 yuan for the electric bike, 350 yuan for the second son's glasses, 150 yuan for the husband's annual accident insurance, 200 yuan for the Children's Day amusement park, and about 1,200 yuan for daily necessities and groceries (including the previous advance). Despite overspending, she still insisted on setting aside 150 yuan from the surplus for the education fund special account, and saving another 50 yuan for family emergency reserves. She silently resolved: next month she would increase the amount of pickled vegetables by 10 percent and strive for part-time income to exceed 800 yuan.

subevent.name: Organize the account book and income receipts.
subevent.description: On the evening of June 30, Ma Xiulan took her account book and all of this month's income receipts from a drawer at home, including the consignment records for pickled cucumbers, embroidery order receipts, and the social security subsidy notice. She spread them out on the dining table, preparing to reconcile her June finances.
subevent.location: Home dining table, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Calculate this month's part-time income
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan sat at the dining table and, against her account book and receipts, calculated her part-time income for June item by item: 250 yuan from consignment sales of pickled cucumbers, 250 yuan net from an embroidery order, and 200 yuan in social security subsidy, for a total of 700 yuan. She recorded the numbers in her account book and verified whether the money had arrived.
subevent.location: Home dining table, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Check the detailed expenditures for this month.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan continued looking through the account book and listed the month's major expenses item by item: 400 yuan for the electric bike, 350 yuan for her second son's glasses, 150 yuan for her husband's annual accident insurance, 200 yuan for the children's amusement park on Children's Day, and about 1,200 yuan for daily necessities and grocery expenses (including the earlier advance). She calculated the total expenses and marked the over-budget portion in the account book.
subevent.location: Home dining table, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Calculate the balance of income and expenses and decide to save money.
subevent.description: In her account book, Ma Xiulan first subtracted all expenses from the 700 yuan income to get the month's balance. Despite serious overspending, she was determined to squeeze 150 yuan from the small surplus saved from daily household expenses into the dedicated education fund account, and set aside another 50 yuan as the family emergency reserve. She wrote these decisions in the remarks column of the account book.

subevent.description: Ma Xiulan opened the mobile banking app and transferred 150 yuan from the family savings account to the education fund special account. After confirming the transfer was successful, she recorded in the ledger: June 30, education fund deposit 150 yuan.

subevent.name: Make the deposit into the family emergency reserve fund.
subevent.description: After completing the education fund deposit, Ma Xiulan transferred 50 yuan from her savings account to the family emergency reserve account. She checked the balance and found it correct, and recorded in the ledger: June 30, emergency reserve deposit 50 yuan.

subevent.name: Set next month's income growth target.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan closed the ledger and silently made up her mind: next month she would increase consignment sales of pickled vegetables by 10 percent, and continue taking embroidery orders, aiming to get total part-time income over 800 yuan in July. She wrote this goal on the first page of the ledger.
subevent.location: Home dining table, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Husband returned from a driving trip; the family gathered for dinner and presented greeting cards.
description: On May 18, when her husband Ma Zhiqiang returned from a driving trip, Ma Xiulan had already prepared a table of his favorite dishes; the main course was hand-rolled noodles with gravy and braised pork ribs. The children presented handmade greeting cards; the second son had drawn a large truck and written 'Dad, drive safely.' During the meal, her husband spoke little but drank a couple more cups. That night, he unusually did not smoke, and Xiulan felt his silent gratitude. She later put the cards in the family album.

subevent.name: Making dinner
subevent.description: In the kitchen at her home on No. 156 Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan began carefully preparing dinner in the afternoon. Using the flour she had bought, she made hand-rolled noodles by hand, simmered the gravy soup base, and slowly braised pork ribs over low heat. It took about two hours to cook her husband's favorite hand-rolled noodles with gravy and braised ribs.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Children making greeting cards
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan's three children — eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin — worked together in the living room to make a hand-drawn greeting card for their father Ma Zhiqiang using colored paper, markers, and stickers. Ma Mingzhe specially drew a large truck and wrote the words “Dad, drive safely” on it to express his good wishes for his father.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Husband returns and family dinner
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Zhiqiang returned to the home on Jingwen Road after a drive. Ma Xiulan set out the hand-rolled noodles with gravy and stewed pork ribs she had made, and the whole family sat down to eat together. During the meal, the children presented handmade greeting cards. Ma Zhiqiang, though not talkative, drank a couple of extra glasses of wine and, as an exception, did not smoke. Ma Xiulan felt her husband's silent gratitude. The dinner atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: Collect and store greeting cards.
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan carefully organized the greeting cards the children had made and put them in the family photo album for safekeeping, as a memento of warm family moments.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Help her husband complete the truck's annual inspection.

On July 14, she accompanied her husband Ma Zhiqiang to drive the truck to the inspection station. While waiting in line, she helped check the vehicle lights to ensure the truck met the requirements. After the truck passed the inspection smoothly, they received the annual inspection qualification sticker. After returning home, Ma Xiulan organized the documents and informed her family about it.

subevent.description: Ma Xiulan searched at home for the documents related to the truck's annual inspection. She found the compulsory traffic accident liability insurance policy, the vehicle license, and the vehicle registration certificate, and used the home printer to make copies of the key pages for backup, ensuring all materials were complete and making full preparations for the next day's inspection.

subevent.name: Accompanied her husband to take the truck to the inspection station
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang drove the truck from home to the designated vehicle inspection station in Jinghai District. After arriving, she helped her husband park in the queue area and took a queue number to wait for the inspection.

subevent.description: While waiting in line for the inspection, Ma Xiulan followed her husband's guidance and used a screwdriver to check whether the truck's headlights turned on properly and the turn signals flashed. She also checked the brake lights and horn, making sure the vehicle's exterior and lighting system met annual inspection requirements, to avoid a re-inspection due to minor issues.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Motor Vehicle Inspection Station

subevent.name: The truck passed the annual inspection smoothly and received the qualification sticker.
subevent.description: The truck successfully passed the inspection line. Her husband remarked that handling it themselves saved the money they would have paid to a scalper, and Ma Xiulan felt very gratified.

subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband drove home. The whole family was delighted for her.
