Ma Yuxin's work "Mom Makes Pickles" won third prize, with a set of 24-color watercolor markers as the prize. After the ceremony, mother and daughter went to Xingwang Vegetable Market to buy fruit, and made a fruit platter at home in the afternoon. In the evening, husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, and Ma Yuxin showed off the prize and the platter, and the whole family celebrated together.

Ma Yuxin's work 'Mom Making Pickles' used naive brushwork to show her mother bending over to cut cucumbers and a clay jar. She won third prize, which was a set of 24-color watercolor pens. During the awards, Ma Xiulan crouched down to put the medal on her daughter, and the mother and daughter took a group photo on stage.

At Sun Guifang's stall, they bought fresh fruits such as watermelon, mangoes, and grapes to prepare a celebration platter. Ma Yuxin happily picked out the fruit, and the mother and daughter chatted and laughed.

subevent.name: Mother and daughter making a fruit platter

Ma Yuxin was in charge of plating, while Ma Xiulan guided from the side. The mother and daughter worked well together in a warm atmosphere.

Ma Yuxin immediately held up the fruit platter she had made and proudly showed off her award-winning work to her father. Ma Zhiqiang picked up his daughter and said with a smile, 'Our family has produced a little painter!' He also praised the mother and daughter for making the platter so well. The whole family tasted the fruit platter together and shared the joy of winning.

name: Mail hand-sewn seat cushions and chili sauce to her elder sister in Beijing.
description: On August 9, Ma Xiulan thought of her elder sister Li Xiuyun, who lived far away in Beijing. She sewed a sturdy cushion from floral fabric scraps at home, packed a jar of her own pickled chili sauce, and took the package to the post office. She also included a note that read: "Elder sister, the cushion will keep you warm in winter, and the chili sauce is made with a recipe even Mom praised." This was both a way of missing her sister and a traditional expression of family affection.

subevent.description: In the living room of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan used leftover floral fabric scraps to piece together a sturdy and durable cushion for her older sister Li Xiuyun, who lives in distant Beijing. name: Plan the summer family travel budget and allocate special funds for the Beijing trip.
description: On the evening of June 25, Ma Xiulan took out her notebook in the study of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and estimated in detail the cost of taking the whole family (her husband and three children) to Beijing for a summer vacation trip: round-trip hard-seat train tickets about 200 yuan, accommodation for two nights 400 yuan, tickets, meals, and other expenses 500 yuan, totaling about 1100 yuan. The education fund has 2400 yuan saved so far. She decided to set aside 600 yuan from it as a special travel fund, and to set aside a fixed 100 yuan from her part-time income every month to supplement it. She wrote the goal on the flyleaf of the account book to motivate herself to increase pickle sales and strive to make the trip happen by the end of the summer vacation.

subevent.name: Estimating the summer vacation travel budget.

subevent.name: Record motivational goals
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan wrote the goal and budget details of taking the whole family to Beijing during summer vacation on the flyleaf of her account book, marking progress milestones in red pen. This was to motivate herself to keep saving, while also reminding herself to increase pickle sales so the trip could happen by the end of summer vacation.

name: Rushing to make pickled radishes as Spring Festival gifts
description: In late January, Ma Xiulan used materials already available at home to quickly make a batch of pickled radish, carefully packing them into jars as gifts for visiting relatives during the Spring Festival, which saved money and showed her thoughtfulness. The process lasted from the 25th to the morning of the 28th. She carefully selected the radishes and prepared the pickling sauce, and every jar had a small label handwritten by herself.

subevent.name: Preparing white radish and sauce ingredients
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan was in her own kitchen. From the winter white radishes stored at home, she carefully picked out about 20 jin of radishes that were uniform in size and spotless, then washed the soil off them one by one, cut them into evenly thick strips with a kitchen knife, and put them in a large basin with salt sprinkled over to draw out the water. At the same time, she found the soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, star anise, dried chili peppers and other seasonings available at home, measured and mixed them, and prepared the base sauce for pickling. The whole process lasted the entire morning. In the afternoon, she took out the drained radish strips, spread them on bamboo trays, and left them to air-dry in a ventilated place for half a day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and courtyard at home

subevent.name: Mix the sauce and give the radish its first pickling
subevent.description: On the morning of January 26, Ma Xiulan brought the radish strips, which had been dried in the sun to half-dry the day before, back into the kitchen. She mixed the seasonings prepared in advance—soy sauce, aged vinegar, white sugar, and others—according to her secret recipe ratio, poured them into a large pot, and heated them until they just came to a boil, then turned off the heat and let the mixture cool. Next, she poured the radish strips and the cooled sauce into a clean porcelain jar and mixed them thoroughly by hand, ensuring every strip was evenly coated with the sauce color. She sealed the jar with its lid, placed it in a cool place, and began the initial pickling. During this time, she checked the seal of the lid and recorded the date the pickling started.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Turning the jar and re-seasoning
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 27, Ma Xiulan opened the pickling vat and used clean long chopsticks to turn the radish strips over from top to bottom, so that each radish fully came into contact with the sauce settled at the bottom. She tasted one radish strip for saltiness and felt it was a little bland, so she added a small spoonful of soy sauce and a little rock sugar, and stirred evenly again. Then she put the lid back on, sealed the gap with cloth strips, and continued pickling. At the same time, she got out the glass jars with lids stored at home, washed them clean, turned them upside down to drain, and prepared to bottle the pickles the next day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Finished the gifts by filling jars and labeling them
subevent.description: On the morning of January 28, Ma Xiulan took the cured soy-marinated radishes out of the vat, drained off the excess sauce, and packed them neatly into the glass jars she had prepared the previous day, pressing them down and leaving a little space. She filled eight jars in total, each about one and a half jin. She wiped the jar rims with a clean dry cloth and screwed them shut. Then she took out the small red paper strips she had cut herself and a brush, wrote "Handmade by Ma Xiulan, Soy-Marinated Radish, Spring Festival of the Yisi Year" on each one, and pasted them onto the jars. When all was done, she stored the jarred radishes in a cool place, waiting to give them as gifts when visiting relatives during the Spring Festival.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Starting the lower back muscle exercise plan
description: After returning home from the community health service center on June 25, Ma Xiulan carefully recalled the cat stretch and wall-supported waist twists that Dr. Wang taught her, and decided to spend 10 minutes each morning and evening doing a set of stretches. At first she was clumsy. The next morning, when she practiced in the courtyard, her husband teased that she looked like she was bowing to Buddha, and she laughed and retorted. After persevering for a week, by the end of June she felt her lower back soreness had noticeably eased, and she could maintain a proper sitting posture for longer while embroidering.

subevent.name: Recall the movements and make an exercise plan
subevent.description: After returning home from the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Ma Xiulan sat down on the sofa in the living room and tried hard to recall the two psoas stretching movements Doctor Wang had taught her: Cat-Cow Stretch and Wall-Assisted Waist Twist. She took out her phone and jotted down the key points, and decided to practice them in the courtyard for 10 minutes every morning and evening starting that night.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Morning courtyard practice on the first day
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan spread an old yoga mat on the concrete floor of her backyard and began practicing cat stretch and waist twists while holding the wall. Her movements were unfamiliar and her posture was a bit stiff. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang passed by, saw her, and laughingly said she looked like she was worshiping Buddha. Ma Xiulan retorted that it was the scientific exercise Dr. Wang had taught her, then seriously finished two more sets of the movements.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Practiced before bed on the first evening.
subevent.description: Before bed at night, Ma Xiulan practiced cat stretch and wall-assisted waist twists by the bedside in the bedroom again. This time her movements were a bit more practiced than in the morning. She deliberately slowed down to feel the stretch in her lower back muscles, and after finishing, her waist felt much more relaxed. Then she washed up briefly and went to bed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Continue practicing every morning and evening to consolidate what has been learned.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan insisted on doing lumbar muscle stretching exercises once each morning and evening in the courtyard or indoors, about 10 minutes each time. Her movements gradually became more skilled and her posture more standard. She practiced in spare moments between household chores, and occasionally invited her younger daughter to do cat stretches together as a game. Over the three days, she gradually felt the ache and tightness in her lower back ease.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Day 1: morning and evening lower back stretching exercises
subevent.description: After getting up at 6:30 a.m. on June 27, 2025, Ma Xiulan first went to the courtyard to take deep breaths, then began her first waist muscle stretching session on the exercise mat in the courtyard, using moves such as cat stretch and waist twists, for about 10 minutes. During a break in her morning chores, she squeezed in a simple set of side waist stretches in the living room. At 7 p.m., after dinner, she did a second formal session in the room; this time she had her younger daughter Ma Yuxin do cat stretch with her as a game, correcting her daughter's posture while doing a relaxed 15-minute session. After practicing throughout the day, she felt that the soreness and stiffness in her waist had eased a little.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard and living room

subevent.name: Morning and evening lumbar muscle stretching exercises the next day
subevent.description: On June 28, 2025, drawing on the previous day's experience, Ma Xiulan did 10 minutes of lumbar muscle stretching in the courtyard at 6:40 a.m. Her movements were smoother than the previous day and her posture gradually became more standard. After returning from grocery shopping in the morning, she used the 10 minutes while waiting for the rice to cook to do a few more simple stretches in the kitchen. Around 8 p.m., she practiced alone on the bed in the bedroom, focusing on stretching the back of the buttocks and twisting the waist, for 12 minutes. She felt that the soreness in her lower back had eased significantly, and the pain during movement was reduced.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard and bedroom

subevent.name: Third day morning and evening lower back muscle stretching exercises
subevent.description: June 29, 2025, was the last day of consolidation practice. At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to do stretching in the courtyard. Her movements were already very proficient; she completed each posture accurately and held each movement for 30 seconds to 1 minute, for about 10 minutes in total. During breaks from handicraft work during the day, she did two wall-supported backbend relaxations on the embroidery stool. At 7:30 in the evening, she invited her youngest daughter to do fun cat-style stretches together in the living room, completing the final 15 minutes of practice with breathing rhythm. After three days of continuous practice, she felt that the soreness and swelling in her waist had basically disappeared, and her posture was more upright.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard and living room

name: The hydrangeas bloomed; she pruned branches, arranged them in a vase, and gave some to a neighbor.
description: On June 15, Ma Xiulan cut blue-purple hydrangeas in her own courtyard, put them in a vase, and placed them on the dining table. In the afternoon, her neighbor Zhang Shufen passed by, saw the flowers, and marveled at them. Ma Xiulan cut a few more branches and gave them to her. The two chatted at the door, adding warmth to their neighborly relationship.

subevent.name: Pruning hydrangea branches and arranging them in a vase
subevent.description: On the morning of June 15, Ma Xiulan saw blue-purple hydrangeas in full bloom in her own courtyard. She used gardening scissors to cut a few of the fullest flower heads, carefully trimmed the stems and leaves, inserted them into a clean vase, poured in fresh water, and then placed the vase on the living room dining table to add a natural bright touch to the home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard and living room

subevent.name: Gave hydrangea branches to a neighbor
subevent.description: In the afternoon, neighbor Zhang Shufen passed by Ma Xiulan's door and saw the hydrangeas on the dining table through the window, marveling at them. Ma Xiulan came out at the sound, saw that Zhang Shufen liked them, so she cut a few more hydrangea branches with scissors, wrapped them simply in newspaper, and gave them to Zhang Shufen. Zhang Shufen thanked her repeatedly, and the two chatted about neighborhood trifles at the door, adding warmth to their neighborly relationship.
subevent.location: Home doorstep, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The whole family did a thorough cleaning and set up a reading corner to welcome the new semester.
description: To welcome the new semester, Ma Xiulan organized a family cleaning on August 10: her husband Ma Zhiqiang wiped the windows, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan tidied the desk and books, her second son Ma Mingzhe swept and mopped the floor, her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin put away toys, and Ma Xiulan washed the curtains and bedsheets and cleaned the living room corner. After the cleaning, the home was fresh and tidy, and the whole family celebrated. On August 15, Ma Xiulan placed a bookshelf, carpet, picture books, and cushions in the freed-up living room corner to create a family reading corner.

subevent.name: Assign cleaning tasks
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan gathered the whole family and assigned clear tasks: her husband Ma Zhiqiang would wipe all the windows; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan would tidy his desk and clear out old books; her second son Ma Mingzhe would sweep and mop the floor; her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin would put away toys and clutter; Ma Xiulan herself would wash the curtains and bed sheets and later organize the living room corners.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Husband wiping the windows.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan's husband, Ma Zhiqiang, used a damp cloth and cleaner to wipe the glass and frames of all the windows in the home one by one, including the living room, bedroom, and kitchen windows, making sure they were spotlessly clean, and cleaned the dust from the windowsills after finishing.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: The eldest son tidies up the desk and old books.
subevent.description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, tidied his desk in his room, sorted and bundled old exercise books and textbooks that were no longer used for disposal or recycling, wiped the desk and bookshelf, and neatly put away the stationery needed for the new semester.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: The second son swept and mopped the floor
subevent.description: The second son Ma Mingzhe first used a broom to thoroughly sweep the floors of the living room, hallway, and every room, gathering the debris and dumping it into the trash can. Then he dipped the mop in water, wrung it out, and mopped the floors one by one, paying special attention to corners and under furniture. After finishing, he washed the cleaning tools and put them back in their original places.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Younger daughter tidies up toys
subevent.description: The youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, picked up all the scattered toys on the floor of her play area, put them into storage boxes or on the toy shelf by category, including building blocks, dolls, and picture books, and also proactively used a rag to wipe the dust off the toy surfaces.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan washed the curtains and bedsheets.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took down all the curtains and bed sheets that needed washing, sorted them into the washing machine, added laundry detergent, and started the wash cycle. After the wash finished, she took them out, hung them on the balcony to dry, and secured them with clips to ensure they were aired dry.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Clean the corner of the living room and set up a reading nook.
subevent.description: After hanging the curtains and bed sheets out to dry, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the clutter and dust in a corner of the living room, moved an idle small bookshelf and a rug there, placed a few children's picture books and a small cushion, and initially created a simple family reading corner.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Wrapping up the big cleaning and celebrating with the whole family
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan checked the hygiene of each area and praised the children and her husband for their efforts. The whole family rested and chatted together in the clean and tidy living room, while the children played on the spacious floor. Ma Xiulan felt very gratified and took photos of the clean home as a keepsake.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Dragon Boat Festival Family Day: Folding Paper Boats, Setting Them Afloat, and a Reunion Dinner
description: On May 31, the Dragon Boat Festival, Ma Xiulan spent the morning folding paper boats in the living room with her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to prepare for the afternoon activity. In the afternoon, her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, took their second son to the canal to set the paper boats afloat. Ma Xiulan quietly followed and photographed the backs of the father and son standing side by side watching the paper boats drift away. In the evening, the whole family of five enjoyed a Dragon Boat Festival dinner together, with traditional dishes such as zongzi and noodles with gravy, in a warm, harmonious atmosphere.

subevent.name: Making paper boats.
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan and her second son Ma Mingzhe folded paper boats in the living room at home, preparing to launch them by the river in the afternoon. Ma Mingzhe excitedly helped nearby.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

subevent.name: Releasing paper boats by the river as a parent-child activity
subevent.description: In the afternoon, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took their second son Ma Mingzhe to the nearby canal to launch paper boats. Ma Xiulan quietly followed behind and used her camera to capture the backs of father and son standing side by side watching the paper boats drift away, freezing a warm Dragon Boat Festival moment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - by the canal

subevent.name: Family Dragon Boat Festival dinner
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan's family of five shared a Dragon Boat Festival dinner together in the dining room at home. The table had traditional dishes such as rice dumplings and noodles with gravy. Everyone ate while chatting about funny moments from the day, and the family atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Home dining room, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Father's high blood pressure led to a medical visit and set up monitoring.
description: On February 10, her father Ma Jianguo had his blood pressure measured at the community clinic as 150/95. Ma Xiulan insisted on accompanying him to the appointment. Dr. Wang prescribed medication and advised a low-salt diet. The next day, she immediately bought an electronic blood pressure monitor and strictly required her father to measure and record his blood pressure every morning and evening. From then on, she made her father's health monitoring a daily family routine.

subevent.name: Father had his blood pressure measured at the community clinic
subevent.description: On the morning of February 10, Ma Xiulan's father, Ma Jianguo, went to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District by himself for a routine physical examination. In the consultation room of Dr. Wang, the general practitioner, his blood pressure was measured. The result showed systolic pressure 150 mmHg and diastolic pressure 95 mmHg, which falls into the Grade 1 hypertension range. Dr. Wang told Ma Jianguo that further diagnosis and treatment were needed.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan accompanied her father to a medical appointment and picked up medicine.
subevent.description: After learning that her father had high blood pressure, Ma Xiulan immediately went to the community health service center and insisted on accompanying him throughout the follow-up visit. Doctor Wang asked Ma Jianguo in detail about his lifestyle habits and medical history, prescribed antihypertensive medication, and advised a low-salt diet, a regular routine, and appropriate exercise. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the doctor's instructions, picked up the medicine at the pharmacy, and then walked her father home.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Purchase an electronic blood pressure monitor.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 11, Ma Xiulan went to Jianmin Pharmacy on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, to buy a branded electronic blood pressure monitor for her father, and consulted in detail about how to use it. She chose a model that was simple to operate and suitable for the elderly, and paid for it using the family's carefully saved money.
subevent.location: Jianmin Pharmacy, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Guided father in using the blood pressure monitor and recorded the first measurement.
subevent.description: That afternoon, Ma Xiulan brought the newly purchased blood pressure monitor to her parents' home and personally taught her father, Ma Jianguo, how to use the electronic blood pressure monitor correctly. She repeatedly demonstrated how to wrap the cuff, press the button, and read the reading, and guided her father to take a measurement on the spot, recording the result in a dedicated monitoring notebook. Ma Xiulan asked her father to measure and record at fixed times every morning and evening from that day on, making health monitoring a daily family routine.
subevent.location: Father's home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Pay attention to the medical insurance payment notice.
description: On October 24, Ma Xiulan saw a notice on the community bulletin board about the 2026 payment for urban and rural residents' basic medical insurance. She immediately photographed it with her phone and sent it to her husband, and in her accounting notebook she set aside a 'medical insurance reserve' column. In the evening, she confirmed with her husband, who said, 'Don't skimp on what should be paid.'

subevent.name: Saw and recorded the medical insurance payment notice
subevent.description: When Ma Xiulan went out in the morning, she passed the community bulletin board and saw the notice for the 2026 urban and rural residents' medical insurance payment. She immediately took a photo with her phone for reference, marked a "medical insurance reserve" column in her carried account book, and reminded herself of this expense.
subevent.location: Community bulletin board in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Send notification to her husband
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan sent the photo of the medical insurance payment notice to her husband Ma Zhiqiang via WeChat, along with a voice message telling him the payment amount and deadline, so that he would be informed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Confirmed the medical insurance payment with her husband.
subevent.description: In the evening, after her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home, Ma Xiulan discussed the medical insurance payment with him face to face. Her husband said, “Don’t skimp on what has to be paid,” and agreed to pay on time. Ma Xiulan then wrote “medical insurance payment” in her accounting notebook as a reminder.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

name: Doing embroidery with childhood friend Liu Chunmei and enjoying the pleasure of handicrafts.
description: On the evening of March 27, after finishing the batch pickling, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to her home, and the two studied new embroidery patterns together. She brought out her treasured embroidery hoop and colorful silk threads, and while chatting, embroidered a pair of pillowcases to give to her mother for her upcoming birthday. Liu Chunmei also brought the beadwork technique she had just learned, and the two exchanged insights until late at night. This get-together allowed Ma Xiulan to temporarily step away from days of exhaustion and feel the calm brought by handwork and the warmth of friendship.

subevent.name: Organize embroidery materials and tools
subevent.description: In the early evening, Ma Xiulan busied herself in the bedroom and living room at home. She took out her treasured embroidery hoops, colorful silk threads, scissors, and other tools from the storage cabinet, as well as a piece of white cotton fabric for making a pillowcase. She carefully checked whether all the thread colors were complete and sorted the threads according to the patterns she had in mind, fully preparing for the evening handicraft gathering.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Invite a childhood friend and wait for their arrival
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to say she was free this evening and invited her to come over for embroidery and to exchange beading techniques. Liu Chunmei gladly agreed and arrived at Ma Xiulan's home about half an hour later. Ma Xiulan warmly welcomed her and led her to sit in the living room.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Embroidery exchange and handicraft making
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei sat facing each other by the tea table in the living room, chatting as they started their handicraft. Ma Xiulan took out an embroidery hoop, fixed the base fabric of a pillowcase in it, and began embroidering with colored silk thread according to the design she had in mind. She planned to embroider a pair of peony pillowcases symbolizing good fortune as a birthday gift for her mother. Liu Chunmei showed off the beading skills she had just learned, weaving small ornaments from fine thread and colorful beads, and shared her tips. Throughout, the two kept exchanging stitching techniques and pattern ideas, filled with laughter, fully absorbed in the joy of handcrafting.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Finished late at night and tidied up
subevent.description: Late at night, the two realized it was already late and decided to end the gathering. Ma Xiulan carefully put away her unfinished pillowcase and tools, and Liu Chunmei also tidied up her beading materials. They admired each other's work and agreed to meet again next time. Then Ma Xiulan walked Liu Chunmei to the door, said a brief goodbye, returned inside, tidied up the living room, and rested.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Go to the district library to attend the lecture on the past of the canal and share the experience with family
description: On the afternoon of April 22, Ma Xiulan walked from home to the Jinghai District Library and attended the public lecture "The Old Canal Tales of Jinghai." The speaker recounted the historical changes of the Grand Canal in Jinghai. She exchanged old memories with the grandmother sitting beside her and found it fascinating. After returning home in the evening, she excitedly retold the lecture to her husband and children during dinner, and the family had a warm discussion about their hometown's history.

subevent.name: Go to Jinghai District Library
subevent.description: On the afternoon of April 22, before her youngest daughter got out of school, Ma Xiulan walked from home (156 Jingwen Road) to the Jinghai District Library, and on the way attended the public lecture 'Jinghai's Canal Past.' As she walked, she recalled the canal stories she had heard from her elders when she was a child, and felt expectant.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - the section from Jingwen Road to the District Library

subevent.name: Attended the public lecture on Jinghai's canal past.
subevent.description: In the lecture hall on the second floor of Jinghai District Library, Ma Xiulan attended a public lecture that lasted about two hours. The speaker was a retired teacher who told the history of the Grand Canal's Jinghai section in authentic Jinghai dialect. Ma Xiulan heard for the first time that Dulin Old Wharf and Jingwen Road had once been an ancient post road, and found it fascinating. In the seat next to her was an elderly lady with her grandson; the two chatted quietly about the old look of Jinghai, and the atmosphere was harmonious.

participant.name: The old lady in the adjacent seat.

subevent.location: Report hall on the second floor of the District Library, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Sharing lecture takeaways at family dinner
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan returned home and prepared dinner. The family of five—her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin—ate at the dining table in the living room. Ma Xiulan excitedly recounted the lecture content, telling stories about the ancient docks and post roads along the Jinghai Canal. The children listened with great interest, and her husband also added related legends he had heard. The family had a warm discussion about their hometown's history, and Ma Xiulan felt a greater sense of belonging to the land beneath her feet.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

name: Chen Yulan returned from visiting relatives, visited a friend, gave printed cloth as a gift, and encouraged the pickle business.
description: On February 22, Chen Yulan ended her visit to relatives and returned to Jinghai. She first had a small gathering with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, then went to Ma Xiulan's home to present a piece of Tangshan-style printed fabric. Ma Xiulan entertained her with tea and snacks. Chen Yulan shared customs from the Spring Festival in Tangshan and the latest clothing store promotions. Upon learning that Ma Xiulan was good at making pickled vegetables, she encouraged her to turn it into a small business and promised to help find a source of discounted raw materials. The two had a lovely conversation, and their friendship grew deeper.

subevent.name: Chen Yulan returned to Jinghai and contacted her friend
subevent.description: In the morning, Chen Yulan returned to Jinghai District, Tianjin after finishing her visit to relatives in Tangshan, Hebei. She contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and junior high school classmate Ma Xiulan via WeChat, told them she was back in Jinghai, and arranged to first gather at Liu Chunmei's home, then go to Ma Xiulan's home to visit.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Chen Yulan's home

subevent.name: A small get-together between Chen Yulan and Liu Chunmei
subevent.description: Chen Yulan arrived at Liu Chunmei's home at 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and the two met briefly. Chen Yulan shared what she had seen and heard during her family visit and mentioned that she planned to give Ma Xiulan a piece of Tangshan printed fabric. After gathering for about an hour, Chen Yulan took her leave and went to Ma Xiulan's home.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Liu Chunmei's home

subevent.name: Chen Yulan went to Ma Xiulan's home.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Chen Yulan left Liu Chunmei's house and walked about 15 minutes to Ma Xiulan's home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District. She carried with her a piece of Tangshan-style printed fabric as a gift.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Subdistrict

subevent.name: Chen Yulan gave printed cloth as a gift, and Ma Xiulan served tea to entertain her.
subevent.description: Chen Yulan arrived at Ma Xiulan's home, and the two sat down in the living room. Chen Yulan gave Ma Xiulan a carefully selected piece of handmade printed cloth from Tangshan. Ma Xiulan thanked her, made tea with the best tea leaves she had at home, and prepared sunflower seeds, peanuts, and other snacks to receive her.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Ma Xiulan's home living room

subevent.name: Sharing Tangshan experiences and encouraging pickled-vegetable making.
subevent.description: During tea, Chen Yulan described in detail the unique customs of the Spring Festival in Tangshan (such as pasting window paper-cuts and steaming New Year cakes), and shared the latest news about her clothing store—recent promotions had been going well, and business was good. When Chen Yulan learned that Ma Xiulan knew how to make traditional pickled vegetables, she encouraged her to turn the pickles into a small business and promised to help look out for affordable ingredient sources when stocking up in the future. The two chatted very congenially about family, children, and handicrafts.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Ma Xiulan's home living room

name: Celebrate the 67th birthday of her mother and the 13th birthday of her eldest son on the same day and record a video
description: On August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan went with her younger sister Ma Xiufen to their mother Li Xiuying's home at No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, to celebrate their mother's 67th birthday. The two sisters ate, chatted, and took photos with their mother. Around 5 p.m., on her way home, Ma Xiulan picked up the Tianjin steamed-bun-shaped cake that had been ordered for her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. In the evening, the whole family — her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin — sat together after dinner, sang the birthday song, and Mingxuan made a wish, "I hope everyone in the family stays healthy," then blew out the candles. Ma Xiulan recorded the whole time, and that night she saved the video to the family video folder, moved by her son's thoughtfulness.

subevent.name: Celebrated mother Li Xiuying's 67th birthday at noon
subevent.description: At noon on August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen went together to their mother Li Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to celebrate their mother's 67th birthday. The sisters prepared simple dishes and fruit, and accompanied their mother while eating and chatting, sharing recent family life. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant. Ma Xiulan took a group photo with her phone as a keepsake.
subevent.location: Mother's home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Pick up the custom birthday cake in the evening
subevent.description: At around 5 p.m. on August 15, 2025, on her way back from her mother's home to her own home at 156 Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan stopped by the local bakery where she had previously ordered a cake, and picked up a small cake specially customized for her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's 13th birthday, shaped like a Tianjin baozi. The cake was unique in appearance, and Ma Xiulan thought her son would like it.
subevent.location: Local bakery in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After dinner, the whole family celebrated the birthday of their eldest son, Ma Mingxuan.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared dinner at home (156 Jingwen Road) and the whole family (husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin) ate dinner together. After dinner, Ma Xiulan placed a Tianjin steamed bun-shaped cake on the table and inserted candles. The whole family sat around and sang the birthday song. Ma Mingxuan closed his eyes, made a wish, saying 'I hope everyone in the family is healthy,' then blew out the candles. Everyone shared the cake, and the atmosphere was warm. The younger siblings also played and laughed.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Record the birthday celebration video and save it to the family folder.
subevent.description: During the whole family's birthday celebration for Ma Mingxuan, Ma Xiulan held up her phone the entire time to record videos, capturing the heartwarming moments of singing the birthday song, making a wish, and blowing out the candles. After the celebration, seeing how sensible her son was made Ma Xiulan's heart ache a little. That night, after the rest of the family had gone to bed, she imported the video file from her phone into a folder named "Family Videos" on the family computer to keep for future memories.
subevent.location: Home study on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Talking and doing embroidery with childhood friend Chunmei in the courtyard.
description: On June 20, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to come to her home courtyard in the afternoon to do embroidery together, and she arranged the wicker chairs in advance and prepared fabric and thread. In the afternoon, Chunmei arrived at the courtyard with homemade sour plum juice. The two sat on wicker chairs beside the hydrangeas, learning to embroider lotus patterns while chatting about the children's recent lives and local town gossip. The activity lasted until sunset. In the evening, Ma Xiulan saw Chunmei off, put away the tools, and checked the progress of the embroidery. Ma Xiulan felt such an afternoon was both relaxing and fulfilling, strengthening their friendship and her craft skills.

subevent.name: Invite her childhood friend and prepare supplies for the get-together.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to confirm that they would do embroidery together in the courtyard in the afternoon, and she prepared the rattan chairs, embroidery fabric, and threads in advance.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Embroidery and chat with a childhood friend in the courtyard
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Liu Chunmei came to Ma Xiulan's courtyard with homemade sour plum drink. The two sat in rattan chairs beside the hydrangeas, learning to embroider lotus patterns while chatting about their children's recent news and interesting happenings in town. The activity lasted until sunset, and both felt relaxed and fulfilled.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: See off a childhood friend and tidy up the courtyard.
subevent.description: After the evening activities, Ma Xiulan saw off Liu Chunmei, then stored and tidied the rattan chairs and embroidery tools in the courtyard, and checked the progress of the day's embroidery work.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

name: Learning new double-sided embroidery techniques from Zhou Xiuqin
description: On June 8, Ma Xiulan visited Zhou Xiuqin's home to watch her create a double-sided embroidery peony picture and was drawn to her exquisite skill. Seeing her strong interest, Zhou Xiuqin personally taught her the basic stitches of double-sided embroidery, including techniques such as splitting silk and hiding threads. Ma Xiulan practiced for three hours. Although her fingers were pricked by the needle a few times, she successfully embroidered a small petal. She took the sample home and planned to use it in new orders to improve the quality of her pieces.

subevent.name: Preparing study materials and heading to Zhou Xiuqin's house
subevent.description: To learn a new double-sided embroidery technique, Ma Xiulan organized her embroidery hoop, embroidery needles, silk threads, and fabric at home, then walked to Zhou Xiuqin's home at No. 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
subevent.location: Ma Xiulan’s home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Observe double-sided embroidery works and learn basic embroidery stitches.
subevent.description: At Zhou Xiuqin's home, Ma Xiulan carefully observed the double-sided embroidered peony piece Zhou Xiuqin was working on, captivated by her exquisite skill. Zhou Xiuqin then personally taught Ma Xiulan the basic stitching techniques of double-sided embroidery, including key skills such as splitting silk threads and hiding threads. Ma Xiulan listened attentively and tried to imitate.
subevent.location: Zhou Xiuqin's home at 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Practice the double-sided embroidery technique.
subevent.description: Under Zhou Xiuqin's guidance, Ma Xiulan began practicing double-sided embroidery by hand, practicing continuously for about three hours. During practice, her fingers were pricked by needles several times, but she persisted and finally succeeded in embroidering a small petal, earning Zhou Xiuqin's approval.
subevent.location: Zhou Xiuqin's home at 88 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Took samples home and planned how to use them
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully put away the double-sided embroidered petal sample she had practiced, said goodbye to Zhou Xiuqin, and returned home. She planned to apply the newly learned double-sided embroidery technique to future handicraft orders to improve the quality and character of her work.
subevent.location: Ma Xiulan’s home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sorting old photos and starting the family album project.
description: On February 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan sorted through old photos in the drawer, shared memories with the children, and discussed the annual family album plan with her husband. On February 19, she checked the old camera she had found last month, confirmed it worked properly, and made a shopping list of the film and albums needed. On February 20, she went to town and bought acid-free albums, film, and photo printing vouchers, officially launching the family album project.

subevent.name: Organize old photos and make a preliminary classification.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan dug out a stash of old photos from the living room drawer at home, carefully wiped off the dust, and sorted the photos into several piles in approximate chronological order, recalling the scenes and stories behind each photo as she organized them.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Sharing old photos and memories with the children.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan called over her three children—Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin—to look at the old photos she had organized, telling them about the people and scenes in the photos. The children listened with great interest, asking questions and laughing from time to time, which strengthened the bond between parent and children.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Discuss the annual family photo album plan with her husband.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan spoke by phone with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was out on a transport run, and told him her plan to start using a camera this year to record important family moments and create a family album at the end of the year. Her husband expressed support and agreed to join in taking and selecting photos on his days off.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home (phone contact)

subevent.name: Check the old camera and make a list of needed items.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out the old camera she had found last month, carefully checked the battery, lens, and shutter function, and after confirming the camera worked properly, calculated how much film she needed to buy and the size of the empty photo album, then wrote a shopping list in her notebook at home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Going to town to buy photo albums and film materials
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took her shopping list and cash and walked to the stationery store and photography equipment store in the town of Jinghai District. She bought an acid-free blank photo album, three rolls of color film, and photo printing vouchers. After briefly discussing photo album-making tips with the store owners, she returned home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin — the town's stationery store and camera equipment store

name: Cook and deliver meals for Aunt Zhao's hospitalized husband
description: On August 20, Aunt Zhao’s husband was suddenly hospitalized and she had no time to take care of meals. When Ma Xiulan learned of this, she took the initiative to cook lunch and dinner and deliver them to the hospital. Aunt Zhao said with emotion, “She is more thoughtful than my own daughter.” This mutual help extended their friendship from exercise to daily care.

subevent.name: Learned that Aunt Zhao's husband was hospitalized and decided to help
subevent.description: While doing morning exercise in Jinghai District, Ma Xiulan learned from her neighbor Wang Guilan that Aunt Zhao's husband, who usually exercised with them, had suddenly been hospitalized. Aunt Zhao was alone at the hospital accompanying him and had no time to arrange meals. Ma Xiulan immediately called Aunt Zhao to confirm the situation and volunteered to cook and deliver meals. Aunt Zhao was moved and accepted.
subevent.location: Morning exercise open area near Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Prepare lunch and dinner at home
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned to the kitchen at home and started making lunch: she cooked millet porridge, steamed egg custard, stir-fried a plate of light greens, and also prepared a soft, savory noodle dish with gravy. Around two in the afternoon, she began preparing dinner: she simmered chicken soup, steamed tofu with minced pork, and baked a few scallion pancakes. Throughout the process, she paid attention to nutritional balance and easy digestion, ensuring the meals were suitable for the patient and the accompanying family members.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Deliver lunch to the hospital
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan packed the prepared lunch into insulated lunch boxes, then rode her bicycle to Jinghai District People's Hospital. After arriving at the inpatient department, she found the ward of Aunt Zhao's husband, handed the hot lunch to Aunt Zhao, and asked with concern about his condition. Aunt Zhao thanked her again and again, praising Ma Xiulan as more considerate than a real daughter. Ma Xiulan chatted briefly with Aunt Zhao and comforted her not to worry.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Inpatient Department of Jinghai District People's Hospital.

subevent.name: Delivered dinner to the hospital and stayed to accompany
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan packed the prepared dinner (chicken soup, minced pork tofu, and scallion pancakes) again and rode her bicycle to the hospital. After arriving, she helped Aunt Zhao set out the meal and also fetched a pot of hot water. Aunt Zhao expressed her gratitude once more, and the two agreed that Ma Xiulan would continue delivering meals the next day. After returning home, Ma Xiulan stored the leftover ingredients properly and planned the next day's menu.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Inpatient Department of Jinghai District People's Hospital.

name: Recorded a short video on pickled vegetables and received guidance
description: On July 28, when Ma Xiulan was alone, she set up her phone and recorded the whole process of making pickled radish for the first time: washing and cutting, air-drying, mixing the marinade, and packing the jars, occasionally using her fingers to demonstrate in front of the camera. She posted the 3-minute video to the "Handmade Pickles Exchange Group," and group members praised her for her quick and neat technique. Aunt Wu @-mentioned her and sent a private message with advice: "Soak the radish in salted water for half an hour before scrubbing it. Rub it like an eraser and it comes clean in one go — effortless and clean." She followed the advice, found it indeed efficient, replied with thanks, and the two chatted until late at night, making an appointment for Aunt Wu to visit her home.

subevent.name: Prepare materials for recording.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan prepared the ingredients (radish, salt, sugar, vinegar, etc.) and tools (cleaver, cutting board, basin, glass jars, etc.) needed for recording the pickled radish video in her home kitchen, and set up her phone camera equipment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Recording a video about pickled radish
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan set up her phone by herself in the kitchen and recorded the entire process of washing and cutting radishes, drying them, making the sauce, and filling the jars, occasionally using her fingers to demonstrate specific steps in front of the camera. In the end, she produced a video about 3 minutes long.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Share the video to the chat group.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan sent the recorded 3-minute pickled radish video to the 'Handmade Pickled Vegetables Exchange Group', and group members praised her deft technique after watching it.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home (Online)

subevent.name: Receiving private guidance from Aunt Wu
subevent.description: Aunt Wu mentioned Ma Xiulan in the group chat and shared radish handling tips with her via private message: soak in salt water for half an hour before scrubbing; it saves effort and gets them clean.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home (Online)

subevent.name: Try making an improved version of pickled radish.
subevent.description: Following Aunt Wu's instructions, Ma Xiulan took fresh radishes, soaked them in salt water for half an hour, then scrubbed and washed them. She continued with the remaining steps and found it was indeed efficient and clean, and successfully made the pickled radishes.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Thank Aunt Wu and had a late-night chat.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan succeeded in the trial, she sent a private message to Aunt Wu to thank her and share her experience. The two chatted late into the night about pickle-making and family life.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home (Online)

subevent.name: Arranged for Aunt Wu to come over for a visit
subevent.description: During a late-night chat, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu agreed that Aunt Wu would visit Ma Xiulan's home another day to make pickled vegetables together.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home (Online)

name: Organizing family photos from the first half of the year
description: On the afternoon of July 25, Ma Xiulan selected 20 family photos from the first half of the year at home (including moments such as her husband drinking chicken soup with a bandaged arm, her eldest son grinning with his report card, a bountiful spinach harvest in the courtyard, and Xinxin holding up an embroidered bellyband), and went to a photo printing shop to have them printed. In the evening, she and her daughter Ma Yuxin used photo corners and stickers to paste the photos into a thick old photo album. Later she flipped through the album alone and sighed, "Before I knew it, I had saved up so many days."

subevent.name: Selecting photos from the first half of the year
subevent.description: After lunch, Ma Xiulan sat on the living room sofa and went through all the photos from the first half of 2025 on her phone and camera, carefully recalling each moment, and selected 20 of the most memorable photos, including her husband drinking chicken soup with a bandage, her eldest son grinning while holding his report card, a bountiful spinach harvest in the courtyard, and her daughter Xinxin holding up a belly wrap.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Go to the photo printing shop to print photos.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan brought her mobile phone containing electronic files of 20 selected photos, walked to a photo printing shop near Jingwen Road in Jinghai District, handed the photos to the clerk for paper printing, paid the fee, waited a while, and picked up the printed photos.
subevent.location: A photo printing shop in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Pasting photos together with her daughter
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan and her six-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) sat together at the table in the living room. Ma Xiulan carefully fixed the printed photos onto the pages of a thick old photo album with photo corners, while Xinxin crookedly stuck flower-patterned candy-colored stickers along the edges of the album. Working together, the album became thick and full of warmth.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Flip through the finished photo album
subevent.description: After pasting in the photos, Ma Xiulan looked through the thick photo album she had just finished, flipping through the family moments of the first half of the year page by page. Filled with emotion, she said softly, "Before I knew it, I had saved up so many days." She felt full of satisfaction and cherished her family life.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Budgeting carefully to buy Chinese New Year goods
description: From January 26 to 27, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took their children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to buy Chinese New Year goods in Jinghai District, Tianjin. On the morning of the 26th, Ma Xiulan made a list and budgeted 500 yuan. In the morning, the whole family went to the market to buy candies, melon seeds, Spring Festival couplets, and "fu" characters, spending about 210 yuan. On the afternoon of the 27th, they went to the supermarket to buy new clothes for the children, spending 272 yuan. She used a mobile bookkeeping app throughout to record expenses. That evening, after returning home, she checked the total spending of 482 yuan and marveled at how the list method saved money.

subevent.name: Make a shopping list and budget
subevent.description: On the morning of January 26, Ma Xiulan sat in the study of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and took out paper and pen to write a Spring Festival shopping list, including candies, melon seeds, Spring Festival couplets, fortune characters, and new clothes for the three children. She estimated that total spending would be kept within 500 yuan. She recorded the budget in her mobile phone bookkeeping app.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home study

subevent.name: Go to the market to buy some New Year goods
subevent.description: On the morning of January 26, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took their three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to the town market in Jinghai District. Following the shopping list, they bought candies, sunflower seeds, Spring Festival couplets, and lucky character posters, spending about 210 yuan in total. Ma Xiulan recorded every expense in real time on her mobile bookkeeping app.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - town market

subevent.name: Go to the supermarket to buy new clothes for the children
subevent.description: On the afternoon of January 27, Ma Xiulan, her husband Ma Zhiqiang, and their three children went to a supermarket in Jinghai District to pick out new clothes for the children. They bought Ma Mingxuan a jacket, Ma Mingzhe a tracksuit, and Ma Yuxin a dress, spending 272 yuan in total. Ma Xiulan recorded each expense in the mobile bookkeeping app.
subevent.location: A supermarket in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Go home to review the ledger and make a summary
subevent.description: On the evening of January 27, Ma Xiulan returned home, opened the expense-tracking app on her phone, and reconciled all expenditures from the past two days. The total was 482 yuan, within the budget of 500 yuan. She marveled that the checklist method really saved money, saved the ledger, and shared the money-saving results with her husband.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

name: Delivery of handmade embroidery orders and building a good reputation.
description: On May 23, Ma Xiulan completed the finishing touches and ironing of a custom-ordered pillowcase embroidered with twin lotus flowers for a regular customer in her study. On May 26, she walked to the customer Liu Fang's home to deliver the goods. Liu Fang was very satisfied and transferred 120 yuan, and then introduced a new customer, Wang Juan. The next day, May 27, Ma Xiulan communicated with Wang Juan via WeChat about the new order requirements and initially discussed the customization details of the mandarin ducks playing in water pattern. This delivery not only brought income but also built a good reputation.

subevent.name: Finished embroidery and tidied up.
subevent.description: In her home study, Ma Xiulan did the final stitching and inspection on the custom embroidered pillowcase with twin lotus blossoms. She carefully trimmed loose threads, confirmed the pattern was complete and flawless, then used an iron to press the pillowcase smooth, folded it, and placed it in a clean cloth bag to prepare for home delivery.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Deliver to the door and hand over
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the packaged embroidered pillowcases and walked to the home of her long-time client Liu Fang on Shengli Street, Jinghai District. She showed the pillowcases to Liu Fang in person. Liu Fang was very satisfied with the embroidery work and patterns and immediately paid 120 yuan via WeChat transfer. Ma Xiulan thanked her client for the recognition and asked if there were any other needs.
subevent.location: Client Liu Fang's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Have an initial discussion with the new client about their needs.
subevent.description: The next morning, Ma Xiulan had a voice call with a new client, Wang Juan, via WeChat, and learned in detail about the embroidery pattern Wang Juan wanted to customize (mandarin ducks playing in water), the size, and the purpose (as a wedding gift). Ma Xiulan showed Wang Juan pictures of similar works she had made before, and they discussed a preliminary quotation and delivery time. Wang Juan expressed great interest and hoped to talk in detail when they met next.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Turned the soil in the courtyard and planted scallions and spinach. Daughter helped water them, bringing laughter.
description: On April 13, taking advantage of the weekend, Ma Xiulan turned over the soil in a corner of the courtyard and sowed scallion and spinach seeds. Her little daughter Xinxin eagerly carried a small watering can to help water the plants, but accidentally trampled several newly sprouted seedlings. Ma Xiulan didn't scold her; instead, she was amused by Xinxin's childish apology. The long-missed laughter lightened the gloomy mood of the past few days.

subevent.name: Prepare gardening tools and seeds
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took out scallion and spinach seeds, along with gardening tools such as a small trowel and watering can, from the storage room in her home, walked to a corner of the family courtyard, and prepared for the planting.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Turn over and level the soil
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used a shovel in a corner of the home courtyard to loosen the soil, remove weeds and stones, and level the ground into furrows suitable for sowing, preparing the conditions for planting.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Sow scallion and spinach seeds
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan evenly scattered scallion and spinach seeds over the turned soil, then gently covered them with a thin layer of soil to finish sowing.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Daughter helped water the plants but stepped on the young seedlings.
subevent.description: The youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) saw her mother planting vegetables and excitedly carried a toy watering can to help water them, but while running she accidentally stepped on several young seedlings that had just sprouted, knocking them down or damaging them.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan comforts her daughter with laughter
subevent.description: Although Ma Xiulan was a little distressed to see the trampled young seedlings, seeing Xinxin look frightened, apologize childishly, and try to straighten the seedlings with her hands made her laugh at the cute scene. Ma Xiulan did not scold her daughter but gently hugged her and taught her how to water carefully. Their laughter lightened the gloomy mood of the past few days.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

name: Family brisk walk and photos in the park.
description: On Sunday, February 16, the weather was fine. Ma Xiulan suggested the whole family go to Jinghai District People's Park for a brisk walking workout. Her husband power-walked with the children for 30 minutes, and Ma Xiulan used her camera to take several family photos. It both exercised their bodies and left warm memories, putting the monthly family fitness plan into practice.

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan proposes a family brisk walk in the park
subevent.description: On the morning of Sunday, February 16, while having breakfast at home in Jinghai District, Ma Xiulan suggested to her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) that the whole family go to Jinghai District People's Park that day for a brisk walk as exercise and take photos together as a memento. Everyone agreed.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: The whole family is preparing to set off for People's Park.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her family changed into clothes suitable for exercise, took items such as a camera and water bottles, and set off on foot from their home on Jingwen Road in Jinghai District to Jinghai District People's Park at around 9 a.m., the whole trip taking about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: On the way from home to People's Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: The whole family took a 30-minute brisk walk in the park
subevent.description: After arriving at People's Park in Jinghai District, Ma Zhiqiang led the three children in brisk walking along the park trail, while Ma Xiulan followed at a slightly slower pace and recorded the process with her camera. The whole family completed a 30-minute brisk walk and got some exercise.
subevent.location: People's Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan takes a family group photo.
subevent.description: After the brisk walk, Ma Xiulan took several family photos in front of the central flowerbed in People's Park. The children and her husband posed cooperatively, and Ma Xiulan captured the warm moments with her camera to document this family activity.
subevent.location: People's Park, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Reconciliation dinner with childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
description: On the evening of May 20, Liu Chunmei, a childhood friend, invited Ma Xiulan to her home for dinner. Midway through the meal, Chunmei put down her chopsticks and said seriously, “About the pickled vegetables, I was too harsh back then. Don't take it to heart.” Ma Xiulan felt a lump in her throat and raised her glass: “Without you, I wouldn't be where I am today. Sister, let bygones be bygones.” They clinked glasses and drank up. The rift left by the pickle returns over the past few weeks disappeared completely during this meal, and their relationship returned to its former closeness.

subevent.name: Liu Chunmei called to invite her to a meal
subevent.description: On the morning of May 20, 2025, Liu Chunmei, Ma Xiulan's childhood friend who had been on bad terms with her for several weeks, took the initiative to call. She sincerely invited Ma Xiulan to come to her home for dinner that evening, saying she wanted to talk in person. After a moment's hesitation, Ma Xiulan gladly accepted, and the two agreed to meet at Chunmei's house at six in the evening.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Ma Xiulan's home (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan prepares a host gift for the appointment.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 20, 2025, before going to the appointment, Ma Xiulan picked a basket of fresh vegetables from her small vegetable garden and found a jar of sweet garlic she had pickled last year, as gifts to show her appreciation. She changed into a clean, plain-colored top, washed up briefly, and got ready to go out.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Ma Xiulan's home (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: Arrived at Liu Chunmei's home for dinner together
subevent.description: At 6 p.m. on May 20, 2025, Ma Xiulan walked to the home of her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, who lived on the same street. Liu Chunmei had prepared a table of home-style dishes (noodles with gravy, sweet and sour spare ribs, cucumber salad, etc.). The two sat facing each other, eating and chatting about recent family matters. The atmosphere was a bit reserved at first.
subevent.location: Liu Chunmei's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin (No. 88 Shengli Street)

subevent.name: Apologized and made up during the meal.
subevent.description: On the evening of May 20, 2025, midway through dinner, Liu Chunmei put down her chopsticks and looked seriously at Ma Xiulan, saying, “About the pickled vegetables, I was too harsh back then. Don’t take it to heart.” Ma Xiulan felt a lump in her throat and raised her glass in response: “Without you, I wouldn’t be where I am today. Sister, let’s not dwell on the past.” They clinked glasses and drank it all in one go. The rift left by the pickled vegetable returns over the past few weeks completely vanished, and their relationship returned to its former closeness.
subevent.location: Liu Chunmei's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin (No. 88 Shengli Street)

subevent.name: Everyone went home separately after the get-together
subevent.description: At about 8:30 pm on May 20, 2025, after reconciling, the two chatted about many heartfelt matters. Ma Xiulan helped clean up the dishes and then said goodbye to Chunmei, walking home with a relaxed and relieved mood. When parting, Chunmei told her to take care on the way, and the two agreed to go to the temple fair together next weekend.
subevent.location: On the road from Liu Chunmei's home to Ma Xiulan's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: In the early morning, she hunted for and brought back a secondhand bookshelf and books, and set up a family reading corner.
description: At 5:30 a.m. on August 15, Ma Xiulan contacted a seller through the community secondhand goods group and went out early to spend 80 yuan on an 80% new small bookshelf and 30 secondhand books (fairy tales, classics, and popular science readers). After transporting the items home in two trips on her electric bike, she assembled the bookshelf by the window in the living room around 8:30, sorted and neatly arranged the books, and decorated them with green plants, completing the setup of the family reading corner.

subevent.name: In the early morning, browsed the secondhand goods group and contacted the seller
subevent.description: At 5:30 a.m. on August 15, after getting up, Ma Xiulan opened WeChat and saw in the community secondhand goods group that someone was transferring a nearly new small bookshelf and 30 used books (including fairy tales, classics, and popular science readers). She immediately messaged the seller privately, expressed her intention to buy, and arranged to go to the seller's home (a residential building on Shengli Street, Jinghai District) at 7 a.m. to inspect the goods and pay.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Go to the seller's place to inspect the goods, pay, and pack them
subevent.description: At 7 in the morning, Ma Xiulan arrived on time at the seller's building on her electric bicycle. She carefully checked that the bookshelf was sturdy and undamaged, and flipped through all the books. After confirming they were in good condition, she paid 80 yuan in cash. The seller helped disassemble the bookshelf, and she used the coarse cloth wrapping she had brought to tie the 30 books into two parcels, then strapped the main parts of the bookshelf to the back seat of her electric bicycle.
subevent.location: A residential building on Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Transported the bookshelf and books home in multiple trips.
subevent.description: Because there were quite a few items, Ma Xiulan made two trips to transport them. On the first trip, she carried the two wrapped bundles of books and the lighter shelf boards home first; the round trip took about 15 minutes. On the second trip, she went back to bring the remaining bookshelf frame and other parts. Each time she tied everything carefully to make sure nothing fell apart on the way. After everything was transported home, she temporarily piled the items in the corner of the living room.
subevent.location: At home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and on the way to and from.

subevent.name: Assembled a bookshelf and set up a family reading corner.
subevent.description: At around 8:30 a.m., Ma Xiulan moved the bookshelf parts to the spot by the window in the living room and reassembled and secured them with a screwdriver and hammer. Then she opened the two bundles of books and neatly arranged them on the bookshelf by category: fairy tales, classics, and popular science. She also used a cloth to wipe the dust off the bookshelf and books, and placed a small green plant on the top shelf. With that, the family reading corner was initially set up, creating a small reading space for the children.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Sisters team up to celebrate their mother's 67th birthday.
description: On the morning of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared the newly developed sauce cucumbers and quilted chair cushions at home. After agreeing by phone with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, they each set out for their parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin. After arriving, the sisters met and exchanged greetings with their parents, and offered birthday wishes to their mother, Li Xiuying. In the living room, the mother tried on the sun-protection coat Ma Xiufen had given her, saying it was a waste but reluctant to take it off. Then the sisters worked together in the kitchen to prepare lunch, and the mother was persuaded to rest in the living room. Around 12 noon, the whole family sat around the dining table for the birthday dinner. The mother sat in the seat of honor, her eyes moist with emotion, and said repeatedly, "Let's do it the same way next year." In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan continued to keep her parents company and returned alone to her home at 156 Jingwen Road in the evening. This warm celebration gave her emotional support.

subevent.name: Sisters set off for their parents' home
subevent.description: On the morning of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared the newly developed soy-sauce cucumbers and a patchwork seat cushion at home for her mother's birthday. She then called her younger sister Ma Xiufen to arrange a time, and each set out from her own home to their parents' home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
subevent.location: Between 156 Jingwen Road and 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Arrive at her parents' home and meet her parents.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and Ma Xiufen arrived at their parents' home one after another, greeted their father Ma Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying, and wished their mother a happy birthday. Mother Li Xiuying was delighted to see her two daughters. The family first chatted in the living room, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room at her parents' home)

subevent.name: Giving the Birthday Gift and Having Mother Try It On
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan brought out her newly developed pickled cucumbers and handmade patchwork chair cushions, while Ma Xiufen gave their mother a stylish sun-protection jacket. Under her daughters' persuasion, their mother Li Xiuying tried on the jacket, muttering 'waste of money' but unwilling to take it off, her face beaming with a happy smile. Their father Ma Jianguo stood by, smiling as he watched them.
subevent.location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (living room at her parents' home)

subevent.name: Sisters join forces to prepare birthday lunch.
subevent.description: Near noon, Ma Xiulan and Ma Xiufen entered the kitchen and worked together to prepare a birthday lunch for Mother. The sisters cooperated smoothly: one was in charge of stir-frying dishes, and the other was responsible for the staple food and soup. Soon a table of sumptuous dishes was ready, including Mother's favorite sweet and sour pork tenderloin and noodles with gravy. Mother Li Xiuying had wanted to help but was persuaded by her daughters to rest in the living room.
subevent.location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (mother's home kitchen)

subevent.name: The whole family enjoys a birthday lunch together.
subevent.description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan and Ma Xiufen set the cooked lunch on the table and invited their parents to be seated. Their mother, Li Xiuying, was invited to the seat of honor. The family sat around the table, eating and chatting, in a joyful mood. Looking at her daughters and her husband, Mother's eyes became slightly moist, and she said over and over, 'Let's do it this way again next year.' Everyone raised their glasses to wish Mother health and longevity, and the family spent a warm birthday time together.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - No. 45 Shengli Street (dining room at her parents' home)

subevent.name: Returning home in the evening
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan continued to accompany her parents and chat at her parents' home, helping to clear the tableware. Toward evening, she said goodbye to her parents and younger sister and returned alone to her home at 156 Jingwen Road with a warm heart. This cozy birthday celebration gave her emotional support.
subevent.location: From No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin to No. 156 Jingwen Road

name: Making and selling pickled vegetable gift boxes
description: Inspired by Chen Yulan's suggestion, on August 13 Ma Xiulan began making pickled vegetable gift boxes. In her living room, she selected good-looking pickled cucumbers, pickled radishes, and sweet garlic, washed and dried them, then portioned them into transparent glass jars, affixed the hand-painted labels designed by Chen Yulan, and tied the mouths with red string. She made 6 boxes in total and priced them at 38 yuan each. On the same day, she took photos and short videos of the gift boxes, posted advertisements in the community WeChat group, and sent private messages to relatives and friends to promote them. She then took samples door-to-door to visit neighbors Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen and relatives Li Xiuying and Aunt Li, demonstrating the products on site. She successfully sold 2 boxes (one each to Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen) and received 2 pre-orders (from Li Xiuying and Aunt Li), collecting 76 yuan in cash and with 76 yuan in pre-order payments pending. On August 15, Ma Xiulan delivered the two pre-ordered gift boxes to the homes of Li Xiuying and Aunt Li, collected the 76 yuan in pre-order payments, and recorded feedback, considering whether to increase production or adjust flavors later.

subevent.name: Making and packaging gift boxes of pickled vegetables
subevent.description: In her living room, Ma Xiulan packed the dried pickled vegetables into clear glass jars, filling and pressing each jar tightly. Then she attached the hand-drawn labels designed and printed by Chen Yulan, and tied red string tightly around the jar mouths. In total, she made six pickled-vegetable gift boxes, each containing one jar of three kinds of pickles, and set the price at 38 yuan per box.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Online promotion and marketing of preserved vegetable gift boxes
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used her phone to take photos and short videos of the pickled-vegetable gift boxes, wrote an introductory description, posted an ad in the community WeChat group, and included her contact information.
