She also sent the ad to familiar neighbors and relatives via WeChat private messages and asked them to help forward it.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Door-to-door sales pitch for pickled vegetable gift boxes.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took a complete sample gift box of pickled vegetables and called on, in turn, her neighbor across the hallway Wang Guilan, Zhang Shufen who ran a supermarket diagonally opposite, and the homes of her mother Li Xiuying and her distant aunt, Aunt Li, who lived nearby. She showed them the gift box packaging and the quality of the pickled vegetables face to face, and explained the price and how to purchase in detail. That day she successfully sold 2 boxes (Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen each bought one) and received 2 pre-orders (one from Li Xiuying and one from Aunt Li), receiving a total of 76 yuan in cash and 76 yuan in pre-orders.
subevent.location: Neighbors' and relatives' homes around Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Deliver the reserved pickled vegetable gift boxes.
subevent.description: Following the order information, Ma Xiulan delivered two gift boxes of pickled vegetables to her mother Li Xiuying and her distant cousin Aunt Li, and collected a total of 76 yuan in pre-order payment. At the same time, she recorded customer feedback and began to consider whether to increase production or adjust the flavor later.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - addresses related to Shengli Street and Jingwen Road

name: Father's 68th birthday, a warm celebration with a low-salt family meal
description: On March 21, Ma Xiulan prepared for her father's 68th birthday family dinner, buying ingredients and making a healthy cake. On his birthday, March 22, Ma Xiulan personally cooked a low-salt version of sweet-and-sour pork, steamed fish, and longevity noodles, and the cake was a healthy one made with yam paste. The three sisters and their families gathered at their parents' home. Their mother, Li Xiuying, wiped away tears and said, 'This year I was most afraid your father wouldn't make it.' Xiulan hugged her and replied, 'But everything is fine now.' Their father's blood pressure measured 135/85 that day, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.

subevent.name: Shopping for low-salt ingredients and making a healthy cake
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan prepared for her father's 68th birthday family dinner. She went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District to buy fresh vegetables, fish, meat, Chinese yam, and other ingredients. After returning home, she used yam puree to make a low-sugar, oil-free healthy cake, and pre-marinated the pork pieces for a low-salt version of sweet and sour pork tenderloin.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Family dinner to celebrate father's birthday
subevent.description: On March 22, the day her father Ma Jianguo turned 68, Ma Xiulan brought the dishes and cake she had prepared to her parents' home (No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District), where she gathered with her elder sister Li Xiuyun and family and her younger sister Ma Xiufen and family. Ma Xiulan cooked on the spot in her parents' kitchen: low-salt sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, steamed fish, and longevity noodles. The whole family sat around and tasted the food. Her mother, Li Xiuying, shed tears because of her father's recovery, and Ma Xiulan put her arm around her mother to comfort her. During the celebration, her father's blood pressure measured 135/85, and everyone breathed a sigh of relief.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-Shengli Street parents' home

subevent.name: Clean up after the family dinner and chat with family
subevent.description: After the birthday family dinner, Ma Xiulan and her sisters cleaned up the dining table and kitchen together and washed the dishes. Then the family sat together in the living room chatting and sharing updates, while the children played nearby. In the evening, everyone said goodbye one after another and returned to their own homes.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-Shengli Street parents' home

name: After politely declining her mother's offer to help, she took the initiative to visit, and the mother and daughter worked together to adjust the pickled vegetable recipe.
description: On April 3, when her mother learned about the pickle returns, she offered to help. Ma Xiulan initially declined. But the next day, she composed herself, took samples of the new recipe to her parents' home, and proactively asked her mother to taste them. In the kitchen, the mother and daughter adjusted the spice proportions together. Based on experience, her mother advised, 'Adding a bit more sugar will enhance the flavor.' Ma Xiulan felt warm inside. When she left, her mother pressed a jar of homemade broad bean paste into her hands, saying, 'Come get it if you need it.'

subevent.name: Politely declining her mother's offer to help.
subevent.description: On April 3, after learning that the pickled vegetables had been returned earlier, her mother, Li Xiuying, took the initiative to contact Ma Xiulan and offered to help improve the taste. Ma Xiulan, feeling down and wanting to try adjusting on her own first, politely declined her mother's kindness and agreed to discuss it again the next day. The call was made by telephone, with each person at her own home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - at Ma Xiulan's home and her mother's home (phone communication)

subevent.name: Visited with a new recipe sample, and mother and daughter worked together to adjust the pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: You would like tutoring methods suitable for parents with lower education levels, especially how to help children reduce careless mistakes and increase their interest in learning? Do you also need to take the family's financial situation into account?
subevent.location: Mother's home kitchen, No. 45 Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Planting flowers in the courtyard, parents and children working together to beautify the home.
description: On April 16, Ma Xiulan obtained sunflower and impatiens seeds from community flower friends, and used the income from pickled vegetables to buy rose seedlings and hydrangeas online. She set aside a corner of the yard, turned the soil, and mixed in fertilizer. Her second son dug holes, her youngest daughter scattered seeds, and together as parents and children they planted the first batch of flowers.

subevent.name: Ask community gardening friends for flower seeds
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan went to the home of a community flower-planting friend who also lives in Jinghai District to discuss plans for planting flowers in the courtyard, and obtained sunflower and impatiens seeds from the friend, preparing to beautify her home.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Zhou Xiuqin's home

subevent.name: Ordered rose seedlings and hydrangeas online
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used the money she had saved from previous handcraft odd jobs and pickle sales, and placed an order on a shopping platform through her phone for rose seedlings and hydrangeas to beautify the courtyard. After payment, she waited for the package to be shipped.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Turning over the soil in the courtyard and mixing in fertilizer
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan marked out an area in her courtyard, loosened the soil with a shovel, and mixed in kitchen-waste compost obtained from the vegetable market to improve the soil for sowing seeds and transplanting flower seedlings.
subevent.location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Parent-child cooperative planting
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan led her second son Ma Mingzhe and younger daughter Ma Yuxin to plant flowers together in the prepared courtyard soil. The second son used a small shovel to dig shallow pits, the daughter sprinkled sunflower and impatiens seeds into the pits, and Ma Xiulan then covered them with soil and gently watered them, completing the first batch of flower planting, which both beautified the home and enhanced parent-child interaction.
subevent.location: Home courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Attending a primary school classmate's birthday KTV party.
description: On the evening of July 12, primary school classmate Zhao Xiaohong was celebrating her birthday. She booked a small private room at a KTV in Jinghai Town and invited several old classmates, including Ma Xiulan. As soon as Ma Xiulan entered, she felt dizzy from the flashing lights and deafening music, so she sat quietly eating the fruit plate at first. Later, Zhao Xiaohong handed her the microphone and selected the familiar song Sweet Honey. Unable to decline, she hid in a corner and sang a few lines softly, and to her surprise everyone applauded. She was also egged into singing a duet of Friends, and a video was recorded and posted in the classmate group. When it ended, it was already near midnight. Zhao Xiaohong joked, 'Come more often in the future.' Ma Xiulan waved her hands repeatedly, saying, 'Forget it, forget it.' But on the way home, she could not help humming the songs she had sung, feeling that letting loose with friends once in a while was actually fun—but she was determined not to tell her husband that she had gone to KTV, only saying that it was a 'classmate get-together.'

subevent.name: Go to KTV.
subevent.description: At around 6:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan set out on foot from home and headed to the KTV that Zhao Xiaohong had booked in Jinghai Town. On the way, she exchanged a few brief words with her neighbor Wang Guilan. About 15 minutes later, she arrived at the entrance of the KTV and waited there for the other classmates to go in together.
subevent.location: A KTV in Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: KTV gathering activity
subevent.description: At 7 p.m., Ma Xiulan and several old classmates, including Zhao Xiaohong, entered a small private KTV room. At first, the flashing lights and deafening music made her dizzy, so she sat silently in a corner eating fruit from the tray. The birthday star Zhao Xiaohong handed her the microphone and requested the song Sweet Honey. Ma Xiulan tried to decline but, hiding in the corner, softly sang a few lines, earning applause from everyone. Then she was urged to sing Friends with her classmates, and the whole process was recorded and sent to the classmates group. They sang and chatted, the atmosphere was lively, and Ma Xiulan gradually relaxed and enjoyed the gathering.
subevent.location: A KTV in Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Return home after the get-together
subevent.description: At nearly 11:30 p.m., the KTV session ended. Zhao Xiaohong tried to persuade everyone to stay a little longer, but Ma Xiulan smiled and waved her hand, saying 'forget it, forget it.' She walked home alone, humming 'Sweet Honey' and 'Friends' from earlier, and felt that letting loose with friends once in a while was also quite enjoyable. She got home close to midnight.
subevent.location: Jinghai District - Jinghai Town Subdistrict, Tianjin

subevent.name: After returning home, talked with her husband.
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan washed up quietly. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was already asleep but woke up and casually asked why she was so late. Following the explanation she had prepared in advance, she replied, "Just had a get-together with a few old classmates and chatted a bit too long," without mentioning KTV. She then lay down and fell asleep, feeling a trace of satisfaction and relaxation inside.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The camera memory card was corrupted and the August photos were lost; she learned to back up regularly.
description: On September 25, Ma Xiulan tried to read the August family photos on the camera memory card, but the card was physically damaged and could not be read, so the photos were lost. She immediately went out and bought a 1TB portable hard drive. After returning home, she copied the existing photos from the computer to the drive and learned to use Windows File History to set up automatic weekly backups.

subevent.name: Attempting to read the damaged memory card
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan started the desktop computer in the study, inserted the camera memory card into a card reader, and tried to read the family photos from August. However, the computer displayed "The disk structure is corrupted and unreadable." After multiple failed attempts, she could not access the data on the card and confirmed that the memory card was physically damaged.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Went out to buy a portable hard drive.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took a small amount of cash and walked to a digital electronics store on Dongfanghong Road in Jinghai District. She told the clerk that she needed to buy a portable hard drive to back up photos. With the clerk's recommendation, she chose a 1TB USB 3.0 portable hard drive, paid, and returned home.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - a digital appliance store.

subevent.name: Connected the hard drive and learned backup operations.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned to the study, connected the newly purchased portable hard drive to her computer via a USB cable, and after the computer automatically recognized it, it worked normally. Following the manual and online tutorials, she copied all existing family photo folders on the computer to the portable hard drive, and while she was at it, learned to use Windows' built-in File History feature to set up weekly automatic backups, ensuring that data would never be lost again.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: During the hospitalization, she entrusted the neighbor with picking up and dropping off her youngest daughter, and thanked her afterward.
description: From March 10 to 12, because her father was hospitalized and needed full-time care, Ma Xiulan asked her neighbor Wang Guilan to help take her youngest daughter to and from school. Wang Guilan gladly agreed and said, 'A close neighbor is better than a distant relative; don't be so formal.' On March 16, after opening the jar of pickled vegetables, Ma Xiulan specially brought a bowl to Wang Guilan to express her gratitude.

subevent.name: Ask neighbors to help pick up and drop off daughter
subevent.description: On March 10, 2025, because her father Ma Jianguo was hospitalized and needed full-time care, Ma Xiulan went to the home of her neighbor Wang Guilan, who lived across the hall, and asked her to help take her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to and from school during the period she would be at the hospital caring for her father (March 10 to 12). Wang Guilan gladly agreed and said, 'A close neighbor is better than a distant relative; don't be so formal.'
subevent.location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Neighbor helped pick up and drop off the daughter.
subevent.description: From March 10 to 12, 2025, every morning and afternoon, the neighbor Wang Guilan, as agreed, picked up and dropped off Ma Xiulan's youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to and from kindergarten on time, ensuring the child's safety. During this period, Ma Xiulan was at the hospital accompanying and caring for her father.
subevent.location: From Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, to a kindergarten in Jinghai District

subevent.name: Sending pickled vegetables to thank the neighbors
subevent.description: On March 16, 2025, Ma Xiulan opened the jar of pickled vegetables she had made herself. She deliberately filled a bowl and carried it to the home of her neighbor across the street, Wang Guilan, to thank her for helping pick up and drop off her daughter a few days earlier. The two chatted about everyday things at the door, and their relationship became more harmonious.
subevent.location: 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Home Burglary and Security Upgrade
description: On the morning of May 16, Ma Xiulan went to the Xingwang Vegetable Market to buy groceries. When she returned, she found the front door ajar and pry marks on the lock. Her heart tightened. She went inside and saw that the bedroom wardrobe had been ransacked; the 300 yuan in cash and a silver necklace her mother had given her at her wedding were gone. She anxiously called her husband and then reported it to the police. Officers from the local police station came and took a statement, but because there were no surveillance cameras, the chances of recovering the items were very slim. With red-rimmed eyes, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the mess. In the afternoon, she asked Master Liu, the community handyman, to help replace the lock with a more secure anti-theft lock, and spent 500 yuan to order a simple security door, which was installed the next day. This incident made her especially upset, but she was also grateful that the children's school supplies and family photo albums were all intact. After that, she always double-checked the doors and windows before going out, and the neighbors also reminded one another to stay safe.

subevent.name: Go to the food market to buy groceries
subevent.description: At around 8 a.m. on May 16, Ma Xiulan walked to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District as usual, planning to buy some fresh vegetables and meat to prepare lunch for the family. At Sun Guifang's stall, she picked out tomatoes, greens, and eggs, and also bought half a jin of pork. After paying at about 9:40, she carried her basket home.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Discovered that the home had been burglarized.
subevent.description: Around 10 a.m., Ma Xiulan returned home and found the door slightly ajar with obvious pry marks on the lock. Her heart tightened. She pushed the door open and went inside, only to see the bedroom wardrobe ransacked and in a mess. The 300 yuan in cash in the drawer and the silver necklace her mother had given her when she got married were gone. Her eyes immediately reddened. She hurriedly called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to tell him what had happened, then dialed 110 to report it to the police.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Clean up the mess and take stock of the losses
subevent.description: After the police left, Ma Xiulan, with red-rimmed eyes, began to tidy the rummaged wardrobe and drawers, folding clothes and putting them back in place. She counted and confirmed that only 300 yuan in cash and a silver necklace were missing. She was glad that her children's school supplies and family photo albums were intact. She wiped the dirty cabinet surface with a cloth, then sat on the bedside and grieved quietly for a while.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Contact a handyman to replace the door lock.
subevent.description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan called Liu Jianguo (Master Liu), the community handyman, to say that her home had been burglarized and the locks needed to be changed urgently. At 1 p.m., Master Liu arrived with tools and a B-grade anti-theft lock cylinder, removed the damaged old lock, installed and debugged the new lock, and charged 150 yuan. Ma Xiulan expressed her gratitude to Master Liu for his timely help.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Order a simple security door
subevent.description: Around 2 p.m., following Master Liu's recommendation, Ma Xiulan contacted a hardware and building materials store in Jinghai District and ordered a simple security door (500 yuan in total, including installation). The shopkeeper promised to install it the next morning. Ma Xiulan paid a 300 yuan deposit via WeChat and agreed to pay the balance after installation.
subevent.location: Home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin (contact by phone)

subevent.name: Install the security door
subevent.description: At 9 a.m. on May 17, two installers from the building materials store brought the security door to Ma Xiulan's home. They removed the old wooden door, installed the new security door, and adjusted the door frame and locks. Ma Xiulan supervised nearby. The installation took about 1.5 hours. When it was done, she paid the remaining 200 yuan on the spot and asked the workers to help test the security of the door lock.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Neighborhood safety reminder
subevent.description: On the afternoon of May 17, Ma Xiulan met neighbor Wang Guilan while going out to take out the trash, and told her about the theft and the upgraded anti-theft measures. Wang Guilan was surprised after hearing this and said she would remind the neighbors to be careful. Then the two of them posted several handwritten safety notices in the community, reminding everyone to lock doors and windows when going out. Neighbor Zhang Shufen also came over to ask about the situation, and they chatted at the door for half an hour about safety matters.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Jingwen Road community entrance and stairwell.

name: Family quarterly deep cleaning, clearing out old clothes to give to neighbors.
description: On June 29, following the quarterly cleaning routine, Ma Xiulan mobilized the whole family to carry out a deep summer clean. Her husband was in charge of wiping windows and moving heavy items, the eldest son cleaned the bookshelves and desk, the second son organized toys and swept the floor, the youngest daughter wiped the tables, and she herself focused on kitchen grease and courtyard clutter. She sorted out many old clothes and picked out some clean, intact ones to give to her neighbor Wang Guilan, who thanked her repeatedly. After a busy day, the rooms were bright and clean, the courtyard was tidy, and everything looked brand new.

subevent.name: Mobilization and division of labor
subevent.description: At 8 a.m., Ma Xiulan gathered the whole family at her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, including her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. She clearly told them that today they would do the quarterly deep cleaning, and assigned each person specific tasks: her husband was responsible for wiping windows and moving heavy items; the eldest son would clean the bookshelves and desk; the second son would tidy up the toys and sweep the floor; the youngest daughter would wipe the tables and chairs; and Ma Xiulan herself would focus on kitchen grease and clearing away clutter in the yard.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Cleaning kitchen grease and tidying up the courtyard clutter
subevent.description: After the division of labor, Ma Xiulan began a deep cleaning of her kitchen and courtyard. She first sprayed strong degreaser on the stove, range hood, and cabinets, scrubbed repeatedly with steel wool to remove the thick grease, then wiped everything clean with a damp cloth. Then she went to the courtyard, sorted and cleared away piled-up old flowerpots, dead branches, fallen leaves, and other clutter, swept the ground, and rinsed the cement floor with clean water. The whole process took about 3 hours.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and courtyard

subevent.name: Children's area cleaning
subevent.description: The three children carried out their own tasks simultaneously. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, organized his bookshelf and desk in the study, sorting books and wiping off dust; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, sorted scattered toys into storage bins in the children's room and swept the floor with a broom; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, wiped the coffee table, low tables, and chairs in the living room with a damp cloth. Ma Xiulan checked on and guided them midway, and the children finished in about two hours.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home study, children's room, and living room

subevent.name: Husband's heavy housework
subevent.description: Her husband Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for washing all the windows in the house and moving heavy items. He first used clean water and a dedicated glass squeegee to clean the window glass in every room, then moved furniture that needed to be shifted (such as the living room sofa and storage cabinet) to make cleaning easier, and finally put heavy items back in place, including the new bag of rice and oil jugs in the kitchen; the whole job was done within an hour.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - various rooms at home

subevent.name: Sorting old clothes and giving them to neighbors
subevent.description: As the afternoon cleaning was drawing to a close, Ma Xiulan went through her bedroom wardrobe and the storage room and found a large number of old clothes that she no longer wore. She picked out about a dozen pieces that were in good condition, clean, and undamaged (including a few adult T-shirts and children's jackets), put them in a bag, and personally went to the home of her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan (158 Jingwen Road). She explained that these were clean old clothes from her own household and gave them to her for everyday wear at home. Wang Guilan thanked her repeatedly and accepted the clothes.
subevent.location: Neighbor Wang Guilan's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Whole-house inspection and finishing touches
subevent.description: At 6 p.m., all cleaning tasks were basically completed. Ma Xiulan led the whole family to check the living room, bedrooms, kitchen, study, bathroom, and courtyard one by one, confirming that the windows were bright, the floors were clean, items were put back in place, and the courtyard was free of clutter. Finally, everyone put away the cleaning tools together, bagged up the trash, and took it out. The whole family was satisfied with the results, and the house looked brand new.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - various spots around the home

name: Spending a craft afternoon with childhood friend Liu Chunmei
description: On Saturday afternoon, September 19, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to her home. The two sat in the courtyard to study new embroidery patterns and chatted about recent life events. Liu Chunmei brought some small coasters she had recently crocheted, and Ma Xiulan showed the peony embroidery stitch she had learned at a community salon. They drank tea and did handicrafts together, spending a leisurely three hours. When she left, Liu Chunmei took with her several jars of pickled vegetables given by Ma Xiulan.

subevent.name: Prepare refreshments for the handicraft afternoon
subevent.description: On the morning of September 19, 2025, Ma Xiulan tidied up the tables and chairs in the courtyard at home, prepared tea and snacks, and placed the recently completed peony embroidery pieces and several jars of homemade pickled vegetables in prominent positions, making full preparations for the afternoon gathering with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Spending a craft afternoon with childhood friend Liu Chunmei
subevent.description: On the afternoon of September 19, 2025, Ma Xiulan hosted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei in the courtyard of her home. The two sat in the courtyard, studied new embroidery patterns together, and chatted about amusing recent events. Liu Chunmei brought some small crocheted coasters she had recently made to show, and Ma Xiulan shared the peony embroidery technique she had learned at the community salon. They drank tea while doing handicrafts, spending a leisurely three hours.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Seeing Off a Childhood Friend and Tidying Up
subevent.description: After the handicraft gathering ended on the afternoon of September 19, 2025, Ma Xiulan gave Liu Chunmei a few jars of homemade pickled vegetables and saw her out. Then Ma Xiulan returned to the courtyard, put away the tea set, snack plates, and craft materials, moved the tables and chairs back into place, and finished the wrap-up work for the day's gathering.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

name: Giving away pickled vegetables for tasting and collecting feedback.
description: On February 8, Ma Xiulan prepared small jars of pickled vegetables as sampling packages in her own kitchen. From February 10 to 12, she contacted three cousins' wives (Zhang Li, Wang Fang, Li Hong) one by one, delivered the samples to their homes, and discussed the flavor of the pickles. On February 14, she collected feedback by phone or WeChat; the cousins' wives were satisfied with the taste and promised to buy. She then organized the opinions and made a sales plan, feeling more confident about selling the pickles.

subevent.name: Prepare pickle tasting samples
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan made small-jar pickled vegetable tasting packs in her own kitchen. She used the pickled vegetables she had prepared earlier, divided them into several small jars, and put labels on them, intending to give them to relatives for tasting.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Contact cousin-in-law and give her a trial pack.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted a cousin's wife in her maternal uncle's family and, after arranging a time, visited her to give her a small jar of the pickled vegetables as a tasting sample, inviting her to share feedback after trying it.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - maternal uncle's home

subevent.name: Contact my cousin's wife and give her sample pack No. 2.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted another cousin's wife, visited her to give her sample packs, and talked about the flavors of the pickled vegetables.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - cousin-in-law's home

subevent.name: Contact her cousin's wife and give her sample pack 3.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted the third cousin-in-law, offered a complimentary sample, and introduced the pickling process.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - cousin-in-law's home

subevent.name: Collect tasting feedback on pickled vegetables
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan proactively asked the wives of several cousins by phone or WeChat for their evaluation and opinions on the taste of the pickled vegetables, collecting honest feedback. The cousins' wives said the taste was very good and were willing to buy them when she began selling them officially.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Organize feedback and formulate a sales plan.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan organized the feedback, summarized the strengths and areas for improvement, and gained confidence in selling the pickled vegetables, preparing to start formal production and sales.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Start a daily morning walking habit.
description: Starting March 1, Ma Xiulan realized she lacked exercise and decided to take a 15-minute walk every morning in the courtyard or on community paths to strengthen her body and relieve the pressure of family care. She has kept it up and gradually feels more energetic.

subevent.name: Habit initiation and adaptation period
subevent.description: Starting March 1, Ma Xiulan began a morning walking plan. She got up around 6:30 every day, put on comfortable sneakers, and walked for 15 minutes in her own yard or along the community paths on Jingwen Road. In the first week, she mainly adjusted her sleep schedule, overcame the difficulty of getting up early, and adapted to the new daily rhythm. During the walks, she observed the flowers and plants in the yard and the community environment, breathed in fresh air, and gradually felt more energetic after getting up early.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Started the first day of the morning walk plan
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of March 1, Ma Xiulan felt a little drowsy when woken by the alarm clock, but thinking of the new walking plan, she forced herself to get up and put on comfortable sneakers. She first walked slowly for a few minutes in her own courtyard, then walked along the community path on Jingwen Road for 15 minutes. The early spring morning air was slightly cool. She saw that the roses in the courtyard had sprouted new buds, and there were few pedestrians on the community path. She took a few deep breaths of fresh air and felt her mind gradually clear. After returning home, she felt the satisfaction of completing the plan.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Second day adjusting to the early morning routine.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on March 2, Ma Xiulan got up a little more easily than the previous morning. She quickly put on her sports shoes and went to the courtyard to take a walk. Today she deliberately took a detour to the eastern section of the community path and saw several willow trees that had already sprouted tender leaves. During the walk, she heard sparrows chirping and felt cheerful. After 15 minutes she returned home, feeling refreshed and much more awake than when she had just gotten up. She decided to continue with it the next day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Ran into a neighbor during an early morning walk.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 3 at 6:30, Ma Xiulan got up as planned and went for a walk. As soon as she stepped out of the courtyard gate, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan, who was also out early buying groceries. They chatted briefly; Wang Guilan learned she was exercising and praised her for being diligent. Ma Xiulan walked and talked, continuing along the community path for 15 minutes. Today's walk felt like it passed quickly because she had someone to chat with, and she felt that this kind of community interaction made getting up early more meaningful.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Energetic fifth day
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning on March 5, Ma Xiulan woke up naturally without needing an alarm clock. She put on her running shoes and took a brisk walk along the community path, feeling that her stamina had clearly improved—within 15 minutes her steps were more powerful than in the past few days. She found that she had more time after getting up early, and after returning home she prepared breakfast calmly. The children were also influenced by her and were in a good mood. She secretly resolved to keep up this good habit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Day 6 of consolidating the habit
subevent.description: At 6:30 on the morning of March 6, Ma Xiulan got up as usual and went out for a walk. The weather was fine, and sunlight spilled into the courtyard. As she walked, she admired the flowers and plants she had planted and pulled up a few weeds in passing. After the 15-minute walk, she felt refreshed and especially cheerful. She realized that this week's early-morning walks had gradually become part of her daily life and no longer felt like a chore.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Weekly habit summary
subevent.description: At 6:30 a.m. on March 7, Ma Xiulan completed her last morning walk of the week. She walked slowly for 15 minutes on the community path, reviewing the changes of the week: from initially struggling to get up to now waking up naturally, from feeling tired to feeling energized. The walk let her breathe fresh air, see the breath of spring in the courtyard and the community, and even run into a neighbor, which enhanced their communication. She decided to continue this plan in the coming days and gradually try to extend her walking time.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Habit consolidation and improvement phase
subevent.description: After the first week of adjustment, Ma Xiulan's morning walk had initially become part of her daily life. In the second and third weeks, she continued to stick to a 15-minute morning walk every day, sometimes trying to pick up her pace or add some simple stretches to improve the exercise effect. She found that she had more energy during daytime housework, and her mood became more stable, reducing the pressure of family care. During this period, she happened to meet her neighbor Wang Guilan while walking and had a brief chat, sharing the benefits of walking.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Resume morning walk (Week 2, Day 1)
subevent.description: At 7 a.m., Ma Xiulan did a simple warm-up in the courtyard outside her home (exercising her wrists, ankles, and waist), then began her morning walk along the paths of the Jingwen Road community, keeping the same pace as the first week for 15 minutes. She enjoyed the morning air during the walk, prepared breakfast after returning home, felt happy, and planned to keep it up.
subevent.location: Community path on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Routine morning walk (the middle days of the second week)
subevent.description: Between 6:40 and 7:00 a.m. on March 10, 12, and 14, Ma Xiulan did a brief warm-up at her front door, then walked along the community path for 15 minutes at a steady pace. After the walk, she returned home to prepare breakfast and felt more energetic during the day's housework and more emotionally stable, with less of the pressure of family caregiving.
subevent.location: Community path on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Try quickening your stride and stretching
subevent.description: On the morning of March 15, Ma Xiulan deliberately quickened her pace while walking, feeling her heartbeat slightly speed up and a light sweat on her forehead. After 15 minutes of walking, she added 5 minutes of simple stretching exercises in the courtyard, including leg stretches, chest openers, and waist twists, feeling the comfort of a stretched body. She decided to add intensity variations every other day from now on.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - small roads in Jingwen Road Community and the family courtyard

subevent.name: Encountered and chatted with neighbor Wang Guilan.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 17, while walking on the community path, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan (the neighbor across the hall), who was returning from buying groceries at the morning market. The two stopped at the intersection and chatted briefly. Ma Xiulan took the initiative to share that after two weeks of insisting on morning walks, she felt more energetic and emotionally stable. Wang Guilan said she also had the idea of becoming active in the morning. After chatting for about 5 minutes, each continued her own route.
subevent.location: Intersection of Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Morning walk on the last day of the consolidation period
subevent.description: On March 21, the last day of the habit consolidation and improvement period, Ma Xiulan got up early as usual. After warming up in the courtyard, she took a 15-minute walk along the community path. Along the way, she again tried to quicken her pace and add stretching movements, completing the full routine. After returning home, she reviewed her progress over the past two weeks, felt satisfied and proud, and planned to continue into the next stage.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - small roads in Jingwen Road Community and the family courtyard

subevent.name: Habit stability and end-of-month summary
subevent.description: In late March, Ma Xiulan's morning walk had become an automatic habit that required no reminder. On March 21, as usual, she walked along the community path on Jingwen Road and felt refreshed. On the evening of March 31, she reviewed her persistence throughout the month, felt improvements in both physical strength and spirit, and decided to maintain the habit long-term. She planned to listen to the radio or invite a neighbor to join her during walks next month, and to record her daily walks in her journal.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard or community paths.

subevent.name: Daily morning walk
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan woke up naturally at 6:30 in the morning. After washing up briefly, she put on her sneakers, left the house, and went to the path in the Jingwen Road community. She walked slowly along the familiar route, breathing in the fresh morning air and stretching her body's joints. By then, the sky was gradually brightening, and she occasionally met neighbors and greeted them. After walking for about 30 minutes, she returned home feeling refreshed. In the last week of March, this habit had become an automatic behavior requiring no reminder, and she went out for a walk at the same fixed time every day.
subevent.location: Community path on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: End-of-month review and habit consolidation summary
subevent.description: After dinner that evening, Ma Xiulan cleared the dining table, took out a brand-new journal, and sat on the living room sofa. She looked through the walking records marked on her phone calendar and reviewed her experience of sticking to morning walks throughout March. She wrote a summary: her physical fitness had improved noticeably—previously she would get winded climbing stairs, but now it felt much easier; she also felt more energetic and spirited throughout the day. She decided to keep this habit long-term and planned to listen to some radio programs during walks next month, or invite neighbors Wang Guilan or Liu Chunmei to join her for more fun. She also planned to briefly record the time, weather, and feelings in her journal after each walk to motivate herself to keep going.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: First trial batch of pickled vegetables: sought recipe advice, prepared the pickling, and successfully opened the jar.
description: On March 1, Ma Xiulan asked her neighbor Wang Guilan for pickled vegetable recipes and learned from short videos on her phone how to use the salt-dehydrating method to quickly remove the bitter taste of white radish. She then pickled them strictly according to the proportions. After two weeks of careful tending, she opened the jar on March 15. The pickled vegetables were salty, sour, sweet, and crisp. Her husband and father both praised them, saying “They are better than store-bought,” marking a solid first step for “Xiulan's Homemade Pickled Vegetables.”

subevent.name: Ask a neighbor for pickled vegetable recipes.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to the home of her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan, to ask for the traditional recipe for pickled vegetables. Wang Guilan explained in detail the proportions of seasonings such as salt, sugar, and soy sauce, as well as the key pickling steps, and shared a few tips she often used. Ma Xiulan carefully recorded the key points of the recipe on her phone and asked on the spot how to remove the astringent taste from white radish.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - neighbor's home

subevent.name: Purchase ingredients and start pickling.
subevent.description: After learning the recipe, Ma Xiulan returned home and used the salt-dewatering method she had learned from short videos on her phone to quickly remove the bitter taste from the white radish. She then prepared the pickling liquid strictly according to the proportions taught by Wang Guilan. She put the prepared white radish, carrot, and other vegetables into an earthen jar, poured in the mixed sauce, sealed the jar, and placed it in a cool, shaded spot, officially beginning the two-week pickling process.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Mid-term inspection and care of the pickled vegetables
subevent.description: On March 7, 2025, after the pickling had been going on for a week, Ma Xiulan opened the clay jar to check the pickled vegetables. She observed the color and smell, turned the vegetables with clean chopsticks to ensure they were evenly flavored, and adjusted the brine concentration as needed. After confirming everything was normal, she resealed the jar and continued pickling. During this time, she also wiped the rim of the jar to prevent bacterial contamination.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Prepare the items needed for opening the jar
subevent.description: On March 14, 2025, the pickling was nearing completion. Ma Xiulan prepared for the official opening of the jar the next day. She washed the porcelain plates and chopsticks, set out small tasting bowls, and notified her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her father Ma Jianguo to come to the house at noon the next day to taste the pickles. She also specially cleaned the kitchen and dining table, planning to serve the newly pickled vegetables as a side dish for lunch.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Open the jar and taste the pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: At noon on March 15, 2025, after the pickles had cured for two full weeks, Ma Xiulan officially opened the jar. When she lifted the lid of the clay jar, a rich savory aroma rushed out; the pickled vegetables were glossy in color and crisp in texture. She scooped out some for her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her father Ma Jianguo to taste. Both were full of praise, saying they were "better than store-bought." Ma Xiulan was delighted, and she packed the pickles into small portions, planning to give them to friends and relatives for tasting later, taking the first step for the "Xiulan Homemade Pickles" brand.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Contact the handicraft market to apply for a stall
description: On February 25, Ma Xiulan learned from Zhou Xiuqin that the Jinghai District would hold a spring handicraft market early next month. She proactively contacted the market organizers to ask about booth applications, filled out the registration form, and submitted an introduction to her pickled vegetable samples, waiting for the review result.

subevent.name: Contact the market organizer to inquire about stall applications.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, using the organizer's phone number provided by Zhou Xiuqin, proactively contacted the organizer of the Jinghai District Spring Handicraft Market to ask about the specific process for applying for a stall, fees, required materials, and the number of stalls. The organizer's staff gave detailed answers.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Filling out the stall application form and preparing the pickled vegetable sample introduction.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully filled out the stall registration form as required by the organizer, including basic personal information, stall needs, and products to exhibit. She also neatly arranged her homemade pickled vegetable samples and wrote a detailed introduction describing the product features, production process, and hygiene guarantees.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Submitted the materials for the stall application.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan emailed the completed application form and the pickle sample introduction materials to the email address designated by the market organizer, confirmed the email was sent successfully, and then waited for the organizer's review result notice.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Attended a community health clinic with a neighbor.
description: On the morning of May 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan at the entrance to her home and walked to the community square on Jingwen Road to take part in a free health clinic held by the Community Health Service Center. At the clinic site on the square, community doctor Wang Jianguo measured Ma Xiulan's blood pressure (118/76mmHg) and random blood glucose (5.6mmol/L), both within the normal range. Dr. Wang also gave advice on diet and exercise, encouraging her to take her family outdoors more often. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask about the benefits of homemade yogurt; Dr. Wang affirmed her practice and suggested eating it with coarse grains. The clinic made her pay more attention to her family's health and strengthened her confidence in making yogurt at home.

subevent.name: Agree to meet and go to the free clinic site
subevent.description: Early in the morning of May 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan at her doorstep. Chatting as they walked, the two headed to Jingwen Road Community Square to attend the free health clinic held by the community health service center.
subevent.location: Home at Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and on the road to the community square.

subevent.name: Participate in health check-up and consultation
subevent.description: On the morning of May 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan and her neighbor Wang Guilan were together at the free clinic station in the Jingwen Road Community Square. Community doctor Wang Jianguo measured Ma Xiulan's blood pressure (118/76 mmHg) and random blood glucose (5.6 mmol/L), and both results were normal. Dr. Wang proactively gave advice on diet and exercise, encouraging her to take her family outdoors more often. Ma Xiulan took the opportunity to ask about the benefits of homemade yogurt. Dr. Wang affirmed her approach and suggested eating it with coarse grains.
subevent.location: Free clinic site at Jingwen Road Community Square, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Adjust the family monthly budget
description: After paying the medical insurance fee, Ma Xiulan adjusted the monthly budget at home, listing the medical insurance expense as a fixed expenditure, and calculated that next month's pickled vegetable income should be used to make up for it first. During dinner, she mentioned this to her husband Ma Zhiqiang. He nodded in agreement and volunteered to smoke one fewer carton of cigarettes next month to save money. She smiled and noted it down as a to-do.

subevent.name: Organize the family's monthly income and expenses.
subevent.description: After paying the medical insurance premium, Ma Xiulan opened her account book on the dining table at home, checked the month's expenses and income one by one, formally classified the medical insurance payment as a rigid expenditure, and calculated the expected income from next month's pickle sales so as to prioritize making up this expense.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Had dinner with my husband and discussed the budget.
subevent.description: During dinner, Ma Xiulan set the table and mentioned to her husband Ma Zhiqiang the decision to adjust this month's medical insurance spending, and the plan to make up the shortfall with next month's pickled vegetable income. Ma Zhiqiang nodded in agreement and volunteered to smoke one fewer carton of cigarettes next month to save money. Ma Xiulan smiled and noted it as a to-do.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Used shepherd's purse to steam balls to give to neighbors, and came up with a plan to grow wild vegetables.
description: On April 6, Ma Xiulan used the leftover shepherd's purse to steam shepherd's purse dumplings and gave them to neighbors Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen to taste. Wang Guilan gave back a bag of eggs from her own chickens and sighed, "The older generation really knows how to eat." Inspired, Ma Xiulan decided to set aside a corner of the courtyard next year to try growing seasonal wild vegetables such as shepherd's purse and purslane, which would save money and add flavor. That evening, she wrote "Next Year's Wild Vegetable Plan" in her account book.

subevent.name: Prepare and steam shepherd's purse balls
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used the leftover shepherd's purse at home and, in the kitchen of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, washed and chopped it one by one, then mixed and stirred it with flour, seasonings, and other ingredients, and finally steamed a tray of shepherd's purse balls as a snack for her neighbors to try.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Give shepherd's purse dumplings to neighbor Wang Guilan
subevent.description: After steaming the shepherd's purse dumplings, Ma Xiulan arranged them on a plate and went to the home of her neighbor across the hall, Wang Guilan (No. 158 Jingwen Road). She gave the dumplings to Wang Guilan to taste and exchanged a few pleasantries about daily life.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Wang Guilan's home

subevent.name: Gave shepherd's purse balls to neighbor Zhang Shufen
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan then also took a portion of shepherd's purse dumplings and went to Shufen Convenience Store (154 Jingwen Road), run by her neighbor Zhang Shufen across the street, to ask Zhang Shufen to taste them and share her experience in making shepherd's purse dumplings.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Shufen Convenience Supermarket

subevent.name: Received eggs from Wang Guilan as a gift in return and felt inspired.
subevent.description: Wang Guilan was very happy to receive the shepherd's purse balls and gave Ma Xiulan a bag of eggs from her own chickens in return, remarking, 'The older generation really knows what's good to eat.' Inspired by this, Ma Xiulan immediately came up with the idea of setting aside a corner of her courtyard next year to try growing seasonal wild vegetables such as shepherd's purse and purslane, thinking that it would both save money and add flavor.
subevent.location: In front of Wang Guilan's house, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Recording next year's wild vegetable plan in the ledger
subevent.description: After returning home that evening, Ma Xiulan took out the family account book, wrote "Next Year's Wild Vegetable Plan" below the day's entry, and briefly noted the types of wild vegetables she planned to plant (shepherd's purse, purslane) and the approximate location in the courtyard corner, as a reminder.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Take the children to the amusement park on Children's Day.
description: On June 1, Children's Day, Ma Xiulan took her three children to a small amusement park in Jinghai Town with the 200 yuan she had saved from earlier pickle-making and embroidery work. The children played on the inflatable castle, bumper cars, and a small roller coaster. She bought a bubble machine, watched the children run in the sunshine, and dozed off for a while on a bench. When she got home in the evening, she found more than thirty smiling photos on her phone.

subevent.name: Prepare items for the amusement park trip.
subevent.description: On the morning of Children's Day, June 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared the snacks, water, wet wipes, and change needed for the amusement park at home, then woke the three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to wash up and change clothes, and gave instructions on things to note for the outing.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Led the children to the amusement park in Jinghai Town.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan walked from home with her three children and reached a small amusement park in Jinghai Town. On the way, she reminded the children to be careful and bought tickets at the entrance.
subevent.location: Small amusement park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Accompanying the children on amusement rides
subevent.description: At the amusement park, Ma Xiulan accompanied the three children as they experienced the inflatable castle, bumper cars, and the small roller coaster one by one. The children had a great time, and Ma Xiulan watched over them and took photos.
subevent.location: Small amusement park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Buy a bubble machine and rest.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used 200 yuan she had saved in small change to buy a bubble machine and handed it to the kids to play with. While the children chased bubbles in the sun, Ma Xiulan sat on a bench in the amusement park and dozed off briefly, enjoying a moment of peace.
subevent.location: Small amusement park, Jinghai Town, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Take the children home in the evening
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan gathered the children, tidied up their belongings, and walked back home. After arriving, she checked her phone and found that she had taken more than thirty photos of the children’s smiling faces that day, and felt very content.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Second son's vision recheck showed his prescription had worsened; replace with new lenses.
description: On September 11, Ma Xiulan took her second son Ma Mingzhe to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center for a vision recheck and found that his myopia had worsened from 100 degrees to 150 degrees. Doctor Wang Jianguo advised replacing the lenses and strictly controlling the use of electronic devices. She felt very guilty and immediately had new glasses made at the clinic's attached counter. After returning home, she implemented an eye-care plan together with her son.

subevent.name: Preparing and Heading to the Community Clinic
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan reminded her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to bring his previous vision examination records, and they walked together to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District. Along the way, she told her son to cooperate with the doctor during the examination.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Vision recheck and doctor's diagnosis.
subevent.description: At the community health service center, Dr. Wang gave Ma Mingzhe a thorough eye examination, which showed his myopia had increased from 100 to 150 degrees. Dr. Wang advised replacing the lenses immediately and strictly limiting screen time, and explained eye care precautions to Ma Xiulan. Ma Xiulan felt very guilty and carefully noted every piece of advice from the doctor.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Get new glasses.
subevent.description: Following Dr. Wang's advice, Ma Xiulan immediately went to the eyewear counter attached to the community health service center and selected new lenses for Ma Mingzhe (150 degrees). She completed the eye exam, payment, and lens pickup on the spot, and confirmed that the new lenses were comfortable to wear.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Go home and put the eye care plan into action.
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan and Ma Mingzhe wrote the doctor's instructions on a sticky note and put it by the desk, adjusted the desk lamp position and the reading distance, set daily limits on TV and phone use, and agreed to spend half an hour doing outdoor activities in the neighborhood every evening from now on.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Chunmei set up consignment sales at the supermarket, with handwritten labels testing the market for the first time.
description: On March 17, Liu Chunmei contacted Ma Xiulan via WeChat and suggested selling Ma Xiulan's homemade pickled vegetables on consignment at the Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District where she worked. After the two settled the details over the phone, Ma Xiulan prepared five jars of pickled vegetables and hand-wrote 'Guilan Sauce Garden' labels. Liu Chunmei then spoke with the store manager, Zhang Jianmin, received permission for consignment, and notified Ma Xiulan. That afternoon, Ma Xiulan took the labeled pickled vegetables to the supermarket, confirmed the selling price and commission split with the manager in person, and placed the jars on the shelves in the condiment section, officially entering the trial sales stage.

subevent.name: Liu Chunmei and Ma Xiulan discuss the consignment plan.
subevent.description: On the morning of March 17, Ma Xiulan's childhood friend Liu Chunmei contacted Ma Xiulan via WeChat and suggested trying to place her homemade pickled vegetables on consignment at the Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District where she worked, in order to increase the family income. The two discussed the consignment details over the phone, including quantity, pricing, and packaging labels. Ma Xiulan agreed and decided to prepare 5 jars for a trial sale first.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Ma Xiulan's home (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan delivered the pickled vegetables to the supermarket and put them on the shelves.
subevent.description: After receiving notice from Liu Chunmei confirming that the consignment was successful, Ma Xiulan packed the 5 jars of pickled vegetables with handwritten labels into a basket and walked to Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District. Guided by Liu Chunmei, she confirmed the consignment details (selling price, commission split, etc.) face to face with store manager Zhang Jianmin, and placed the pickled vegetables on the shelf in the supermarket's condiment section, officially entering the trial sales stage.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Condiment section, Hualian Supermarket, Jinghai District

name: Starting the family video documentation plan
description: Since February, Ma Xiulan has consciously used her old camera to record daily life, capturing scenes such as the children playing, cooking, and interactions with neighbors. She sorts and saves them into the photo folders she created last month, accumulating material for making a photo album at the end of the year.

subevent.name: Check the camera and create folders
subevent.description: At home on No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan took out an old digital camera that had been idle for a long time from the storage cabinet, checked the battery level, memory card space, and whether the functions were working properly, and after confirming everything was fine, she charged it for later use. She then opened the main folder “2025 Family Album” created last January on the computer, confirmed that subfolders such as “Children Growing Up,” “Home Cooking,” and “Neighborhood Daily Life” already existed, and got everything ready for organized saving later.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home

subevent.name: Filming the children playing at home
subevent.description: At home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan took the opportunity while her three children (eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin) were playing and doing homework in the living room to use an old camera to capture natural moments of them interacting. She focused on recording the scene of her second son Ma Mingzhe and his younger sister Ma Yuxin building blocks together, as well as the back view of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan concentrating on his studies at the desk. After taking the photos, she briefly checked the results and put the camera back on its charging dock.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home

subevent.name: Shooting cooking and family food scenes
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan was in the kitchen of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, preparing dinner for the family (noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin). She turned on the camera, set it up on the kitchen counter, and from kneading the dough and rolling it out to making the gravy and frying the tenderloin, she filmed close-ups of the steps in stages, recording her careful cooking process. Her daughter Ma Yuxin ran into the kitchen to help pass ingredients and was also captured in the photos. After dinner, she also took several photos of the whole family sitting around the table eating warmly.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Filming neighbor interactions
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took her camera and left home. Near No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan (from across the hall), who was picking vegetables, and the two chatted about daily life. Ma Xiulan took out her camera and, with Wang Guilan's consent, photographed the two of them sitting on small stools by the door, picking vegetables and chatting. She then went diagonally across to Zhang Shufen's convenience store, filmed Zhang Shufen tidying the shelves, and had a brief chat. After returning home, she imported the photos into her computer and filed them under the 'Neighborhood Daily Life' folder.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home and community supermarket

subevent.name: Filming household chores and daily vegetable garden life
subevent.description: In the small vegetable garden in the backyard of her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan watered and loosened the soil for the cold-hardy winter vegetables (such as spinach and cilantro). She asked her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to take a photo of her back as she worked. Afterward, she went inside and recorded moments of housework such as wiping furniture, tidying the children's books, and tending to her hand embroidery. She also handed the camera to her daughter, Ma Yuxin, and taught her to press the shutter to take a family portrait. These photos were then sorted and saved into corresponding folders.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home and backyard vegetable garden

subevent.name: Sorting and Selecting Photos at the End of the Month
subevent.description: At her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan imported all the photos taken in February from the camera to the computer, browsed them one by one, and deleted blurry and duplicate photos. Then she dragged the acceptable photos into pre-categorized folders such as 'Children Growing Up', 'Family Food', 'Neighborhood Daily Life', and 'Housework and Vegetable Garden'. She also created a text file in each folder briefly recording the shooting date and the little stories behind the photos, for preliminary organization in making a family album at the end of the year.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Home

name: Printed out amusement park photos and put them in the photo album; second son made a heartwarming promise.
description: On June 2, Ma Xiulan imported the amusement park photos into her computer and specially selected three to print: her second son laughing heartily while driving a bumper car and Xinxin hugging bubbles. She pasted them into the photo album. That evening, her younger son whispered, [Mom, when I grow up and earn money, I'll take you on the Ferris wheel]. She smiled and hugged her son. For a while afterward, the children studied with extra effort, as if saving up their strength to fulfill that promise, adding a few bright touches to her exhausting days mid-year.

subevent.name: Putting photos into the album and a heartwarming promise to her second son
subevent.description: On the evening of June 2, Ma Xiulan was in the living room pasting three printed photos into the family album. During that time, her second son Ma Mingzhe whispered to her, "Mom, when I grow up and earn money, I'll take you to ride the Ferris wheel." Ma Xiulan smiled and hugged her son; the scene was warm.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: The children are in a stage of studying hard because of their commitment.
subevent.description: From June 3 to June 14, Ma Xiulan's three children — eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin — were motivated by the heartwarming promise and were especially self-disciplined and hardworking in their studies. Ma Mingxuan proactively completed his middle school homework and reviewed math; Ma Mingzhe conquered English vocabulary with his elder brother's guidance; Ma Yuxin showed a positive learning attitude in kindergarten and was praised by her teacher. On June 14, Ma Xiulan held a family summary meeting, affirmed the children's efforts, and announced that the promised Beijing trip would soon be fulfilled, bringing this phase to a successful close.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin – home and schools.

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan encouraged the children and reaffirmed her promise.
subevent.description: At 6:50 in the morning, Ma Xiulan had breakfast ready at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and called the three children to the table. While serving them porridge, she gently brought up the warm promise the whole family had made earlier—if the children studied hard, she would take them on a trip to Beijing. She smiled and reminded Xuanxuan (Ma Mingxuan), Zhezhe (Ma Mingzhe), and Xinxin (Ma Yuxin) to keep their word and work hard starting today. The three children all nodded in agreement, and the atmosphere at the table was pleasant and positive. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan walked them to school, giving each of them a separate reminder.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Ma Mingxuan finished his middle school homework on his own and reviewed math
subevent.description: After school in the afternoon, Ma Mingxuan did not go out to play as usual. Instead, he went back to his room on his own, put down his schoolbag, and immediately took out his middle school math homework to start working on it. He carefully worked through each geometry problem; when he encountered something he did not understand, he first tried repeatedly on scrap paper, and only asked his mother if he truly could not solve it. Ma Xiulan was collecting clothes in the yard. Hearing her son ask for help, she felt very pleased. At about 7 p.m., Ma Mingxuan not only finished all of that day's homework, but also spent an extra half hour reviewing math definitions and formulas, and put together his own notes on wrong problems.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Ma Yuxin was praised by her teacher at kindergarten
subevent.description: At 5 p.m., Ma Xiulan went to a kindergarten in Jinghai District to pick up her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin. The class teacher, Ms. Zhang, took Ma Xiulan aside and said with a smile that Xinxin had done especially well today: she had concentrated on completing a collage in the arts and crafts class and took the initiative to help the teacher clear the dishes at lunch. Ma Yuxin proudly held up her work and told her mother that this was a gift for her. Ma Xiulan squatted down, kissed her daughter on the cheek, felt warm inside, and walked home happily with her daughter.
subevent.location: Outside a kindergarten classroom in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to tutor his younger brother Ma Mingzhe on his English homework.
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan was preparing dinner in the kitchen. Ma Mingzhe was in the living room with his English textbook, worrying over the words. Ma Mingxuan voluntarily put down his own book, sat next to his younger brother, and patiently taught him to read the words aloud, even making up a jingle to help him remember. Ma Mingzhe followed his older brother and read five or six times, finally able to read all the words correctly. When Ma Xiulan brought out the dishes and saw the brothers' harmonious scene, she was very happy and deliberately gave each of them an extra piece of fruit as a reward.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan and the children summarize the week's learning achievements.
subevent.description: On Saturday morning, Ma Xiulan had no other activities planned, so she called the three children together for a simple family review meeting. She asked each of them to talk about the one thing they had worked hardest on that week. Ma Mingxuan showed his wrong-answer notebook, Ma Mingzhe produced an all-correct mental arithmetic card, and Ma Yuxin performed a nursery rhyme she had learned in kindergarten. Ma Xiulan praised each of them and again stressed that as long as they kept going until June 15, they would plan the details of a trip to Beijing together. The children were greatly encouraged and said they would continue to work hard next Monday.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: On the phase-end day, Ma Xiulan affirmed the children's efforts and gave them encouragement.
subevent.description: On Sunday evening, after finishing the kitchen cleanup, Ma Xiulan called the children into the living room and said to them solemnly: 'You've all done it over these thirteen days, and Mom is very satisfied.' She took out a pre-written promise card that read 'Beijing Trip Plan · To be fulfilled soon' and asked each child to sign their name on it. The children cheered and jumped for joy. Ma Xiulan then called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, shared the children's performance, and decided to discuss the specific travel date when her husband had his next day off. This phase of effort ended happily in a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Made a summer vacation plan and gave the second son remedial education for his negligent watering.
description: On July 1, the first day of summer vacation, Ma Xiulan wrote on the small blackboard in the living room the rules: "study for two hours every day, do housework for one hour, and work in the vegetable garden for one hour." She assigned specific tasks to her three children: her eldest son Ma Mingxuan was responsible for weeding the courtyard roses, her second son Ma Mingzhe was to record the cucumber watering and check whether the soil was dry or wet, and her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin was to tidy up toys and wipe the table. On the afternoon of July 4, she found that the cucumber vine leaves were wilted and the soil was cracked. Because the second son had been too busy playing and forgot to water, he squatted in the corner and cried with guilt. Ma Xiulan did not scold him. She took his hand, carried a bucket with him, and watered the plants together. As she watered, she said, "Plants, like people, must be treated with care; just remember next time." After the remedy, the cucumbers recovered their spirit the next day. The second son drew a cucumber in his diary and wrote, "Must not forget."

subevent.name: Make a summer plan and assign tasks
subevent.description: On July 1, the first day of summer vacation, Ma Xiulan wrote the summer rules on the small blackboard in the living room: two hours of study, one hour of housework, and one hour of vegetable garden work each day, and assigned specific tasks to the three children. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was responsible for weeding the roses in the courtyard; the second son, Ma Mingzhe, was responsible for recording cucumber watering and checking soil moisture; the youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, was responsible for tidying toys and wiping the table.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Discovering the watering oversight and making up for it as a teaching moment
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 4, Ma Xiulan was checking the vegetable garden when she found the cucumber vine leaves wilted and the soil cracked. The reason was that her second son, Ma Mingzhe, had forgotten to water them because he was too busy playing. Ma Mingzhe squatted in the corner, crying with guilt. Ma Xiulan did not scold him. She took his hand and carried a bucket to water the plants together. While watering, she taught him that crops, like people, should be tended with care, and that he should just remember next time.
subevent.location: Courtyard vegetable garden at home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Cucumber plant recovery and the second son's diary
subevent.description: On July 5, after the supplementary watering the day before, the cucumber vines revived and their leaves unfolded. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, drew the cucumber in his diary and wrote “Never forget” to remember the lesson from this oversight.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: First batch of Xiulan's handmade pickles made in bulk, stocking up for the market
description: On receiving the stall approval notice, Ma Xiulan immediately bought white radish, cucumber and other ingredients along with sealed jars, and on March 24 started batch pickling the first 20 jars of pickled vegetables. She strictly followed the already successfully tested recipe, and had her second son help put on handwritten labels. The pickling cycle was about 5 days, during which she checked fermentation daily to ensure quality, moving the pickled vegetable sideline from trial production to small-scale production.

subevent.name: Purchasing ingredients and airtight jars
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, bought fresh vegetables such as white radishes and cucumbers from Aunt Sun's stall, and bought 20 airtight jars at a nearby supermarket to prepare supplies for pickling vegetables in batches.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Starting the pickling and applying labels.
subevent.description: In the kitchen at home, Ma Xiulan strictly followed the successfully tested recipe to process the ingredients and mix the sauce, pickling and sealing 20 jars of pickled vegetables. At the same time, she asked her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to handwrite 'Xiulan's Handmade Pickles' and flavor labels with a marker and stick them onto each sealed jar.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Check the fermentation progress every day.
subevent.description: During the pickling period, Ma Xiulan checked the fermentation status of the 20 jars of pickled vegetables at fixed times every day, observing the color, smell, and any abnormalities, turning the jars when necessary to ensure even flavor, and recording the fermentation progress to ensure quality met the standard.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Completed the pickling and packaging.
subevent.description: At the end of the pickling cycle, Ma Xiulan opened each sealed jar one by one to check the color and texture of the finished product. After confirming they were up to standard, she resealed the pickled vegetables in jars, tidied the labels, and neatly arranged them in the storage room to prepare for the market sale.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home storage room
