name: Soaking feet in mugwort water before bed to relieve fatigue
description: On August 19, neighbor Wang Guilan gave mugwort to Ma Xiulan, who was suffering from sore waist and tired legs due to overwork. Starting that evening, Ma Xiulan tried soaking her feet for 15 minutes in hot water with mugwort before bed. After persisting for several days, on August 26 she made it a regular evening habit. She felt that her sleep quality had noticeably improved and she had more energy during the day.

subevent.name: Receive mugwort given by a neighbor
subevent.description: When the neighbor Wang Guilan learned that Ma Xiulan had a sore back and tired legs from housework and accompanying her husband on his truck runs, she took the initiative to bring over a bundle of mugwort leaves she had dried at home, suggesting she use it when soaking her feet. Ma Xiulan accepted the mugwort at her front door and thanked her neighbor for her concern.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Try soaking the feet in mugwort before bedtime.
subevent.description: Every night before bed, Ma Xiulan soaked her feet in hot water in her home bathroom for 15 minutes, adding a little mugwort to the water to ease lower back soreness and leg fatigue. She felt relaxed, and her sleep quality improved. She kept doing this every day and observed the effects.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home bathroom

subevent.name: Fixed habit of soaking feet in mugwort water before bed
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan made it a daily habit to soak her feet for 15 minutes every night before bed in hot water with mugwort, continuing to do this in the bathroom at home. She felt that her sleep quality had improved significantly and she had more energy during the day, so she planned to keep it up long term.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home bathroom

name: Homemade yogurt improves the family's health
description: On May 15, after learning about the benefits of yogurt probiotics on a TV health program, Ma Xiulan decided to make homemade yogurt to improve her family's health. On May 20, she used the money she had saved from selling pickled vegetables to buy a yogurt maker and starter culture powder online. On May 22, after receiving the package, she made yogurt for the first time according to the instructions. After 8 hours of fermentation, it succeeded. The whole family enjoyed it, and her youngest daughter said she would be willing to drink it every day.

subevent.name: Watching a health program to learn about the benefits of yogurt
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan watched a health program on TV in the living room. The program explained in detail the benefits of probiotics in yogurt for gut health. Thinking of her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin's occasional constipation, she decided to try making homemade yogurt to improve the family's gut health.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Buy a yogurt maker and yogurt starter powder online
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used the small change she had saved from selling pickled vegetables to order a home yogurt maker and several packets of yogurt starter powder through the Taobao shopping app on her phone, preparing the equipment and ingredients for making homemade yogurt.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Sign for the yogurt maker delivery.
subevent.description: The courier delivered the package containing the yogurt maker and starter culture powder to Ma Xiulan's home. She signed for it at the door, opened the package, and carefully checked that the yogurt maker was intact, the accessories were all complete, and the starter powder packaging was undamaged.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - at the door of home.

subevent.name: First time making yogurt.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan cleaned the inner pot of the yogurt maker according to the manual, made the first batch of yogurt with fresh milk and starter culture, and succeeded after fermenting for 8 hours. She had her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin taste it. The whole family loved it, especially the youngest daughter, who said she would be willing to drink it every day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Attending the wedding of my husband's distant younger male cousin
description: On May 24, Ma Xiulan's family of four went to Hedong District, Tianjin, to attend the wedding of her husband's distant cousin. She dug out her floral-print dress from the bottom of the chest and made an exception by having her husband take a taxi there. At the wedding banquet, she sat at a table with her sisters-in-law, chatting as they ate about how the children in each family were doing. She also quietly compared the dishes, thinking, 'This sweet-and-sour pork is not as good as what I make.' During the meal, her husband was dragged away to help with the drinking toasts and came back with a red face. She handed him a cup of hangover-relief tea and muttered, 'Drink less; you have to drive out again tomorrow.' This wedding made her feel the warmth among relatives, and she also privately calculated the expenses of social reciprocity.

subevent.name: Pre-wedding preparations and departure
subevent.description: On the morning of May 24, Ma Xiulan dug out her favorite floral print dress from the bottom of the wardrobe and put it on, carefully combed her hair, and paired it with clean cloth shoes. Then she urged her husband Ma Zhiqiang to change into a clean shirt and helped their 13-year-old elder son Ma Mingxuan and 10-year-old younger son Ma Mingzhe tidy their clothes. Since the family had no car, Ma Xiulan made an exception and had her husband call a taxi on his phone. The family of four set off from their home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and went to Hedong District, Tianjin, to attend the wedding of her husband's distant cousin.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Arrived at the wedding venue and gave a monetary gift
subevent.description: After the taxi arrived at the wedding banquet venue of a hotel in Hedong District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan's family signed in at the reception area. Ma Xiulan took out a red envelope containing cash that she had prepared in advance from her small handbag and handed it to her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who personally gave it to her cousin's family and expressed congratulations. Then the family of four followed the signs to find their seats. Ma Xiulan sat at the same table with several sisters-in-law and other female relatives, chatting and exchanging greetings.
subevent.location: Hotel wedding banquet hall, Hedong District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Wedding banquet dining and socializing
subevent.description: After the wedding banquet officially began, Ma Xiulan chatted with her sisters-in-law at the same table while eating, with topics revolving around the children's academic performance and recent life events. She quietly compared the dishes on the table, especially feeling that the sweet and sour pork was not as tasty as the one she usually made. During the meal, her husband Ma Zhiqiang was pulled away by other relatives to help with toasts. When he came back with a red face, Ma Xiulan immediately handed him a cup of sobering tea and quietly urged him to drink less, since he had to drive for the transport business the next day. The two sons ate quietly and occasionally played with other children. The whole meal lasted about two hours, with a warm and lively atmosphere.
subevent.location: Hotel wedding banquet hall, Hedong District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Return home after the wedding.
subevent.description: After the wedding banquet, Ma Xiulan's family briefly said goodbye to the bride and groom and their relatives, offering their blessings. Then Ma Xiulan called another taxi, and the family of four returned from Hedong District, Tianjin, to their home in Jinghai District. On the way, Ma Xiulan and her husband discussed the details of the wedding and remarked on the warmth among relatives. By the time they arrived home it was already afternoon. Ma Xiulan changed into house clothes and prepared to start her daily chores.
subevent.location: Tianjin Hedong District to Jinghai District - inside the taxi and at home

subevent.name: After returning home, she calculated her social gift expenses.
subevent.description: After returning home and settling the two children, Ma Xiulan sat down in the living room with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She took out the accounting book and a pen and carefully calculated the social expenses: this time they had given 300 yuan as a cash gift, plus about 80 yuan for round-trip taxi fare, for a total expense of nearly 400 yuan. Ma Xiulan told her husband that they should also be more frugal next month. Although spending money on these social obligations pained her, it was necessary to keep in touch with relatives. After discussing, the two recorded this expense in the family ledger and also planned to reduce non-essential spending in the near future.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Took her children back to her parents' home to visit her parents.
description: On the afternoon of July 7, Ma Xiulan called her mother Li Xiuying to say she planned to bring her three children to visit her parents' home the next day. On the morning of July 8, Ma Xiulan took the children by bus to her parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District. Her mother had prepared fruit and snacks, and her father was repairing a small stool. Ma Xiulan helped in the kitchen and learned to make cold noodles with sauce. The family had lunch together. When they left in the afternoon, her mother gave the children red envelopes. After returning home, Ma Xiulan kept accounts and planned to buy autumn clothes for her parents.

subevent.name: Informed her parents of the planned visit in advance.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 7, Ma Xiulan called her mother Li Xiuying to tell her that she planned to take her three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) to visit her parents at Shengli Street in Jinghai District on the morning of July 8. Li Xiuying was very happy, said she would prepare fruit and snacks, and her father Ma Jianguo also said he would fix the small bench.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Prepare items for going out.
subevent.description: Around 7 a.m. on July 8, Ma Xiulan was at home on Jingwen Road, organizing the children's clothes and things for going out, and took along some homemade pickled vegetables as small gifts. She reminded the children to put on their shoes properly, confirmed the bus route and schedule, and then left with the three children.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Take the bus to parents' home
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took her three children on a bus within Jinghai District, boarding at Jingwen Road Station and getting off at Shengli Street Station. The children chatted excitedly along the way, and Ma Xiulan reminded them to behave politely at their grandmother's house. The bus ride took about 20 minutes.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - on a bus

subevent.name: Arrived at parents' home and interacted.
subevent.description: At about 9:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan's family arrived at her parents' home at 45 Shengli Street. Her mother, Li Xiuying, had already prepared watermelon, grapes, and snacks, and her father, Ma Jianguo, was repairing a broken little stool in the yard. The children ran into the yard to play, while Ma Xiulan went inside to help her mother wash vegetables and prepare lunch. Her mother, Li Xiuying, taught her how to make a cold noodle dish she had just learned, and the two chatted about family matters as they cooked.
subevent.location: Parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: The whole family had lunch together.
subevent.description: Around 12 noon, Ma Xiulan and her mother Li Xiuying prepared lunch, including the newly learned cold noodles with sauce, stir-fried greens, and tomato and egg soup. The whole family sat around the dining table to eat. Her father Ma Jianguo praised the cold noodles, and the children also ate happily. During the meal, they talked about the children's studies and recent life.
subevent.location: Parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Received a red envelope when saying goodbye.
subevent.description: Around 3 p.m., Ma Xiulan was about to leave with the children. Her mother, Li Xiuying, took out three red envelopes and tucked one into each of her grandchildren's hands (200 yuan per envelope). Ma Xiulan declined, saying, 'Mom, don't spend the money,' but her mother insisted on giving them. Ma Xiulan had no choice but to accept, silently noting to quickly buy autumn clothes for her parents with this money—some practical clothing.
subevent.location: Parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Take the bus back home.
subevent.description: At 3:30 p.m., Ma Xiulan took the children to the bus stop on Shengli Street and took the bus back to Jingwen Road. On the bus, the children played with red envelopes, and Ma Xiulan reminded them not to lose them. They arrived home about 20 minutes later.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - on a bus

subevent.name: Bookkeeping and planning after returning home
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan recorded the red envelope money she had received into the family expense ledger at her home on Jingwen Road, and planned to go to the clothing market in Jinghai District soon to choose autumn clothing for her parents. She told the children not to waste the red envelope money and to be grateful.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: 41st birthday: a modest celebration with a potted plant from her husband and cards from the children
description: On September 12, Ma Xiulan's birthday happened to fall on a Thursday. She went about her household chores as usual, not expecting any special celebration. In the evening, her husband came back early from driving and brought home a potted fuchsia, saying, "This flower is like the ponytail you tie up when working." The three children teamed up to draw a 3D greeting card, and the second son folded three paper roses following an online tutorial. Holding the flowerpot, she took a photo in the courtyard and posted on Moments that evening: "At 41 years old, there are flowers in the yard, food in the bowl, and you by my side."

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan handled daily household chores.
subevent.description: As usual, Ma Xiulan got up early to prepare breakfast for the whole family. After sending the three children to school, she cleaned the house, tidied the courtyard, and tended the small vegetable garden, spending the ordinary yet fulfilling Thursday morning of her 41st birthday.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Husband bought a birthday potted plant.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan's husband, Ma Zhiqiang, ended his work early that day. On his way home after returning the vehicle, he made a special trip to a flower shop in Jinghai District and carefully chose a potted fuchsia plant as a birthday gift for his wife. He thought of how Ma Xiulan usually wore her hair in a ponytail and felt the flower's temperament suited her well.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Flower shop

subevent.name: Children making pop-up greeting cards
subevent.description: After school in the afternoon, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin made a birthday card for their mother at home. Ma Mingzhe folded 3 paper roses following an online tutorial, Ma Mingxuan drew the card background and wrote the blessing message, and Ma Yuxin helped with coloring and pasting. Together, the three of them completed a three-dimensional greeting card full of childlike charm.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Evening birthday celebration and group photo
subevent.description: In the early evening, Ma Zhiqiang arrived home early, holding a potted fuchsia plant for Ma Xiulan, and the three children also presented handmade pop-up greeting cards. Ma Xiulan was pleasantly surprised. Holding the flowerpot, she took photos in the yard to remember the occasion, and then the family sat around together for dinner, celebrating her 41st birthday simply and warmly.
subevent.location: Home and courtyard at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Posting a birthday update on Moments
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan posted a commemorative photo from her birthday on her personal WeChat Moments (a photo of herself holding a flowerpot in the courtyard), with the caption, “41 years old, flowers in the yard, rice in the bowl, and you by my side,” expressing her gratitude for family happiness and the company of loved ones.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Husband performed full maintenance on the truck and established a pre-trip inspection habit.
description: Encouraged by the successful annual inspection, on July 20 her husband took the initiative to perform a full maintenance on the truck, changing the engine oil and brake pads. Ma Xiulan reminded him to add a vehicle fire extinguisher and a first-aid kit. She organized the vehicle documents into a transparent file folder and attached a label. After that, before each trip, her husband would voluntarily check the vehicle's condition, and Ma Xiulan occasionally helped verify. This annual inspection experience brought the couple into closer collaboration on the core safeguard of the family economy.

subevent.name: Establish a daily habit of checking before setting out.
subevent.description: Starting July 21, Ma Xiulan's husband Ma Zhiqiang would consciously check the condition of the truck before every trip, including tire pressure, engine oil level, brake response, lights, and the locations of the fire extinguisher and first-aid kit. Occasionally, Ma Xiulan would help check that the documents in the document bag were complete before he left, and remind him to pay attention to the weather and road conditions. This habit continued until the end of 2025, becoming a fixed collaborative routine for the couple to keep the family's transportation income safe.
subevent.location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and truck parking spot

subevent.name: After the rain, helped check the windshield wipers and tires.
subevent.description: On September 20, 2025, after several days of continuous rain, Ma Xiulan was worried that wet roads might affect driving safety, so she took the initiative to walk over to the truck to help Ma Zhiqiang with the inspection. Ma Zhiqiang focused on testing the wipers' wiping effect and the headlights' penetration, while Ma Xiulan squatted down to check tire tread depth and tire pressure, and used a flashlight to inspect the chassis for abnormal wear. The two cooperated seamlessly. After confirming that the vehicle was suitable for driving in the rainy weather, Ma Xiulan watched Ma Zhiqiang drive away.
subevent.location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and truck parking spot

subevent.name: Winter departure preparations and vehicle inspection
subevent.description: Got up at 5:35, prepared a thermos, fleece blanket, and hot water bottle for her husband, and checked the document pouch. Ma Zhiqiang checked the antifreeze level and the heating system, and gave a thumbs up after testing it normally. She then did shoulder and neck stretches, took her daughter to school, walked in the courtyard for 10 minutes, and did Baduanjin.
subevent.location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and truck parking spot

subevent.name: Final vehicle inspection of the year
subevent.description: On the morning of December 31, 2025, Ma Zhiqiang conducted the year's final pre-departure comprehensive inspection of the vehicle. The process had become extremely familiar: he checked item by item from tires to lights to safety equipment. Ma Xiulan accompanied him throughout, helping verify the year-end transport documents and certificate validity, and reviewed the year's safe driving record with Ma Zhiqiang. After the inspection, Ma Xiulan handed him the new knee pads she had bought and reminded him again to be careful on the complex road conditions. This inspection marked a successful conclusion to the 2025 habit of daily pre-departure checks.
subevent.location: Home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and truck parking spot

name: Develop a health monitoring plan for father and launch monthly family dinners
description: On March 23, Ma Xiulan discussed with her sisters and added having their father measure his blood pressure morning and evening to the daily to-do list, with their mother supervising and reporting via WeChat. They also agreed to have a low-salt home-cooked meal together at least once a month, taking turns cooking. On April 6, Ma Xiulan cooked for the first time, making shepherd's purse wontons and steamed bass. Her father happily had another bowl of rice, and the whole family enjoyed lunch together, achieving the goal of supervising his diet and strengthening family bonds.

subevent.name: Discussing her father's health monitoring plan with her sisters
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted her elder sister Li Xiuyun and younger sister Ma Xiufen to discuss a health management plan for their father Ma Jianguo at their parents' home. The three decided to include measuring their father's blood pressure morning and evening in the daily must-do checklist, with their mother Li Xiuying supervising and reporting in the family WeChat group every day. At the same time, the three sisters agreed to have a family dinner at their parents' home at least once a month, taking turns buying groceries and cooking, with the theme of 'low-salt home-style dishes'. Ma Xiulan was responsible for the first round.
subevent.location: Living room of parents' home, No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: First low-salt family dinner (Ma Xiulan as head cook)
subevent.description: As planned, Ma Xiulan went to her parents' home at noon on April 6 to prepare a family dinner. She had bought ingredients in advance and made two low-salt home-style dishes: shepherd's purse wontons and steamed sea bass. Her father, Ma Jianguo, was happy and gladly had another half bowl of rice. Her elder sister Li Xiuyun and younger sister Ma Xiufen each brought side dishes. The whole family had lunch together in a harmonious atmosphere, achieving the goal of monitoring her father's diet and strengthening family bonds.
subevent.location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at parents' home

name: Chen Yulan visited for a week with her son, designed new labels for the pickled vegetables, and proposed gift box packaging.
description: On August 8, her close friend Chen Yulan came to Jinghai from Tangshan with her son Chen Xiaojun for a short stay. Ma Xiulan took them to the local vegetable market, showed them the pickle jars, and mentioned her worry about poor sales. On August 12, after tasting, Yulan helped design hand-drawn labels and suggested making gift boxes for presents. Ma Xiulan suddenly saw the light. On August 14, when they parted, Yulan agreed to come again during the Chinese New Year.

subevent.name: Welcoming Chen Yulan and her son to stay
subevent.description: On August 8, Ma Xiulan welcomed her junior high school classmate Chen Yulan and Chen's son Chen Xiaojun, who had come all the way from Tangshan, Hebei, to visit her at her home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin. Ma Xiulan had prepared the guest room and lunch in advance and warmly entertained her old friend. The three chatted about everyday life while eating, and Chen Yulan shared updates on running her clothing store in Tangshan.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Visiting the vegetable market and sharing worries about slow sales of pickled vegetables
subevent.description: That afternoon, Ma Xiulan took Chen Yulan and her son to the Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District and picked out local seasonal vegetables and fresh ingredients. After returning home, Ma Xiulan showed Chen Yulan around the jars of pickled vegetables she had made, let her taste several kinds, and worriedly mentioned that this year the pickles had poor sales and couldn't be sold, hoping to hear her old friend's advice.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Xingwang Vegetable Market and home kitchen

subevent.name: Chen Yulan designed new labels and suggested gift box packaging
subevent.description: On August 12, after carefully tasting several of Ma Xiulan's pickled vegetables again, Chen Yulan thought the texture and quality were very good, but the packaging was too plain. She took out a brush and paper and designed a new hand-drawn style label for Ma Xiulan, with pictures of pickled vegetables and Tianjin landmarks, and suggested, 'You could try making gift boxes for presents—it would look more upscale.' Ma Xiulan suddenly saw the light and decided to adopt the suggestion.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home study

subevent.name: Seeing off Chen Yulan and her son and agreeing to meet again
subevent.description: On the morning of August 14, Chen Yulan and her son ended a week-long visit and prepared to return to Tangshan. Ma Xiulan prepared her own pickled vegetables and local specialties as return gifts. As they parted, the two hugged tightly at the door, and Chen Yulan said with a smile, "I'll come again for the New Year, and then I'll see how the gift boxes are selling." Ma Xiulan was deeply moved and watched them drive away.
subevent.location: At the entrance of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Making zongzi for the Dragon Boat Festival and sharing them with neighbors
description: Before the Dragon Boat Festival (early morning on May 29), Ma Xiulan went to the outskirts to pick fresh reed leaves. On the day of the Dragon Boat Festival, May 31, she, her mother Li Xiuying, and neighbor Wang Guilan prepared ingredients in their own courtyard and wrapped zongzi in two flavors: honey date and red bean paste. After the zongzi were cooked, Ma Xiulan distributed them while hot to neighbor Zhang Shufen and childhood friend Liu Chunmei. Wang Guilan reciprocated with a bag of eggs raised at home. The fragrance of zongzi and the warmth of friendship quietly spread through the neighborhood.

subevent.name: Picking reed leaves in the countryside
subevent.description: Early on the morning of the Dragon Boat Festival, Ma Xiulan went alone to the riverside on the outskirts of Jinghai District, Tianjin, to pick fresh green reed leaves as raw materials for making zongzi. She selected wide, complete reed leaves, tied them up with rope, and brought them back.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - riverside in the suburbs

subevent.name: Prepare ingredients for making zongzi.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, together with her mother Li Xiuying and neighbor across the hall Wang Guilan, prepared the ingredients for making zongzi in their own courtyard: the glutinous rice was soaked in advance, the picked reed leaves were washed clean, and the candied date and red bean paste fillings were prepared separately. The three divided the work: Ma Xiulan was responsible for rinsing the glutinous rice, Li Xiuying for washing the reed leaves, and Wang Guilan for preparing the fillings.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home yard

subevent.name: Making zongzi.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, her mother Li Xiuying, and neighbor Wang Guilan made zongzi together in the courtyard, chatting while they worked. They made two flavors: candied date zongzi and red bean paste zongzi. Ma Xiulan was skilled and was in charge of folding the leaves and tying them; her mother filled the rice and filling; Wang Guilan helped pass materials and arrange the finished zongzi.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home yard

subevent.name: Deliver rice dumplings to neighbor Zhang Shufen.
subevent.description: After the rice dumplings were cooked, Ma Xiulan arranged them on a plate while hot, walked to the entrance of the supermarket run by Zhang Shufen diagonally across the street, offered Zhang Shufen a few honey-date and red bean paste rice dumplings, and gave Dragon Boat Festival greetings. Zhang Shufen gladly accepted and expressed thanks repeatedly.
subevent.location: In front of Shufen Convenience Store, No. 154 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Giving zongzi to childhood friend Liu Chunmei.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan packed another bag of zongzi and walked to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home (No. 88 Shengli Street). After knocking, she handed the zongzi to her personally. The two chatted for a while about everyday matters and wished each other a healthy Dragon Boat Festival. Liu Chunmei was very happy and invited Ma Xiulan in to sit down, but Ma Xiulan politely declined because she still needed to go home.
subevent.location: At Liu Chunmei's doorstep, 88 Shengli Avenue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Wang Guilan gave eggs in return.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan returned from delivering zongzi, her neighbor Wang Guilan came to her home with a bag of fresh eggs from her own chickens as a Dragon Boat Festival return gift. Ma Xiulan could not refuse and happily accepted. The two chatted for a while at the doorway, each thanking the other for their kindness.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - home entrance

name: Registered for a beginner computer training class for middle-aged and elderly people
description: On the evening of November 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan saw a training class enrollment notice on the community bulletin board. After learning the details, she discussed it with her husband that same evening and gained his support. The next morning, she went to the community service center, completed the registration and payment, and officially enrolled in the 'Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Older Adults.'

subevent.name: Check the community bulletin board for training class information
subevent.description: On the evening of November 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan saw a recruitment notice for a "Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Older Adults" on the community bulletin board on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District. She carefully read the detailed information, including training time, location, the 150 yuan fee, and how to register, and jotted down the key points.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Bulletin Board

subevent.name: Discuss the registration details with her husband.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan returned home, she told her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the living room about the community computer training class and expressed her wish to sign up to learn computer skills. Ma Zhiqiang was hesitant at first, but after some discussion he ultimately supported Ma Xiulan's decision and agreed to let her spend 150 yuan to register for the training course.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road, home living room.

subevent.name: Go to the community service center to complete registration and payment.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 2, 2025, Ma Xiulan brought 150 yuan in cash and her ID card to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center in Jinghai District, found the staff member in charge of registration, filled out the registration form for the Computer Basics Training Class for Middle-Aged and Elderly People, paid the fee, officially completed the registration procedures, and received the class schedule and teaching materials.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Service Center

name: Carefully budgeted and bought a second-hand electric bike to reduce transportation costs
description: On June 17, Ma Xiulan asked her neighbor Zhang Shufen at Shufen Convenience Store about the market for second-hand electric bikes and learned that someone in the community was selling one. On June 18, using the income from consigning pickled cucumbers, she spent 400 yuan to buy a 70-percent-new Yadea electric bike from a resident who was moving away. On June 19, she rode the electric bike for the first time to take her daughter and go to the vegetable market, finding that the round trip took only 10 minutes, saving a lot of time. She calculated that she could save about 60 yuan a month on taxi fares, and planned to use the saved time for pickles and embroidery to supplement the family income.

subevent.name: Ask a neighbor about the market for second-hand electric bikes.
subevent.description: While shopping at Zhang Shufen's convenience supermarket, Ma Xiulan asked her neighbor Zhang Shufen about the recent market for second-hand electric bikes in the community. Zhang Shufen told her that a family in the same community that was moving was selling a Yadea electric bike that was about 70% new, and suggested a reasonable price range. Ma Xiulan wrote down the information and decided to go see the bike the next day.
subevent.location: Shufen Convenience Store, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Checked and bought a second-hand electric bike.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, following the clue provided by Zhang Shufen, went to the home of a household in the same community that was moving to inspect the second-hand Yadea electric scooter for sale. She carefully inspected the vehicle's appearance, tires, brakes, and battery, and took it for a test ride for a short distance, confirming that the vehicle was 70% new and performed well. Then she agreed with the seller on a deal for 400 yuan. Ma Xiulan paid the full amount using the income from selling pickled cucumbers earlier, completed the simple handover procedures on the spot, and rode the electric scooter back home.
subevent.location: A household in Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: First time using the electric bike and planning to save time
subevent.description: For the first time, Ma Xiulan rode her newly bought electric bike to take her younger daughter Ma Yuxin to kindergarten, and stopped by the vegetable market on the way to buy groceries. She found that riding the electric bike to the vegetable market and back took only 10 minutes, and picking up and dropping off her child saved nearly half an hour compared with walking. After returning home, she calculated the savings from buying the bike: she expected to save about 60 yuan per month on taxi fares and have much more time to make pickled vegetables and do embroidery. She began planning how to use the saved time to increase her handicraft output to supplement the household income.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community and surrounding areas, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Daily care and recording of courtyard plants and flowers.
description: Starting in May, the flower seeds began to sprout one after another and the rose seedlings grew branches. Every morning when watering, Ma Xiulan used her phone to photograph the changes in the flower buds and shared them in the family group chat. The courtyard gradually became more colorful and turned into a spiritual corner for her to relieve the pressure of the pickled vegetable business.

subevent.name: Early care for germinating flower seeds and rose plants shooting new branches
subevent.description: Every morning, Ma Xiulan waters the newly sprouted flower seeds and the rose seedlings that have put out branches in her own courtyard, carefully observes the growth of the buds and branches, and regularly uses her phone to photograph the changes in flower buds and leaves, recording the details of the plants' early growth. These caretaking tasks give her a moment of peace amid the busyness of caring for her family. At the same time, she shares the photos and growth progress to the family group, and exchanges updates about the courtyard with her family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: First watering and record of flower seeds and rose seedlings
subevent.description: On the morning of May 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan watered the newly sprouted flower seeds and rose seedlings that had put out branches in her own courtyard for the first time. She carefully adjusted the water flow to ensure each seedling received just the right amount of water. Then she used her phone to take photos of the initial state of the sprouts and branches, and shared the photos and growth records in the family group chat, sharing the joy of the new changes in the courtyard with her family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Mid-term watering and weeding care
subevent.description: On the morning of May 5, 2025, Ma Xiulan continued watering the courtyard and noticed a few small weeds growing in the flowerpots. She pulled them out by hand to keep the soil clean. She observed that the rose branches had grown about 2 cm longer, and the flower seedlings had grown a second pair of true leaves. She took photos to record this again, but this time she did not share them immediately, keeping them for comparison.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Rose buds appeared; took photos and shared
subevent.description: Early on the morning of May 9, 2025, Ma Xiulan was watering the plants when she was delighted to find two small buds at the top of a rose branch. She happily took close-up photos and immediately shared them in the family group chat with a caption. Her husband and children all liked it, and her daughter Xinxin said she wanted to draw them. Ma Xiulan then did a bit of tidying in the yard and gave the seedlings a light dose of fertilizer.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Continue watering and checking leaves for pests
subevent.description: On the morning of May 12, 2025, Ma Xiulan watered the plants as usual and carefully checked the undersides of the rose leaves. Finding a few aphids, she gently wiped them off with her hands and sprayed the leaves with diluted soapy water. She took photos of the process and asked her childhood friend Liu Chunmei for advice on rose care. After that, she continued with her other household chores.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Stage Care Completed and Summary Shared
subevent.description: On May 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan completed the last stage of scheduled watering in the courtyard. She reviewed the past two weeks of plant care, organized several photos she had taken into a set of comparison images, sent them to the family group chat, and wrote a caption describing how the plants had changed from sprouting to branching out. Family members replied one after another, and her mother Li Xiuying praised her for having such capable hands that anything she planted thrived. Ma Xiulan felt satisfied and planned to keep caring for the plants attentively until they bloomed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: The nurturing and blooming of the first flower
subevent.description: On the morning of May 22, 2025, while watering the courtyard, Ma Xiulan was pleasantly surprised to find a mung-bean-sized bud at the top of a flower seedling. She took a photo and shared it in the family group, which drew enthusiastic responses from family members. For the next four days (May 23 to 26), she carefully tended it: not touching the bud, pinching off side shoots, fertilizing with rice-washing water, and recording the bud's growth day by day (from the size of a mung bean to a peanut). She took photos every day to report to her family. On the morning of May 27, the bud fully bloomed into a small pinkish-white flower. Ma Xiulan took photos and videos, announced the good news in the family group, and everyone congratulated her; her husband sent a red envelope, and the children gathered around to watch. She picked the flower and put it in a glass in the living room for the whole family to enjoy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Discovered the first flower bud and shared it with the family.
subevent.description: At 6:20 in the morning, Ma Xiulan came to the courtyard to water the plants as usual. When she bent down to check the flower seedlings, she was pleasantly surprised to find a tiny tender green bud the size of a mung bean sprouting at the tip of one of them. She immediately squatted down, used her phone's macro mode to take a close-up of the bud, and then took a panoramic shot. Afterwards, she sent the photos and a text in the WeChat family group: "Look! Our little flower is about to bloom, the first bud!" Her husband and children responded enthusiastically in the group: the eldest son Ma Mingxuan sent a 'thumbs up', the second son Ma Mingzhe cheered 'Awesome', and the daughter Ma Yuxin shouted via voice message 'Mom is amazing'. Ma Xiulan was in a great mood and deliberately took a few more photos of that seedling from different angles to save.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Fine care during the flower bud swelling stage.
subevent.description: After discovering the bud, Ma Xiulan took even more careful care of it. For four consecutive days, when watering in the early morning, she was especially careful not to touch the bud, increased the frequency of checking the rose branches, and gently pinched off newly grown side shoots to concentrate nutrients. Every other day she fertilized the budding plant with diluted rice-washing water, and recorded the bud size changes in her diary in pencil: "May 23: mung-bean sized, May 24: soybean sized, May 25: pea sized, May 26: peanut sized." Every day she took a photo and briefly reported the bud's status in the family group chat: "It grew another size bigger." The children's first task after coming home from school every day was to run to the courtyard to look at the flower bud.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Record of the first flower blooming and the celebration.
subevent.description: At 5:50 in the morning, Ma Xiulan had just pushed open the courtyard gate when she smelled a faint floral scent. She hurried to the flower bed and found that the bud had fully opened into a small pinkish-white flower, about 3 cm in diameter, dotted with morning dew. Excited, she crouched down and took more than a dozen photos and a 15-second video from different angles. Then she sat on the low stool by the gate and uploaded the best photo to the family group with the caption: "It's bloomed! The first flower has bloomed! Our little garden has flowers now!" Family members tapped likes one after another. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, sent her a big red envelope to congratulate her; her eldest and second sons ran out to look at it, and her daughter hugged her mother's leg and said, "So pretty." Ma Xiulan deliberately picked the flower and placed it in a glass cup in the living room so the whole family could enjoy it.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Recording the flowers blooming and creating a spiritual corner.
subevent.description: In early June, the flowers in the courtyard bloomed one after another. The roses blossomed, and the seedlings grown from flower seeds also produced colorful little flowers. Every morning while watering, Ma Xiulan would use her phone to photograph the blooming flowers and share these beautiful scenes with the family group so the family could enjoy them together. During this time, the courtyard gradually became a spiritual corner for her to relax and ease the stress of life, and she gained a full sense of accomplishment and peace.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: First taste of the joy of flowers in bloom
subevent.description: At 6:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan went to the courtyard to water the plants as usual and discovered that the first rose bud had finally fully bloomed. The pink petals were layered one after another, still beaded with dew. She was pleasantly surprised and immediately took several close-up photos from different angles with her phone, then shared them on WeChat in the family group named "Happy Family" with the caption "The roses at home are blooming—so beautiful!" The children and her husband all liked it, and she felt immensely happy and fulfilled.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Flower seedlings blooming in a riot of color
subevent.description: After several days of careful tending, the area in the corner of the courtyard where she had sown flower seeds sprouted colorful little flowers — orange, purple, and white, arranged in pleasing layers. While watering in the early morning, Ma Xiulan was drawn to the colors. She crouched down for a closer look, took a short video with her phone, and even captured the sound of birds chirping outside the window as background. She posted the video to the family group chat and on Moments, writing, 'The flowers I planted have bloomed — the little courtyard is lively now!' She received a lot of praise from relatives and friends and felt very happy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Blossoms fill the courtyard, sharing joy
subevent.description: At this time, the roses, seedlings, and some potted flowers in the courtyard had all come into full bloom, and the whole small yard was fragrant and colorful. After watering the flowers, Ma Xiulan deliberately moved the most blooming flowerpots together to create a 'small garden' scene, then took panoramic photos and macro close-ups with her phone, and also filmed a slow-motion video of bees collecting nectar. She selected and organized these materials, posted them to the family group chat, and called her mother Li Xiuying to excitedly describe the changes in the yard. Her mother was also very happy and said she would come over to see it another day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

subevent.name: Accumulations in a Spiritual Corner
subevent.description: This day was the last day of the parent event's time range, and the flowers in the courtyard were still blooming beautifully. After watering in the early morning, Ma Xiulan moved a small stool and sat by the flowers. While admiring the flowers, she used her phone to review the photos she had taken over the past few days, selected the most satisfactory ones, compiled them into a 'June Blooms' album, and shared it with the family group. She felt that getting up early every day during this period to tend the flowers and take photos had become the most relaxing time for her. The small courtyard was not only a place for growing vegetables and flowers, but also a peaceful harbor in her heart. She planned to often do handicrafts and drink tea in this corner in the future.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Family Courtyard

name: Showcased embroidery skills at the community "Skillful Mothers" salon and took orders for baby belly bands
description: On September 13, Ma Xiulan attended the community's 'Clever Hands Mom' salon. She embroidered a peony on site and taught three young mothers basic stitching. The community gave her a set of embroidery tools as a souvenir. The day after the event, two mothers privately contacted her and each ordered a baby's full-moon belly band, 25 yuan per piece.

subevent.name: Preparing to attend the Handy Moms Salon
subevent.description: At her home on Jingwen Road, Ma Xiulan sorted out her embroidery tools and samples, picked out her most prized peony embroidery piece to take to the community salon for display, and prepared some teaching materials for basic stitches. She had confirmed the activity time and location with the community staff in advance.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Attended the community's Handy Moms Salon and displayed embroidery.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan attended the Clever Hands Mom salon at the Jinghai District Community Activity Center. On the spot, she skillfully embroidered a delicate peony flower, earning the admiration of the mothers present. Then she patiently guided three young mothers, Mother Zhang, Mother Li, and Mother Wang, in learning basic stitching, from threading the needle to the running stitch. At the end of the event, community worker Sister Liu, on behalf of the community, presented her with a set of fine embroidery tools as a token of thanks and remembrance.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Community Activity Center.

subevent.name: Received an order for baby belly bands
subevent.description: The day after the salon ended, Ma Xiulan received private messages at home via WeChat from two mothers, Mother Zhang and Mother Li, who had attended the salon the day before. They greatly admired Ma Xiulan's craftsmanship and each ordered a baby belly band for their babies who were about to turn one month old, agreeing on a price of 25 yuan each and a delivery date. Ma Xiulan carefully recorded their size requirements and pattern preferences, and promised to finish as soon as possible.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Eldest son became absorbed in physics experiments, causing his history grades to slip; the family set study rules together.
description: On September 8, the eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was selected as the physics class representative and was extremely excited. On September 10, after school, he used a magnifying glass at home to focus sunlight for a fire-lighting experiment and nearly set the curtains on fire. Ma Xiulan did not lose her temper, but seriously studied safety knowledge with him. Unexpectedly, on September 17, the class teacher reported that Mingxuan had repeatedly neglected his history homework because he was too absorbed in experiments, and his grades had clearly dropped. That evening, after discussing with her husband, Xiulan made an agreement with her son that he would spend no more than one hour on experiments every day, and she would personally check his homework. Mingxuan bowed his head and agreed.

subevent.name: Ma Mingxuan was selected as the physics class representative.
subevent.description: After Ma Mingxuan returned home from school, he excitedly told his mother that he had been selected as the physics class representative and showed her his physics book. Ma Xiulan was happy for him and encouraged him to study hard.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Ma Mingxuan nearly caused a fire while doing a physics experiment.
subevent.description: After school, Ma Mingxuan used a magnifying glass on the balcony at home to focus sunlight and do a fire-starting experiment, almost burning the curtains. Ma Xiulan noticed in time and stopped him. Instead of losing her temper, she seriously studied fire safety knowledge with him and gave him a safety education.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home balcony.

subevent.name: The homeroom teacher reported that his history grades were declining.
subevent.description: During the day, Ma Xiulan received a call from Han Mei, the head teacher of her eldest son. She learned that Ma Mingxuan, because of his obsession with physics experiments, had repeatedly neglected his history homework and that his history grades had clearly declined. Ma Xiulan felt worried and decided to discuss it with her husband that evening.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Held a family meeting to establish study rules.
subevent.description: That evening, after discussing with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, Ma Xiulan talked together with her son Ma Mingxuan. They agreed that daily physics experiment time would not exceed one hour, and Ma Xiulan would personally check homework for every subject each day to ensure the history homework was completed. Ma Mingxuan lowered his head and agreed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Visit mother on Mother's Day and give her a hand-embroidered sachet.
description: On May 11, Mother’s Day, Ma Xiulan took her three children and a hand-embroidered peace sachet and walked to her mother Li Xiuying’s home. After arriving, she hung the sachet at the head of her mother’s bed. Her mother was pleasantly surprised and praised her improved needlework. Ma Xiulan smiled and replied, 'I learned it from you, after all.' The mother and daughter then wrapped chive-and-egg dumplings together in the kitchen, while the children played in the living room or watched curiously. At noon, when the whole family ate dumplings, her mother praised her skill again, and at the table they chatted about the children’s studies and neighborhood gossip. In the afternoon, as they were leaving, her mother pressed a bag of homegrown spinach into her hands and they agreed to make pickled vegetables together next week. Feeling the warmth of family love, Ma Xiulan walked home with the children.

subevent.name: Going to mother's home
subevent.description: On the morning of Mother's Day, Ma Xiulan took her three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) and the hand-embroidered peace sachets, and walked from her home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) to her mother Li Xiuying's home (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin). Along the way, the children excitedly talked about going to grandma's house.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - on the way from Jingwen Road to Shengli Street

subevent.name: Giving and hanging a hand-embroidered peace sachet
subevent.description: After arriving at her mother Li Xiuying's home, Ma Xiulan gave her mother a peace sachet embroidered by hand and hung it herself at the head of her mother's bed. Her mother Li Xiuying was very pleasantly surprised and carefully examined the stitching, praising her daughter's improving craft. Ma Xiulan smiled and replied, "I learned it from you, after all." Her daughter Ma Yuxin helped pass the sachet on the side, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (bedroom in mother's home)

subevent.name: Make chive and egg dumplings with mother.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her mother Li Xiuying were busy together in the kitchen preparing chive and egg dumplings for lunch. As they trimmed chives, kneaded dough, rolled out wrappers, and wrapped dumplings, they chatted about family matters. Ma Xiulan asked her mother for advice on how to mix steamed bun filling. Her two sons, Ma Mingxuan and Ma Mingzhe, were watching TV and fooling around in the living room, while her daughter Ma Yuxin curiously watched the adults making dumplings from the side, occasionally trying to pinch together a crooked dumpling of her own.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - No. 45 Shengli Avenue (mother's home kitchen)

subevent.name: The whole family ate dumplings together and chatted
subevent.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan's family and her mother Li Xiuying sat around the table together to eat freshly cooked dumplings. During the meal, the mother and daughter chatted about the children's studies and neighborhood trivia. Her mother praised Ma Xiulan for her improving cooking skills, and Ma Xiulan said happily, "That's all because I learned it from you." The three children also vied to tell their grandmother amusing stories from school, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: No. 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (dining room at mother's home).

subevent.name: Say goodbye to mother and agree to make pickled vegetables next week.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan packed up her things and prepared to take the children home. Before leaving, her mother Li Xiuying pulled up a bag of homegrown spinach from the garden and pressed it into Ma Xiulan's hands. The mother and daughter agreed to make pickled vegetables together next week. The children reluctantly said goodbye to their grandmother. Feeling the warmth of family affection, Ma Xiulan walked home with the children.
subevent.location: 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin (at mother's doorstep)

name: Trial production of soy-pickled cucumbers succeeded, cooperation with Chunmei Supermarket expanded, and monthly income rose steadily.
description: On June 10, following the recipe guidance she had obtained earlier, Ma Xiulan began trial-making pickled cucumbers. She selected tender local cucumbers and made a light, low-salt sauce. After trying a sample, even she was surprised by the crispness. On June 15, she took the finished products to Chunmei's supermarket to recommend them. After tasting them, Chunmei immediately made the decision: 'People in the city will definitely like this flavor. I'll give you two shelf spaces!' After that, the pickled cucumbers were displayed side by side with the original pickled radish, and the customer return rate was quite high. When she settled accounts at the end of the month, the monthly income from pickled vegetables was stable between 200 and 300 yuan, nearly doubling from the previous month.

subevent.name: Purchase trial production materials
subevent.description: Following the recipe she learned from her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin, Ma Xiulan went the day before to Sun Guifang's stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, carefully selected 5 jin of fresh local tender cucumbers, and bought low-salt soy sauce, black vinegar, white sugar, garlic cloves, and other ingredients at a nearby seasoning shop, preparing to trial-make pickled cucumbers. At home, she also checked that the pickling jar was clean and dry.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Xingwang Vegetable Market and home kitchen

subevent.name: Made a trial batch of pickled cucumbers, and the tasting was a success.
subevent.description: In her own kitchen, Ma Xiulan began to test making pickled cucumbers according to the recipe. She washed the tender cucumbers and cut them into strips, salted them to draw out the water, squeezed them dry, then poured in a sauce made from low-salt soy sauce, black vinegar, sugar, and other seasonings. Finally, she added sliced garlic and dried chilies, sealed the container, and refrigerated it. After letting it sit for 6 hours, she took it out to taste. The cucumbers were crisp and tender, with a balanced salty-sweet flavor; even she herself was surprised by how successful the flavor was. She then divided the sample into two portions: one for the family to taste, and the other to take to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei the next day to recommend.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Take samples to Chunmei Supermarket to discuss shelf placement.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan packed the successfully trial-made pickled cucumbers in clean glass jars and rode her bicycle to Hualian Supermarket in Jinghai District (where Liu Chunmei worked). After tasting them, Liu Chunmei immediately praised them highly, saying the flavor was fresh and refreshing and suitable for urban consumers. Relying on her good relationship with the supervisor as a stock clerk, she persuaded the supervisor to give Ma Xiulan two shelf spaces to display the pickled cucumbers and the original pickled radish. The two parties made a verbal agreement that Ma Xiulan would deliver goods three times a week, and the supermarket would settle payment based on sales.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hualian Supermarket

subevent.name: Pickled cucumbers continued to be sold and restocked at the supermarket.
subevent.description: Starting June 16, according to the agreement with Liu Chunmei, Ma Xiulan made a batch of pickled cucumbers at home every two days, packed them in glass jars, and delivered them to Hualian Supermarket for sale. The pickled cucumbers were displayed alongside the existing pickled radish in the condiment area, attracting many customers to try them, with a high rate of return customers. During this period, Ma Xiulan slightly adjusted the spiciness based on customer feedback and proactively communicated with Liu Chunmei about sales to keep the shelves stocked. Sales were better on weekends, and she needed to make one extra delivery. The entire sales period lasted until the end of the month, laying the foundation for subsequent settlement.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen and Hualian Supermarket

subevent.name: Routine and weekend batch production and restocking.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan kept a rhythm of making a batch every two days. On June 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30 (regular days), she made 10–15 jars of pickled cucumbers at home per batch. At the same time, because weekend sales were good, she added an extra batch on Saturday June 21 and Sunday June 29, increasing the quantity to 20 jars. After each batch, she packed the pickled cucumbers into glass jars, delivered them by electric bike to Hualian Supermarket for shelving, checked the leftover stock from the previous batch, and had a brief chat with Liu Chunmei about shelf arrangement and customer reactions. On weekend deliveries, she would stay a little longer to help introduce the products to customers.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen and Hualian Supermarket

subevent.name: Fine-tune the pickled cucumber recipe based on customer feedback
subevent.description: During sales over the past few days, some customers reported that the pickled cucumbers were too spicy. After Ma Xiulan learned of this feedback through Liu Chunmei, she deliberately reduced the proportion of chili peppers and added a little sugar to balance the flavor when making them on the morning of June 20, and made a separate jar as a trial product. She labeled the trial product as the mild version and sent it to the supermarket, asking Liu Chunmei to recommend it first to regular customers for tasting. She would decide on an official adjustment after observing subsequent sales.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

subevent.name: Discussing sales and shelf management with Liu Chunmei
subevent.description: Apart from the regular delivery days and the extra weekend supply days, Ma Xiulan specifically followed up on sales with Liu Chunmei through WeChat and phone calls. After the first regular restock on June 18, they confirmed shelf displays and initial customer feedback by phone; on June 22, she called again to find out how customers accepted the slightly adjusted spiciness, and Liu Chunmei reported that most customers preferred the original version, so Ma Xiulan decided to restore the original recipe; on June 26, they discussed the weekend stock volume and whether a promotion was needed; on June 30, at the end of the month, the two met at the supermarket in person to check the total sales quantity, remaining inventory, and estimated revenue, preparing for the subsequent settlement and briefly planning the supply arrangements for the next month.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hualian Supermarket and home

subevent.name: Settle the income from pickled vegetables at the end of the month
subevent.description: On the afternoon of June 30, Ma Xiulan went to Hualian Supermarket and, together with Liu Chunmei and the accounting staff, checked this month's sales ledger for pickled vegetables (pickled cucumbers and pickled radishes combined). The calculation showed that total income from pickled vegetables in June was stable at 200 to 300 yuan, with pickled cucumbers contributing most of the increase—nearly double compared with last month (about 100–150 yuan when only pickled radishes were sold). After receiving the cash payment, Ma Xiulan thanked Liu Chunmei and planned to add a spicy and numbing flavor and expand supply next month.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Hualian Supermarket

name: Received the Parents' Open Day notice for the second son.
description: On the evening of November 10, the second son brought home a notice about the school's open house for parents. Ma Xiulan read it several times, decided to attend in person, carefully picked out her cleanest thick coat, and prepared to see how her child actually behaved at school.

subevent.name: The second son brought back a notice about Parents' Open Day.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan's second son, Ma Mingzhe, came home from school, took out a parent open day notice distributed by the school from his backpack, handed it to Ma Xiulan, who was preparing dinner in the kitchen, and briefly explained what it said.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Read the notice and decided to participate
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan set aside the housework she was doing and carefully read the entire parent open day notice, including the specific date, time arrangement, activity agenda, and matters requiring parental cooperation. After thinking it over, she decided to attend in person, wanting to see with her own eyes how her child actually performed at school.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Prepare clothes for the open day
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went back to the bedroom, opened the wardrobe, and rummaged for her cleanest thick coat. After finding it, she tried it on, confirmed that it fit well and was neat, then hung it on the hanger and prepared it, planning to wear it to school when the time came.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

name: The soy-pickled radish served during Spring Festival New Year visits received praise.
description: On February 1 (the fourth day of the first lunar month), the family of five took homemade pickled radish gift boxes to visit the maternal uncle's family in another town in Jinghai District. At the dinner table, Ma Xiulan picked up a piece of pickled radish for her uncle; after tasting it, everyone praised it, and several cousins' wives immediately asked for the recipe and said they wanted to buy some. She quietly noted their interest - the New Year gift turned out to be a living advertisement.

subevent.name: Prepare a gift box of pickled radish
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan portioned out the previously pickled radish, carefully packing it in food-grade packaging bags and gift boxes, to take to her uncle's home as New Year visit gifts. She checked the weight and appearance of each portion of pickled radish carefully to make sure the gift boxes were neat and beautiful.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Went to my maternal uncle's home to pay a New Year's call.
subevent.description: Carrying a gift box of pickled radish prepared in advance, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang set out from their home on Jingwen Road in Jinghai District with their three children (eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin), taking public transportation to their maternal uncle's home in another town in Jinghai District to pay New Year's calls. On the way, the children excitedly talked about receiving lucky money during the New Year visits, while Ma Xiulan told them to be polite.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - on the way from home to maternal uncle's house

subevent.name: New Year's visit and dinner at maternal uncle's home, where the pickled radish was well received
subevent.description: After arriving at maternal uncle Li Guohua's home, Ma Xiulan's family paid New Year's greetings to her uncle, aunt Zhang Guilan, and several cousins' wives. During the lunch gathering, Ma Xiulan opened the preserved radish gift box and picked a piece for her uncle to taste. Her uncle praised it repeatedly, and the cousins' wives also tasted it and joined in the praise, asking on the spot about how the preserved radish was made and saying that if Ma Xiulan was willing to sell it, they would all like to buy some. Ma Xiulan silently noted their interest, delighted at heart.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Uncle Li Guohua's home

subevent.name: Record potential customers' interest in pickled radish.
subevent.description: Back home in the evening, Ma Xiulan took out her notebook and carefully recorded the intentions of her cousins' wives (Wang Fang, Liu Li, Chen Jing) at her uncle's house to buy pickled radish, including their approximate purchase quantities and contact numbers, so as to contact them later to discuss the details. This planted the seed for her possible part-time handmade food sales.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Review household income and expenses for November.
description: At around 7 p.m., Ma Xiulan took the household ledger and calculator from the drawer and put them on the dining table, and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang to go over the month's income and expenses together. The two sat side by side at the table, and Ma Xiulan read out the figures in the ledger item by item: her husband's wages 5,000 yuan, full-attendance bonus 300 yuan, pickled vegetable profit 1,680 yuan, cloth hair flower income 20 yuan, totaling 7,000 yuan; expenses included heating fee 2,000 yuan, computer training class 150 yuan, daily expenses about 3,500 yuan, totaling 5,650 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang used the calculator on his phone to double-check and confirmed the balance was 1,350 yuan, and they discussed the necessity of the major expenses, thinking the heating fee was necessary and daily expenses could be saved on.

subevent.name: Organizing the account book and notifying her husband
subevent.description: At around 7 p.m., Ma Xiulan took the family account book and a calculator out of the drawer and put them on the dining table. Then she went to the living room and called her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who was watching TV, asking him to come over and go over the month's income and expenses together, and to help check the numbers.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home dining room

subevent.name: Review household income and expenses for November.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat side by side at the dining table. She read out the numbers in the account book item by item: her husband's salary 5,000 yuan, perfect attendance bonus 300 yuan, pickled vegetable profit 1,680 yuan, fabric hair flower income 20 yuan, totaling 7,000 yuan; expenses included heating fee 2,000 yuan, computer training class 150 yuan, daily expenses about 3,500 yuan, totaling 5,650 yuan. Ma Zhiqiang double-checked with the calculator on his phone and confirmed a balance of 1,350 yuan. The two discussed the necessity of the large expenses. Ma Zhiqiang said the heating fee was necessary, and some of the daily expenses could be saved.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home dining room

name: Relieved stress over the eldest son's grades by taking a walk
description: On the evening of November 18, after her eldest son's midterm results were released, Ma Xiulan felt anxious and worried. She went out alone and walked along Jingwen Road for half an hour. On the way, she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen, and the two chatted for a while in the open area of the residential complex, talking about the difficulties of raising children. After returning home, she felt much calmer and decided to go for more walks whenever she encountered worries in the future.

subevent.name: Learned eldest son's midterm grades
subevent.description: On the evening of November 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan received the midterm exam results notice for her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. Finding the grades unsatisfactory, she immediately felt anxious and worried about her child's academic performance and future.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home

subevent.name: Going out alone for a walk to de-stress
subevent.description: Feeling anxious, Ma Xiulan decided to go out for a walk to ease her mood. She left home alone and walked along Jingwen Road, thinking about her children's education as she went, for about half an hour.
subevent.location: Tianjin-Jinghai District-Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Chatted and confided in her neighbor Zhang Shufen.
subevent.description: During her walk, Ma Xiulan passed an open space in the neighborhood and met her neighbor Zhang Shufen. They both stopped, and Ma Xiulan poured out her worries about her eldest son's grades and the difficulties of raising children. Zhang Shufen comforted and encouraged her, and the two chatted for about a dozen minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road - Community open space

subevent.name: After returning home, she calmed down and made a decision.
subevent.description: After walking home, Ma Xiulan felt much calmer and noticeably less anxious. She decided that in the future, when bothered by worries, she would go out for walks more often to regulate her mood.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home

name: Preparing for the community handicraft salon
description: On November 24, Ma Xiulan received an invitation from the community residents' committee to showcase embroidery and fabric flower making at next month's community handicraft salon. That day, she began preparing semi-finished items and simple tools for the display and practiced explaining the steps, hoping to gain more recognition.

subevent.name: Received community salon invitation and confirmed attendance
subevent.description: On the morning of November 24, Ma Xiulan received a call from the community neighborhood committee, inviting her to demonstrate embroidery and cloth hair flower making at next month's community craft salon. She immediately agreed to attend and confirmed the approximate time and requirements of the salon.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Organize and prepare semi-finished products and tools for display
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 24, Ma Xiulan searched through her handicraft material box at home and sorted out embroidery semi-finished pieces suitable for display (such as embroidered patches and pattern drawings) and the basic tools needed for making cloth hair flowers—fabrics, beads, glue, hair clips, and so on. She packed them by category according to the display order, making sure there were enough materials.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Practicing embroidery and explaining the steps for making hair flowers
subevent.description: From the evening to the night of November 24, Ma Xiulan was alone in the living room of her home. Using the semi-finished items she had prepared, she simulated the salon scene, verbally explaining embroidery stitches and the process of making hair flowers while manually demonstrating the key steps. She practiced repeatedly to ensure smooth explanations and clear demonstrations; the whole process lasted about two hours.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: The whole family received and planted persimmon saplings, and visited to share the good news.
description: On March 12, Arbor Day, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang went to the community to pick up persimmon saplings and kept them properly. On the afternoon of March 15, the family planted the saplings together in the courtyard. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, took the initiative to water them, and her husband set up a windproof support. On the afternoon of March 16, Ma Xiulan took her second son to the hospital to visit her hospitalized father, Ma Jianguo, and shared the good news about planting the tree. Her father was pleased and gave earnest advice.

subevent.name: Collect persimmon saplings
subevent.description: On Arbor Day, March 12, Ma Xiulan and her husband went to the community greening station in Jinghai District, received two persimmon saplings distributed by the community using their ID cards, carefully checked whether the sapling roots were healthy, wrapped the roots in plastic bags to keep them moist, and brought them home to place in a cool spot for later.
subevent.location: Community Greening Station, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: The whole family works together to plant persimmon saplings.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 15, the whole family was in good spirits after the first batch of pickled vegetables was opened. Ma Xiulan and her husband used a shovel to dig a tree pit about 40 centimeters deep in the southeast corner of the courtyard, placed the persimmon sapling in the pit, straightened it, then Ma Xiulan filled in the soil and her husband tamped it down with his feet. Their second son, Ma Mingzhe, took the initiative to bring a bucket of water and thoroughly watered it to settle the roots. Her husband found wooden sticks and twine to build a triangular windbreak support for the sapling to make sure it was stable. Ma Xiulan smiled and said to her second son, 'Once the trunk grows thicker, it will bear fruit, and then we'll have our own persimmons to eat.'
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Went to the hospital to visit her father and shared the good news about planting trees
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 16, Ma Xiulan took her second son Ma Mingzhe and carried homemade pickled vegetables and fruit to the inpatient department of Jinghai District People's Hospital to visit her father Ma Jianguo, who was hospitalized with high blood pressure. In the ward, Ma Xiulan told her father that they had planted persimmon saplings at home, described the planting process, and told the amusing story of her second son taking on the watering task. Her father smiled with relief after hearing this and urged them to take good care of the trees. Ma Xiulan said that when the trees grew up and bore fruit, she would be sure to bring some for him to taste.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Inpatient Department of Jinghai District People's Hospital.

name: Family discusses plan for paying winter heating costs
description: On the afternoon of October 28, Ma Xiulan found a payment notice from the heating company in the mailbox; this season's fee was 1,200 yuan. That evening during dinner, she and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took out the account book at the dining table to discuss it. Her husband said, "What should be spent must be spent," and proactively offered to smoke one less carton of cigarettes next month to share the expense. They initially decided to squeeze this money out of the pickled vegetable income. On the evening of October 30, after dinner, the two finally agreed in the living room: take 1,200 yuan from the pickled vegetable sales revenue to pay the heating fee, and the husband would cut spending on one carton of cigarettes next month.
