Ma Xiulan recorded the plan in detail in the account book and planned to go pay the fee the next day.

subevent.name: Received a heating fee payment reminder.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 31, Ma Xiulan was returning from the vegetable market with groceries and casually opened her mailbox. She found a winter heating fee notice from the heating company, which showed that 1200 yuan was due for the current quarter. She took the notice home and began to calculate the family expenses.
subevent.location: Mailbox at the front door of No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Discuss the heating budget with her husband.
subevent.description: During dinner that evening, Ma Xiulan took out the payment notice and the family account book on the dining table and discussed the 1,200 yuan heating fee with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. She listed the other necessary expenses for the month in detail. After hearing this, her husband said, "What must be spent should be spent," and proactively suggested smoking one less carton of cigarettes next month to share the cost. While eating, the two planned together and initially decided to squeeze this money out of the pickled vegetable income.
subevent.location: Family dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Confirm the payment plan and record it.
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband finally agreed: to squeeze 1,200 yuan from this month's pickled-vegetable sales income to pay the heating fee, and her husband would cut back on one carton of cigarettes next month as a supplement. Ma Xiulan took out her account book, recorded this budget arrangement in detail, clipped the payment notice into the book, and planned to go to the heating company's payment office the next day.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Learning new pickled vegetable recipes and small-batch trial production
description: On May 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan searched online at home for low-salt fermented pickle recipes, selected and wrote down two kinds: spicy pickled cabbage and sweet garlic. In the afternoon she went to Xingwang Vegetable Market to buy fresh vegetables and auxiliary ingredients. In the evening she made a small batch in the kitchen and sealed it for fermentation. On May 17, after fermentation was complete, she invited family members to taste and evaluate it, recorded the successful experience, then cleaned and tidied the kitchen.

subevent.name: Learn and record a new pickled vegetable recipe.
subevent.description: In the morning, she used her phone at home to go online and searched short-video platforms and food blogs for low-salt fermented pickle recipes. Ma Xiulan combined her family's tastes and the ingredients available, selected two recipes: spicy cabbage and sweet garlic, and carefully recorded key information such as ingredient ratios, pickling steps, and fermentation temperature ranges in a notebook to prepare for the next stage.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Purchase fresh vegetables and pickling seasonings
subevent.description: In the afternoon, she rode her electric bike to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. Based on the recorded recipe list, she selected fresh Chinese cabbage, garlic, ginger, chili peppers, apples, pears, and other vegetables and fruits, and bought coarse salt, sugar, fish sauce, glutinous rice flour, and other pickling ingredients. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she chatted a bit more about recent vegetable prices and quality, then went home to sort everything out after shopping.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Make small batches of spicy pickled cabbage and sweet garlic
subevent.description: In the evening, she began pickling in the home kitchen. First she cut the napa cabbage and soaked it in salted water, then prepared the seasoning paste for spicy pickled cabbage (chili powder, mashed garlic, minced ginger, fish sauce, glutinous rice paste, etc.) and spread it evenly over each layer of leaves, then packed it into a clean sealed jar. Next she handled the sweet garlic: she peeled off the outer old skin, soaked it in lightly salted water to remove the spiciness, made a sweet-and-sour solution (white sugar, white vinegar, cooled boiled water), immersed the garlic cloves in it, and sealed it. She made one small jar of each batch and attached labels noting the date and the source of the recipe.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Trial production completed and taste evaluation
subevent.description: In the morning, she made a final check of the spicy cabbage and sweet garlic that had been fermenting for a week. The spicy cabbage leaves were translucent red with a rich sour and spicy flavor; the sweet garlic had lost its spiciness, turning translucent amber with a pleasant sweet-and-sour taste. Ma Xiulan invited her husband Ma Zhiqiang and the three children to taste them together, and everyone said they liked both new flavors. She packed the two products into small bottles, took photos to record the appearance of the finished products, and wrote a summary note about the successful trial, accumulating experience for future batch production or stall sales.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: Washing the utensils and tidying up the kitchen
subevent.description: After the trial production was complete, Ma Xiulan repeatedly cleaned all the used knives, cutting boards, basins, sealing jars and other utensils with dishwashing liquid, scalded them with boiling water to sterilize, dried them, and put them back in place. She cleaned the leftover vegetable leaves and sauce from the countertop, restored the kitchen to tidiness, and prepared for the next batch.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Community Harmonious Family Nomination Award
description: On December 20, Jinghai Community held its annual "Most Beautiful Family" awards ceremony. Ma Xiulan's family was nominated for the "Harmonious Family" award for their good marital harmony, smooth parent-child relationships, and mutual neighborly help. The community director handed her a quilt as the prize. She carried it home and, as soon as she entered, called out to her husband with a smile: "This is our family's certificate!" Her husband touched the quilt, spread it on the bed, and that night the whole family huddled under the new quilt watching TV, warm and cozy.

subevent.name: Attend the community awards ceremony
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan went to the Jinghai Community Activity Center to attend the annual “Most Beautiful Family” selection awards ceremony. At the ceremony, because her family enjoyed a harmonious marriage, close parent-child relationships, and mutual neighborly help, she was nominated by the community director for the “Harmonious Family” nomination award and was presented on the spot with a quilt as the prize. After briefly exchanging words with the community director and other winners, Ma Xiulan accepted the prize and prepared to go home.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Community Activity Center.

subevent.name: Carrying the prize home
subevent.description: After the award ceremony, Ma Xiulan left the community activity center holding the new quilt and walked home along Jingwen Road. On the way, she ran into her neighbor Wang Guilan and had a brief chat, sharing the joy of winning the award. When she reached her doorstep, she was in a cheerful mood and pushed the door open.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Share the good news with her husband.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan walked in and saw her husband Ma Zhiqiang resting in the living room. Smiling, she held up the quilt and said loudly, 'This is our family's certificate!' Hearing this, Ma Zhiqiang came over, touched the quilt, expressed approval, and asked for details about the award ceremony. Ma Xiulan briefly recounted what happened, and both of them felt happy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Making the bed and enjoying the new quilt
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Zhiqiang spread the new quilt on the bed. Ma Xiulan called the three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to come to bed together. The family of five squeezed onto the bed with the new quilt, turned on the TV, and watched a show, filling the room with warmth. Ma Xiulan felt the warmth of family and was filled with contentment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

name: Organize and file side-business receipts
description: After confirming the success, Ma Xiulan bought a new folder that evening, categorized and filed all the side-business orders, receipts, and payment vouchers she had accumulated, and set a rule to organize them once at the beginning of each month. She secretly resolved not to leave things to the last minute again, which also laid the foundation for a possible future registration as a small food workshop.

subevent.name: Went to the stationery store to buy a new folder.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan picked out and bought a new folder at a stationery store near her home (156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin) to store documents related to her side business.
subevent.location: Stationery store, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Organize and archive all side-business receipts at home
subevent.description: That evening, at the table in her living room, Ma Xiulan took out all the documents accumulated from her side business, such as orders, receipts, and payment vouchers, sorted them by chronological order and category (orders, receipts, vouchers), and neatly placed them into a newly bought folder.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Establish a rule to tidy up at the beginning of each month and record it
subevent.description: After finishing the filing, Ma Xiulan stuck a sticky note on the first page of the folder, wrote the rule 'organize once on the 1st of every month,' and silently resolved to organize on time from now on and stop cramming at the last minute.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Go to the community clinic for consultation about shoulder and neck soreness.
description: In mid-January, after many consecutive days of embroidery and housework, Ma Xiulan felt soreness and stiffness in her neck and went to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center to consult Dr. Wang. After an examination, Dr. Wang believed it was muscle strain, advised her to do shoulder and neck stretches every day, and prescribed two topical patches. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the advice and began to pay more attention to her posture after returning home.

subevent.name: Felt shoulder and neck soreness and decided to see a doctor
subevent.description: At her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan, after several consecutive days of embroidery and housework, felt neck pain and stiffness and had difficulty turning her neck. She realized she needed medical advice and decided to go to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center on the same street for a consultation.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Go to the community health service center.
subevent.description: After tidying up her clothes, Ma Xiulan left home and walked along Jingwen Road to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center. On the way, she moved her neck to relieve discomfort; the walk took about 10 minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Consulting Dr. Wang at the clinic and undergoing an examination.
subevent.description: After arriving at the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Ma Xiulan registered and entered the general clinic, where she saw the familiar community doctor Wang Jianguo (Dr. Wang). Dr. Wang asked in detail about when her symptoms started and her daily activities (embroidery and housework), then performed a cervical palpation examination. He confirmed muscle tension with no bone problems and diagnosed her with neck muscle strain.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Obtained the doctor's instructions and topical medication
subevent.description: Dr. Wang prescribed Ma Xiulan a box of topical plaster for promoting blood circulation and removing blood stasis, and verbally advised her to do shoulder and neck stretches once every morning and evening (such as slowly lifting her head, turning left and right, etc.), while also maintaining proper sitting posture and avoiding looking down for long periods. Ma Xiulan carefully noted every piece of advice, picked up the medicine at the pharmacy, thanked Dr. Wang, and left the clinic.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Carried out the rehabilitation recommendations after returning home.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan walked home from the clinic. After arriving, she immediately applied a medicated patch to the sore spot on her neck as instructed, and then carefully did about 10 minutes of shoulder and neck stretching exercises, including slowly tilting her head back, turning her head left and right, and shrugging her shoulders. She decided to get up and move every half hour while doing crafts and housework, and to adjust her sitting posture and lighting while embroidering, to reduce strain on her neck. After finishing the stretches, she felt that her neck was a little more relaxed.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Together with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, she celebrated their mother Li Xiuying's 67th birthday.
description: On the evening of August 14, 2025, Ma Xiulan talked with her younger sister Ma Xiufen on the phone and agreed to surprise their mother Li Xiuying for her 67th birthday the next day, dividing up the tasks of preparing pickled cucumbers, patchwork chair cushions, sun-protective clothing, and braised dishes. On the morning of August 15, Ma Xiulan packed gifts and dishes at home, then walked to her mother's house (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District) at noon. After meeting up with Ma Xiufen, the two sisters cooked together in the kitchen, making noodles with gravy, sweet and sour pork tenderloin, and other signature dishes, while their father Ma Jianguo helped out. In the evening, the family sat around the dining table, gave gifts, enjoyed dinner, and recalled fun memories from past years in a warm atmosphere. The celebration lasted until 8 p.m., when Ma Xiulan took her children home.

subevent.name: Called her younger sister to confirm birthday arrangements.
subevent.description: On the evening of August 14, 2025, Ma Xiulan called her sister Ma Xiufen on her mobile phone in the living room of her home to confirm the arrangements for their mother Li Xiuying's 67th birthday the next day. The two agreed that Ma Xiulan would prepare her homemade pickled cucumbers and the recently finished patchwork chair cushions as gifts, while Ma Xiufen would bring a newly bought sun-protection jacket and braised delicacies from Binhai New Area. They planned to cook a table of dishes together in the kitchen at their mother's home (45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District) to give her a surprise. The call lasted about 20 minutes, and they confirmed their respective tasks and arrival times.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home

subevent.name: Preparing mother's birthday gift and dishes
subevent.description: On the morning of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan was busy in the kitchen and handicraft corner at home. She took the pre-pickled cucumbers out of the jar and put them into fresh-keeping boxes, then carefully wrapped the handmade patchwork chair cushion she had made as a birthday gift for her mother. The whole preparation took about an hour. After finishing, she organized the items she needed to bring and prepared to head to her mother's house at noon.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 156 Jingwen Road - Home

subevent.name: Go to mother's home for a birthday celebration
subevent.description: At noon on August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan, carrying the prepared pickled cucumbers and patchwork chair cushions, walked to her mother Li Xiuying's home at 45 Shengli Street, Jinghai District. The walk took about 15 minutes. When she arrived, her mother had not yet noticed the celebration plan. She first met up with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who had arrived early, and the two chatted with their parents in the living room before starting to cook.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - No. 45 Shengli Street - Mother's home

subevent.name: Sisters work together to prepare a birthday meal for their mother.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan and her younger sister Ma Xiufen cooked together in their mother's kitchen. Ma Xiulan was in charge of cooking her signature dishes: noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, while Ma Xiufen prepared the braised dishes she had brought and made several cold dishes. The two chatted as they worked, and about two hours later they finished a hearty dinner, including Tianjin baozi, their mother's favorite, and seasonal vegetables. Their father, Ma Jianguo, helped on the side, and their mother, Li Xiuying, was asked to rest first.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 45 Shengli Street - mother's home kitchen

subevent.name: Celebrate my mother's 67th birthday
subevent.description: On the evening of August 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan, her younger sister Ma Xiufen, and her father Ma Jianguo celebrated their mother Li Xiuying's 67th birthday. The family sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan brought out a patchwork chair cushion and pickled cucumbers, while Ma Xiufen gave a sun-protection jacket and braised delicacies. Their mother was pleasantly surprised and moved. Everyone ate and chatted, recalling funny moments from past birthdays, in a warm and happy atmosphere. The celebration lasted until around 8 p.m., after which Ma Xiulan helped clear the dishes and then took the children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) home.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 45 Shengli Street - Mother's home dining room

name: Video call with younger sister to discuss travel and adjust plans
description: On the evening of September 18, Ma Xiulan received a video call from her younger sister, Ma Xiufen. Xiufen was concerned about her sister's National Day trip to Beijing, reminded her that the weather in Beijing was getting colder and she should bring more clothes, and also recommended a cheap snack shop near Tiananmen. The two talked for half an hour, from travel plans to their parents' health. Xiufen said she would find time to return to Jinghai soon to see their parents. After hanging up, Xiulan noted down her sister's reminders and the snack shop information, updated the initial plan for the National Day Beijing trip, and decided to prepare warm clothing and plan meals. She also planned to call their parents another day to ask about their health.

subevent.name: Video-called her younger sister to discuss travel details.
subevent.description: On the evening of September 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan received a video call at home from her younger sister Ma Xiufen. Her younger sister asked about her sister's travel plans to Beijing, reminded her that the weather in Beijing had turned cold and she should bring more clothes, and recommended an inexpensive snack shop near Tiananmen. The two also talked about their parents' health. Xiufen said she would find time to go back to Jinghai to visit their parents soon. The call lasted about half an hour, and the sisters chatted happily.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Recorded her sister's suggestions and adjusted the travel plan.
subevent.description: After the call ended, Ma Xiulan took out her notebook, wrote down the weather reminders and the snack shop information her younger sister had mentioned, and updated the preliminary plan for the National Day trip to Beijing, adding preparations for cold-weather clothing and meal arrangements. She also decided to call her parents another day to check on their health.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Implementing the family healthy diet plan—making multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt a routine.
description: Starting in June, Ma Xiulan added multigrain porridge to breakfast and reduced purchases of fried dough sticks. At the same time, she used spinach from the courtyard and homemade yogurt to create an economical and nutritious combination. On June 25, a follow-up exam showed her anemia had improved (hemoglobin 105 g/L), which further strengthened her confidence in improving her diet. Throughout June, she stuck to the principle of less oil and less salt and made homemade yogurt a healthy snack for the children. To do this, she even learned a simple yogurt fermentation method from Chunmei.

subevent.name: Learn how to make homemade yogurt from my childhood friend.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei's home to learn in detail how to make simple fermented yogurt, including milk selection, fermentation temperature control, and starter culture use. She wrote down the steps and planned to make it at home.
subevent.location: Liu Chunmei's home, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Purchasing ingredients such as whole grains and milk
subevent.description: According to the healthy eating plan, Ma Xiulan went to the Jinghai District vegetable market and supermarket to buy the grains needed for multigrain porridge (such as millet, oats, red beans, etc.), as well as pure milk and yogurt starter powder for making yogurt, to prepare for the implementation of the plan in June.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - vegetable market and supermarket

subevent.name: Began implementing the plan for multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt.
subevent.description: Starting June 1, Ma Xiulan made multigrain porridge for the family every morning instead of fried dough sticks to reduce oil and salt intake. At the same time, following the method she had learned, she began making homemade yogurt as a daily healthy snack for the children. She stuck to the principle of less oil and less salt, incorporating vegetables such as spinach grown in the yard into the diet, forming an economical and nutritious eating pattern.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: Starting the multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt plan.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 1, in the kitchen of their home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan made multigrain porridge for the whole family for the first time, replacing fried dough sticks with grains such as millet, brown rice, and red beans, and paired it with stir-fried spinach picked from the courtyard. At the same time, following the method she had learned from her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin, she tried making homemade yogurt for the first time with whole milk and probiotic powder, putting it in clean glass jars to ferment at room temperature for about 12 hours. During breakfast, Ma Xiulan explained the goals of the new diet plan to her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children (Ma Mingxuan, 13 years old; Ma Mingzhe, 10 years old; Ma Yuxin, 6 years old): reduce oil and salt intake, increase dietary fiber and probiotics, and encouraged everyone to keep it up. The whole family supported the new attempt, especially the two younger children, who were very curious about the homemade yogurt.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: Purchased coarse grains and yogurt fermentation materials.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 5, after seeing the children off to school, Ma Xiulan walked to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District and bought fresh corn, sweet potatoes, and apples at Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall. Then she went to Zhang Shufen's convenience supermarket and bought five kilograms of bulk millet, two kilograms of rolled oats, and a small pack of probiotic powder. At the supermarket, she chatted with Zhang Shufen about her new diet plan, and Zhang Shufen suggested that the leftover fruits and vegetables could be used to make a natural starter. After returning home, Ma Xiulan sorted and stored the grains in the kitchen cabinet and calculated that the trip cost about 45 yuan, which fit the family's frugal budget.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Food Market and nearby supermarkets, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Second time making yogurt and optimizing the multigrain porridge recipe
subevent.description: On the weekend morning of June 8, Ma Xiulan made yogurt for the second time in her home kitchen. This time she strictly controlled the fermentation time (10 hours) and added two tablespoons of sugar, hoping to reduce the sourness. At the same time, she tried a new multigrain porridge recipe: cooking millet, oats, diced sweet potatoes, and red dates to make the porridge sweeter and stickier. At 9 a.m., the whole family (her husband Ma Zhiqiang happened to be off work) tasted breakfast together in the dining room. Ma Zhiqiang praised the porridge, and Ma Mingzhe said the yogurt tasted better than last time. Ma Xiulan wrote down the adjusted recipes and took photos of the finished yogurt to share with the family WeChat group and the handicraft exchange group, receiving likes from Aunt Wu and Zheng Xiuying. In the afternoon, she mixed the remaining yogurt with cut fruit and gave it to the children as a snack.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: Use courtyard vegetables to enrich side dishes for multigrain porridge.
subevent.description: On the morning of June 12, Ma Xiulan picked mature bok choy, chives, and cilantro from the small family vegetable garden. She blanched the bok choy and dressed it cold, chopped the chives and added them to the multi-grain porridge for flavor, and used the cilantro as a garnish. In the kitchen, Ma Xiulan paired the garden vegetables with the multi-grain porridge to make a varied breakfast. Ma Mingxuan said the cold dressed bok choy was refreshing and tasty. Ma Xiulan thought she could rotate the garden vegetables for long-term use, which would both reduce costs and ensure freshness. At noon, she also made the leftover multi-grain porridge into multi-grain vegetable cakes as an after-school snack for the children.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin — home courtyard and kitchen.

subevent.name: Make homemade yogurt a regular afternoon tea staple.
subevent.description: On June 15, after two weeks of trying, Ma Xiulan finalized a standardized process for making homemade yogurt: make it twice a week (Sunday and Wednesday), one liter each time. That day was Sunday, and she made the third batch of yogurt using the optimized method, adding homemade strawberry jam (made from courtyard strawberries and rock sugar). At 3 p.m., after the children came home from school, each enjoyed a small bowl of strawberry yogurt with multigrain cookies. Ma Yuxin was especially happy and said on her own initiative that from now on she wanted such an afternoon snack every day. Ma Xiulan shared this week's recipe with Liu Chunmei on WeChat, and Liu Chunmei said she also wanted to learn how to make yogurt.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: Invite neighbors to try the new eating pattern
subevent.description: On the morning of June 18, Ma Xiulan made an extra portion of multigrain porridge and yogurt. At 10 a.m., she knocked on the door of her neighbor Wang Guilan with a bowl of hot porridge and a jar of homemade yogurt, sharing the results of her healthy eating plan. After tasting it, Wang Guilan praised it as made with love. The two chatted at the doorstep for over half an hour, and Wang Guilan asked for the multigrain porridge recipe. Ma Xiulan explained the proportions and steps in detail, and promised to teach Wang Guilan how to make yogurt next time. After returning home, Ma Xiulan told her husband about Wang Guilan's positive feedback, feeling that this plan not only improved their own diet but also could influence the neighbors.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - the doorstep of No. 156 Jingwen Road and Wang Guilan's home

subevent.name: Summarize the results of the multigrain porridge and yogurt plan and plan the next steps
subevent.description: On June 24, the last day of the plan. After breakfast, Ma Xiulan gathered the family in the dining room for a brief family meeting to review the new eating pattern of the past month. She tallied the implementation: multigrain porridge had been kept up for 24 days, homemade yogurt had been made 7 times (including the first time), and the total cost of ingredients was about 180 yuan, saving about 60 yuan compared with buying fried dough sticks and supermarket yogurt before. The children's weights were stable and their bowel movements were more regular; her husband Ma Zhiqiang also said he no longer felt sleepy easily while driving during the day. Ma Xiulan said the plan was very successful and proposed continuing the multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt as long-term family habits. The whole family agreed. She also recorded the summary in her journal and took a photo to send to her mother Li Xiuying and elder sister Li Xiuyun to share the joy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: The follow-up check showed that the anemia had improved.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District for a follow-up anemia check. The result showed hemoglobin 105 g/L, and her anemia had improved significantly. Doctor Wang affirmed her dietary improvements and advised her to continue.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Stick to the healthy eating plan until the end of the month
subevent.description: The follow-up results strengthened Ma Xiulan's confidence. She continued her diet of multigrain porridge and homemade yogurt for the remaining days of June to further consolidate the effects, and planned to maintain this healthy habit in the long term.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

name: Cold protection for the persimmon tree
description: On November 20, the weather turned colder. Ma Xiulan carefully wrapped the trunk and root collar of the persimmon tree in her yard with straw and old cloth strips to prevent frost damage. She also piled dry grass around the roots, hoping for new sprouts the next spring.

subevent.name: Applying cold-weather protection to the persimmon tree
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, in her own courtyard, first carefully wrapped the trunk and root collar of the persimmon tree with straw and old cloth strips, making sure they were tightly bound to prevent frost damage; then she piled hay around the roots to form an insulating layer, hoping it would sprout new buds the next year.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

name: Financial decision for roof repair after the heavy rain
description: On July 22, Ma Xiulan found water leaking from the kitchen ceiling. After Master Liu inspected it, he said the roof tiles needed to be replaced. After discussing with her husband, they decided to spend 1,000 yuan on a thorough repair, considering it a necessary family investment. She recorded this expense separately in the family ledger as a special item for house maintenance, and agreed with her husband to set aside 200 yuan from their monthly income as a house repair fund. After the work was completed on the 24th, the new tiles were neat, and she felt relieved, thinking the money was well spent.

subevent.name: Master Liu came to inspect and provided a repair plan.
subevent.description: After arriving, Master Liu inspected the kitchen ceiling and the roof condition and confirmed that the water infiltration was caused by roof tiles damaged in the heavy rain, so the damaged tiles needed to be replaced. He quoted 1,000 yuan for the repair. After learning the situation, Ma Xiulan said she needed to discuss it with her husband before making a decision.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Discussing repair decisions with her husband.
subevent.description: After Master Liu left, Ma Xiulan discussed roof repair matters with her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the living room at home that evening. The two talked in detail about the necessity of the repair and the budget, and finally agreed to spend 1000 yuan on a thorough repair, believing it was a necessary investment to ensure the safety of the house.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Keep accounts and set up a housing repair fund.
subevent.description: After deciding on the repair, Ma Xiulan recorded this expected expenditure of 1000 yuan separately in the family ledger that evening, categorizing it as a housing maintenance item. At the same time, she agreed with her husband that starting this month, they would set aside 200 yuan from monthly family income as a home repair fund to deal with similar needs in the future.
subevent.location: Home study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Roof tile replacement construction.
subevent.description: On July 23, Master Liu, as agreed, arrived at Ma Xiulan's home with tools and new tiles and began repairing the roof by replacing tiles. Ma Xiulan helped by passing tools and supervising the construction progress to ensure quality.
subevent.location: Home rooftop, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Renovation completion inspection and payment.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 24, Master Liu completed all the tile replacement work, and the new tiles were laid neatly. After carefully checking the roof for leaks, Ma Xiulan was very satisfied and paid 1,000 yuan on the spot. Seeing the repaired roof, she felt reassured and thought the money was well spent.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Setting up a family reading corner.
description: On the afternoon of August 10, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang cleared out the clutter in the corner of the living room to make space for a reading corner. On the afternoon of August 15, after Ma Xiulan returned home from her parents' house, she and her husband laid down an old blanket, arranged cushions, set up a bookshelf, and hung her hand-embroidered 'Light of Reading' wall hanging. Then the three children excitedly sorted and shelved the books, and finally the whole family sat together reading, enjoying the cozy time.

subevent.name: Returned home from her parents' house
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan set out with her three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) from her parents' home on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and walked back to her own home at 156 Jingwen Road to prepare for the upcoming decorating work.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - on the way from parents' home back to own home

subevent.name: Cleared the clutter in the corner of the living room.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang cleared out the old cardboard boxes, unused items, children's toys, and other clutter piled up in the corner of the living room, moving them one by one to the storage room to make space for the reading corner they were about to set up.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Lay the foundation and install the bookshelf.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband laid out old blankets they had prepared in advance on the cleaned floor, arranged soft cushions, and together set up and secured a small bookshelf. At the same time, they hung the "Light of Reading" wall hanging that Ma Xiulan had embroidered by hand. The core facilities of the reading corner were now complete.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: The children organize books and put them on the shelf
subevent.description: The three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) were very excited to see the new bookshelf. Each of them collected their own books from the bedrooms, living room, and elsewhere. Under Ma Xiulan's guidance, they selected books suitable for reading, arranged them neatly on the new bookshelf by size and category, and cleared out old books that were no longer needed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Family shared reading experience
subevent.description: After the setup was complete, the whole family (Ma Xiulan, Ma Zhiqiang, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) sat around the newly arranged reading corner, each picked a favorite book and read quietly together, enjoying warm family time, marking the official opening of the reading corner.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Visiting the agritourism demonstration village in Jizhou District to explore ideas for a sideline business
description: On October 27, Ma Xiulan went with a community-organized group to visit the agritourism demonstration village in Xiaying Town, Jizhou District. She focused on orchard picking and the farmhouse-made hawthorn jam and apricot jam, and took the initiative to ask the farmers for their recipes. At noon, while tasting the braised fish in soy sauce, she privately asked the chef for seasoning tips. In the afternoon, while visiting the homestay, she noticed that local handicrafts were being sold in the guest rooms, and she quietly wondered whether she could cooperate to sell her pickled vegetables on consignment. On the way back she bought two bottles of farmhouse chili sauce, planning to try improving them by combining Aunt Wu's recipe. The trip cost 60 yuan as a registration fee, but it broadened her horizons and gave her new ideas for sales channels for her pickled vegetable side business.

subevent.name: The community delegation set out for Jizhou District.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan set off from her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, with a community-organized inspection group, taking a coach to the farm stay demonstration village in Xiaying Town, Jizhou District. The drive took about 2 hours, and on the bus she chatted with neighbors in the group about the purpose of the trip.
subevent.location: On the bus from Jinghai District, Tianjin to Jizhou District

subevent.name: Orchard visit, fruit picking, and sauce-making
subevent.description: After arriving at the demonstration village, Ma Xiulan focused on observing the operating model of the orchard picking area, and stopped at the booth where farm households were making hawthorn jam and apricot jam on site. She proactively asked the farmers in detail about the ingredient ratios and cooking heat, and used her phone to record key points.
subevent.location: Orchard and production area, Agritourism Demonstration Village, Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Tasting farmhouse dishes and learning about seasoning.
subevent.description: At noon they ate at a farmhouse restaurant. Ma Xiulan tried the signature soy-braised fish and found the sauce rich and savory. During a break in the meal, she privately asked the chef about the braising sauce recipe and seasoning techniques, and noted down the key steps.
subevent.location: Farmhouse restaurant in Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Investigate the sales model for handicrafts at homestays.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, she visited a distinctive local guesthouse and found local handicrafts (embroidery, cloth shoes, etc.) displayed in the guest rooms with price tags for sale. Ma Xiulan took the initiative to discuss consignment cooperation terms with the guesthouse owner, considered the possibility of trying to sell her homemade pickled vegetables there, and asked for contact information.
subevent.location: A homestay in Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Purchasing samples and returning
subevent.description: Before the return trip at the end of the field visit, Ma Xiulan bought two bottles of local farmhouse chili sauce at a stall in the demonstration village at her own expense (30 yuan in total), as a reference for improving her recipe. Then she rode back with the group to Jinghai District, planning to try combining it with Aunt Wu's recipe.
subevent.location: On the bus from Xiaying Town, Jizhou District, Tianjin to Jinghai District

name: Video call with younger sister Ma Xiufen to share travel photos.
description: On the afternoon of October 8, 2025, Ma Xiulan was at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, organizing photos from her Beijing trip and practicing how to talk about them, preparing for the video call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen that evening. That night, she showed the photos to her sister, who lives in Binhai New Area, via WeChat video, and described how awe-inspiring the flag-raising at Tiananmen Square and the Long Corridor at the Summer Palace were; her sister was filled with envy. The two agreed that both families would travel together next summer vacation. Ma Xiulan asked about her sister's recent work and urged her to take care of her health. The call lasted nearly an hour. After it ended, Ma Xiulan wrote down her initial ideas for the trip in a small notebook in the living room, so that she could discuss them with her husband later.

subevent.name: Organizing Beijing travel photos
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 8, Ma Xiulan, at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, selected photos taken during a previous trip to Beijing from her phone album, organized them into a group in the order of the trip, and practiced telling the stories in the photos in advance to prepare for a video call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen in the evening.
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Video call with younger sister Ma Xiufen to share travel experiences
subevent.description: On the evening of October 8, Ma Xiulan had a WeChat video call at home in Jinghai District with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, who lives in Binhai New Area. She showed her sister the organized photos from the Beijing trip one by one, describing in detail the awe-inspiring flag-raising ceremony at Tiananmen Square and the elegance of the Long Corridor in the Summer Palace. Ma Xiufen was very envious after seeing them. The sisters then agreed on a plan for the two families to travel together during next year's summer vacation. Ma Xiulan also asked about her sister's recent work at the clothing store and reminded her to take care of her health. The entire call lasted nearly an hour.
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: After the call ended, she jotted down her ideas for an outing
subevent.description: After finishing the video call with her younger sister Ma Xiufen, Ma Xiulan took out a small notebook in the living room of her home in Jinghai District and briefly wrote down the initial ideas the sisters had agreed on for a joint family trip next summer, including possible destinations and times, so that she could discuss it later with her husband Ma Zhiqiang.
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Keep up daily morning stretching
description: Since early February, Ma Xiulan has persisted in doing 5 minutes of stretching exercises every morning after getting up. Her shoulder and neck soreness has gradually eased. Sometimes she also gets her husband Ma Zhiqiang to join in, making it a small family health ritual.

subevent.name: Initial development of a morning stretching habit
subevent.description: Starting February 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan began the initial development of a morning stretching habit. On February 1, she tried full-body stretching for the first time. On February 2, she continued practicing alone. On February 3, she got her husband Ma Zhiqiang to join in. On February 4, she did it alone because her husband was out. On February 6, she stretched alone again and felt her shoulder and neck soreness ease. On February 7, she finished the period with one stretching session. Throughout this phase, she gradually got used to morning stretching, and her shoulder and neck soreness was somewhat relieved.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: First morning stretch
subevent.description: On the morning of February 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan, after getting up, did her first 5-minute full-body stretch in the bedroom by herself, including shoulder and neck relaxation, waist twists, and leg stretches, thereby starting her morning stretching habit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Solo morning stretching.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 2, 2025, after getting up, Ma Xiulan did her second 5-minute full-body stretching routine alone in the bedroom. The movements were the same as the previous day, and she gradually became familiar with the rhythm.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Getting her husband to join in stretching
subevent.description: On the morning of February 3, 2025, while Ma Xiulan was stretching in the bedroom, she got her husband Ma Zhiqiang to join in. The two of them completed a 5-minute full-body stretch together, including shoulder and neck relaxation, waist twists, and leg stretches. Ma Zhiqiang said he was willing to give it a try.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Solo morning stretching.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 4, 2025, after getting up, Ma Xiulan did a 5-minute full-body stretching routine alone in the bedroom, because her husband was out on a transport run and did not join.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Solo morning stretching.
subevent.description: On the morning of February 6, 2025, Ma Xiulan got up and did her sixth 5-minute full-body stretching routine alone in the bedroom. The soreness in her shoulders and neck had eased compared with before, and her movements were smoother.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Wrap-up of the first phase of morning stretching
subevent.description: On the morning of February 7, 2025, Ma Xiulan completed her 7th 5-minute full-body stretching session alone in the bedroom. As the wrap-up of the early stage of forming her morning stretching habit, she felt that the soreness in her shoulders and neck had noticeably eased and decided to continue.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Morning stretching habit stabilization period
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan has fully developed a daily morning stretching habit and no longer needs deliberate reminders. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang joins in 3-4 times a week, and the children sometimes also curiously imitate the movements. Ma Xiulan has started to briefly record how she feels after stretching and shares it with her neighbor Wang Guilan to encourage each other.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: The whole family participates in morning stretching
subevent.description: On Saturday morning at 7 a.m., Ma Xiulan laid out a yoga mat in the living room and began doing 10 minutes of morning stretches, including stretches for her neck, shoulders, waist, and legs. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, inspired by her habit, joined in on his own and sat on the sofa nearby imitating her movements. When her eldest son Ma Mingxuan passed by, he stopped out of curiosity and imitated his mother by moving his wrists and ankles. Her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin also ran over and, giggling, followed along with simple bending movements. Ma Xiulan patiently corrected the children's movements, and the family atmosphere was harmonious. This lasted about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Stretch alone and record feelings
subevent.description: On Monday morning at 6:40, Ma Xiulan got up and did her morning stretches alone in the living room, moving smoothly and naturally. After stretching, she took out a small notebook and, sitting at the dining table, jotted down how she felt today: 'Today my body feels very light. After sticking with it for a week, I have more energy.' Then she photographed the notebook page with her phone and shared it with her neighbor Wang Guilan via WeChat, with the message: 'Sister Wang, I feel really great after stretching today. You should try it too!' Wang Guilan quickly replied with an encouraging emoji and a voice message, and the two agreed to chat again tomorrow.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Morning stretching with her husband
subevent.description: On Wednesday morning at 7:00, Ma Xiulan was stretching in the living room. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang joined her after changing clothes. The two stood side by side and completed shoulder, neck, waist, and leg stretches together at Ma Xiulan's pace. Because Ma Zhiqiang had a sore lower back from driving long distances the night before, Ma Xiulan specifically taught him a movement to relieve lumbar soreness, and the two cooperated well. After the stretching, Ma Xiulan handed him a glass of warm water and said, "It feels good to keep it up, doesn't it?" Ma Zhiqiang nodded in agreement and said he would participate more often in the future. The whole process took about 12 minutes, and the atmosphere was warm.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Morning Stretching: Weekly Record Completed
subevent.description: Friday at 6:50 a.m., Ma Xiulan alone in the living room completed the last morning stretch of the week, with standard movements, taking 8 minutes in total. After stretching, she opened her notebook and summarized the week's experience: 'The habit has become natural. Doing it every day, my body is no longer stiff, and my mood has improved.' She took photos of this week's records and sent them to the family WeChat group, and @'d her husband and children, encouraging everyone to stick with it together. The children sent thumbs-up emojis in the group, and her husband replied with 'Good.' Ma Xiulan felt a strong sense of accomplishment.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Daughter's cavity treatment and the awakening of family oral hygiene awareness.
description: On the morning of September 28, her youngest daughter Xin Xin cried out with a toothache. Ma Xiulan examined her and found a black cavity in her baby tooth, so she immediately took her to the community dental clinic. The doctor performed a root canal and filled the tooth, costing 200 yuan. During the treatment, Xin Xin cried and fussed nonstop, while Xiulan held her hand and promised, 'After this, Mom will make you a cloth doll.' After returning home, she reduced the family's candy supplies and began enforcing the children's teeth-brushing before bed.

subevent.name: Discovered that her daughter had a toothache and decided to seek medical treatment
subevent.description: On the morning of September 28, Ma Xiulan was at home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, when she heard her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) crying that she had a toothache. She immediately checked and found an obvious black cavity in the primary molar on the lower left side. Ma Xiulan judged that medical attention was needed soon and decided to take Xinxin to the community dental clinic on Jingwen Road. She first calmed Xinxin down, then packed a few belongings and got ready to leave.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Taking her daughter to the community dental clinic.
subevent.description: At around 9:30 in the morning, Ma Xiulan walked hand in hand with her daughter Ma Yuxin to the community dental clinic, also on Jingwen Road, about a 5-minute walk. Along the way, Ma Xiulan kept comforting her daughter, encouraging her to be brave, and promising to buy her a small snack after the dental visit (but later realizing that candy was not good, she changed it to making a cloth doll). After arriving at the clinic, Ma Xiulan registered and briefly explained the situation to the nurse.
subevent.location: Dental Clinic of Jingwen Road Community, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Root canal treatment and tooth filling for daughter's dental caries.
subevent.description: In the treatment room of the community dental clinic, the doctor (Dr. Wang) examined Ma Yuxin and diagnosed severe decay in her baby tooth that had damaged the pulp, so root canal treatment and filling were needed. During the procedure, Xinxin cried and fussed uncontrollably from pain and fear. Ma Xiulan sat beside her the whole time, holding her hand and softly comforting her, promising, “Mommy will make you a cloth doll afterwards.” After about 30 minutes of treatment, the doctor finished. The total cost was 200 yuan (Ma Xiulan paid in cash). Afterward, the doctor explained the aftercare instructions and prescribed a small amount of anti-inflammatory medicine.
subevent.location: Treatment Room of Jingwen Road Community Dental Clinic, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Reduce the family's candy stock after returning home
subevent.description: After returning home at noon, Ma Xiulan settled Xinxin on the sofa to rest, then began tidying the snack cabinet in the living room. She counted all the high-sugar candies, cookies, and drinks, put most of the candies (about half a jin) into a sealed bag and placed it on the top shelf of the cabinet, keeping only a small amount for the children to enjoy occasionally. She also told the three children: from now on, they could not eat candy casually, only a little on special occasions. At the same time, she decided to buy fewer processed snacks and more fruit instead when shopping for groceries.
subevent.location: Kitchen and living room of the home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: For the first time, strictly supervised the children brushing their teeth before bed
subevent.description: At 9 o'clock that evening, Ma Xiulan gathered her three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) in the bathroom and asked them to brush their teeth carefully one by one. She personally demonstrated the correct brushing method (up and down, inside and out, brushing for a full two minutes) and checked each child's brushing one by one. For six-year-old Xinxin, Ma Xiulan squeezed out toothpaste for her and guided her hand by hand to make sure every tooth was brushed. She set a rule that from then on, everyone must finish brushing by 9 p.m. each night and could go to bed only after brushing, and announced that 13-year-old elder brother Ma Mingxuan would be in charge of supervising his younger siblings' compliance. The first supervision session lasted about 15 minutes.
subevent.location: Home bathroom on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Preparing for a Double Ninth Festival visit to honor the elderly
description: On October 9, 2025, Ma Xiulan hurriedly made 10 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables at home and prepared cleaning and health-checking supplies such as rags and a blood pressure monitor. On the afternoon of October 10, she went to the community service center to report to grid worker Zheng Xiuying, confirmed the addresses and needs of two elderly people living alone, then took the items and invited her neighbor Wang Guilan to go with her. The two agreed on their division of work for the visits.

subevent.name: Check in with the community grid worker to confirm the visit details.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to the Jingwen Road Community Service Center, found community grid worker Zheng Xiuying, checked in with her, and made the final confirmation before the Double Ninth Festival visit to the elderly. The two verified the addresses, health conditions, and specific needs of two elderly residents living alone (residing on Shengli Street and Jingwen Road respectively), such as whether they needed daily necessities or medical assistance, and recorded the contact information of the elderly residents' children in case of emergencies. Zheng Xiuying gave Ma Xiulan a handwritten visit checklist and reminded her of precautions for entering the residents' homes.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Rushing to make low-salt pickled vegetables
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned from the community service center to her home at 156 Jingwen Road, put on an apron, and began making pickled vegetables for the visits. Following the recipe she had prepared in advance, she used cucumbers, radishes, and chili peppers harvested from her own small vegetable garden, strictly controlled the salt ratio (reducing the salt per jar by one-third compared to the usual amount), and added an appropriate amount of garlic cloves and shredded ginger to enhance the flavor. In the kitchen, she sterilized, filled, and sealed 10 clean glass jars one by one, which took about two hours. When finished, she tied a small card with red string around each jar and wrote, "Wishing you health on the Double Ninth Festival — respectfully presented by Ma Xiulan."
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Prepare cleaning and health check tools
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan sorted out the supplies she needed for the next day’s home visits in her bedroom and storage room. She took out a clean rag, checked it, and packed it with spare garbage bags. From the cabinet she took the household electronic blood pressure monitor (replaced the batteries with new ones and tested it to make sure it worked). She also prepared a sticky note with the phone number of Dr. Wang from the community clinic, in case any elderly person had a health emergency. All the items were neatly packed into a reusable cloth bag and placed in a prominent spot by the living room door.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Invite neighbor Wang Guilan and discuss the division of labor
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, carrying the prepared pickled vegetables and a supplies list, walked across to 158 Jingwen Road and knocked on Wang Guilan's door, formally inviting her to visit the elderly people living alone together on the Double Ninth Festival. The two sat down in the living room, and Ma Xiulan explained the visit plan in detail: first, go to Uncle Li's home on Shengli Street, then to Grandma Zhang's home on Jingwen Road. She suggested that Wang Guilan take charge of cleaning and tidying, while she herself would measure blood pressure, give out the pickled vegetables, and chat with the elderly. Wang Guilan readily agreed and suggested she could bring a broom and a few rags from home to help. They agreed to meet the next morning at 9:00 at the entrance of Ma Xiulan's residential community.
subevent.location: Wang Guilan's home, 158 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Couple's night talk on a warm winter night.
description: On the evening of December 8, after the children had gone to sleep, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat in the kitchen chatting over hot tea. She took out the ledger, and the two carefully calculated this year's income and next year's expenses. Her husband said softly, 'You've worked hard. Next year I'll put in a few more runs.' She shook her head and held his rough hand: 'As a family, we'll bear it together. There's nothing to fear.' Outside the window the cold wind howled, but inside the room it was warm and cozy.

subevent.name: Prepare hot tea and the account book.
subevent.description: At 9:30 in the evening, Ma Xiulan picked up the family accounting book and a pen from the living room coffee table, went into the kitchen, boiled water with the kettle, brewed two cups of hot tea, placed them at either end of the small kitchen table, and waited for her husband Ma Zhiqiang to come over from the living room.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: The couple carefully went over the family accounts.
subevent.description: At 10 p.m., Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat face to face at the small kitchen table, drinking hot tea and flipping through the account book. Ma Xiulan read out the main income and expenses for the year item by item, including her husband's salary, her own income from part-time handicraft work, daily expenses, and the children's tuition and living expenses. The two estimated possible expenditures and savings plans for the coming year together.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home Kitchen

subevent.name: Comforting each other and expressing support
subevent.description: At 10:30 p.m., after finishing the accounts, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took Ma Xiulan's hand and said softly, "You've worked hard. Next year I'll drive a few more trips." Ma Xiulan shook her head, held his rough hand, and replied, "As long as the family carries the burden together, there's nothing to be afraid of." The two were silent for a moment; outside the window the cold wind howled, while the kitchen was filled with warmth — both felt the support and warmth of family.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home Kitchen

name: Accompanied her parents for their autumn health check-up and dietary adjustments.
description: Ma Xiulan contacted her parents in advance and accompanied them to the community health service center on September 15, 2025, for the free autumn health checkup. Her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure was stable, and her mother Li Xiuying had slightly elevated blood lipids. The doctor advised a light diet. After the checkup, Ma Xiulan went home to adjust the family menu and made a health reminder card for her parents, sticking it on the refrigerator for daily reminders.

subevent.name: Scheduling and preparing for the autumn health checkup
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted her father Ma Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying by phone in advance, confirmed that they were available on September 15 to participate in the community-organized free autumn health check-up, reminded her father to bring his hypertension medical records and relevant examination reports, and her mother also planned to attend. At the same time, she prepared the medical insurance cards for her parents and herself and confirmed the check-up time and location.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - No. 156 Jingwen Road (Ma Xiulan's home)

subevent.name: Accompanying her parents to their autumn health checkup
subevent.description: On the morning of September 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan accompanied her father Ma Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying to the Jinghai District Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center for the community-organized free autumn health check-up. Her father had his blood pressure measured and an electrocardiogram, and her mother completed tests for blood lipids and blood glucose. Her father's indicators were stable, but her mother's blood lipid test results were elevated.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Listen to the doctor's advice and record the examination results
subevent.description: After the examination, Ma Xiulan and her parents listened to the community doctor (Dr. Wang Jianguo) as he explained the results in detail. The doctor said that her father Ma Jianguo's high blood pressure was well controlled and his blood pressure was stable, while her mother Li Xiuying's blood lipids were on the high side. He advised adjusting the diet, reducing greasy foods, and eating more vegetables, fruits, and whole grains. Ma Xiulan carefully noted the doctor's instructions and promised on the spot to adjust the family's meal plan at home.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Go home, adjust the recipe, and make a health reminder card.
subevent.description: After returning home that afternoon, Ma Xiulan, following the doctor’s advice, immediately adjusted the family’s menu for the coming week, reducing braised and fried dishes and adding light, healthy dishes such as steamed fish, blanched vegetables, and mixed-grain rice. She also made a health reminder card for her parents, writing on cardboard the examination dates, values, doctor’s advice, and precautions for her father’s blood pressure and mother’s blood lipids. She attached it to the refrigerator door with a magnet so the whole family would be reminded daily to pay attention to healthy eating.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Preparation and remedy consultation for the annual social security subsidy eligibility confirmation.
description: On the morning of November 28, Zheng Xiuying from the community service station called to remind Ma Xiulan that she needed to bring her flexible employment certificate at the beginning of next month to complete the annual eligibility confirmation for social security subsidies. Ma Xiulan searched through everything to find her pickled vegetable sales notebook and hand-written receipts, and found that the records were incomplete, breaking into a sweat. She immediately contacted Zheng Xiuying to ask for remedies. Zheng Xiuying suggested contacting customers to re-sign receipts or going to the community to ask about alternative proof. Ma Xiulan wrote down the suggestions and breathed a slight sigh of relief.

subevent.name: Received a reminder call from Zheng Xiuying.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 28, 2025, Ma Xiulan answered a phone call from Zheng Xiuying at the community service station in her living room. Zheng Xiuying told Ma Xiulan that she needed to bring her flexible employment certificate to the community service station at the beginning of next month for the annual eligibility confirmation of social security subsidies; otherwise, the subsidy payment might be affected. Ma Xiulan said she understood and thanked her for the reminder.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

subevent.name: Searched for the pickled vegetable sales notebook and hand-embroidery receipts
subevent.description: After hanging up, Ma Xiulan immediately rummaged through the utility cabinets and drawers at home, looking for the notebook and receipts recording her income from flexible employment (pickled vegetable sales and hand embroidery). She first found the hand-embroidery receipts in the bedroom desk drawer, then dug out the pickled vegetable sales notebook from the bottom of a storage box in the living room. The whole process took about 20 minutes, during which she was tense and sweating on her forehead.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District, 156 Jingwen Road - bedroom desk at home, living room storage box

subevent.name: Checking records found them incomplete.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan spread the found pickle sales notebook and hand-embroidery receipts on the dining table in the living room and checked the dates and amounts one by one. She found that the pickle sales records for the last three months had omissions, and some hand-embroidery receipts had not been recorded in time, so the overall income proof was incomplete. Worried that this would affect the confirmation of her social security subsidy eligibility, she paced around in anxiety, muttering to herself as she tried to recall the possible sales times.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - dining table in the living room at home.

subevent.name: Contact Zheng Xiuying to ask for remedies.
subevent.description: After discovering the incomplete records, Ma Xiulan immediately called Zheng Xiuying again on her phone and anxiously explained that her records were incomplete, asking whether it was possible to issue a supplementary certificate or provide alternative materials. Zheng Xiuying reassured her not to worry too much and suggested she contact the previous client as soon as possible to sign a supplementary receipt, or go to the community service station to ask about other ways to prove flexible employment (such as a certificate issued by the community). Ma Xiulan wrote down the suggestions and felt a little relieved.
subevent.location: No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

name: Neighbor Wang Guilan brought over pickled radish, and Ma Xiulan gave her preserved vegetables in return.
description: On the evening of November 22, neighbor Wang Guilan brought a bowl of her home-pickled radish to Ma Xiulan's home, saying it was newly pickled and asked her to taste it. After thanking her, Ma Xiulan turned around, took a small jar of newly made pickled vegetables from the kitchen, and gave it in return. The two chatted about everyday life at the door. Wang Guilan praised Ma Xiulan for her skillful hands, and Ma Xiulan thanked her for her usual care.

subevent.name: Wang Guilan gave pickled radish as a gift
subevent.description: In the evening, neighbor Wang Guilan came to Ma Xiulan’s door with a bowl of freshly pickled radish she had made herself. After knocking and greeting, she handed it to Ma Xiulan, saying it had just been pickled and she wanted Ma Xiulan to taste it. Ma Xiulan opened the door to welcome her, took the bowl with both hands, broke into a delighted smile, and thanked her repeatedly.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan gave pickled vegetables in return.
subevent.description: After taking the pickled radish, Ma Xiulan turned and walked into the kitchen, took a small jar of her newly made pickled vegetables from the cabinet, wrapped the jar mouth in cloth, walked back to the door, and handed it to Wang Guilan, smiling and saying that these were pickled vegetables she had just made, asking her to take them home to try, and thanking her for looking after her at ordinary times. After a few polite refusals, Wang Guilan happily accepted.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Chatting idly at the doorway
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan stood at the front door and, on the occasion of returning a gift for the vegetables sent over, chatted about everyday life. Wang Guilan praised Ma Xiulan for her skillful hands and the tasty pickled vegetables she made, while Ma Xiulan thanked Wang Guilan for usually helping look after the children and sharing fresh vegetables. The two chatted for about ten minutes, on topics including the children's studies, community news, and preparations for the upcoming holiday. The atmosphere was warm and pleasant. In the end, they said goodnight and went home separately.
subevent.location: At the doorstep of 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: The promotion of slow-selling pickled vegetables and the savings dispute and compromise triggered by her husband's salary cut
description: In early August, high temperatures caused a sharp drop in pickled vegetable sales, and by August 14 inventory had piled up for two weeks. Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei launched a buy-three-get-one-free promotion, successfully clearing the stock and earning 230 yuan. However, her husband Ma Zhiqiang's salary was cut during the logistics company's off-season, and on the evening of August 15 he proposed suspending the monthly 200 yuan savings plan at the dinner table. Ma Xiulan refuted tearfully; after a heated argument, her husband slammed the door and left. The next day he came home with crucian carp to admit his mistake. After calm negotiation, both sides lowered the monthly savings to 50 yuan and agreed to raise it back once her husband's income recovered.

subevent.name: Slow sales of pickled vegetables and handling of backlog
subevent.description: In early August 2025, the high heat caused a sharp decline in sales of Ma Xiulan's homemade pickled vegetables; on the first day, only 5 jars were sold. Over the next few days, she and her childhood friend Liu Chunmei tried promotions at the vegetable market and publicized them through WeChat Moments. Neighbor Wang Guilan and others helped promote sales. On August 10, Ma Xiulan made gift boxes and contacted relatives and friends for distribution, receiving some orders. By August 14, there were still 28 jars in stock. After discussing with her husband, she decided to stop making new pickled vegetables, give some to neighbors, and leave the rest with a vegetable stall owner to sell on consignment, in order to stop losses and reduce inventory.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road and Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Pickled vegetable sales decline on the first day
subevent.description: At 6:00 in the morning on August 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan, as usual, moved 30 jars of freshly pickled traditional vegetables to her rented regular stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. Starting at 9:00 a.m., she noticed significantly fewer customers than before. By noon only 3 jars had been sold, while during the same period last year she could sell about 15 jars. She took the initiative to hawk and invited regular customers to try samples, but with little effect. When she closed the stall at 4:00 p.m., 5 jars had been sold in total, and the remaining 25 jars had to be transported home. In her home kitchen, Ma Xiulan counted the inventory with a heavy heart and began to worry about the poor sales of pickled vegetables caused by the persistent high temperatures.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road and Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Childhood friend helped market the pickles
subevent.description: On the morning of August 3, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to the vegetable market again with the 28 jars of pickled vegetables that had not sold the previous day and set up a stall. When her childhood friend Liu Chunmei heard about this, she came to the stall at 10 a.m. to help. Liu Chunmei handed out small spoons to passersby for tasting and played short videos she had recorded of the pickling process on her phone to attract customers. Ma Xiulan continued to tout the goods and launched a temporary promotion of 'buy three, get one free.' By 3 p.m. that day, they had sold 8 jars, but that was still below the usual daily sales. The two discussed countermeasures in front of the stall, and Liu Chunmei suggested promoting through WeChat Moments. After packing up the stall, Ma Xiulan and Liu Chunmei had a simple lunch at a nearby steamed bun shop and discussed further promotion plans in detail.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Trying to promote on WeChat Moments
subevent.description: On the morning of August 5, 2025, Ma Xiulan did not go to the vegetable market to set up her stall, but stayed at her home at 156 Jingwen Road. Following Liu Chunmei's advice, she used her phone to take a few photos of the pickled vegetables and wrote a promotional blurb describing them as Tianjin-style pickled vegetables made by her own traditional family craftsmanship, with no additives and at an affordable price. At 10 a.m., she posted the text and photos to her WeChat Moments, and privately messaged several close friends and relatives, including her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin and neighbor Wang Guilan, asking them to help share it. Wang Guilan came over to visit that morning and proactively offered to try selling them at the entrance of her residential community. Ma Xiulan was very grateful and gave Wang Guilan two jars of pickled vegetables as samples. In the evening, Ma Xiulan received WeChat orders from several friends, for a total of 6 jars, and planned to deliver them the next day.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Making simple gift boxes and contacting relatives and friends
subevent.description: On the morning of August 10, 2025, Ma Xiulan began making simple pickled vegetable gift boxes in the living room of her home. She found the clean glass jars and paper boxes she had saved up, repackaged the pickled vegetables in stock, put different flavors (such as cucumber, radish, and chili) into each box, and tied them with red string into bows. She worked until noon and made 10 simple gift boxes in total. Then she contacted her younger sister Ma Xiufen and sent her photos and prices of the gift boxes via WeChat. Ma Xiufen said she could recommend them in the Moments of the clothing store where she worked. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan also contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei and her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin, asking them to help promote the items in their respective communities and offer group-buying discounts. Both friends readily agreed. That evening, Ma Xiulan received orders for 3 gift boxes from Binhai New Area and 5 bulk orders from Jinghai, which slightly eased the backlog.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Take inventory and decide on a loss-cutting plan
subevent.description: On the morning of August 14, 2025, Ma Xiulan re-counted all the pickled vegetable stock in the kitchen, including unsold bulk pickled vegetables and undelivered gift boxes. There were still 28 jars of pickled vegetables in stock, which exceeded the expected shelf life (although pickled products can be stored, their best-flavor period is limited). She realized that even continuing regular sales would make it hard to sell them all in the short term. In the morning she called her husband Ma Zhiqiang (who was out on a transport run). After discussing, they decided: give some of the pickled vegetables to the families of close neighbors Wang Guilan and Zhang Shufen, as well as to her parents' home; for the rest, try to wholesale them at cost price to Aunt Sun, the seasoning stall owner at the vegetable market, and ask Aunt Sun to sell them on consignment. Ma Xiulan would no longer set up a stall herself. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan contacted Wang Guilan, Zhang Shufen, and Aunt Sun respectively, and completed verbal agreements for the gifts and consignment sales. At that point, Ma Xiulan decided to stop making new pickled vegetables for the time being, prioritize clearing the existing stock, and began thinking about how to avoid the problem of slow summer sales in the future. Although she still lost some money, her mood was much calmer than before.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road and Xingwang Vegetable Market
