subevent.name: Promotion to clear out pickled vegetable stock.
subevent.description: On the morning of August 14, after discussing at her home on Jingwen Road with her childhood friend Liu Chunmei, Ma Xiulan decided to launch a buy-three-get-one-free promotion. In the afternoon, the two set up a stall at Xingwang Vegetable Market, attracting customers by loudly hawking and offering discounts. They successfully cleared out the entire two-week backlog of stock, earning 230 yuan in the end.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: A savings argument triggered by a salary cut.
subevent.description: During dinner on August 15, her husband Ma Zhiqiang told Ma Xiulan at the dinner table in their home on Jingwen Road that, because the logistics company had cut salaries in the off-season, he proposed suspending the monthly 200 yuan family savings plan. Ma Xiulan tearfully objected, accusing him of ignoring the family's long-term plans, and they had a fierce argument. Ma Zhiqiang lost his temper, slammed the door, and left.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home dining room on Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Settled and reached a savings reduction agreement.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of August 16, Ma Zhiqiang came home carrying crucian carp and proactively admitted his mistake to Ma Xiulan. The two calmly discussed it in the living room and finally decided to reduce the monthly savings from 200 yuan to 50 yuan, agreeing to restore the original amount once Ma Zhiqiang's income recovers. Ma Xiulan accepted the proposal, and the family returned to harmony.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

name: Prepare breakfast and have breakfast together as a family.
description: From December 25 to 28, Ma Xiulan sorted through the family's annual income and expenses and finally double-checked them with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. The family's total income was 43,200 yuan, total expenditure was 41,000 yuan, and the year-end balance was 2,200 yuan. She calculated her total part-time income at about 4,800 yuan, including 1,680 yuan in net profit from pickled vegetables, 550 yuan from hand embroidery and fabric crafts, and 1,600 yuan in social security subsidies. On the 27th, she checked the education reserve fund account balance of 3,500 yuan, which was 1,500 yuan short of the 5,000-yuan goal, but she had already saved more than half. On the evening of the 28th, her husband closed the account book and said softly, 'Next year will be better for us.' She nodded in agreement.

subevent.name: Collect and sort out annual income and expense receipts.
subevent.description: In the study at home, Ma Xiulan organized the various receipts and bills in the drawer, including her husband's pay slips, her own part-time income records, daily household expense receipts, and utility bills, to prepare for the year-end financial review.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Calculate the family's annual income and expense details.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan spread the account book and calculator out on the living room coffee table, entered and calculated the household's total annual income of 43,200 yuan and total expenditure of 41,000 yuan, and confirmed an annual surplus of 2,200 yuan. She also separately calculated her personal part-time income details, including a net profit of 1,680 yuan from pickled vegetables, 550 yuan from hand embroidery and fabric crafts, and 1,600 yuan from social security subsidies, totaling about 4,800 yuan.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Review the education reserve fund account
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan checked the balance of the savings account dedicated to her children's education through mobile banking; it showed 3,500 yuan. She compared it with the target of 5,000 yuan, confirmed that she was still 1,500 yuan short, but had saved more than half. She then recorded the account status in the family ledger.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: The couple reviewed and summarized the year's finances together.
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang sat at the dining table, going through the account books together, checking income and expense items and the education reserve fund data one by one. After closing the ledger, her husband said in a low voice, "Next year we'll do better." Ma Xiulan nodded in agreement, and the two reached a consensus on the family's financial situation.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

name: Market research on the pickled vegetable sideline business.
description: Starting on February 3, Ma Xiulan had the idea of a pickled vegetable sideline and recorded key research points. Over the following days, she searched online for market information, asked her neighbor Wang Guilan for experience, and discussed plans with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. On February 7, she organized her notes and set goals for market visits. On February 8, she went to a handicraft market with her good friend Zhou Xiuqin, observed the business and layout of the pickled vegetable stalls, and, encouraged, decided to make preparations. On February 9, based on the visits, she listed the materials needed, calculated the costs, and completed the preliminary research.

subevent.name: Came up with the idea of a pickled-vegetable side business and planned to research it.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan sat in the living room at home thinking about the feasibility of making pickled vegetables in her spare time as a family side business. She took out a notebook and recorded the key points that needed research, including the types of pickled vegetables, raw material costs, sales channels, and market entry requirements.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Search online for pickled vegetable market information.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used her phone to search online for making methods of local Tianjin pickled vegetables, prices of common ingredients, market stall fees, and other information, and took screenshots of the key content to save in her phone's photo album for later use.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Consulting neighbor Wang Guilan about tips for making pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Wang Guilan at her door on Jingwen Road. As they chatted, she mentioned her idea of making pickled vegetables as a sideline. Wang Guilan shared her many years of experience with pickling and suggested she start with small trial batches, and also promised to give her some chili peppers she had grown herself.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Discuss the pickled vegetable side business plan with her husband
subevent.description: In the evening, after her husband Ma Zhiqiang came home from work, Ma Xiulan discussed making pickles as a side business with him at the dinner table. Ma Zhiqiang expressed support, but reminded her to pay attention to cost control and food hygiene, and also promised to help her move the equipment on the weekend.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Organize the research notes and define the goals for the market visit.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan organized the research information and experience notes from the previous days into two tables: one was a cost estimate, and the other was key points for observing the market. She decided to go with Zhou Xiuqin the next day to the handicraft market to inspect the pickled vegetable stall in person.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Visited the handicraft market with Zhou Xiuqin and examined the pickled vegetable stalls
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her good friend Zhou Xiuqin went together to the handicraft market in Jinghai District. They specifically found the pickled vegetable stall to observe its business and saw quite a few customers waiting in line. Zhou Xiuqin encouraged her to try boldly. The two also carefully looked at the stall's packaging jars, price list, and small tablecloth arrangement. Ma Xiulan took photos with her phone and decided to start preparing as soon as she got home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Handicraft Market

subevent.name: Listed the ingredients for making pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: After returning from the market, Ma Xiulan, based on her research notes and the earlier information, made a detailed list at home of the fresh vegetables, salt, sugar, spices, and airtight jars needed for the first batch of pickled vegetables, and calculated the total cost at about 80 yuan.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Paying the urban and rural residents' medical insurance premium
description: On the morning of October 25, Ma Xiulan took 532 yuan from her pickled vegetable income and went to the community service station to pay 380 yuan in insurance premiums for her family of five and 152 yuan on behalf of her parents. She carefully checked the payment receipts, clipped them into her account book, and murmured to herself, 'Only when the whole family has protection can I feel at ease.'

subevent.name: Prepare cash for the medical insurance premium.
subevent.description: In the study at home, Ma Xiulan counted out the medical insurance payment from the cash she kept from her pickle sales: the premiums for her family of five (herself and her spouse Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin) totaled 380 yuan, and the premiums for her parents (Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying) were 152 yuan, for a total of 532 yuan. She put it in her small handbag for later use.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Going to the community service station.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the prepared cash and ID documents and walked to the community comprehensive service station located on Jingwen Road. The station is about 500 meters from her home, about a 5-minute walk away.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Pay the medical insurance premiums for the family of five.
subevent.description: At the medical insurance window of the community service station, Ma Xiulan handed 380 yuan in cash to the staff member and provided the ID numbers of herself, her spouse Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin to pay the 2025 basic medical insurance for urban and rural residents. The staff member printed out the payment receipt.
subevent.location: Community Comprehensive Service Station, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Pay medical insurance premiums for her parents
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan then explained to the staff member that she wanted to pay the medical insurance premiums on behalf of her parents. She provided the ID information of her father Ma Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying, handed 152 yuan in cash to the counter, completed the 2025 annual premium payment for the elderly couple, and received the corresponding payment receipt.
subevent.location: Community Comprehensive Service Station, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Verify and store the payment vouchers.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan carefully checked the names, ID card numbers, and amounts on the two payment vouchers on the spot at the service station counter. After confirming they were correct, she carefully folded the vouchers and tucked them into the accounting notebook in her handbag, murmuring to herself, 'Only when the whole family has protection can I feel at ease.'
subevent.location: Community Comprehensive Service Station, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan completed all the payment procedures, she walked back to her home at 156 Jingwen Road. When she got home, she put the accounting notebook back in the desk drawer and carefully put away the change.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Online New Year's Eve craft tea party
description: On December 29, Ma Xiulan organized an online New Year's Eve craft tea party. In the afternoon, she prepared display materials and equipment in the living room and contacted participants; in the evening, she video-called with five sisters, showed her works of the year, and exchanged praise and ideas; after the meeting, they said goodnight and agreed to share photos and continue chatting later.

subevent.name: Prepare materials and equipment for the tea party.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 29, Ma Xiulan sorted out display items in the living room for the New Year's Eve craft tea party, including the family album and the Hebei chili sauce developed together with Aunt Wu, and checked the phone stand and charging devices to ensure smooth video calls in the evening. At the same time, she contacted Zhou Xiuqin, Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, her mother, and Aunt Wu one by one through the WeChat group, confirmed the call time and software usage, and reminded everyone to prepare their annual handmade works.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Held an online New Year's Eve handicraft tea party
subevent.description: From 7 to 10 p.m., Ma Xiulan initiated a video call in her living room; Zhou Xiuqin, Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, her mother, and Aunt Wu, who was far away in Hebei, all joined. The six of them took turns showing off their works of the year: Ma Xiulan held up the family photo album and the Hebei chili sauce she had developed together with Aunt Wu; Zhou Xiuqin displayed new Spring Festival paper-cutting designs; Aunt Wu showed a newly crocheted shawl; Liu Chunmei presented handmade chair cushions she was selling on consignment. They praised one another and exchanged techniques. Aunt Wu immediately invited Ma Xiulan to come to Hebei next year to compare skills. Laughter rose one after another, and the atmosphere was warm and intimate.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Tea Party Wrap-Up and Follow-Up Plans
subevent.description: After the video call ended at 10 p.m., Ma Xiulan said goodnight to her sisters in the WeChat group chat and agreed to share photos of the displayed works in the group. She put away the family photo album and chili sauce properly, had a private chat with Aunt Wu to confirm the initial intention to go to Hebei for an exchange next year, and replied to private messages from Zhou Xiuqin, Liu Chunmei, Wang Guilan, and her mother. Before bed, she looked through the photo album and savored the warm moments of the evening.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Pay the winter heating fee and clean the radiators
description: On the morning of November 3, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to the heating business hall in Jinghai District to pay 1,200 yuan for her own heating and advance 800 yuan for her parents. After returning home, she cleaned all the radiators in the house to ensure smooth heating in winter.

subevent.name: Go to the heating service hall
subevent.description: On the morning of November 3, 2025, Ma Xiulan set out from her home at No. 156, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and walked or cycled to the Jinghai District Heating Service Hall to pay the winter heating fee.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - route from home to the heating service hall

subevent.name: Pay our own heating bill and cover our parents' heating bill in advance
subevent.description: At the heating service hall in Jinghai District, Ma Xiulan first paid 1200 yuan for her own heating fee, then advanced 800 yuan for her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying's heating fee, paying 2000 yuan in total. After paying, she received the receipt and confirmed that the payment was completed.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Heating Business Hall

subevent.name: Return home.
subevent.description: After completing the payment, Ma Xiulan walked or cycled back to her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, carrying the receipt.
subevent.location: Along the way from the heating utility hall in Jinghai District, Tianjin to home.

subevent.name: Cleaned all the radiators in the house.
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took out rags, brushes, and other tools, and cleaned the dust on the surfaces and dirt in the gaps of the radiators in every room of the house one by one. She checked whether the valves moved smoothly to ensure smooth heating in winter. After cleaning, she put the tools back in place.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home, 156 Jingwen Road

name: Attended her natal nephew's wedding and reunited with her female cousins.
description: On November 23, Ma Xiulan took the three children by herself to Shengli Street in Jinghai District to attend the wedding of her mother's brother's son. She wore a newly made top with Chinese knot buttons and looked especially spirited in front of her maternal relatives. At the banquet, she sat with her female cousins whom she had not seen for many years and talked about their lives. Her older cousin praised her for her cooking, while her younger cousin shared parenting tips. Ma Xiulan helped set the tables and serve dishes, and the elders praised her for being capable. She felt the strong warmth of family affection and also kept track of the social gift accounts.

subevent.name: Pack for the wedding and prepare red envelopes.
subevent.description: After getting up in the early morning, Ma Xiulan put on the new Chinese-style top with frog buttons she had made earlier, helped herself and her three children get dressed neatly, and took cash out of the piggy bank to put into red envelopes as wedding gifts for her nephew. At the same time, she reminded the children of the etiquette and rules for the wedding.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Took the children to the wedding venue
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the three children from their home on Jingwen Road to the wedding venue on Shengli Avenue in Jinghai District (a restaurant or a relative's home), on foot or by public transportation. Along the way, she took good care of the children to ensure they arrived safely and on time.
subevent.location: Shengli Street section, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Arrived at the wedding venue and exchanged pleasantries with the bride's family.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan arrived at the wedding venue on Shengli Street with her children, greeted her parents, brothers, and other elder relatives from her maiden family, and gave red envelope gifts. Then she found her seat and settled the children down.
subevent.location: A wedding venue on Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Wedding ceremony and dining at the same table with female cousins.
subevent.description: The wedding ceremony was underway, and Ma Xiulan watched with her children. After the banquet began, she sat with cousins she hadn't seen for years, eating and chatting. Her older cousin praised her cooking skills, and her younger cousin shared parenting experience. The atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Wedding banquet venue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Helped set the table and serve dishes, and was praised by the elders
subevent.description: During the banquet, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to stand up and help set the tables and serve dishes. Noticing this, relatives and elders praised her for being capable and thoughtful. She felt the warm, deep affection of family.

participant.name: Several elders from my parents' family

subevent.location: Wedding banquet venue, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After the wedding ended, she said goodbye to relatives and returned home.
subevent.description: After the wedding, Ma Xiulan said goodbye one by one to her family and female cousins, and took the three children back home on Jingwen Road from Shengli Street. When the children got sleepy on the way, she patiently comforted them.
subevent.location: Section from Shengli Avenue to Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After returning home, recorded the social gift ledger.
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan took a small notebook out of her pocket and wrote down the amount of cash gift she had given at her nephew's wedding, as well as any return gift she received, updating the family gift ledger for future reference.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home living room on Jingwen Road

name: Husband received the perfect attendance award and the family celebrated
description: On November 25, her husband Ma Zhiqiang received a 300 yuan attendance bonus because logistics orders had picked up, and he bought a roast duck to celebrate at home. At the dinner table, he took the initiative to raise a toast and promised to smoke less next year and support Xiulan more. The couple became even more in tune with each other.

subevent.name: Husband buys roast duck after work
subevent.description: On the evening of November 25, 2025, Ma Xiulan's husband Ma Zhiqiang received a 300 yuan attendance bonus as logistics orders rebounded. After work, he went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District and bought about one roast duck from Aunt Sun's stall, planning to take it home to celebrate the joyful news with his family.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan prepares a celebration dinner
subevent.description: In the evening of November 25, 2025, Ma Xiulan prepared other dishes in advance in the home kitchen (such as gravy noodles, seasonal vegetables, etc.), and arranged for the three children, Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, to help set the tableware, waiting for her husband Ma Zhiqiang to bring roast duck home, creating a warm celebration atmosphere.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Family celebration dinner
subevent.description: On the evening of November 25, 2025, after Ma Zhiqiang came home with roast duck, the whole family (Ma Xiulan, Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin) gathered around the living room dining table for a celebratory dinner. Ma Zhiqiang raised his glass on his own initiative to thank the family for their support and promised to smoke less next year and help Ma Xiulan with more household chores. The couple felt more in tune with each other, and the children happily shared the roast duck.
subevent.location: Living room at home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After-dinner cleanup and family interaction
subevent.description: On the evening of November 25, 2025, after dinner, Ma Xiulan and Ma Yuxin cleaned up the dishes and wiped the table together, while Ma Zhiqiang watched TV for a while with their two sons in the living room and once again mentioned the joy of the perfect attendance bonus. The family atmosphere was warm and harmonious. Afterwards, everyone washed up and went to bed.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Courtyard winter preparation and cleaning
description: From November 8 to 9, Ma Xiulan made winter preparations for the roses in her own courtyard. She first prepared tools and straw, then pruned the rose branches, then piled straw around the base of the roses for warmth. Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, helped carry the straw and swept up the courtyard leaves the next day. Mother and son worked together to finish preparing the courtyard for winter.

subevent.name: Prepare cold-weather tools and materials
subevent.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan took out pruning shears, straw, gloves, and other cold-protection supplies from her storage room to prepare the courtyard roses for winter. She checked that the tools were in good condition and piled the straw in a corner of the courtyard for later use.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Pruning rose branches
subevent.description: In the courtyard, Ma Xiulan used scissors to cut away dead and diseased branches from the roses, keeping the sturdy main branches to help them survive the winter. While pruning, she explained the key points of pruning to her son who was helping beside her.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Pile straw to protect from the cold
subevent.description: After pruning, Ma Xiulan evenly piled the prepared straw around the roots of the roses to form an insulating layer and prevent frost damage. Ma Mingzhe took the initiative to help carry and spread the straw, and the mother and son worked in perfect coordination.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: The second son picked up fallen leaves.
subevent.description: After helping stack the straw, Ma Mingzhe took a broom and a dustpan, swept the fallen leaves on the courtyard ground clean, and dumped them into the trash can. He carefully swept every corner and was praised by his mother, Ma Xiulan.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

name: Completed computer training class for middle-aged and older adults
description: On December 4, at the Jinghai District community computer training classroom, Ma Xiulan attended the graduation ceremony of the computer training class for middle-aged and older adults and received her completion certificate. Afterwards, under Teacher Wang's guidance, she used Excel to enter the cost and revenue data for the year's preserved vegetables, used AutoSum and formulas to calculate the net profit, and felt that she had mastered computer skills.

subevent.name: Attended the completion ceremony.
subevent.description: In the community computer training classroom in Jinghai District, Ma Xiulan attended the completion ceremony of the computer training class for middle-aged and elderly people together with the other trainees, listened to the teacher summarize the course content, and received her certificate of completion.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community computer training classroom

subevent.name: Entered the full year's cost data for pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan opened an Excel spreadsheet on the computer in the training classroom and, based on the handwritten records prepared in advance, entered the costs of raw materials, auxiliary ingredients, packaging, and other items for each batch of pickled vegetables throughout the year, item by item, and checked the data accuracy.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community computer training classroom

subevent.name: Enter the full year's pickled vegetable income and calculate the net profit
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan continued to enter the sales revenue data for all batches of pickled vegetables throughout the year into Excel. She used the AutoSum function to calculate the total revenue and total cost, then used a formula to find the net profit, and confirmed that the calculation results were accurate.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community computer training classroom

name: Deposit the year-end balance into a fixed-term deposit.
description: On the morning of December 29, Ma Xiulan took the 2,200 yuan left over from her year-end inventory and walked to the Postal Savings Bank in Jinghai District to open a one-year fixed deposit. She planned to use the money as a family emergency reserve and also as extra security for education savings. While the teller helped her fill out the form, she looked at the figures printed on the deposit certificate and felt much more at ease.

subevent.name: Walked to the Postal Savings Bank.
subevent.description: At 8:30 a.m. on December 29, Ma Xiulan put 2,200 yuan in cash into her small change purse, set out on foot from her home on Jingwen Road, walked east along Jingwen Road, and arrived at the Postal Savings Bank branch in Jinghai District about 15 minutes later.
subevent.location: Postal Savings Bank of China, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Open a one-year fixed deposit.
subevent.description: At around 9 a.m. on December 29, Ma Xiulan filled out a fixed deposit slip at the counter of the Postal Savings Bank in Jinghai District and deposited 2,200 yuan in cash into a one-year fixed deposit account. The teller verified the information and printed the deposit certificate. She carefully confirmed the amount and maturity date on the certificate, then put it away.
subevent.location: Postal Savings Bank of China, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Deposit certificate custody and family financial records
subevent.description: After returning home at noon on December 29, Ma Xiulan placed the fixed deposit certificate in the file folder in her bedroom drawer for safekeeping, and wrote in the family ledger: On December 29, 2025, she deposited 2,200 yuan into a one-year fixed deposit, with the note “family emergency and education reserve fund.”
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Sign up the eldest son for a history enrichment class
description: On the afternoon of September 20, Ma Xiulan took her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, to an after-school tutoring institution in town to enroll him in the 'Junior High History Enrichment Class.' Because Mingxuan's history grades had dropped, she had long wanted to find a tutor for him. It happened that this institution's fall session was opening with a 20% discount, and one session of 20 class hours cost 600 yuan. She carefully read the course syllabus and talked with the teacher about her son's situation. In the end, she used the 500 yuan her husband had quietly slipped her, plus 100 yuan from her fabric-craft income, to pay the fee. Mingxuan was a bit resistant at first, but when he saw the interesting historical stories in the textbook, he reluctantly agreed to give it a try. When Ma Xiulan signed the payment form, she felt she had accomplished another major task and silently thought, 'As long as the child makes progress, the money is worth it.' The class is held once a week on Saturdays and will continue until the end of December.

subevent.name: Preparation before heading to the tutoring center
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan counted out the fees needed for registration. She put the 500 yuan her husband Ma Zhiqiang had secretly given her earlier and the 100 yuan she had earned from handicraft odd jobs — 600 yuan in cash in total — into her wallet. She also called her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, packed some personal items, confirmed the tutoring center's address and business hours, and prepared to set off for town.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Going to the town tutoring center
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took Ma Mingxuan and set off on foot from home at 156 Jingwen Road, walked through several streets to the tutoring institution on Commercial Street in Jinghai District. On the way, Ma Xiulan patiently talked to her eldest son, who was somewhat resistant, emphasized the importance of history study for school advancement, and encouraged him to read the stories in the textbook. Mingxuan gradually calmed down.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - on the road to town

subevent.name: On-site consultation and learning about course details.
subevent.description: After arriving at the tutoring center, Ma Xiulan, accompanied by Mingxuan, spoke with the course consultant at the front desk. She carefully looked through the curriculum outline, teaching plan, and fall semester class schedule for the "Junior High School History Advanced Class," confirmed the policy of 20 class sessions at an original price of 750 yuan, now with a 20% discount for an actual payment of 600 yuan, and asked about the instructor's qualifications and teaching format. Ma Mingxuan initially pouted reluctantly, but when he casually opened the textbook and saw a comic story about the Battle of Red Cliffs, his attention was caught and he grudgingly said he was willing to give it a try. The teacher further asked about Mingxuan's history grades and weak areas at school and thought this class type was very suitable for him.
subevent.location: After-school tutoring institutions in towns of Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Pay the fee and complete registration
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan made up her mind, took out the 500 yuan her husband had given her and 100 yuan in change she had earned from her handicrafts, totaling 600 yuan in cash, and handed it to the institution's payment office. The staff issued a receipt and asked her to sign the registration confirmation form, which noted "Junior High History Enrichment Class", with classes every Saturday afternoon, continuing until the end of December. As she signed, Ma Xiulan silently thought, "As long as the child makes progress, this money is worth spending." She took the receipt and course schedule and felt she had accomplished something important.
subevent.location: After-school tutoring institutions in towns of Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Return home and inform family members.
subevent.description: After the enrollment procedures were completed, Ma Xiulan left the institution with Ma Mingxuan and walked back to their home on Jingwen Road. When they arrived home, Ma Xiulan told her husband Ma Zhiqiang that the enrollment had been successful and showed him the course schedule and receipt. Ma Zhiqiang nodded in support. Then Ma Xiulan reminded Ma Mingxuan again to cherish the opportunity and attend class on time. The whole family was full of expectations for Mingxuan's future history studies.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Accompany her husband on a driving trip to Shijiazhuang, experiencing the hardships of the road
description: On August 25, her husband Ma Zhiqiang received an urgent order to transport goods to Luquan District, Shijiazhuang, and needed to rush back early the next morning. Since the distance was long, he planned to spend the night in the truck. On a whim, Ma Xiulan entrusted the three children to her mother Li Xiuying and decided to accompany her husband on the trip. She climbed up into the high passenger seat, buckled her seatbelt, and watched the rolling cornfields of the Hebei Plain along the way, chatting casually with her husband. After arriving at the factory area, she helped keep an eye on the cargo in the truck. While her husband was unloading, she bought a roujiamo and bottled water to stave off hunger. At night, the two lay side by side on the back seat of the cab, listening to the chirping of insects outside and the barking of dogs in the distance. Xiulan whispered, “Do you usually sleep here?” Her husband answered with an “Mm,” and after a long while added, “I'm used to it.” This trip gave Xiulan a deep appreciation of the hardships her husband faced on the road, and after returning home she was more considerate of him.

subevent.name: Entrust the child to her mother.
subevent.description: Because Ma Xiulan decided at the last minute to accompany her husband Ma Zhiqiang on a driving trip, on the morning of the 25th she took her three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) to her mother Li Xiuying's home, entrusted her mother to look after them for a day and a night, and gave detailed instructions about the children's meals, daily routines, and precautions.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Mother Li Xiuying's home

subevent.name: Met up with her husband and set off for Shijiazhuang.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan met her husband Ma Zhiqiang in the parking lot of the logistics company. She climbed into the high passenger seat of the truck and fastened her seatbelt, then drove with her husband from Jinghai District, Tianjin, along the highway toward Luquan District, Shijiazhuang. On the way, the two chatted about everyday matters, and Ma Xiulan enjoyed the cornfield scenery of the Hebei Plain through the window.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin, to Luquan District, Shijiazhuang - truck cab and expressway

subevent.name: Arrive at the factory area, unload goods, and have a meal.
subevent.description: After the truck arrived at a factory area in Luquan District, Shijiazhuang, Ma Xiulan stayed in the truck to help watch the goods while her husband Ma Zhiqiang unloaded. While waiting, Ma Xiulan bought roujiamo and bottled water from a nearby stall, and the two had a quick snack in the truck and rested for a while.
subevent.location: Luquan District, Shijiazhuang - a factory area

subevent.name: Spent the night in the truck's cab.
subevent.description: At night, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang lay side by side on the bed behind the seats in the truck cab, listening to the chirping of insects outside and the distant barking of dogs. Ma Xiulan softly asked her husband whether he usually slept here. He replied, "I'm used to it." This scene made Ma Xiulan deeply realize how hard her husband worked while traveling around.
subevent.location: Luquan District, Shijiazhuang City - truck cab

subevent.name: Return home the next day
subevent.description: Early the next morning, after an overnight drive from Luquan District, Shijiazhuang, Ma Zhiqiang drove Ma Xiulan back to their home in Jinghai District, Tianjin. They took turns resting along the way and arrived safely on the morning of the 26th.
subevent.location: Luquan District, Shijiazhuang to Jinghai District, Tianjin - in the truck and at home

subevent.name: After returning home, she was more considerate toward her husband.
subevent.description: After Ma Xiulan returned home, she immediately picked up the children and thanked her mother. Having deeply realized the hardship of her husband working away from home, she became more considerate toward him at home, took the initiative to do household chores, showed concern for him, and urged him to get enough rest.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Implementing family eye-care rules.
description: Starting July 1, Ma Xiulan posted the "Eye Protection Rules" on the living room blackboard: no more than 30 minutes of TV a day, no using the phone while lying down, and turn on the desk lamp when writing. She also moved the second son's seat from the corner by the wall to a spot near the window, encouraged the three children to have at least 1 hour of outdoor activity every day, and reduced her own embroidery in dim light. In early August, she gritted her teeth and spent 80 yuan to buy an eye-protection desk lamp online, installing it on the eldest son's desk for shared use.

subevent.name: Supervise daily adherence to eye-care guidelines
subevent.description: At home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan continued to supervise the family in following the eye care rules. Every morning she reminded the children to watch their TV time, in the late afternoon she urged them to get at least 1 hour of outdoor activity (such as playing in the small yard in front of the house or at a nearby park), and in the evening she checked whether the desk lamp was on while they did homework. She also made sure not to do embroidery in dim light and would correct her eldest son when he lay down to look at his phone. During this period, Ma Xiulan mainly relied on verbal reminders and leading by example to maintain the habits, and no obvious violations occurred.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Supervise daily adherence to eye-care guidelines
subevent.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan reminded her three children that they should not watch TV for more than one hour, and told them to mind their sitting posture. Around 4 p.m., she urged Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin to do outdoor activities for at least one hour in the yard or at the nearby Jinghai District Park, and she tended the small vegetable garden nearby. At 7 p.m., when the children began writing homework, she checked whether the desk lamp on each child's desk was on, and corrected her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's behavior of looking at his phone while lying down. She also did embroidery under bright light to lead by example.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home and nearby park

subevent.name: Supervise daily adherence to eye-care guidelines
subevent.description: At noon, Ma Xiulan reminded the children not to watch TV for too long and arranged for them to do outdoor activities in the afternoon. Ma Mingxuan played hide-and-seek with his younger brother and sister in the yard, while Ma Xiulan sat at the door embroidering. In the evening, she checked the brightness of the desk lamps one by one and praised her eldest son for not lying in bed looking at his phone today, encouraging him to keep it up.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home and courtyard

subevent.name: Supervise daily adherence to eye-care guidelines
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan had the children write out the day's activity plan, making sure there was time to be outdoors. In the afternoon, she took the three children to the park in Jinghai District to play ball and taught her daughter to recognize flowers and plants. In the evening, while they were doing homework, she noticed her second son had poor posture and promptly corrected him, demonstrating the correct sitting position. She also made a point of not doing handicrafts in dim light.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home and Park

subevent.name: Supervise daily adherence to eye-care guidelines
subevent.description: On the last day of the month, Ma Xiulan focused on checking how well the eye-care habits had been maintained. During the day, she reminded the children to keep up outdoor activities and took her youngest daughter to tidy up the vegetable garden in the yard. In the evening, she reviewed how the month's routine had been carried out, encouraged the children to keep following the rules, and gave each of the three children a handmade certificate as encouragement.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home and courtyard

subevent.name: Buying an eye-protection desk lamp online
subevent.description: At her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan gave it some thought, then used her phone to search for eye-protecting desk lamps on an e-commerce platform. She finally selected an LED eye-protecting desk lamp priced at 80 yuan and placed and paid for the order. She chose standard delivery, expected to arrive in 2-3 days. The ordering process took about half an hour. She also exchanged a few words about it with her neighbor Wang Guilan on WeChat, saying that although she felt a little pained to spend the money, it was worth it for the children's eyesight.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - bedroom at home

subevent.name: Install an eye-protection desk lamp
subevent.description: At her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan received the eye-protection desk lamp she had ordered online. After unpacking it, she installed the lamp on her eldest son Ma Mingxuan's desk and adjusted the angle and brightness. She called the three children over and told them the lamp was a shared eye-protection device and that they must turn it on while doing homework. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan also checked the lighting at the other desks to make sure it met the requirements of the rules. The entire installation and instruction process took about half an hour.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Setting up a family reading corner and strengthening reading habits
description: In mid-October, Ma Xiulan used souvenirs brought back from Beijing and 20 books found in a secondhand bookstore to set up a family reading corner in a corner of the living room. She led the three children in organizing the old bookshelf and putting up photos taken during trips. The eldest son took the initiative to help arrange the books, while the second son and daughter drew a reading agreement. After that, family reading time every evening became more warm and cozy, and the reading corner became a favorite spot for the whole family.

subevent.name: Tidied the old bookshelf
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, along with her three children (eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin), emptied and wiped clean the old bookshelf in the corner of the living room, preparing to set up a family reading corner. During the process, the eldest son helped move books, the second son and daughter wiped the shelves with damp cloths, and Ma Xiulan cleaned the dust from the top of the bookshelf. The whole family worked together, creating a warm atmosphere.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Arrange books and souvenirs
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan classified the 20 books she had bought from a secondhand bookstore by subject and placed them on the tidied bookshelf. She decorated the top shelf and the gaps between the shelf boards with souvenirs brought back from the trip to Beijing, such as the Forbidden City bookmark, Summer Palace postcards, and small ornaments. Her eldest son Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to help arrange the books by category, while the second son and the daughter handed over items from the side. The whole family worked together to make the bookshelf full of vitality.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Posting travel photos and creating a reading pact.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her three children used tape to stick photos from the previous Beijing trip (such as the group photo at Tiananmen and zoo pictures) on the wall next to the bookshelf, forming a small photo wall. Her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin used colored markers to draw a Family Reading Pact on a piece of cardboard, including rules such as 'read quietly', 'take care of books', and 'share in turns'. Then Ma Xiulan helped stick it on the side of the bookshelf. Ma Xiulan guided them from the side, and the children were in high spirits.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: First family reading time together.
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the three children to the newly arranged reading corner for their first group reading session. The eldest son Ma Mingxuan took the initiative to tidy the books on the bookshelf and picked out a popular science book; the second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin each chose a picture book. Ma Xiulan sat nearby, sometimes reading stories softly to her daughter and sometimes guiding her second son to recognize characters. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang also picked up a reference book and flipped through it. The whole family was immersed in a warm reading atmosphere, and the reading corner from then on became the family's favorite spot.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home reading corner

name: Annual settlement of pickled vegetables, education fund deposit, and future planning
description: On November 20, Ma Xiulan completed the shipment of the year's last batch of pickled vegetables. After settling accounts with Liu Chunmei, the annual net profit was 1,680 yuan (including the profit from the travel souvenir packs). She deposited 900 yuan into the education reserve fund, bringing the total to 3,500 yuan (target 5,000 yuan), and used the remaining money to help with household expenses. On November 22, the couple washed and dried the summer and autumn pickle jars and stacked them in the corner of the yard. Her husband said for the first time, "Can we expand a bit next year?" She smiled and agreed.

subevent.name: Complete the shipment and settlement of the last batch of pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: At her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan packed and shipped this year's last batch of handmade pickled vegetables, including travel souvenir packs, to her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. The two counted the items face to face and settled the year's accounts. After calculation, the annual net profit from the pickled vegetables was 1680 yuan, and Liu Chunmei paid Ma Xiulan via WeChat transfer.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Deposit into education reserve fund
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used mobile banking to transfer 900 yuan from her personal account to the dedicated family education savings account, bringing the total education reserve fund to 3,500 yuan (target 5,000 yuan). She carefully checked the account balance and confirmed the transfer was successful.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Clean and organize the summer and autumn pickle jars
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang moved all the jars used for making pickled vegetables in summer and autumn out of the corner of the yard, carefully washed the inside and outside with clean water and brushes, and then let them dry naturally in the sun. When the jars were completely dry, the two of them neatly stacked them in the corner of the yard to prepare them for use the following year.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Discuss expanding pickled vegetable production next year
subevent.description: While organizing the pickled vegetable jars, her husband Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative for the first time to suggest, "Can we expand a bit next year?" Ma Xiulan smiled and agreed. As they worked, they briefly discussed initial ideas for expansion, such as adding more types of pickled vegetables and moderately increasing the number of jars and pots, but they did not go into depth on specific investment and sales channels.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

name: Husband repaid the heating advance payment.
description: On the evening of November 3, her husband Ma Zhiqiang pressed 800 yuan into Ma Xiulan's hand and whispered, "I'll pay you back next month." Ma Xiulan took the money and recorded it in her account book.

subevent.name: Received the heating advance repayment from her husband
subevent.description: On the evening of November 3, at her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan took 800 yuan in cash from her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Ma Zhiqiang pressed the money into her hand and said in a low voice, 'I'll pay you back next month.' Ma Xiulan nodded in confirmation and accepted the money.
subevent.location: Home, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Giving father a cashmere scarf to show concern for his health
description: After the performance, Ma Xiulan took out the cashmere scarf she had received and decided to pass it on to her father Ma Jianguo, whose blood pressure was high. She went to his home, gave him the scarf personally, reminded him to keep warm, and said with a smile, "May your blood pressure be as smooth as satin." Moved, her father put on the scarf and said he would keep up his morning exercise and blood pressure checks.

subevent.name: Took out the cashmere scarf and decided to give it as a gift
subevent.description: After the performance event ended, Ma Xiulan took out the cashmere scarf she had received from her belongings. Thinking that her father Ma Jianguo's blood pressure had been high recently, she decided to give the scarf to him to express her care and remind him to keep warm.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Activity venue

subevent.name: Gave a scarf as a gift and reminded her to take care of her health.
subevent.description: At her father's home, Ma Xiulan personally gave her father Ma Jianguo a cashmere scarf, urging him to keep warm, and said with a smile, 'May your blood pressure be as smooth as brocade.' Her father Ma Jianguo took the scarf, was very moved, put it on right away, and said he would continue his morning exercise and blood pressure checks.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - 45 Shengli Street - living room at father's house

name: Preparing a stall for the handmade market: approval notice and preparation of the first batch of pickles
description: On the afternoon of March 20, after accompanying her father to his follow-up checkup and returning home, Ma Xiulan received a call from Zheng Xiuying at the community service center and learned that her application for a stall at the handicraft market had been approved, with the market set for the first weekend of April (April 5-6). That evening, she discussed it with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and decided to feature homemade pickled vegetables, drawing up a plan for batch pickling and purchasing packaging. On March 21, she went to Xingwang Vegetable Market to buy fresh vegetables. On the 22nd, she went to the neighboring supermarket to order glass jars and seasonings, and after returning home she began salting the vegetables to draw out moisture, getting ready to make the pickles properly. The pickled vegetable side business had made key progress.

subevent.name: Received the call approving the stall at the handicraft market
subevent.description: After accompanying her father Ma Jianguo to his follow-up checkup and returning home, Ma Xiulan received a call in her living room from Zheng Xiuying at the community service center. Zheng Xiuying told her that the handicraft market stall she had applied for had been approved and scheduled for the first weekend of April (April 5-6). Ma Xiulan asked in detail about the stall fee, basic facilities, and sales regulations. Zheng Xiuying answered each question and reminded her to prepare products as soon as possible. The call lasted about 15 minutes. Ma Xiulan was very excited and immediately began thinking about sales plans.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

subevent.name: Discuss with her husband and determine the main promoted products
subevent.description: That evening, after her husband Ma Zhiqiang got home from work, Ma Xiulan couldn't wait to share the good news that the stall had been approved. The two discussed sales strategy in detail in the bedroom. Xiulan suggested using her pickling skills to make the homemade pickles the featured product. Zhiqiang agreed and suggested preparing about 50 bottles for the first batch, priced at 15 yuan per bottle. They also made a rough calculation of costs and expected profits, decided to focus on traditional flavors of pickled cucumbers and chili sauce, and initially planned out a production schedule.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home bedroom

subevent.name: Planning large-batch pickling and packaging procurement for pickled vegetables
subevent.description: After reaching an agreement with her husband, Ma Xiulan sat at the small desk in her home study, took out a piece of paper and a pen, and began drafting a detailed plan for the first batch of pickled vegetables. She listed the required raw materials: 10 jin of cucumbers, 5 jin of peppers, salt, sugar, soy sauce, garlic, ginger, and so on. At the same time, she planned the packaging: she needed to buy 50 glass jars with sealed lids and design simple labels. She also considered that some peppers and cucumbers from her own vegetable garden could be picked to save costs. After completing the plan, she stuck the list on the refrigerator and prepared to start purchasing the next day.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District, home study

subevent.name: Purchase fresh vegetables needed for pickling.
subevent.description: Following the plan made the previous day, Ma Xiulan walked to Xingwang Vegetable Market near her home on the morning of March 21. She went straight to Aunt Sun Guifang's vegetable stall, which she usually visited. According to the list, she picked 10 jin of good-looking cucumbers and 5 jin of fresh chili peppers, and also bought some garlic and ginger. Aunt Sun warmly weighed them for her and waived the odd change, and the total cost was about 35 yuan. Ma Xiulan used the handcart she brought to carry the vegetables home, washed them, and drained them for later use.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Purchase glass jars for packaging pickled vegetables and other materials.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of March 22, Ma Xiulan went to Shufen Convenience Store run by her diagonal neighbor Zhang Shufen and ordered 50 lidded glass jars with a capacity of 500 ml each. Zhang Shufen agreed to supply them at wholesale price for a total of 60 yuan, and they agreed delivery in two days. Ma Xiulan also stopped by the community grocery store on the way to buy condiments such as salt, sugar, and soy sauce, spending about 20 yuan. After returning home, she put the vegetables she had bought into a large basin and salted them to draw out water, completing the first step for the formal pickling process.
subevent.location: Shufen Convenience Store, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and home kitchen

name: Rush to make 60 jars of autumn pickled vegetables and stick handwritten labels on them
description: To cope with the increase in education expenses after school starts, Ma Xiulan planned to rush out a batch of autumn pickled vegetables. On August 31, she went to the Jinghai District vegetable market to buy vegetables, seasonings, and other ingredients. From September 1 to 3, she enlisted her mother Li Xiuying and her handicraft friend Zhou Xiuqin to come to her home. Over three days, they divided the work and completed the vegetable pre-treatment, seasoning, and jarring, finally producing 60 jars of pickled vegetables. Ma Xiulan personally attached the same handwritten label, "Xiulan's Homemade Pickles," to each jar, and neatly lined up the finished products beside the stove, ready for sale.

subevent.name: Purchasing ingredients for pickled vegetables
subevent.description: With education expenses increasing after the new school term began on September 1, Ma Xiulan planned to rush a batch of autumn pickled vegetables to supplement the family income. She rode her electric bike to the Jinghai District vegetable market and bought seasonal vegetables such as radishes, cucumbers, and green beans - enough for about 60 jars - as well as salt, soy sauce, star anise, and other seasonings, plus glass jars, getting all the materials ready for the next three days of large-scale production.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jinghai District vegetable market

subevent.name: Day 1: Pickle Preprocessing
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan enlisted her mother Li Xiuying and her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin to come and help at home. The three divided the work and cooperated: Ma Xiulan washed the vegetables and cut them into suitable sizes; her mother mixed the brine and handled the initial pickling; Zhou Xiuqin drained the pickled vegetables and layered them in a large basin. After a full day of work, they completed the initial pickling and dehydration of all the vegetables, preparing them for the next step of seasoning and jarring.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Seasoning and jarring the pickled vegetables the next day
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, her mother, and Zhou Xiuqin continued working together, thoroughly mixing the vegetables that had been dehydrated the day before with the sauce prepared in advance (soy sauce, star anise, sliced ginger, etc.), then filling clean glass jars one by one, pressing down each jar and pouring in sauce to the brim, and finally screwing on the lids for an initial seal. The three worked together skillfully and filled about 40 jars in total that day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: On the third day, stick labels and organize the finished products.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, her mother, and Zhou Xiuqin filled and sealed the remaining 20 jars. Then the three of them wiped the jar bodies with a clean cloth. Ma Xiulan took out the blank labels she had cut in advance and wrote the uniform words “Xiulan Handmade Pickled Vegetables” on them with a black marker, sticking one label on the center of each jar. Finally, they neatly arranged all 60 jars of pickles beside the stove, counted the number, and checked that the labels were firmly attached, completing the entire rush-order task.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: During the peak season for pickled vegetables, joint production ran into sudden overtime work, and the team optimized its collaboration plan.
description: On July 14, Ma Xiulan, Zhou Xiuqin, and Wang Guilan prepared in advance, divided tasks, and purchased ingredients. On July 15, the three began assembly-line production of pickled vegetables. Early on the 16th, Zhou Xiuqin's mother was suddenly hospitalized. Ma Xiulan had to adjust the division of labor with Wang Guilan and take on double the work alone until late at night. On the 17th, Ma Xiulan communicated with Zhou Xiuqin to resolve friction, and together they established a primary/backup plan and a WeChat group confirmation mechanism, maintaining output without hurting feelings.

subevent.name: Prepare raw materials and tools for pickled vegetable production
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan met with Zhou Xiuqin and Wang Guilan a day in advance to decide on the division of labor (Xiuqin would wash, cut, and prepare the ingredients; Guilan would simmer the seasoning liquid; Xiulan would fill the jars and seal them). They went together to the vegetable market in Jinghai District to buy enough fresh cucumbers, radishes, and spices such as salt, sugar, and Sichuan peppercorns. After returning home, they washed the jars and prepared tools such as knives and cutting boards, making material preparations for three consecutive days of assembly-line work.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - home kitchen and vegetable market

subevent.name: On the first day, the pickled vegetable assembly line went smoothly.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan, Zhou Xiuqin, and Wang Guilan started the assembly-line work at Xiulan's home as agreed: Zhou Xiuqin washed and cut the cucumbers and radishes into appropriate sizes; Wang Guilan prepared the sauce in a large pot with soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, spices, and so on; Ma Xiulan mixed the cut vegetables with the sauce, put them into jars, and sealed them. The three cooperated smoothly and completed one-third of the planned amount that day, with progress going well.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: In the early morning, Zhou Xiuqin got a phone call that her mother had been hospitalized.
subevent.description: At about 6 a.m. on July 16, 2025, Zhou Xiuqin received a call at home from the hospital and learned that her mother, after suddenly feeling unwell, had been taken by neighbors to the People's Hospital of Jinghai District and that a family member was urgently needed. She immediately contacted Ma Xiulan, told her that she could not join the day's pickle production as planned, and apologized. After understanding the situation, Ma Xiulan expressed understanding and decided to handle all of the day's work on her own.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Zhou Xiuqin's home and Ma Xiulan's home (contacted by phone)

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan alone completed double the usual pickled vegetable workload until late at night
subevent.description: In Zhou Xiuqin's absence, Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan adjusted their division of work: Wang Guilan continued to be responsible for simmering the sauce, while Ma Xiulan took on both the washing and cutting work originally belonging to Zhou Xiuqin and her own task of filling and sealing jars. She worked continuously from 7 a.m. until midnight the next day, and was so exhausted that her back and waist became stiff. She finally sealed all the remaining jars, ensuring that the day's pickle output did not drop.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Resolve cooperation friction with Zhou Xiuqin and establish primary and backup plans.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Zhou Xiuqin came to apologize after handling her mother's hospitalization. Ma Xiulan couldn't help complaining that the last-minute change had almost caused problems, and Zhou Xiuqin, with red-rimmed eyes, explained the urgency of her mother's condition. After calming down, Ma Xiulan recognized the difficulty and proactively softened her tone. The two women decided on a primary-backup plan: if one had something come up, they could swap tasks in advance or postpone by half a day, and they set up a WeChat group to confirm attendance daily. They agreed to review on Sunday evenings and schedule the next week's tasks, so that productivity was maintained without hurting their relationship.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Ma Xiulan's home living room

name: Take the children to visit the Tianjin Museum.
description: On August 23, Ma Xiulan set out from her home in Jinghai early in the morning and took the three children by long-distance bus to the Tianjin Museum. They visited the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was fascinated by the ancient weapon models and sketched them, while the other two children also watched curiously. After having lunch at a fast-food restaurant near the museum, they continued their visit and bought souvenir postcards near closing time. In the afternoon, they took the long-distance bus back to Jinghai. After returning home, the children shared what they had seen, bringing the day's cultural outing to a perfect end.

subevent.name: Pre-departure preparations
subevent.description: At around six in the morning, Ma Xiulan got up at her home on Jingwen Road. She prepared breakfast for her three children and packed water bottles, snacks, and tissues. She reminded her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to bring his notebook and pen, and told her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin to dress neatly. Then the family set off for the long-distance bus station.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Take a long-distance bus from Jinghai to the city center and look for the museum
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the shuttle bus from Jinghai Long-Distance Bus Station to the city center with her three children, and on the way confirmed with the driver where to get off for Tianjin Museum. After arriving in the city, she followed her phone navigation and street signs, walking about twenty minutes before finding the Tianjin Museum.
subevent.location: Tianjin - long-distance bus and downtown streets

subevent.name: Visit the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall.
subevent.description: After entering the Tianjin Museum, Ma Xiulan first led the children to visit the Ancient Tianjin exhibition hall. Her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was fascinated by the ancient weapon models on display and took out his pocket notebook to sketch them intently; her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and daughter Ma Yuxin also looked at the exhibits curiously, while Ma Xiulan read the exhibit signs and explained Tianjin's ancient history to the children.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Ancient Tianjin Exhibition Hall, Tianjin Museum

subevent.name: Lunch break
subevent.description: Around noon, Ma Xiulan took the children to a fast-food restaurant near the museum for lunch. She ordered food the children loved, such as noodles with gravy and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin, to refuel their energy. After the meal, they rested briefly and discussed the exhibits they had seen in the morning.
subevent.location: Tianjin - fast food restaurant near the museum

subevent.name: Buy museum postcards
subevent.description: As the museum was about to close, Ma Xiulan took the children to the museum gift shop and spent 20 yuan on a set of Tianjin Museum postcards as a memento of the day. The children gathered around to pick out their favorite designs. Ma Xiulan put the postcards away, planning to let the children write and draw on them once they got home.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Tianjin Museum Souvenir Shop

subevent.name: Taking the long-distance bus back to Jinghai
subevent.description: After the museum closed in the afternoon, Ma Xiulan took the children back along the same route, taking a long-distance bus from the city center back to Jinghai. On the bus, the children excitedly talked about what they had seen and heard today. Ma Xiulan looked out the window at the scenery, feeling fulfilled and satisfied, thinking that this cultural trip was very meaningful.
subevent.location: Tianjin - long-distance bus and home in Jinghai District

subevent.name: Return home, tidy up, and share.
subevent.description: After returning to the home on Jingwen Road in the evening, Ma Xiulan had the children wash their hands and rest. She took out the postcards for the children to admire in turn and briefly organized today's photos and notes. The family sat together, and the children chattered about the fun moments at the museum, bringing the day to a perfect close.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Community Double Ninth Festival activity: gratitude and follow-up impact
description: On October 12, the community put up photos of the Double Ninth Festival event and a thank-you list on the bulletin board, and Ma Xiulan was among those listed. Zheng Xiuying told her that these points could be exchanged for rice, flour, oil, and other staples at the end of the year, but more importantly, several of the elderly people who had been served jointly wrote a thank-you letter to the community. When the community selected the 'Most Beautiful Family' at the end of November, her stories of caring for the elderly were recommended as model material. Although she ultimately only received a nomination award, the recognition strengthened her resolve to keep participating in community service. After that, she joined an elderly assistance activity every quarter, and pickled vegetables and blood pressure checks became her standard volunteer offerings.

subevent.name: Check the community bulletin board
subevent.description: On the morning of October 12, when Ma Xiulan passed the community bulletin board, she saw the photos of the Double Ninth Festival event and the thank-you list posted by the community. Her name was on the list, and she felt happy and proud.
subevent.location: Community bulletin board on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Learned about point redemption in conversation with Zheng Xiuying
subevent.description: That afternoon, Ma Xiulan met part-time job introducer Zheng Xiuying in the community. Zheng Xiuying told her that community points could be exchanged for rice, flour, oil, and grain at the end of the year, and mentioned that several elderly people who had received services had jointly written a thank-you letter. Upon learning this, Ma Xiulan became even more determined in her resolve to volunteer.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Small Square

subevent.name: Received a joint thank-you letter from the elderly.
subevent.description: On October 14, community workers gave Ma Xiulan a copy of a thank-you letter jointly written by the elderly, thanking her for her pickled vegetables and blood pressure measurement services during the Double Ninth Festival. Ma Xiulan was deeply moved and treasured it.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Service Center

subevent.name: Nomination recommendation for the community's 'Most Beautiful Family' selection
subevent.description: On November 25, the community held a meeting to select the “Most Beautiful Family”. Ma Xiulan's deeds of respecting the elderly were recommended as exemplary material. At the meeting, she shared her experience participating in elderly assistance activities and ultimately received the nomination award.
subevent.location: Community meeting room on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Preparing pickled vegetables for the elderly assistance event.
subevent.description: On December 18, Ma Xiulan made traditional pickled vegetables in her home kitchen, preparing them for the next elderly assistance activity. Following her mother's recipe, she pickled a large jar of radishes and cucumbers.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Participate in the December community elderly care activity: send pickled vegetables and measure blood pressure
subevent.description: On the morning of December 20, Ma Xiulan brought homemade pickled vegetables to the home of an elderly person living alone in the community. She gave the vegetables to the elderly person, measured their blood pressure, patiently asked about their health, and completed this quarter's elder-care service.

participant.name: Elderly people living alone in the community

subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - an elderly person's home in Jingwen Road Community.

subevent.name: Redeeming community points for year-end goods.
subevent.description: On December 28, Ma Xiulan used her community volunteer service points at the community service center to redeem daily necessities such as rice, flour, cooking oil, and grain, easing the family's financial burden and giving her a sense of accomplishment.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Jingwen Road Community Service Center

subevent.name: Planning next year's elderly assistance service plan
subevent.description: On December 31, Ma Xiulan reviewed her volunteer experiences over the year at home, organized and filed the thank-you letters and the nomination award certificate, and decided to continue participating in elderly assistance activities every quarter in the coming year. Pickled vegetables and blood pressure measurement became regular service items.
subevent.location: Home study, 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Annual social security subsidy confirmation.
description: On November 28, Ma Xiulan organized the sales records of pickled vegetables and receipts for hand-embroidery orders at home to prepare materials for the annual social security subsidy confirmation. On the morning of December 1, she asked her childhood friend Liu Chunmei to sign and certify her income situation. That afternoon, she went to the social security service station and successfully completed the annual confirmation. As she walked out, she let out a long sigh: "I almost forgot about this. If it had been stopped, I would have lost the monthly 200 yuan."

subevent.name: Organizing social insurance subsidy confirmation materials
subevent.description: In her home study, Ma Xiulan sorted, categorized, and summarized the recent pickle sales details and hand-embroidery order receipts, ensuring every income had supporting records, in preparation for the next day's annual confirmation of social security subsidies.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home study

subevent.name: Ask Liu Chunmei to sign as proof of income
subevent.description: On the morning of December 1, Ma Xiulan took the organized pickled vegetable sales records and hand-embroidered order receipts and walked to the home of her childhood friend Liu Chunmei. She asked Liu Chunmei to sign as a witness on the income proof document to confirm the authenticity of her part-time income.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Liu Chunmei's home

subevent.name: Went to the service station to complete the annual social security subsidy confirmation
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 1, Ma Xiulan brought the signed income verification materials and went to the Jinghai District Social Security Service Station. She found the staff member, submitted the materials, and completed the annual confirmation procedures for the social security subsidy. After finishing, she let out a long sigh of relief, because she had almost forgotten to handle it. If it were interrupted, the monthly subsidy of 200 yuan would be affected.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Social Security Service Station

name: Volunteer service for the elderly on the Double Ninth Festival
description: On October 9, Ma Xiulan signed up for the Double Ninth Festival volunteer service for the elderly at the community service center, and made 10 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables at home. On October 10, she and her neighbor Wang Guilan agreed on a visiting plan. On the morning of October 11, the Double Ninth Festival, Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan took pickled vegetables to visit two elderly people who lived alone, helped clean up and measure blood pressure. Granny Zhao was touched and said she was even dearer than her own daughter. At noon, Ma Xiulan hurried back to her father's home to cook him a soft lunch. That day she also went to the community service center to register volunteer service points.

subevent.name: Signed up for community volunteer service for the elderly
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan signed up at the community service center to participate in the Double Ninth Festival volunteer service for the elderly on October 11, confirming the service content and information about the people to visit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community Service Center

subevent.name: Making low-salt pickled vegetables.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan visited elderly people living alone for the Double Ninth Festival. She carefully made 10 jars of low-salt pickled vegetables in her home kitchen, using seasonal vegetables and controlling the salt content to make them suitable for the elderly.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Arranged a visit plan with neighbor Wang Guilan.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan discussed with Wang Guilun, the neighbor across the hall, the plan to visit elderly people living alone in the community together on the morning of the Double Ninth Festival, and confirmed the meeting time and route.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Visit elderly people living alone in the community.
subevent.description: On the morning of the Double Ninth Festival, Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan, carrying homemade low-salt pickled vegetables, visited two elderly residents living alone in the community (86-year-old Grandma Zhao and another old man, Uncle Li). Ma Xiulan cleaned their homes, took their blood pressure, and chatted warmly with them. Grandma Zhao was so moved that she took Ma Xiulan's hand and said, "You are dearer to me than my own daughter."
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home of an elderly person living alone in the community

subevent.name: Prepared a soft, tender lunch for her father
subevent.description: After the visit, Ma Xiulan hurried back to her father Ma Jianguo's home and, using the noon hour, made him a soft, easy-to-digest lunch, taking care of her father's dietary health.
subevent.location: Ma Xiulan's father's home, Shengli Street, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Log volunteer service points
