subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to the community service center to complete the points registration for the Double Ninth Festival elderly care volunteer service. The community staff recorded the service hours and content, and at the end of the year, points can be exchanged for items.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Community Service Center

name: Family bath at the public bathhouse before the New Year
description: On December 12, Ma Xiulan bought six bath tickets and called her parents to tell them to go to the public bathhouse together on the weekend. When her daughter Ma Yuxin heard this, she excitedly packed her small towel. The next day (December 13), Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, their three children Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin, and her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, seven people in all, went to Jinghai's long-established bathhouse to bathe, completing the traditional pre-New Year bathing activity.

subevent.name: Buy six bath tickets
subevent.description: After making the decision, Ma Xiulan went that evening to the time-honored bathhouse in Jinghai or a nearby ticket outlet and bought six bath tickets, planning to use them for herself, her spouse, three children, and her mother and father (since her parents were going together).
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - ticket office of the time-honored bathhouse

subevent.name: Called her parents to let them know about the bathhouse event
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan called her father Ma Jianguo and mother Li Xiuying, who live in the same district, to tell them the specific arrangements and time for going to the bathhouse on the weekend, and confirmed that her parents could come along.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: Daughter Xinxin excitedly tidies up her little towel.
subevent.description: The 6-year-old daughter Ma Yuxin was very excited when she heard that they would go for a soak at the bathhouse on the weekend. That night she took the initiative to pack her small bath towel and a change of clothes, waiting to set off.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Children's Room

subevent.name: The whole family went to a time-honored bathhouse for a bath.
subevent.description: On Saturday, December 13, Ma Xiulan, together with her spouse Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, daughter Ma Yuxin, and her parents Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, a group of seven, went to a time-honored bathhouse in Jinghai for a bath. They entered the bathing area one after another to wash and soak, completing the traditional pre-New Year bathing activity.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Time-honored Bathhouse

name: Eldest son got double A in biology and geography on the junior high school exam; the homeroom teacher called to congratulate, and the whole family joyfully gathered to drink chicken soup.
description: On the morning of June 19, the results of eldest son Ma Mingxuan's biology and geography minor high school exam were released, and he got an A in both subjects. Homeroom teacher Han called specifically to praise him, saying he was "steady and hardworking, a role model for the class." Ma Xiulan was buying vegetables at the market at the time; when she heard the news, she was so excited that she immediately bought a plump, tender free-range chicken. Once home, she carefully stewed a pot of golden chicken soup. In the evening the family sat around the table, and her husband raised his bowl and said with a smile, "My son has brought our family glory!" Mingxuan shyly scratched his head as his younger siblings gathered around him asking about exam details; the room was filled with warmth.

subevent.name: Eldest son's mini high-school entrance exam results announced
subevent.description: In the morning, the middle school in Jinghai District attended by Ma Xiulan's eldest son Ma Mingxuan released the results of the biology and geography mini high school entrance exam. Ma Mingxuan received an A in both subjects. He learned his results at school.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - a middle school in Jinghai District

subevent.name: At the vegetable market, received a call from homeroom teacher He Dian and bought a chicken.
subevent.description: While Ma Xiulan was shopping for vegetables at Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District, she received a call from Teacher Han Mei, the head teacher of Ma Mingxuan's class. Teacher Han praised Ma Mingxuan for being steady and hardworking, saying he was a role model for the class. Ma Xiulan was thrilled at the news and immediately bought a plump, tender free-range chicken at a market stall, planning to go home and stew it in soup to celebrate.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Family dinner to celebrate double A grades.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan, her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin — a family of five — sat around the dining table. Ma Xiulan served steaming hot chicken soup. Her husband raised his bowl and praised their son for bringing honor to the family. Mingxuan shyly scratched his head, and his younger siblings curiously asked for details about the exam. The room was filled with laughter and joy.
subevent.location: Family dining room at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Start the bedtime deep-breathing relaxation exercise
description: Starting February 15, Ma Xiulan arranged a 5-minute deep-breathing exercise every night before bed. Sitting on the edge of the bed with eyes closed, she slowly inhaled and exhaled, focusing on relaxing her shoulders and neck, gradually relieving the day's housework fatigue and anxiety. She also got her husband to occasionally practice with her, improving the family's sleep quality.

subevent.name: First week: bedtime deep breathing exercise
subevent.description: Starting from February 15, Ma Xiulan sat on the edge of the bed in her bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, every night before sleep (around 21:30-21:35), closed her eyes, and did five minutes of deep breathing exercises. Following a method she learned from an online video, she slowly inhaled for 4 seconds, held her breath for 2 seconds, and exhaled for 6 seconds, focusing on relaxing her shoulder, neck, and back muscles. During the practice, she felt the day's household fatigue gradually ease and her anxiety lessen. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang joined her for the first two nights at her invitation but couldn't keep it up in the following days because he was tired from work. After the first week, Ma Xiulan found that she fell asleep noticeably faster.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: First bedtime deep-breathing exercise
subevent.description: At 21:30 on the evening of February 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan sat down by the bed in her bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, and began the deep breathing relaxation exercise she had learned online. She closed her eyes and followed the rhythm of slowly inhaling for 4 seconds, holding her breath for 2 seconds, and exhaling for 6 seconds, concentrating on relaxing her shoulders, neck, and back muscles. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, at her invitation, joined her in the practice; the two sat side by side on the bed. The exercise lasted 5 minutes. After it ended, Ma Xiulan felt her housework fatigue had been relieved and her mood was calm. She thought this was the start of a good habit.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Second night deep breathing practice (husband participated)
subevent.description: On the evening of February 16, 2025, at 21:30, Ma Xiulan continued her 5-minute deep-breathing exercise beside the bed in the bedroom. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang joined in again, and the two kept the same breathing rhythm. Ma Xiulan noticed that she was more relaxed than on the first day and could enter a focused state more quickly. After the practice, she briefly exchanged feelings with her husband, who said he also found it soothing. Ma Xiulan became more confident in keeping this habit.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: The third evening of practicing deep breathing alone.
subevent.description: On the evening of February 17, 2025, at 21:30, Ma Xiulan did her usual deep-breathing exercises beside the bed in the bedroom. Her husband, Ma Zhiqiang, had gone to sleep early because he was tired from work during the day, so he could not join her. Ma Xiulan closed her eyes and completed a 5-minute practice alone: slowly inhaling for 4 seconds, holding her breath for 2 seconds, and exhaling for 6 seconds, focusing on relaxing her shoulders and neck. She felt lonely but persisted, realizing that this was her own time to relax. After the practice, she lay down to sleep. She fell asleep slightly more slowly than the previous two nights, but it was still within the normal range.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Deep breathing practice on the fourth evening.
subevent.description: At 21:30 on the evening of February 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan was alone by the bedside in her bedroom doing a 5-minute deep breathing exercise. She closed her eyes and repeated several rounds in the rhythm of inhaling for 4 seconds, holding her breath for 2 seconds, and exhaling for 6 seconds. This time she tried imagining expelling the day's worries from her body while exhaling, and it felt quite effective. After the exercise, she felt her shoulder muscles noticeably relax and her anxiety ease. She recorded her feelings and thought that deep breathing was very helpful for relieving the fatigue of housework.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Deep breathing exercise for the fifth night
subevent.description: At 21:30 on the evening of February 19, 2025, Ma Xiulan did her fifth deep-breathing exercise beside her bed in the bedroom. She skillfully adjusted her breathing rhythm, starting with a slow inhale, holding her breath, then exhaling slowly. During the exercise, she found that the muscles in her back were no longer as tense as in the past few days, and she could concentrate more easily. After the five minutes ended, she felt calmer in both mind and body and was increasingly satisfied with the effects of the practice. She decided to keep it up next week and considered whether to extend the practice time to 10 minutes.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Sixth Night Deep Breathing Practice
subevent.description: At 21:30 on the evening of February 20, 2025, Ma Xiulan completed her sixth 5-minute deep breathing practice beside her bed in the bedroom. She closed her eyes, calmly inhaled for 4 seconds, held her breath for 2 seconds, and exhaled for 6 seconds, focusing entirely on her breathing. After the practice, she felt the irritability before falling asleep had noticeably decreased and was pleased that she was getting quicker at it. She noticed that over the past week her sleep quality had improved and she had more energy during the day. She decided to incorporate deep breathing into daily life, even trying it when she felt tired during the day.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Evening deep breathing exercise and summary at the end of the first week
subevent.description: At 21:30 on the evening of February 21, 2025, Ma Xiulan did her final deep-breathing practice of the first week beside her bed in the bedroom. As usual, she completed 5 minutes: inhale for 4 seconds, hold for 2 seconds, exhale for 6 seconds, relaxing her whole body. After finishing, she reviewed the changes of the week: she fell asleep noticeably faster, her neck and shoulder soreness eased, and her mood was more stable. Although her husband only joined in for the first two days, she didn't mind, believing that practicing alone could still bring her benefits. She planned to continue this habit the next week and try to lead the children in brief breathing relaxation during the day.
subevent.location: Bedroom at home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Whole family bathing and resting at the bathhouse
description: On the afternoon of December 13, 2025, Ma Xiulan went with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, her father Ma Jianguo, her mother Li Xiuying, and the three children to the public bathhouse in Jinghai District, Tianjin. After arriving, Ma Xiulan, her mother, and her daughter entered the women's section, while Ma Zhiqiang, his father, and the two sons entered the men's section, and everyone changed clothes and bathed. In the women's section, Ma Xiulan and her mother scrubbed each other's backs while chatting about family matters; in the men's section, Ma Zhiqiang taught his eldest son to wash carefully behind his ears. Steam filled the air, and both body and mind relaxed. After bathing, the whole family went to the lounge. Ma Xiulan ordered hot soy milk, the children gathered around the TV, her husband and father played Chinese chess, while her mother and Xiulan chatted and watched nearby. In the cozy warmth, Ma Xiulan felt that much of the year's fatigue had been washed away. When they left the bathhouse, it was already dark. She took her daughter's hand and said, 'New Year is coming soon.'

subevent.name: The whole family arrived at the bathhouse and prepared to bathe
subevent.description: On the afternoon of December 13, 2025, Ma Xiulan, together with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, her father Ma Jianguo, her mother Li Xiuying, her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, her second son Ma Mingzhe, and her daughter Ma Yuxin, went to a public bathhouse in Jinghai District, Tianjin. Upon arrival, Ma Xiulan, her mother Li Xiuying, and her daughter Ma Yuxin entered the women's section, while her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her father Ma Jianguo took the two sons into the men's section. Everyone bought tickets, changed clothes, and prepared for the bath.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Public Bathhouse

subevent.name: The whole family's bathing process.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan bathed with her mother Li Xiuying and daughter Ma Yuxin in the women's section, scrubbing each other's backs and chatting about family matters. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang bathed with her father Ma Jianguo and the two sons in the men's section, where Ma Zhiqiang taught his eldest son Ma Mingxuan to make sure he washed behind his ears. Throughout the bath, hot steam filled the air, and everyone felt relaxed in body and mind. The bath ended about an hour later.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - public bathhouse

subevent.name: A short family rest in the bathhouse lounge
subevent.description: After the bath, the whole family came to the lounge of the bathhouse. Ma Xiulan ordered a few cups of hot soy milk. The children gathered in front of the TV to watch shows, while her husband Ma Zhiqiang and father Ma Jianguo sat down at the chess table to play Chinese chess. Her mother Li Xiuying and Xiulan sat to the side watching and chatting. In the warmth of the heating, Ma Xiulan felt that much of the year's fatigue had been washed away. Everyone rested there for about 40 minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - public bathhouse lounge

name: Attend the parents' open day for her second son
description: Early on November 11, Ma Xiulan sat at the back of the classroom listening to the math lesson. Seeing her second son raise his hand to answer questions twice, she couldn't help smiling. After class, she talked with the head teacher, Yang Jianguo. The teacher affirmed that the child was smart but pointed out, 'He's careless with his work and needs to practice more patience.' She took away the water bottle her son hadn't finished, planning in her mind how to help him at home.

subevent.name: Set off for school
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan finished the housework, brought a notebook and a thermos cup, and walked from home to Yucai Primary School in Jinghai District, where her second son Ma Mingzhe studied, to attend the school's open day event for parents.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin — from home to Yucai Primary School

subevent.name: Sitting in the back row of the classroom listening to a math class
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan arrived at Yucai Primary School on time, entered the classroom of her second son's class, and sat in the back row attentively sitting in on the math class. During class, she noticed her son Ma Mingzhe voluntarily raise his hand twice to answer questions and give correct answers. She felt gratified by her child's progress, and a smile appeared on her face.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Yucai Primary School classroom.

subevent.name: Spoke with homeroom teacher Yang Jianguo after class
subevent.description: After the math class ended, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to find her second son's homeroom teacher, Mr. Yang Jianguo, to learn about the child's performance at school. Teacher Yang acknowledged that Ma Mingzhe was smart and quick-witted, but also pointed out that he was careless in doing exercises and lacked patience, suggesting that the parents should urge the child to do focus training and careful practice. Ma Xiulan listened carefully to the advice and expressed her gratitude to the teacher.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - hallway outside the Yucai Primary School classroom

subevent.name: Leave school and think about a plan to help.
subevent.description: Before leaving the classroom, Ma Xiulan took her son's unfinished water bottle with her. On the way home, she walked while thinking about how to help her second son get rid of his careless habits. She initially planned to talk with him after returning home and make a study plan with extra calculation exercises every day.
subevent.location: On the road from Yucai Primary School to home in Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: After returning home, she talked with her second son and made a plan
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan called her second son Ma Mingzhe over and gently relayed the advice from his homeroom teacher, Teacher Yang, encouraging him to build carefulness and patience by doing a few extra calculation problems every day. Mother and son discussed it and decided that starting that day, after finishing homework each night, he would do an extra 10 mental arithmetic problems, with Ma Xiulan checking them. She patiently guided her son through the first set of practice for the day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Enabled the Alipay payment QR code and helped a neighbor buy an apron online.
description: Starting March 1, Ma Xiulan researched and applied for an Alipay payment code for her pickled vegetable sideline. On March 4, she received the physical payment code and posted it at her stall, and on March 5 she tested it and it worked normally. On March 8, her neighbor Wang Guilan asked her to buy an apron on her behalf. Ma Xiulan readily helped and selected and ordered one on Taobao. The neighbor's gratitude made her more confident in her digital skills, and she experienced the sense of accomplishment of purchasing on behalf of others for the first time.

subevent.name: Research applying for an Alipay payment QR code
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan searched online from home on her phone for how to apply for an Alipay personal payment QR code, browsed Alipay's official tutorials and FAQs, confirmed that she met the application requirements for a personal payment QR code, and learned about the service fees and settlement rules.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Received and posted the payment collection QR code.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan received the physical payment code sticker sent by Alipay, stuck it in a prominent position at her pickled vegetable stall, and tried scanning it with her phone to confirm the QR code was valid.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - Home (pickled vegetable stall)

subevent.name: Testing the payment QR code function.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan had her husband Ma Zhiqiang use his Alipay to scan the QR code and pay 1 yuan to test whether the payment collection code was working properly. After confirming the transfer arrived, she felt at ease using it.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Neighbor asked me to buy an apron on her behalf.
subevent.description: Neighbor Wang Guilan came to Ma Xiulan's home and said she wanted to buy a plain apron but didn't know how to shop online, so she asked Ma Xiulan to help her purchase it. Ma Xiulan readily agreed and asked in detail about her color and size preferences.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Helped a neighbor order an apron online and was thanked
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used her phone to search for aprons on Taobao, and together with Wang Guilan picked out a plain pure-cotton apron. After placing the order, she told Wang Guilan it was expected to arrive in three days. Wang Guilan was very grateful for Ma Xiulan's help and praised her repeatedly. Ma Xiulan felt a strong sense of accomplishment and became more confident in her digital skills.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Comprehensive regular physical checkup
description: On December 5, Ma Xiulan went to the community health service center. She had a full physical examination combining the community's free items and a self-paid gynecological exam. When she picked up the report on December 7, all indicators were within normal range, and her long-monitored blood pressure and blood sugar remained stable. Dr. Wang said with a smile, "You've taken good care of yourself this year - your Baduanjin practice has paid off!" She walked out of the hospital with a brisk pace, took a photo of the report, and sent it to her husband.

subevent.name: Go to the community health service center for a physical examination.
subevent.description: In the morning on an empty stomach, Ma Xiulan walked to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center. After registering at the front desk, she underwent blood pressure, blood glucose, blood routine, urine routine, electrocardiogram, B-ultrasound, and other examinations, and additionally paid out of pocket for a gynecological examination. The whole checkup process took about two hours. The doctor told her to pick up the report in two days.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Pick up the physical examination report and consult the doctor.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to the community health service center again to pick up her physical examination report. Dr. Wang Jianguo explained the report to her, showing that all indicators were normal and her blood pressure and blood sugar were stable. Dr. Wang praised her for taking good care of herself this year and mentioned the benefits of her Baduanjin practice. Ma Xiulan felt happy after hearing this.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Report the physical examination results to the family
subevent.description: After leaving the community health service center, Ma Xiulan took a photo of her physical examination report with her phone on the way home and sent it to her husband Ma Zhiqiang via WeChat, telling him that all the results were normal and to rest assured.
subevent.location: Road near Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Online community sharing and preparation of a shared recipe document
description: On October 18, Ma Xiulan posted a group photo of her pickled vegetables and photos from her Beijing trip in the 'Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Handicraft Sisters Group', and group members all liked them. Aunt Wu suggested creating a shared recipe document, and she actively responded. From October 20 to 25, she participated in organizing pickle and handicraft recipes, and also formally invited Aunt Wu to stay at her home next month, further expanding the craft exchange circle.

subevent.name: Sharing travel photos and pickled vegetables in a WeChat group
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 18, Ma Xiulan used her phone to send to a WeChat group called Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Handicraft Sisters Group a group photo of the pickled vegetables she had carefully made, as well as photos from her recent trip to Beijing. She attached text messages introducing the special characteristics of the pickles and her travel experiences, sparking enthusiastic likes and comment exchanges from the sisters in the group. The group members praised her craftsmanship and the quality of the photos, and the atmosphere was lively.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: In the group, responded to the proposal to jointly build and share a recipe document.
subevent.description: While the group members were enthusiastically discussing the photos, Aunt Wu proactively suggested in the group chat creating a shared recipe document for the sisters to record and share various handicraft and food recipes. Seeing this, Ma Xiulan immediately typed a response in the group expressing strong support, and offered to be responsible for organizing the pickled vegetable and embroidery content. She had a brief discussion with Aunt Wu in the group, initially settled on the document format and sharing method (using Tencent Docs), and agreed to divide up the content organization over the next few days.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - living room at home (online WeChat group).

subevent.name: Participated in organizing and uploading recipes for pickled vegetables and handicrafts
subevent.description: From October 20 to 25, Ma Xiulan used 1 to 2 hours of spare time between chores each day to recall and type out, at her desk using her phone or the old home computer, the recipes for pickled vegetables she was good at, such as sweet garlic, soy-pickled cucumbers, and spicy cabbage, and traditional embroidery stitches such as running stitch, seed stitch, and blanket stitch. She uploaded the compiled text to the group's shared Tencent Docs in batches, together with simple hand-drawn diagrams. During this period, she repeatedly exchanged suggestions for formatting improvements in the group with Aunt Wu and Zhou Xiuqin, and helped proofread the recipes uploaded by other sisters to ensure the content was accurate and clear.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home study

subevent.name: Invite Aunt Wu to stay at our home for a few days next month
subevent.description: On the evening of October 25, when the recipe document had just taken initial shape and everyone was happy, Ma Xiulan sent a formal invitation to Aunt Wu through a private WeChat chat, asking her to come stay for a few days next month (November) at her home in Jinghai, Tianjin. She said she wanted to learn crochet techniques in person and treat Aunt Wu to local snacks and take her around the Jinghai market. Aunt Wu happily accepted the invitation over the phone, and the two agreed to finalize the exact visit date in mid-November. This invitation further deepened their friendship and made the craft exchange circle even closer.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home (online WeChat private chat)

name: Husband recovered from his arm injury and took the initiative to do the heavy work.
description: On July 10, 2025, Ma Zhiqiang felt his right arm had fully regained strength. Seeing Ma Xiulan carrying two jars of pickled vegetables at once, he grabbed them from her and said, 'Your back is bad; from now on call me for all this heavy stuff!' That afternoon he picked up a shovel and loosened the soil in the yard to prepare for autumn planting; in the evening he carried the pickle jars that had been moved outside during the day back into the house. Starting July 11, for a whole week, he moved the pickle jars to a ventilated, shady spot in the yard every morning and back into the house every evening, completely taking over this heavy task. When Ma Xiulan was making tea or helping nearby, seeing her husband’s sweat-soaked back reminded her of how listless he had been after last month’s accident, and she felt deeply warmed.

subevent.name: Moved the pickle vats back in the evening.
subevent.description: On the evening of July 10, Ma Zhiqiang, as previously agreed, took the initiative to move the two jars of pickled vegetables that had been moved to a cool, ventilated spot during the day back into the house. Ma Xiulan watched from the side and felt warmth in her heart.
subevent.location: Home courtyard, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Turn over the courtyard soil to prepare for autumn sowing.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 10, Ma Zhiqiang picked up a shovel and loosened the soil in the courtyard to prepare for autumn sowing. As Ma Xiulan was making tea, she saw his sweat-soaked back and remembered how dejected he had been after last month's accident, and a warm feeling rose in her heart.
subevent.location: Home courtyard, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Family movie night
description: On the evening of Saturday, October 17, Ma Xiulan used the old TV at home to play the classic animated film "Havoc in Heaven" borrowed from the community cultural center. The whole family sat together in the living room to watch. She had made popcorn in the pressure cooker in the kitchen in advance. The children excitedly imitated Sun Wukong's movements, and her husband, unusually, didn't look at his phone. After the film ended, the family discussed their favorite characters, filling the room with laughter, and spent a simple and warm evening.

subevent.name: Prepare popcorn
subevent.description: On the evening of October 17, Ma Xiulan made popcorn in her home kitchen using a pressure cooker, preparing snacks for the family movie night. She had prepared corn kernels and sugar in advance, skillfully operated the pressure cooker, and popped a large basin of sweet popcorn. She also shared some with her youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, who was watching nearby.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Set up the TV and gather the family
subevent.description: In the living room, Ma Xiulan turned on the family's old TV and put into the player the disc of the classic animated film Havoc in Heaven, which she had borrowed from the community cultural station. She called her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) to come and sit in the living room. Everyone gathered around the sofa, waiting for the movie to begin.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Watched 'Havoc in Heaven'.
subevent.description: In the evening, the whole family sat around the living room watching the classic animated film Havoc in Heaven. The children (especially the second son Ma Mingzhe) excitedly imitated Sun Wukong's jumps and golden cudgel swings. Her husband Ma Zhiqiang, for once, put down his phone and focused on watching the film with the family. The whole living room was filled with laughter and joy, with a warm and happy atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Discussion and cleanup after the movie
subevent.description: After the movie ended, Ma Xiulan and her family discussed their favorite characters. Ma Mingxuan liked Sun Wukong's cleverness, Ma Mingzhe imitated the Monkey King's moves, and Ma Yuxin praised the fairy's beauty. Everyone kept laughing, and they spent a simple and warm evening. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan cleaned up the popcorn bowl and cups, turned off the TV, and arranged for the children to wash up and go to bed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Making dumplings as a family on the Winter Solstice.
description: On the evening of December 21, after the thorough cleaning was done, Ma Xiulan organized the preparations for making dumplings in the kitchen of her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin. She asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to chop the meat filling, while she seasoned the filling and kneaded the dough. Her mother Li Xiuying washed the vegetables and prepared the seasonings, and the children watched curiously. Once the ingredients were ready, the whole family sat around the living room table and started wrapping dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang kneaded the dough and cut it into pieces, Ma Xiulan demonstrated rolling out the wrappers and filling them, the children clumsily learned to roll wrappers and pinch pleats, and Li Xiuying guided them from the side, amidst constant laughter and cheerful chatter. After the dumplings were wrapped, they were boiled in a pot, and Ma Zhiqiang mixed Laba vinegar. When the steaming dumplings were brought to the table, the father, Ma Jianguo, also arrived home. The whole family sat together and ate the dumplings dipped in Laba vinegar. Ma Jianguo remarked, 'The Winter Solstice is as important as the New Year; nothing is better than having the whole family together.' The warmth drove away the bitter cold outside.

subevent.name: Preparation before making dumplings
subevent.description: After the big cleanup, Ma Xiulan began organizing the preparations for making dumplings in the kitchen of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin. She asked her husband Ma Zhiqiang to help chop the meat filling, while she skillfully seasoned the filling, kneaded the dough, and prepared the rolling pin and cutting board. Meanwhile, her mother Li Xiuying also came over to help wash the vegetables and prepare seasonings. The children (eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin) gathered curiously around the table waiting.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Making dumplings together as a family.
subevent.description: Once the ingredients were ready, Ma Xiulan and her family sat around the dining table in the living room and started making dumplings. Ma Zhiqiang was responsible for kneading the dough and cutting the dough pieces. Ma Xiulan demonstrated how to roll out the wrappers and wrap the filling. The three children clumsily learned to roll wrappers and pinch pleats. Although the dumplings were all different shapes, laughter and chatter never stopped. Li Xiuying joined in too, guiding the grandchildren as she wrapped. The whole family participated, creating a warm and lively atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - dining table in the living room at home.

subevent.name: Boiling dumplings and the Winter Solstice dinner.
subevent.description: After wrapping the dumplings, Ma Xiulan and Li Xiuying boiled them, while Ma Zhiqiang prepared Laba vinegar. When the steaming dumplings were brought to the table, her father Ma Jianguo also arrived. The whole family sat around the table and ate dumplings dipped in Laba vinegar. Ma Jianguo said with emotion, 'The Winter Solstice is as significant as the New Year; a family together is what matters most.' They ate and chatted, the warmth driving away the bitter cold outside, enjoying a cozy family dinner.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

name: Handling the eldest son's midterm grade crisis and executing the academic balance plan.
description: On November 18, 2025, midterm exam results were released. The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, failed because he repeatedly failed to hand in history homework. His homeroom teacher, Han Mei, asked to meet with the parents. After receiving the notice that day, Ma Xiulan went to the school in the afternoon to talk and understand the situation. In the evening, she calmly analyzed the reasons with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, and they decided not to scold him but to jointly make a balanced plan. That night, she talked with the child and set up an 'Interest and Study Balance Plan,' requiring him to make up the missing history homework within a week and limiting experiment time. On November 19, she supervised the first day of making up homework; on November 22, based on progress, she adjusted the experiment schedule, limiting it to two hours on weekends and half an hour on weekdays. Ma Xiulan supervised and encouraged throughout, feeling both worried and hopeful about the results.

subevent.name: Receive the grade notice and a meeting request from the homeroom teacher
subevent.description: On the morning of November 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan received a call from Han Mei, the head teacher of her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, informing her that the midterm exam results had been released and that Ma Mingxuan had failed history because he had repeatedly failed to submit history homework. She asked the parents to come to the school for a face-to-face meeting. Ma Xiulan immediately agreed with Teacher Han to go to the school in the afternoon to discuss.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home (answering the phone)

subevent.name: Meet with the homeroom teacher to understand the situation.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan went to the middle school where Ma Mingxuan studies and had a face-to-face meeting with his homeroom teacher, Han Mei, in the office. Teacher Han explained in detail Ma Mingxuan's missing history homework this semester and the reasons for losing points on exams, and suggested that the parents pay attention and urge the child to complete homework on time. Ma Xiulan listened carefully and said she would fully cooperate with the school.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - the middle school Ma Mingxuan attends (a middle school in Jinghai District)

subevent.name: Analyze the reasons behind the couple's communication
subevent.description: On the evening of November 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan returned home and discussed with her husband Ma Zhiqiang (a truck driver who had just finished work) in the living room the issue of their eldest son Ma Mingxuan failing history. The two analyzed the situation and believed the main reason was that the child was too absorbed in his extracurricular experimental hobbies and neglected homework. They decided not to scold him, but instead work with the child to create a balanced plan.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - living room at home (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: Talked with the eldest son and made a plan together
subevent.description: On the evening of November 18, 2025, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang had a serious talk with their eldest son Ma Mingxuan in the study. They first affirmed his interest in scientific experiments while pointing out the importance of studying. After Ma Mingxuan silently agreed, the three of them jointly formulated a "Interest and Studies Balance Plan": Ma Mingxuan was required to submit all missing history homework within one week and limit his daily experiment time to after finishing homework. The plan was written down and posted by the desk.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: First day of supervising the eldest son's make-up history homework.
subevent.description: After school on November 19, 2025, Ma Xiulan supervised her eldest son Ma Mingxuan at home as he finished his homework for the day and began to turn in missing history homework. Under his mother's supervision, Ma Mingxuan completed the outline of the first missing assignment and sent it to the history teacher for review. Ma Xiulan checked the progress, encouraged him, and confirmed that the plan was going smoothly.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study (156 Jingwen Road)

subevent.name: Adjust the eldest son's schedule for his experimental hobby
subevent.description: On Saturday, November 22, 2025, Ma Xiulan and her eldest son Ma Mingxuan adjusted the schedule for after-school science experiments together based on the progress of handing in overdue homework. The original unlimited daily experiments were changed to two focused hours on weekends, and on weekdays, 30 minutes of experiments after finishing homework each day. Ma Mingxuan accepted this. Ma Xiulan posted the new schedule on the refrigerator and reminded the whole family to supervise.
subevent.location: Home kitchen at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Bringing pickled vegetables to market and building community word-of-mouth.
description: On the morning of September 4, Ma Xiulan transported the 60 jars of pickled vegetables she had hurriedly made to the entrance of the Jingwen Road vegetable market by tricycle and set up a stall. She attached handwritten labels and priced them at 8 yuan per jar. Because the pickled vegetables were authentic in taste and reasonably priced, she sold 42 jars in two days, earning 336 yuan. The remaining 18 jars were stored at home, and she planned to deliver them to several households introduced by her neighbor Wang Guilan. While at the stall, she also introduced the pickling process to several customers who asked about prices, and collected contact information from three or four repeat customers.

subevent.name: First day selling pickled vegetables at the stall
subevent.description: On the morning of September 4, Ma Xiulan transported 60 jars of pickled vegetables by tricycle to the entrance of the Jingwen Road vegetable market, set up the stall, affixed uniform handwritten labels (priced at 8 yuan per jar), and began promoting them to passing customers. She proactively introduced the pickling process to customers who asked about prices. That day she sold 25 jars in total, earning 200 yuan, and noted down the contact information of several repeat customers.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Selling pickled vegetables at the stall the next day and packing up
subevent.description: On the morning of September 5, Ma Xiulan transported the remaining 35 jars of pickled vegetables to the stall to sell. That day she sold 17 jars and earned 136 yuan. In the afternoon she packed up and went home, temporarily storing the remaining 18 jars at home, and counted the total sales over the two days as 336 yuan.
subevent.location: Jingwen Road Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Contact neighbors to discuss the delivery plan for the remaining pickled vegetables
subevent.description: On the evening of September 5, Ma Xiulan took the initiative to contact her neighbor Wang Guilan, explained how the remaining 18 jars of pickled vegetables were selling, and asked her to provide the names and addresses of the interested households she had introduced earlier. Ma Xiulan and Wang Guilan discussed the delivery order and schedule, and initially set a plan for door-to-door delivery within the next two days.
subevent.location: Home, No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin

name: Mid-Autumn Family Reunion
description: On October 6, the Mid-Autumn Festival, Ma Xiulan's family had a dinner gathering with her parents, who live locally, her younger sister Ma Xiufen, and her brother-in-law and children. She personally made several signature dishes, including a low-salt version of sweet and sour pork fillet and seasonal vegetables, and brought out preserved fruit and mooncakes brought back from Beijing. In the evening, the whole family admired the moon in the courtyard, the children played with lanterns, and her husband Ma Zhiqiang, for once, did not have to work overtime, so the family thoroughly enjoyed their time together.

subevent.name: Buying ingredients for the Mid-Autumn Festival.
subevent.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. At the stall of her acquaintance Sun Guifang, she bought the pork tenderloin needed for a low-salt version of sweet and sour pork and the day's fresh seasonal vegetables (such as choy sum and carrots), and also stocked up on some kitchen seasonings and fruit to prepare for the evening reunion dinner.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Prepare the Mid-Autumn Festival dinner.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan was busy in her kitchen, carefully cooking her signature dishes: low-salt sweet and sour pork tenderloin (using homemade sauce to control the salt) and garlic seasonal vegetables. At the same time, she arranged the preserved fruits and mooncakes she had brought back from Beijing on a plate, and prepared other cold dishes and staple foods to ensure a plentiful and delicious dinner.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Mid-Autumn Festival family dinner.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan's parents, Ma Jianguo and Li Xiuying, and her younger sister Ma Xiufen's family (brother-in-law Wang Gang and nephew Wang Hao) arrived one after another. Ma Xiulan's husband Ma Zhiqiang also came home from work on time. The whole family sat around the round table in the home dining room, enjoying the dishes Ma Xiulan had cooked herself and Beijing preserved-fruit mooncakes. They chatted and reminisced, and the atmosphere was warm and harmonious.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: Enjoying the moon and relaxing in the courtyard
subevent.description: After dinner, the whole family moved to the courtyard at home to enjoy the moon. Ma Xiulan sat on stone stools with her parents and younger sister, chatting and sharing family news; the three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, and Ma Yuxin) ran around the yard chasing each other with lanterns; her husband Ma Zhiqiang, who rarely had overtime, also joined the children in setting off small sparklers. The family immersed themselves in the warm, reunited holiday atmosphere late into the night.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

name: Set up a stall at the Jinghai District handicraft market.
description: On Saturday, December 14, Ma Xiulan packed pickled vegetables, embroidered pieces, and small fabric items into two large woven bags early in the morning, and caught a ride on neighbor Zhang Shufen's electric bike to the weekend handicraft market at Jinghai District Cultural Square. At her stall, she spread out a velvet cloth and arranged the goods neatly. Next to her were Zhou Xiuqin's paper-cutting stall and Liu Chunmei's stall selling handmade chair cushions on consignment. In the morning, she sold 8 jars of pickled vegetables, 5 sets of embroidered coasters, and 2 small cloth dolls, for a total of 185 yuan. At noon, the three pooled money for boxed lunches and discussed customer needs while eating. In the afternoon, customers gradually became fewer, so she packed up an hour early. After returning home, she recorded the day's earnings in her ledger and showed Aunt Wu the sales results in the WeChat group.

subevent.name: Preparation and loading before setting up the stall
subevent.description: On the morning of December 14, Ma Xiulan sorted the pre-pickled vegetables, hand-embroidered items, and small cloth crafts into two large woven bags at home, preparing to go to the weekend handicraft market at Jinghai District Cultural Square.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Take an electric bike to Cultural Square.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan hitched a ride on her neighbor Zhang Shufen's e-bike, carrying two woven bags full of goods, from 156 Jingwen Road to the weekend handicraft market at Jinghai District Cultural Square.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Cultural Square

subevent.name: Set up the stall and start business.
subevent.description: After arriving at the Cultural Square, Ma Xiulan spread a flannel cloth on her stall, neatly arranged products such as pickled vegetables, embroidered coasters, and small cloth dolls, and began the morning sales. Beside her were Zhou Xiuqin's paper-cutting stall and Liu Chunmei's consignment handmade chair cushions.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Cultural Square Handicraft Market

subevent.name: Morning sales and lunch discussion
subevent.description: Youngest daughter wipes the low cabinet and coffee table.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Cultural Square Handicraft Market

subevent.name: In the afternoon, she closed the stall and returned home.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, as customers gradually thinned out, Ma Xiulan closed the stall an hour early, packed the remaining goods into woven bags, tidied up the stall, and then walked to the agreed meeting point to get a ride home.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Cultural Square to home

subevent.name: Recording and sharing sales updates
subevent.description: After returning home, Ma Xiulan recorded the day's income of 185 yuan in the family ledger, and in the WeChat group showed Aunt Wu, who was far away in Cangzhou, the sales situation and product photos, exchanging tips on handicraft making.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: New Year's Eve Family Banquet and Warm Memories.
description: On New Year's Eve, December 31, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in the early morning to buy ingredients. In the afternoon, she carefully cooked dishes such as braised fish, steamed pork with rice flour, and sweet and sour pork tenderloin in the home kitchen, and took out the family photo album and placed it beside the dining table. In the evening, she had dinner with her husband Ma Zhiqiang. Her husband took the initiative to pour wine and raise his glass, saying, 'Wife, let's keep it up next year!' Ma Xiulan was moved and picked up a piece of sweet and sour pork tenderloin to feed him, and the two shared a warm moment. After dinner, she cleaned up the dishes, picked up the photo album, and looked at the light brown marks on it, recalling the family moments of the past year, her heart full of warmth and contentment.

subevent.name: Shopping for ingredients for New Year's Eve dinner
subevent.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District. At Sun Guifang's stall, she carefully selected ingredients for the New Year's Eve dinner, including fresh fish, pork belly, tenderloin, and vegetables, planning to cook dishes such as braised fish, steamed pork with rice flour, and sweet and sour pork tenderloin for her family.
subevent.location: Xingwang Vegetable Market, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Cooking and setting the table for the New Year's Eve dinner
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan started bustling in the kitchen of her home on Jingwen Road in Jinghai District from the afternoon onward, carefully cooking dishes such as braised fish, steamed pork with rice flour, and sweet-and-sour pork tenderloin. She placed the dishes on the dining table one by one, and also took out the family photo album and put it beside the table to create a New Year's Eve atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - kitchen and dining room at home

subevent.name: New Year's Eve dinner and good wishes.
subevent.description: In the evening, Ma Xiulan and her husband Ma Zhiqiang had a New Year's Eve dinner together in their dining room at home in Jinghai District. Ma Zhiqiang took the initiative to pour wine for his wife, raised his glass, and said, 'Honey, let's keep at it next year!' Ma Xiulan was moved, picked up a piece of sweet and sour pork tenderloin and brought it to her husband's mouth. The two shared a warm interaction.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

subevent.name: Tidying up and reminiscing after the New Year's Eve dinner
subevent.description: After dinner, Ma Xiulan cleared the table and dishes, then held the photo album and studied the light brown imprint, recalling her conversation with her husband and the family moments over the past year. She felt warm and content, bringing New Year's Eve to a perfect close.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and living room

name: Kept up Baduanjin practice and successfully led the exercises at the community evening party.
description: Since November, Ma Xiulan has been practicing Baduanjin every day and can now complete the entire set smoothly. On November 15, the community held an autumn variety show, and she was selected as one of the exercise leaders. Although she was nervous about performing on stage for the first time, she made no mistakes throughout. After stepping off the stage, her neighbor Shufen handed her hot tea to comfort her.

subevent.name: Practice Baduanjin daily.
subevent.description: Starting from November 1, 2025, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin every morning on the open ground of the Jingwen Road residential community. At first she relied on a phone video to learn the movements, gradually memorizing the routines, and later she could independently complete the entire set. The practice was clearly effective and laid the foundation for a performance at the community party.
subevent.location: Open space in the residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Baduanjin practice, days 1-2
subevent.description: Two days in a row, Ma Xiulan got up at 6:30 a.m., went to the open area of the Jingwen Road residential complex, first watched a Baduanjin instructional video on her phone to review the key movements, then practiced the full set of Baduanjin once, including moves such as 'pushing up the sky with both hands', 'drawing the bow to shoot left and right', and 'regulating the spleen and stomach', for about 20 minutes. After finishing the practice, she returned home to prepare breakfast.
subevent.location: Open space in the residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Practice Baduanjin, days 5-6.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan continued to practice Baduanjin for two mornings in a row. She gradually deepened her control of the movement rhythm, tried to reduce the number of times she looked at her phone, and relied on body memory to complete the forms. After practicing, she took a short walk in the open space, chatted briefly with her neighbor Wang Guilan, and then returned home.
subevent.location: Open space in the residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Day 7-8 of practicing Baduanjin
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin on the open ground in the residential compound at 6:30 in the morning for two consecutive days. After a week of practice, her movements had become relatively smooth. She placed her phone on a stand beside her and performed the movements on her own without relying on the video, occasionally glancing at it to confirm when she forgot a move. After practice, she felt warm and full of energy.
subevent.location: Open space in the residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Practicing Baduanjin, days 11-12
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin for two consecutive days. Her movements were now very smooth and familiar, and throughout the entire session she didn't need to refer to a video, only occasionally adjusting her breathing rhythm. She extended the practice time to 25 minutes, repeatedly savoring each movement. After finishing, she strolled around the neighborhood to check on the growth of her small vegetable garden.
subevent.location: Open space in the residential area, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Final rehearsal and preparation before the evening party
subevent.description: During the day on November 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan repeatedly practiced the full set of Baduanjin movements in front of a mirror at home, confirming that the rhythm was accurate. Then she changed into the uniform performance outfit and held a final rehearsal with the other community exercise leaders at the community activity center to familiarize themselves with the stage positions.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Home and Community Activity Center

subevent.name: Leading the exercise performance and interaction at the community gala.
subevent.description: On the evening of November 15, 2025, Ma Xiulan attended the autumn cultural performance held by the Jingwen Road Community in Jinghai District. As one of the exercise leaders, she went on stage to lead the residents in Baduanjin. Although it was her first time on stage and she was nervous, her movements were smooth and flawless throughout. After coming off stage, her neighbor Zhang Shufen handed her hot tea to comfort her. Ma Xiulan chatted briefly with Shufen and the neighbors around them, sharing her feelings about the performance.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - Community Activity Center.

name: Launched the "Beijing Travel Commemorative Pack" pickled vegetables and made up for order losses
description: After returning from the trip (October 4), Ma Xiulan, because of exhaustion and delayed procurement of ingredients, postponed the launch of the autumn pickled vegetables by two weeks and missed some orders. She discussed it with Liu Chunmei and decided to launch a small-jar 'Beijing Travel Commemorative Set' with handwritten travel cards, limited to 30 jars. On October 10, the commemorative set went on sale and was quickly sold out, with profits exceeding those of regular products and making up for the loss caused by the delay.

subevent.name: Purchase raw materials and packaging materials for the souvenir outfits.
subevent.description: Following the agreed plan, Ma Xiulan went to local grocery stores and the vegetable market in Jinghai District to buy seasonal vegetables, seasonings, and small glass jars, label paper, and packing twine specially for commemorative packaging. She deliberately chose red label paper with Beijing-style patterns, organized all the materials at home, and notified the raw material supplier to restock promptly to resume normal production.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - vegetable market and home

subevent.name: Making Beijing travel souvenir jars of pickled vegetables
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan began making 30 jars of limited-edition pickled vegetables in her home kitchen using a traditional recipe. She washed and chopped the cucumbers, green beans, and other vegetables she had purchased, prepared a secret sauce, pickled them until flavorful, and packed them into small glass jars. The process lasted the whole day. During this time, she had her daughter Yuxin help pass the jars, while her eldest son Mingxuan helped wipe the jars after finishing his homework. By evening, all 30 jars of pickled vegetables were finished and sealed.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Handwritten travel cards and packaging preparation.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan used the morning to review her impressions from the Beijing trip and handwrote short travel notes and blessings on 30 small cards, such as 'The autumn flavor brought back from Beijing, may you taste the warmth beneath the old city wall.' In the afternoon, she tied the cards to the jar mouths with red string, attached the label 'Beijing Trip Commemorative Pack,' and carefully packaged 30 jars of pickled vegetables, waiting to put them on the shelves the next day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: The commemorative edition went on sale and sold out.
subevent.description: At 9 a.m., Ma Xiulan posted the launch of the commemorative pickled vegetables on WeChat Moments, with pictures including travel cards and jarred finished products, and stated that only 30 jars were available on a first-come, first-served basis. Liu Chunmei helped repost it in the community WeChat group. After the message was sent, orders poured in, and all 30 jars were snapped up in less than two hours. Ma Xiulan calculated the sales and found that the profit was 30% higher than that of regular pickled vegetables, which not only made up for the loss from the earlier order delay but also brought in extra income.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District - at home (mobile phone operation and packaging for delivery)

subevent.name: Settling earnings and offsetting order losses
subevent.description: Starting October 11, Ma Xiulan began contacting customers she had missed because the new product launch was delayed, communicating with them one by one, and compensating these regular customers with part of the profits from the commemorative pack pickled vegetables as discounts or gifts. She kept detailed records of every compensation expense and completed all the compensation plans before October 15. When it was all added up, not only did she make up for the losses from all the delayed orders, but she also gained extra income thanks to the popularity of the commemorative pack. Ma Xiulan was very satisfied with this.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Caring for the birthday potted plant and keeping up the habit of documenting it in photos and videos
description: On September 13, Ma Xiulan had the potted plants, greeting cards, and impromptu family photos taken on her birthday printed out and placed them in the “Golden Autumn Memories” section of the family album. She also began learning how to care for the fuchsia, watering it regularly and pinching off the growing tips. The flowerpot was placed next to the roses in the courtyard, becoming another little life she cares for daily. Since then, she has taken a photo of the flower’s condition every month, inadvertently continuing her habit of visual documentation.

subevent.name: Print birthday photos
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the memory card to the photo studio in the town center of Jinghai District. She printed three photos taken on her birthday with her phone: a close-up of the fuchsia potted plant, a handwritten greeting card from the whole family, and an impromptu family photo. She paid the printing fee and took back the paper photos.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Town Center Photo Studio

subevent.name: Saved the photos to the family album
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan took the family album out of the storage cabinet in the living room, found the reserved page titled 'Golden Autumn Memories', carefully inserted the printed photos of potted plants, greeting cards, and the family portrait into the album, wrote down the date and a short note, and completed the filing.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Learning how to care for fuchsia
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan used her phone to search online for fuchsia care knowledge, focusing on watering frequency, pinching techniques, and wintering precautions, and wrote down key points briefly in handwritten notes to prepare for subsequent daily care.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Routine care of the fuchsia potted plant
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan followed the care methods she had learned: she checked the moisture of the potted plant soil every day, watered regularly to keep the medium moist but not waterlogged, pinched off the growing tips during the peak growing season to encourage branching and flowering, and also paid attention to keeping the plants warm in winter. She continued caring for them through the end of the year.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Initial inspection and watering
subevent.description: That morning, Ma Xiulan made her first careful inspection of the potted fuchsia in her courtyard. She touched the surface of the potting soil, confirmed that it was too dry, and then slowly watered along the inner edge of the pot with a watering can until water seeped out from the bottom. She also checked the leaves for yellow spots or pests, and casually removed a withered leaf. After watering, she placed the potted plant in a semi-shaded spot in the courtyard to ensure good ventilation.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: First pinching in the peak growing season.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan noticed that the new shoots of the fuchsia had grown to about 10 cm and decided to pinch them out on a sunny morning. With clean fingers, she gently pinched off the two young leaves at the tips of the branches to encourage side buds to sprout. After pinching, she sprayed a small amount of diluted carbendazim solution on the wounds to prevent infection and moved the potted plant to a spot with plenty of indirect light. The whole process took about twenty minutes, and after finishing, she cleaned her hands and tools.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Second pinching and shaping
subevent.description: About three weeks after the first pinching, Ma Xiulan checked and found that side branches had grown, but some branches were too dense. In the afternoon she performed the second pinching: she kept 3–4 pairs of leaves on the side branches and pinched off the tips, while also cutting away crossing and weak branches to keep the plant's crown compact and rounded. After pinching, she applied a dilute liquid fertilizer (homemade fermented rice-washing water fertilizer) and watered thoroughly. She repositioned the potted plant to ensure even light exposure on all sides.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Pre-winter pruning and overwintering preparations.
subevent.description: As the Beginning of Winter approached, Ma Xiulan began preparing her potted plants to overwinter. In the morning, she first did light pruning, cutting away diseased and weak branches, overcrowded branches, and spent flowers to reduce nutrient consumption. Then she used a soft cloth dipped in clean water to wipe the dust off the leaves. Next, she spread a layer of dry moss about 2 cm thick on the surface of the potted soil to keep it warm and moist, and moved the potted plants from the courtyard to a corner of the south-facing balcony at home, where there was diffused light during the day and the nighttime temperature did not drop below 10°C. Finally, she watered them thoroughly and stopped applying additional fertilizer.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home balcony.

subevent.name: Winter insulation and cold-proofing reinforcement
subevent.description: A cold wave hit, and Ma Xiulan worried that the balcony would be too cold at night. In the afternoon, she built a simple greenhouse in the corner of the balcony using an old quilt and clear plastic sheeting, covering the fuchsia potted plant. The frame was supported with thin bamboo strips to ensure the ventilation holes were not completely sealed. At the same time, she adjusted the watering frequency from once a week to once every 10 days to prevent the roots from freezing. After finishing, she checked the thermometer and confirmed that the nighttime temperature could stay above 8°C.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home balcony.

subevent.name: Year-end comprehensive inspection and maintenance
subevent.description: On the last day of the year, Ma Xiulan conducted the final comprehensive check of the year on her potted fuchsia. She removed the greenhouse film to let it breathe, tested the moisture of the potting soil with her fingertip, found it a bit dry, and watered it with a suitable amount of warm water (left to sit at room temperature overnight). She carefully went through all the branches, pruning yellowing leaves and leggy shoots that had appeared during winter dormancy. She checked whether any roots were coming out through the bottom of the pot and confirmed that repotting was not needed. Finally, she wiped the pot walls and leaves with a damp cloth so the plant could greet the new year in a tidy state. In her notebook, she briefly recorded the year's key care points and the plan for revival in early spring.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home balcony.

subevent.name: November: photograph the growth of potted plants
subevent.description: On November 13, Ma Xiulan again used her phone to photograph the fuchsia potted plant in the courtyard, recording its pre-winter changes in form and maintaining her habit of taking a photo every month.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Photograph the growth of the potted plants in December.
subevent.description: On December 13, Ma Xiulan took the month's photo of the fuchsia potted plant, documenting its condition after indoor care in winter, completing the year's final photo record.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

name: Complete the annual eligibility confirmation for the social insurance subsidy.
description: On November 28, Ma Xiulan organized materials in her home study, including her pickle sales notebook, hand-embroidery receipts, and flexible employment proof. On the morning of November 29, she took the materials to the community service station and found Zheng Xiuying to complete the annual eligibility confirmation for the social security subsidy. Zheng Xiuying checked the accounts and stamped them on the spot. In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan returned home, locked the materials in a drawer, and resolved to keep her monthly accounts more organized from then on.

subevent.name: Organize qualification confirmation materials.
subevent.description: On November 28, Ma Xiulan carefully organized her pickle sales notebook, hand-embroidery receipts, and flexible employment certificate in her home study, sorting the materials neatly to make full preparations for going to the community service station the next day to complete the annual eligibility confirmation for social security subsidies.
subevent.location: Study room in the home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Go to the community service station to complete the eligibility confirmation.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 29, Ma Xiulan brought her prepared notebook of pickled vegetable sales, handwritten embroidery receipts, and flexible employment certificate, and walked to the Jinghai District community service station. She found the part-time job coordinator Zheng Xiuying and handled the annual qualification confirmation for social security subsidies. Zheng Xiuying patiently helped her go over the accounts, found the records basically complete, and after confirming everything was correct, stamped the relevant documents on the spot. Ma Xiulan breathed a sigh of relief, then said goodbye to Zheng Xiuying and returned home.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - Community Service Station

subevent.name: Go home, organize the materials, and reflect on my bookkeeping habits.
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 29, after returning home, Ma Xiulan locked the stamped qualification confirmation documents, the pickled vegetable sales notebook, hand-embroidery receipts, and the flexible employment certificate in the desk drawer at home for safekeeping. She calmed down and reflected on the whole process, realizing the importance of keeping clear accounts. She resolved to record all income and expenses in a more organized way every month from then on, to avoid being flustered during year-end reconciliation.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home on Jingwen Road

name: Complete the embroidery order and deliver it to the customer.
description: On December 11, Ma Xiulan finished the last stitch of an embroidery piece titled “Blossoms of Prosperity” that had taken her three days to complete. This 50 cm × 60 cm piece was commissioned by an old customer through Zhou Xiuqin; the design features peonies with butterflies, executed in fine stitching. In the afternoon, she mounted the embroidery in a wooden frame and delivered it personally to the customer's home in the Jinghai urban area. The customer was very satisfied, paid the remaining 350 yuan on the spot, and said she would order another piece before next Spring Festival. Ma Xiulan returned home, recorded the income in her side-business ledger, and felt very pleased.

subevent.name: First day of embroidery: Flowers Blooming in Prosperity.
subevent.description: Starting in the morning, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the piece "Flowers Blooming in Prosperity" in her home study, focusing on the basic stitches for the peony petals and butterfly wings. She completed most of the outlines and made smooth progress.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Finish off the stitches and inspect the embroidered piece
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan did the final stitching and a thorough inspection of the Blooming Flowers, Wealth and Honor embroidery piece, cut the threads, tidied the surface of the embroidery, and confirmed that the work was completed without any flaws.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

subevent.name: Mounting the embroidery
subevent.description: At home, Ma Xiulan carefully framed the finished embroidery using the prepared wooden frame and tools, making sure the embroidered surface was smooth and wrinkle-free.
subevent.location: Home, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Deliver goods to the customer's home and collect payment.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan personally delivered the framed 'Blossoms of Prosperity' embroidery to the home of client Wang Lihua in Jinghai city center. Wang Lihua was very satisfied and paid the remaining 350 yuan on the spot, and verbally placed an order for another piece before next Spring Festival. Ma Xiulan expressed her thanks.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - customer's home

subevent.name: Return home to sort out the accounts.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan returned home and recorded the income of 350 yuan from this embroidery order in her sideline business ledger, with a note about the customer's intention to place an order before next year's Spring Festival. She felt delighted.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home study room

name: Maintain a daily morning walk, combined with breathing exercises and step tracking
description: Since April 1, Ma Xiulan has been brisk walking for about 20 minutes every day at 6 a.m. while her family is still asleep, going along Jingwen Road to the neighborhood park for two laps, while doing deep breathing and tracking steps on her phone. Neighbor Zhang Shufen often joins her, and the two exchange health tips while walking. Ma Xiulan noticed her complexion improved after three consecutive weeks, and began to regard the walk as an unshakable morning ritual, encouraging her husband to join on weekends.

subevent.name: Prepare gear for the morning walk.
subevent.description: On March 30, Ma Xiulan decided to start taking morning walks from April 1. She dug out her old sneakers at home to check whether they still fit, and cleared phone storage to make room for installing a step-counting app. She also downloaded the pedometer app in advance and set a daily step goal, and told her husband Ma Zhiqiang about her upcoming morning exercise plan, asking him to join in if he had time on the weekend.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Adaptation period for morning walks in the first week
subevent.description: From April 1 to April 7, Ma Xiulan set out from her home on Jingwen Road at 6 a.m. every day while her family was still asleep, walked along the sidewalk to the street park, and briskly walked two laps around the park for about 20 minutes, while coordinating deep breathing (inhaling for 4 steps, exhaling for 4 steps), and used a step-counting app on her phone to record her steps. During the week, she basically did it alone. Occasionally she met her neighbor Zhang Shufen at the park gate, and after a brief greeting they each continued walking. She paid attention to adjusting her breathing rhythm to keep her heart rate steady, and after returning home she prepared breakfast for her family as usual. For seven consecutive days she never missed a day, and initially developed the habit of getting up early.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk, day 1
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 1, while her family was still asleep, Ma Xiulan set out from her home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and walked along the sidewalk to the neighborhood park. In the park, she briskly walked two laps for about 20 minutes while doing deep breathing (inhaling for 4 steps, exhaling for 4 steps), and used the pedometer app on her phone to record her steps. She completed the whole trip alone and ran into no acquaintances. During the walk, she paid attention to adjusting her breathing rhythm to keep her heart rate steady. She got home before 7 a.m. and began preparing breakfast for the family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk, day 2
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 2, Ma Xiulan set out again from her home on Jingwen Road and walked to the neighborhood park. She briskly walked two laps in the park for about 20 minutes, continued practicing her deep breathing rhythm (inhale for 4 steps, exhale for 4 steps), and used her phone pedometer app to record her steps. The weather was sunny and the park air was fresh, and she felt her breathing was smoother. On the way home she passed by the supermarket at neighbor Zhang Shufen's house, but it was not yet open because it was still early. She got home before 7 a.m. and prepared breakfast.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk, day 3
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on the morning of April 3, Ma Xiulan insisted on getting up and walked to the street park as planned. She walked briskly for two laps in the park for 20 minutes, keeping a steady breathing rhythm, and her step-count app recorded normally. Today, she ran into her neighbor Zhang Shufen at the park gate, and after exchanging brief greetings, they each continued their walk. She returned home before 7 and began making breakfast for the family.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk, day 4
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 4, Ma Xiulan continued her morning walk routine. Starting from her home on Jingwen Road to the neighborhood park, she briskly walked two laps for about 20 minutes, combined with deep breathing exercises. It was slightly cool this morning, so she wore a thin jacket. She didn't meet anyone she knew along the way and kept a steady pace. She returned home before 7 a.m. and began preparing breakfast, so the children had a hot meal after getting up.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk day 5.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 5, Ma Xiulan went out for a walk as usual. She walked to the street park, briskly walked two laps in the park for 20 minutes, and deep breathing became more natural in step with her pace. She checked her phone app and saw that her step count had increased compared to the previous day. After a short rest on a park bench, she returned.
