On the way home, she met her neighbor Wang Guilan watering flowers at the door, and the two chatted about their gardens for a bit. She got home before 7 and made breakfast.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning walk, day 6
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 6, Ma Xiulan had already developed the habit of waking up early and woke up naturally without an alarm. She went to the neighborhood park and briskly walked two laps for 20 minutes, breathing steadily, feeling relaxed and refreshed. She did not meet any other walkers today and completed the entire walk alone. She got home before 7 a.m. and started preparing breakfast for her family in a cheerful mood.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Day 7 of morning walks.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 7, it was the last morning walk of the week. Ma Xiulan kept to her routine, walking from her home on Jingwen Road to the street park, briskly walking two laps for 20 minutes, and doing deep breathing exercises more smoothly. She used the step-counting app on her phone to record her total steps for the week and reviewed the changes over the week. At the park exit she met Zhang Shufen, and the two exchanged their exercise experiences from the past few days. She returned home before 7, prepared breakfast for her family, and made plans for the new week. Having gone seven consecutive days without interruption, she had initially formed the habit of early-morning exercise.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Second week: walking and talking with Zhang Shufen
subevent.description: Starting April 8, her neighbor Zhang Shufen voluntarily joined Ma Xiulan's morning walk group. The two agreed to meet every morning at 6 o'clock at the entrance of Shufen Convenience Store at No. 154 Jingwen Road, then walk together along the road to the street park, brisk-walking while exchanging health tips and sharing funny life stories. Ma Xiulan learned some stretching exercises from Zhang Shufen; after the walk, the two did simple stretches on a park bench to relax. Zhang Shufen's company made the walk more enjoyable, and Ma Xiulan felt time passed more quickly. They encouraged each other and even kept going on rainy days, switching to doing indoor stretches under the eaves. That week, their health awareness and casual conversations deepened their neighborly bond.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Third week of physical improvement and ritualized adherence
subevent.description: Entering the third week, Ma Xiulan noticed that her complexion had improved noticeably, the dizziness she used to feel on waking in the morning was gone, and her bowel movements had also become regular. She became more determined to treat her morning walk as an unshakable ritual, and even when Zhang Shufen was occasionally absent due to other commitments, she kept going alone. Every morning she would check in and record her feelings in the memo app on her phone, and she began to consciously adjust her walking posture, aiming for a lighter and steadier stride. She also took the initiative at dinner to share the benefits of walking with her husband and children, encouraging the whole family to be active together. That weekend (Saturday, April 19), she successfully persuaded her husband Ma Zhiqiang to walk with her. Although Ma Zhiqiang only walked half the way before going back to catch up on sleep, Ma Xiulan was very happy and they agreed to try again next weekend. On Sunday she continued to consolidate the ritual on her own, her steps growing even lighter and steadier, and in her heart she had come to regard walking as an unshakable daily habit. After walking with Zhang Shufen early Monday morning, she reviewed the week's progress in her memo and resolved to keep up this good habit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Adjust walking posture on the Wednesday of the third week
subevent.description: Early in the morning, Ma Xiulan again went on a walk with Zhang Shufen. During the walk, she deliberately adjusted her walking posture, aiming for lighter and steadier steps. After returning home, she checked in on her phone memo and recorded her feelings for the day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: On Thursday of the third week, she kept up her walk alone.
subevent.description: Because Zhang Shufen was absent at the last minute due to household matters, Ma Xiulan walked alone along Jingwen Road to the street park to complete her morning walk. She persisted in checking in on her memo app, reflected on the sense of accomplishment from persisting alone, and observed the changes in roadside plants.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Friday of the third week: went for a walk and shared dinner.
subevent.description: In the early morning, Ma Xiulan went for a walk with Zhang Shufen. After returning home, she checked in and recorded it. At dinner, she shared with her husband Ma Zhiqiang and their three children (Ma Mingxuan, Ma Mingzhe, Ma Yuxin) the benefits of walking—better complexion, regular bowel movements, and dizziness gone—and encouraged the whole family to be active together.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: On the Saturday of the third week, persuaded her husband to go for a walk together
subevent.description: On a weekend morning, Ma Xiulan successfully persuaded her husband Ma Zhiqiang to take a walk together along Jingwen Road. Ma Zhiqiang only walked half the way and went home to catch up on sleep, but Ma Xiulan was very happy, and the two agreed to walk together again next Saturday. After the walk, Ma Xiulan checked in on her phone memo as usual.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Solo consolidation ritual on the Sunday of the third week
subevent.description: On Sunday morning, Ma Xiulan took a morning walk by herself and kept up her check-in record. Her pace was lighter and steadier, and she now regarded walking as an unshakable ritual in her heart. She planned to invite her husband to join again next week.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Week 3 Monday: walking together and review.
subevent.description: On Monday morning, Ma Xiulan and Zhang Shufen went for a walk together again. After returning home, she reviewed the week's progress in her notes: improved complexion, regular bowel movements, and her husband participating for the first time. She resolved to keep up this good habit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Week 4 consolidation and trying a weekend family walk.
subevent.description: Starting April 21, Ma Xiulan persisted in walking briskly every morning at 6 a.m. with her neighbor Zhang Shufen along Jingwen Road to the street-corner park, forming a steady habit. On the morning of Saturday, April 26, she invited her husband Ma Zhiqiang to join them for a walk. Ma Zhiqiang accompanied her the whole way and volunteered to participate regularly next month. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan encouraged her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to get up early and exercise, but he refused. On the morning of April 30, Ma Xiulan completed the month's final walk with Zhang Shufen as usual. That evening, she reviewed the month's step count statistics, summed up her achievements, and set new goals for the next month.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Morning routine walk with neighbor Zhang Shufen.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on recent mornings, Ma Xiulan sets off on time from her home on Jingwen Road and walks along Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park to meet her neighbor Zhang Shufen. The two keep the same brisk walking pace, coordinate their breathing, chat about family matters while walking, and encourage each other. The whole walk takes about 40 minutes. After it ends, each returns home to prepare breakfast and handle the children's daily routine. This has been their steady morning exercise habit since this month, and they carry it out every day.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Invite husband and eldest son to morning exercise together on the weekend
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on Saturday, Ma Xiulan first invited her husband Ma Zhiqiang to take a walk together. Ma Zhiqiang agreed and accompanied her the whole way, walking from Jingwen Road to the street park and back. On the way, they exchanged views on exercise habits, and Ma Zhiqiang proactively said he could join the morning exercise regularly next month. After returning home, Ma Xiulan then encouraged her eldest son Ma Mingxuan to get up early on the weekend and take part in activities, but Ma Mingxuan refused, saying he wanted to sleep in. Ma Xiulan did not insist, and went alone with Zhang Shufen (Did Zhang Shufen not participate in this account? In the actual account, Ma Xiulan was walking with her husband, so Zhang Shufen may not have participated? But the account says she kept walking with Zhang Shufen as a daily routine, and on Saturday her husband accompanied her, so maybe Zhang Shufen did not go along that day? The original account says Ma Xiulan again invited her husband to walk together, and Ma Zhiqiang accompanied her for the entire walk on Saturday morning, without mentioning Zhang Shufen, so the participants were Ma Xiulan, Ma Zhiqiang, and Ma Mingxuan. Zhang Shufen was not present. Therefore only these three are listed as participants.)
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Completed morning exercise on the last day of the month and planned the next month's goals.
subevent.description: At 6 a.m. on April 30, Ma Xiulan met Zhang Shufen as usual on Jingwen Road, and the two walked briskly along the road to Jiexin Park, completing the last morning walk of the month. On the way home, they shared what they had gained from exercising this month. That evening, at home, Ma Xiulan opened the pedometer app on her phone, reviewed the month's step statistics, calculated the average daily steps, and compared them with her original goal. Based on this month's results, she set a new step goal for the next month and planned to continue her early-morning walking habit while also trying to get her husband more involved.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Jingwen Road to Jiexin Park

subevent.name: Monthly walking summary and new goal setting
subevent.description: On the evening of April 30, after dinner, Ma Xiulan opened the step-counting app on her phone and checked the total number of steps and average daily steps for the whole of April. She found that her average daily steps reached 8,000, far exceeding her expected goal of 6,000, and felt very satisfied. She wrote down this month's walking reflections in her notebook: her complexion had improved, she had more energy, her friendship with Zhang Shufen had deepened, and her husband had begun to participate. She marked the May goal on the family calendar: continue walking every day, strive to increase the average daily steps to 9,000, and encourage her husband to join at least once every weekend. At the same time, she planned to buy a more professional pair of sports shoes to replace her old ones.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Aunt Wu came over and they tried making Hebei chili sauce together.
description: From November 10 to 16, 2025, Aunt Wu, a handicraft friend from Hebei, visited and stayed with them. During this period, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu made the first trial batch of an ancestral Hebei chili sauce on the 10th; on the morning of the 12th, Ma Xiulan, Aunt Wu, and Zhou Xiuqin, a handicraft friend invited by Ma Xiulan, went together to a local market in Jinghai, and in the afternoon they jointly tasted the chili sauce and adjusted the recipe to make a second trial batch; on the 13th, they made the final chili sauce using materials found at the market, wrote down the recipe, and took a group photo. Through the week together, their craft friendship deepened.

subevent.name: Preliminary preparation and purchasing
subevent.description: The day before, Ma Xiulan tidied the guest room at home and went to the Jinghai District vegetable market and supermarket to buy fresh chili peppers, garlic, salt, sugar, and other ingredients needed to make spicy sauce, as well as family food for hosting Aunt Wu, ensuring that everything was ready for the visit.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home and Xingwang Vegetable Market

subevent.name: Welcome Aunt Wu and help her settle in.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan went to the Jinghai District passenger station to pick up Auntie Wu, who had arrived by long-distance bus from Cangzhou, Hebei. The two went home together, and Ma Xiulan showed Auntie Wu around the house, arranged her room, and they had a simple lunch while catching up.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home and passenger station.

subevent.name: First trial batch of Hebei chili sauce.
subevent.description: After the midday rest, Ma Xiulan and Aunt Wu made the first batch of Hebei chili sauce together in her home kitchen, following the ancestral recipe that Aunt Wu had brought. Ma Xiulan prepared the ingredients and tools, while Aunt Wu guided the key steps (heat control and seasoning ratios). They chatted about everyday matters as they worked, and the first attempt was a success.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Invite Zhou Xiuqin to join the trial production exchange.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan contacted her craft friend Zhou Xiuqin via WeChat, inviting her to come to her home to taste the first batch of chili sauce and take part in further improvements. That afternoon, Zhou Xiuqin arrived, and the three of them tasted the first version of the chili sauce at the dining table, discussed ways to adjust the flavor (such as increasing or decreasing the heat and adding spices), and immediately made a second version on the spot. Zhou Xiuqin suggested adding a bit of sesame to boost the aroma, and Aunt Wu adopted it.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and living room

subevent.name: The three went to the local Jinghai market together.
subevent.description: In the morning, Ma Xiulan, Aunt Wu, and Zhou Xiuqin went together to the largest weekend market in Jinghai District, located near Shengli Avenue. Aunt Wu was full of praise for the local fresh ingredients, such as the stalls with local chili peppers and spices. The three strolled around and selected fresh ingredients and handicraft fabrics needed for the upcoming trial production, and at noon they ate at a restaurant near the market.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Weekend Market

subevent.name: Trial production and summary of the final version of the chili sauce.
subevent.description: On the day before Aunt Wu left, Ma Xiulan, Aunt Wu, and Zhou Xiuqin gathered in the kitchen again. Combining the experience from the previous days and the new ingredients bought at the market, they made a trial batch of the final version of Hebei chili sauce. Aunt Wu taught them the preservation secret (the sealed fermentation method). The three recorded the recipe and took a group photo. After it was done, they divided the sauce into several bottles, and Ma Xiulan and Zhou Xiuqin each kept some.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

name: Trial-Producing Fabric Hair Flowers and Receiving the First Orders
description: On November 5, her younger sister Ma Xiufen sent leftover fabrics and design drawings from a garment factory, inviting her to collaborate on making fabric hair flowers. Ma Xiulan spent two days making more than a dozen styles. On November 7, neighbors Sun Lihua and Zhao Xiaohong each selected two, at 5 yuan each, giving her her first income from fabric crafts.

subevent.name: Receive the fabric and design drawings sent by her younger sister.
subevent.description: On the morning of November 5, 2025, Ma Xiulan received a package at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, sent by her younger sister Ma Xiufen from Binhai New Area. It contained leftover fabric from a garment factory and design patterns for fabric hair flowers. After unpacking it, she carefully inspected the material quality and color combinations, discussed design ideas with her sister over WeChat, confirmed their intention to cooperate, and prepared for the upcoming production.
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: First day of trial-making fabric hair flower samples.
subevent.description: From the afternoon to the evening of November 5, 2025, Ma Xiulan used the leftover materials and design drawings sent by her younger sister to begin making cloth hair flowers as trials in her home living room. She first cut the fabric and matched colors, then used tools such as needle and thread and a glue gun to make about six different styles of hair flower samples, covering simple, floral print, and pleated styles. She took photos and sent them to her younger sister for opinions.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

subevent.name: The next day, completed making all the hair flower designs
subevent.description: All day on November 6, 2025, Ma Xiulan continued making fabric hair flowers at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin. Based on her younger sister's feedback from the previous day, she adjusted some styles and added new designs, finally completing more than a dozen hair flowers in different colors and shapes. She neatly arranged the finished pieces on a tray, ready to show and sell to her neighbors.
subevent.location: Home in Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Neighbors choose hair flowers, and she earns income from the first batch of orders
subevent.description: On the afternoon of November 7, 2025, neighbors Sun Lihua and Zhao Xiaohong came to Ma Xiulan's home for a visit and saw the fabric hair flowers on the table. They loved the designs, and each bought two flowers in different colors, at 5 yuan each. Ma Xiulan received 20 yuan in cash in total, her first income from making fabric hair flowers. She happily recorded the order and thanked her neighbors for their support.
subevent.location: Tianjin - living room at home in Jinghai District.

name: Family movie night
description: On Sunday evening, November 9, Ma Xiulan used the roast duck her husband brought home to prepare dinner and enjoyed it with her three children. After the meal, she suggested the whole family watch TV together, and found the old movie Liu Sanjie from the disc case and put it into the player. Then she and the children curled up on the sofa to watch the movie. Her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin were absorbed; her eldest son Ma Mingxuan, although not very interested, also stayed along. Ma Xiulan explained the plot to the children while watching, and the home was filled with laughter and joy. After the movie ended, she warmed up milk for the children and they drank together.

subevent.name: Prepare and enjoy a roast duck dinner.
subevent.description: On the evening of Sunday, November 9, 2025, Ma Xiulan used the roast duck her husband brought home as the main ingredient to prepare dinner in the kitchen and dining room of her home at 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin. She sliced the roast duck, served it with sweet bean sauce, cucumber strips, and thin pancakes, and cooked a pot of hot soup. She then sat around the dining table with her three children (eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin) to enjoy the meal. At the table, the children excitedly talked about how delicious the duck was, while Ma Xiulan urged everyone to eat more vegetables. The atmosphere was warm. Dinner began at around 18:00 and lasted about 30 minutes.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home dining room

subevent.name: Suggest watching a movie and look through the discs.
subevent.description: After dinner, at about 18:40, Ma Xiulan cleared away the dishes and chopsticks and suggested the whole family watch TV to relax. She walked to the TV cabinet in the living room, opened the disc case, carefully searched through it, and picked out a DVD of the old movie Liu Sanjie. The children gathered around curiously; her second son Ma Mingzhe and daughter Ma Yuxin showed strong interest, while her eldest son Ma Mingxuan stood by watching. Ma Xiulan put the disc into the DVD player, pressed play, and then called the children to sit together on the sofa.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: The whole family watched the movie Liu Sanjie.
subevent.description: Around 7 p.m., the movie began. Ma Xiulan and her three children snuggled together on the living room sofa to watch "Liu Sanjie." Her second son, Ma Mingzhe, and daughter, Ma Yuxin, were deeply captivated by the beautiful folk songs and the interesting plot; her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, though not very interested in this kind of old movie, still stayed with the family. Ma Xiulan explained the cultural background and plot details to the children as they watched, such as Liu Sanjie's cleverness and her resistance to the landlord. Laughter and discussion came from the home from time to time. The movie lasted about 1 hour and 40 minutes and ended around 8:40 p.m.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home living room

subevent.name: After the screening, heated milk and distributed it.
subevent.description: After the movie ended, at about 20:45, Ma Xiulan got up, walked into the kitchen, took a carton of milk from the refrigerator, poured it into a small pot, and heated it. While heating the milk, she chatted with the children in the living room about the movie they had just watched. A few minutes later, when the milk was ready, she poured it into three cups and handed them to the children. Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin took their cups and drank happily, while Ma Mingxuan also took his cup and thanked her. Ma Xiulan poured herself a cup as well and sipped it with the children, enjoying the cozy time after the movie.
subevent.location: Tianjin - Jinghai District - home kitchen

name: Making and hanging hand-embroidered New Year ornaments
description: From December 22 to 25, 2025, Ma Xiulan, under the living room lamp at her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, embroidered three New Year ornaments in sequence—a small blessing pouch, auspicious clouds, and a pomegranate—using fabric scraps bought on the old street and collected embroidery threads. Her daughter Xinxin joined out of curiosity and learned to sew. On the morning of the 25th, the mother and daughter hung the ornaments on the door frame, by the window, and beside the bedroom door, appreciating their auspicious meanings.

subevent.name: Prepare and start embroidering small fortune pouches
subevent.description: On the evening of December 22, 2025, Ma Xiulan sat under the lamp in the living room of her home in Jinghai District, Tianjin, took out the fabric scraps she had bought earlier from the old street and the embroidery thread she had collected, and began to embroider her first New Year ornament—a small fortune bag. She first cut the fabric and threaded the needle, then carefully embroidered the outline of the character Fu. Her younger daughter Ma Yuxin (Xinxin) came over curiously, and Ma Xiulan taught her hand in hand to sew two stitches; the mother and daughter kept laughing. Afterwards, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering on her own and completed the basic shape of the small fortune bag.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Embroider an auspicious cloud ornament
subevent.description: On the evening of December 23, 2025, after finishing the day's housework, Ma Xiulan continued embroidering the second New Year decoration—Auspicious Clouds—under the living room lamp. She chose light blue and white embroidery thread and embroidered according to the traditional auspicious cloud pattern. The process went smoothly. During this time, her daughter Xinxin occasionally came over to watch, but did not try to do it herself. After about two hours, the embroidered surface of the Auspicious Clouds decoration was basically finished, leaving only the final edge-sewing.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Embroidered and completed a pomegranate hanging ornament.
subevent.description: On the evening of December 24, 2025, Ma Xiulan finished the last New Year hanging ornament—the pomegranate embroidered piece. Using red and green embroidery thread, she embroidered full pomegranate fruits and leaves, and added tassels at the bottom. After completing it, she carefully inspected the three ornaments (small fortune pouch, auspicious cloud, and pomegranate), trimmed the loose threads, and organized them for hanging.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Hanging New Year decorations.
subevent.description: On the morning of December 25, 2025, Ma Xiulan hung the three embroidered New Year ornaments in appropriate places: the small blessing pouch on the inside door frame of the entrance door, the auspicious cloud on the living room window side, and the pomegranate by the bedroom door. She invited her daughter Xinxin to help, and briefly explained the auspicious meaning of each ornament. After they were hung, mother and daughter admired them contentedly for a while.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - various rooms at home

name: Meet up with childhood friend Liu Chunmei for handicraft exchange over afternoon tea
description: On October 14, Ma Xiulan invited her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat to come to her courtyard for afternoon tea and embroidery exchange on the afternoon of the 15th. Liu Chunmei gladly agreed and said she would bring homemade osmanthus cake. On the morning of the 15th, Ma Xiulan cleaned the courtyard and prepared flower tea, preserved fruit, embroidery materials, and a gift of pickled vegetables. In the afternoon, Liu Chunmei arrived as promised. The two enjoyed flower tea, osmanthus cake, and preserved fruit in the courtyard, exchanged newly learned embroidery stitches, shared updates about their children, and agreed to attend the community handicraft market together next month. The gathering lasted over two hours. Before parting, Ma Xiulan gave her some homemade low-salt pickled vegetables, and they agreed to meet again.

subevent.name: Invited childhood friend Liu Chunmei to confirm the afternoon tea gathering
subevent.description: On October 14, Ma Xiulan contacted her childhood friend Liu Chunmei via WeChat and invited her to come to the courtyard at 156 Jingwen Road on the afternoon of October 15 for afternoon tea and a discussion of hand embroidery. Liu Chunmei gladly agreed and said she would bring homemade osmanthus cake. The two settled on 2 pm as the specific time.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - family living room

subevent.name: Preparing for the afternoon tea gathering
subevent.description: On the morning of October 15, Ma Xiulan was busy preparing at home: she first cleaned the courtyard, moved out the stone table and chairs and wiped them clean; went to the garden to pick fresh autumn roses, washed them, and brewed flower tea with boiling water; took out the preserved fruit brought back from Beijing and placed it on an exquisite plate; took a jar of homemade low-salt pickled vegetables from the kitchen as a gift. In addition, she also organized materials on several new embroidery patterns and stitching techniques she had recently learned, preparing to exchange ideas with Liu Chunmei.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

subevent.name: Afternoon tea gathering with Liu Chunmei for handicraft exchange
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 15, Liu Chunmei arrived at Ma Xiulan's courtyard as promised. The two sat at the stone table in the yard, tasting the newly brewed autumn rose tea while eating the osmanthus cake Liu Chunmei had brought and the preserved fruit Ma Xiulan had prepared. They mainly exchanged ideas about the new embroidery stitches they had each been learning recently, showing each other their work and discussing technique details. During the conversation they also talked about their children's recent lives; Ma Xiulan mentioned her eldest son's studies and her second son's mischief, and Liu Chunmei shared funny stories about her child's growth. Then they discussed signing up together for the community handicraft market next month and planned to share a stall to display their handmade embroidered items. The gathering lasted more than two hours in a warm and pleasant atmosphere. When leaving, Ma Xiulan gave Liu Chunmei a small jar of homemade low-salt pickled vegetables. Liu Chunmei happily accepted it, and they agreed to meet again next time.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - home courtyard

name: The whole family soaked at a time-honored bathhouse
description: On the afternoon of December 13, Ma Xiulan's family of six walked to a time-honored bathhouse on the old street in Jinghai District. In the women's section, Ma Xiulan scrubbed her daughter's back and then soaked in the hot pool to ease the soreness in her lower back; her mother, Li Xiuying, sighed with comfort. In the men's section, her husband and father chatted. After their bath, the whole family went home, cleaned up, and shared their bathing experience over dinner.

subevent.name: The whole family goes to a time-honored public bathhouse.
subevent.description: In the afternoon, Ma Xiulan and her family of six set out from their home on Jingwen Road and walked to a time-honored bathhouse on Old Street in Jinghai District. Along the way, Ma Xiulan chatted with her mother Li Xiuying about everyday family matters, while the children excitedly talked about how much they enjoyed soaking in the bath.
subevent.location: Old Street section, Jinghai District, Tianjin

subevent.name: Soaking and back scrubbing in the women's area.
subevent.description: After entering the bathhouse, Ma Xiulan, with her daughter Ma Yuxin and her mother Li Xiuying, entered the women's section. Ma Xiulan first carefully scrubbed and rinsed the back of her 6-year-old daughter, then soaked in the hot pool for the first time in a while. The warm water eased the soreness in her lower back muscles. Her mother Li Xiuying also soaked in the pool and sighed, 'It's been a long time since I felt this comfortable.' The three of them enjoyed about half an hour of soaking in the women's section.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - female section of a time-honored bathhouse

subevent.name: Soaking and chatting in the men's bathing area
subevent.description: Meanwhile, in the men's bathing area, her husband Ma Zhiqiang and her father Ma Jianguo chatted about family matters while soaking in the hot pool, discussing trivial household affairs and recent news. The second son Ma Mingzhe also played by the pool, occasionally joining their conversation. The three of them soaked for about half an hour in a relaxed and harmonious atmosphere.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - men's section of a time-honored bathhouse

subevent.name: After returning home, tidied up and had a family dinner.
subevent.description: Back home, Ma Xiulan organized the wet towels and changed clothes and hung them up to dry. Her mother Li Xiuying and her husband Ma Zhiqiang helped prepare dinner. The family sat around the dining table, eating steaming hot noodles with gravy and home-style dishes while sharing the comfortable experience of today's bath, enjoying a warm and happy time.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

name: Fourth-quarter household deep cleaning
description: On December 21, Ma Xiulan organized the whole family for a winter cleaning: her husband was in charge of wiping windows and moving heavy items, the eldest son cleaned the bookshelves and desks, the second son tidied toys and swept the floor, and the youngest daughter wiped the tables. She directed the overall operation, focusing on cleaning the kitchen grease and the clutter in the yard. The second son volunteered to take on raking the fallen leaves in the yard, and she praised him for growing up. She carefully wiped and hung up the 'Harmonious Family' certificate just issued by the community, and the house looked completely refreshed.

subevent.name: Preparations and division of tasks before the big cleaning
subevent.description: On the morning of December 21, Ma Xiulan gathered her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin at home for a brief family meeting to assign the specific tasks for that day's winter deep cleaning. She prepared rags, brooms, cleaning supplies, a ladder, and other tools, and clearly divided the work: her husband would clean windows and move heavy items; the eldest son would tidy the bookshelf and desk; the second son would organize toys and sweep the floor; the youngest daughter would wipe the tables; and she herself would take charge of the overall operation and focus on cleaning kitchen grease and courtyard clutter. Everyone took their tools and got started.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Ma Zhiqiang cleans windows and moves heavy items
subevent.description: Ma Zhiqiang, following the division of labor, used a ladder, rags, and glass cleaner to carefully wash all the windows in the house, including the living room, bedroom, and kitchen windows. At the same time, he moved heavy furniture such as the sofa and coffee table in the living room to let Ma Xiulan clean the corners, and carried away some discarded clutter in the courtyard. Ma Xiulan helped by passing tools and reminded him to pay attention to safety. The whole process took about two hours.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District – all rooms and courtyard of the home

subevent.name: The children tidied their rooms and cleared the fallen leaves in the courtyard
subevent.description: The eldest son, Ma Mingxuan, was in charge of cleaning his bookshelf and desk. He rearranged the books by size, filed away documents, and wiped the dust off the desk. The second son, Ma Mingzhe, was responsible for tidying the toy box in the living room and sweeping the floor. He sorted the scattered Lego pieces and toy cars into storage boxes, then swept the living room floor with a broom. The youngest daughter, Ma Yuxin, used a damp cloth to wipe the coffee table, TV cabinet, and low tabletops. Afterward, Ma Mingzhe noticed that there were many fallen leaves in the courtyard, so he took the initiative to sweep them up with a broom and dustpan and put them into a garbage bag. Ma Xiulan saw her second son's initiative and praised him for growing up and becoming sensible. The children cooperated and spent nearly an hour and a half.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin – home living room, bedroom, and courtyard

subevent.name: Ma Xiulan cleaned the grease in the kitchen and the clutter in the courtyard, and hung up the certificate of merit.
subevent.description: Ma Xiulan put on rubber gloves and used degreaser and steel wool to carefully clean the grease stains on the kitchen stove, the range hood filter, and the tiled walls, then wiped down the cabinet surfaces. Afterward, she went to the courtyard, cleared and sorted the scattered dead branches, empty flower pots, and other clutter, and swept the ground. Finally, she wiped the "Harmonious Family" certificate just issued by the community with a dry cloth and hung it straight on the most prominent wall in the living room. Looking at the refreshed room, she felt very satisfied.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen and courtyard

subevent.name: Finishing the big cleaning and resting with the whole family
subevent.description: Around four in the afternoon, all the cleaning tasks were basically complete. Ma Xiulan led the family through a final check: confirming that the windows were bright, the floors were clean, items were put back in place, and the courtyard was tidy. She praised everyone's contributions, especially her second son Ma Mingzhe for his proactive sense of responsibility. Then they put the cleaning tools away and washed up to rest. Ma Xiulan brewed a pot of tea and cut some fruit for the children. The whole family sat in the refreshed living room chatting, enjoying the fruits of their labor.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Consolidated the family walking habit and gained health self-discipline.
description: On October 20, Ma Xiulan took her second son to the community clinic for a follow-up eye exam. The results showed that his myopia had not worsened. Dr. Wang praised the family's efforts and emphasized the protective effect of daily outdoor walks on eyesight. Over the previous month, Ma Xiulan had insisted on taking the whole family for a 30-minute walk after dinner every day. Not only did her second son's eyesight remain stable, but she also felt less back pain and slept better. She resolved to make walking a lifelong habit and marked daily walking check-ins on the family calendar.

subevent.name: Take the second son for a vision recheck
subevent.description: On the afternoon of October 20, Ma Xiulan took her second son, Ma Mingzhe, to the Jingwen Road Community Health Service Center in Jinghai District for a vision recheck. General practitioner Wang Jianguo performed an eye exam on Ma Mingzhe. The results showed that his myopia had not worsened. Dr. Wang affirmed the family's efforts to persist with outdoor walks and emphasized the protective effect of daily walking on eyesight.
subevent.location: Tianjin Jinghai District Community Health Service Center

subevent.name: Preparing dinner for the whole family
subevent.description: On the evening of October 20, Ma Xiulan was preparing dinner for her family in the home kitchen and reminded everyone to go out for a walk together after dinner to reinforce healthy vision habits.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: The whole family went for a 30-minute walk after dinner.
subevent.description: After dinner on October 20, Ma Xiulan went out with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin for a walk along the streets near Jingwen Road, lasting about 30 minutes. During the walk, the whole family chatted and interacted, and Ma Xiulan felt happy in both body and mind.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - block near Jingwen Road

subevent.name: Family calendar walking check-in.
subevent.description: After the walk, Ma Xiulan took out the family calendar and drew a walking mark on the square for October 20, successfully completing her daily check-in. She also wrote the encouraging phrase "Keep walking, keep the whole family healthy" on the calendar to inspire the whole family to keep the walking habit for life.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

name: Maintain healthy family eating and summer dietary wellness
description: After summer began in July, Ma Xiulan made the family’s healthy diet more specific: every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday, breakfast was fixed as homemade yogurt mixed with multigrain porridge; lunch and dinner added more seasonal vegetables such as cold cucumber and tomatoes, with less oil and salt. She learned to make a cooling soup from mung beans, red beans, and Job’s tears to replace carbonated drinks. On July 12, she noticed that her second son had sores at the corners of his mouth. After confirming that it was a vitamin deficiency, she made sure everyone ate an apple or a pear every day and adjusted the menu to include stir-fried carrots with pork. She also planted a pot of mint on the windowsill and made mint water for the children. At the end of July, she noted that the family’s food expenses were 50 yuan less than the previous month, and their complexions had clearly improved.

subevent.name: Formulating a family healthy eating plan and purchasing ingredients
subevent.description: On July 1, at her home at No. 156 Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, Ma Xiulan planned the family's healthy diet plan for the whole of July: breakfast on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays would be homemade yogurt mixed with multigrain porridge, and lunch and dinner would add more seasonal vegetables such as cucumber salad and tomatoes, with less oil and salt. She then went to Xingwang Vegetable Market in Jinghai District and bought mung beans, red beans, coix seed, multigrain, fresh vegetables, fruit, as well as a flowerpot and mint seeds. Her daughter Ma Yuxin accompanied her.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin – Home and the vegetable market

subevent.name: Learning and making a refreshing summer soup
subevent.description: On the afternoon of July 2, Ma Xiulan used the mung beans, red beans, and coix seed she bought yesterday to cook a summer heat-relief soup in her home kitchen, following a method learned online, as a substitute for carbonated drinks for her family. She carefully recorded the proportions and heat levels, and stored the leftover soup ingredients in separate portions.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Plant mint on the windowsill.
subevent.description: On July 3, Ma Xiulan planted mint on her windowsill using a newly bought flowerpot and mint seeds. She loosened the soil, sowed the seeds, watered them, and placed the pot in a sunny spot. She planned to steep the mint in water for the children to drink once it grew.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - windowsill at home

subevent.name: Implement the healthy breakfast plan on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays
subevent.description: Every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday morning, Ma Xiulan makes homemade yogurt mixed with multigrain porridge as breakfast for the whole family in the kitchen at home. The night before, she uses a yogurt maker to ferment the yogurt; in the morning, she mixes the cooked multigrain porridge (including millet, oats, and brown rice) into the yogurt and adds a little honey or fruit pieces. The whole family is satisfied after eating.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home kitchen

subevent.name: Discovered her second son had cracked mouth corners and adjusted his diet
subevent.description: On the morning of July 12, Ma Xiulan noticed that her second son Ma Mingzhe had cracked sores at the corners of his mouth and judged that it was caused by a lack of vitamins B and C. She immediately adjusted the day's menu, adding shredded carrot stir-fried with pork to lunch, and decided that from that day on she would make sure everyone in the family ate an apple or a pear every day to ensure vitamin intake. She also told her husband and eldest son about this change and asked them to supervise each other.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - Living room at home.

subevent.name: Remind family members to eat fruit every day.
subevent.description: Starting July 12, Ma Xiulan made sure every family member ate an apple or a pear every day after meals or during rest time. She washed and cut the fruit, distributed it to the children, and set an example by eating it herself. She kept up this habit until the end of the month.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home dining room

name: Persist in doing morning Baduanjin exercises every day.
description: After finishing the Baduanjin class, Ma Xiulan developed the habit of getting up at 6 a.m. every morning to do a set of Baduanjin. From July 16, she and Aunt Zhao agreed to practice together in the community garden on Wednesday and Sunday mornings, correcting each other's movements. On July 20, she did it together with her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan. Mingxuan initially thought it was old people's exercise, but after finishing he said his shoulders felt relaxed, and thereafter he occasionally joined in voluntarily. Ma Xiulan kept up the practice, and by the end of July she could complete the entire routine independently without watching the video, and she began teaching her youngest daughter a few simple movements. She felt that the soreness in her back and waist had noticeably eased, and her sleep quality had also improved.

subevent.name: Start daily morning exercise
subevent.description: After completing the Baduanjin class, Ma Xiulan decided to get up at 6 a.m. every morning to practice a set of Baduanjin. That morning, she practiced on her own for the first time in her small yard, relying mainly on memory and video references for the movements, and felt her body stretch and relax.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Practiced Baduanjin alone in the morning.
subevent.description: On mornings when she didn't have an appointment with Aunt Zhao, Ma Xiulan got up at 6 every day and practiced Baduanjin independently in her own courtyard, keeping up with her check-in routine. She gradually became familiar with the movement patterns, her back and waist soreness significantly eased, and her sleep quality also improved.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Practice Baduanjin together with Aunt Zhao.
subevent.description: Since July 16, Ma Xiulan and her neighbor Aunt Zhao have agreed to practice Baduanjin together in the community garden every Wednesday and Sunday morning, correcting each other's movements and deepening their friendship. On these mornings, they meet on time and complete the full set of exercises together.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District - community small garden

subevent.name: Practiced Baduanjin with her eldest son
subevent.description: On the morning of July 20, Ma Xiulan practiced Baduanjin with her eldest son Ma Mingxuan in the courtyard. At first, Mingxuan thought it was like an old people's exercise, but after finishing, he said his shoulders felt relaxed. After that, he occasionally joined in on his own.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

subevent.name: Teaching youngest daughter the basic movements of Baduanjin
subevent.description: By the end of July, Ma Xiulan was able to complete the entire set of Baduanjin independently without watching a video. Early in the morning of July 31, she began teaching her youngest daughter Ma Yuxin a few simple moves, such as 'Two Hands Hold Up the Heavens to Regulate the Triple Burner.' The mother-daughter interaction was warm.
subevent.location: Jinghai District, Tianjin - home courtyard

name: Establishing a family screen-time pact and a daily walking habit
description: On September 12, 2025, Ma Xiulan negotiated a screen-time agreement with her family: no more than 1 hour of screen time per day, phones used only for study, and after dinner the whole family would take a half-hour walk on Jingwen Road. September 13 to October 31 was the adaptation period, during which the family kept to the plan and the walking and screen-time limits gradually became routine; November 1 to December 31 was the consolidation period, during which the habits were further solidified and family interaction increased noticeably. The agreement is planned to be carried out long-term to protect eyesight and strengthen family bonding.

subevent.name: The whole family discussed and drew up a screen-time limit pact
subevent.description: On the evening of September 12, Ma Xiulan called a family meeting in the living room of their home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, with her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin. After nearly an hour of discussion, the whole family reached an agreement: watch TV for no more than 1 hour a day, use phones only for studying, and take a half-hour walk together along Jingwen Road after dinner. Ma Xiulan led by example and decided to switch from the TV drama she was following to listening to the radio. The agreement was written on paper and stuck on the refrigerator.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.

subevent.name: Implement screen time limits and walking habit (adaptation period).
subevent.description: Starting September 13, Ma Xiulan's family began implementing the new pact. Every day after dinner, Ma Xiulan led her family out from their home on Jingwen Road and walked along Jingwen Road for about half an hour. Daytime TV watching was strictly limited to within one hour, and the children's use of mobile phones was limited to study-related activities only. Ma Xiulan herself also insisted on listening to the radio instead of watching TV. This stage was the early stage of habit formation, with the whole family supervising each other and gradually adapting to the new pace of life.
subevent.location: Tianjin, Jinghai District — Jingwen Road and home

subevent.name: Family launches a screen limit and walking pact.
subevent.description: After dinner on Saturday, September 13, Ma Xiulan gathered her husband Ma Zhiqiang, eldest son Ma Mingxuan, second son Ma Mingzhe, and youngest daughter Ma Yuxin at their home on Jingwen Road and officially announced the family screen-time limit and walking pact. She reiterated that from that day on, the whole family would walk together along Jingwen Road for half an hour after dinner every day; during the daytime, each person's TV time would be strictly limited to 1 hour; the children's phones would only be used for studying; and she herself would listen to the radio instead of watching TV. After the meeting, Ma Xiulan led the family on their first group walk. Starting from the front door, they walked along Jingwen Road for about half an hour, chatting and supervising the children to put down their phones, experiencing the new habit together.
subevent.location: Home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the way

subevent.name: Daily routine for the first week of the adjustment period
subevent.description: From Monday to Saturday this week (September 14 to 19), Ma Xiulan strictly followed the screen time pact. Every day after dinner, she led the children out from the home on Jingwen Road and walked along Jingwen Road for about half an hour, during which she urged Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin to put down their toys and phones, and Ma Mingxuan also voluntarily joined in. During the day, Ma Xiulan kept TV watching to within one hour, instead using the radio to listen to news and lifestyle programs, while also supervising the three children: Ma Mingxuan used his phone only to look up study materials, and Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin had their screen time limited to within 15 minutes for games or cartoons. On the days Ma Zhiqiang was home (14th, 17th, 19th), he also joined the walks; on the other days he was out driving and did not return. The whole family reminded one another and gradually adapted to the new rhythm.
subevent.location: Home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the way

subevent.name: Daily execution for the second week of the adaptation period
subevent.description: During the second week (September 20 to 26), Ma Xiulan continued to lead the family in following the new habits. After dinner every day, they walked for about half an hour along the same route. Along the way, the children gradually got used to outdoor activities, and Ma Mingzhe began proactively sharing amusing stories from school. Daytime screen-time monitoring continued: Ma Xiulan kept listening to the radio herself, and the TV was only turned on briefly during lunch; Ma Mingxuan occasionally used his phone to look things up only after finishing his homework on his own initiative, and Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin reduced screen time with their mother's company, playing with building blocks or drawing instead. Ma Zhiqiang was home for five days this week (20-24), actively joining the walks and urging the boys on. The whole family encouraged each other, and there were no violations this week.
subevent.location: Home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the way

subevent.name: Daily implementation for the sixth week of the adaptation period
subevent.description: In the sixth week (October 18 to 24), the new habit had become almost natural. Ma Xiulan still took the children for a walk along Jingwen Road after dinner every day. Ma Zhiqiang was home only on the nights of the 18th and 22nd this week, but the children were able to organize themselves. Daytime screen time management became easier: Ma Xiulan herself almost forgot to watch TV, immersed in the radio and handcrafts; Ma Mingxuan arranged his own study and phone time; Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin would proactively ask their mother how much time was allowed before watching cartoons. On the evening of October 20, while walking, Ma Xiulan met her neighbor Zhang Shufen in the open space of the community. They talked about the effect of limiting screen time, and Zhang Shufen praised that the children had become more lively. This week, no one in the family violated the rules, and the atmosphere was harmonious.
subevent.location: Home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the way

subevent.name: Daily execution of the seventh week of the adaptation period
subevent.description: Week 7 (October 25 to 30), the adaptation period was coming to an end. Ma Xiulan insisted on taking the children for a walk after dinner every day. Ma Zhiqiang was only at home on the 25th and 26th that week due to work, but walking had already become a regular family activity, and the children went out on their own. During the day, screen restrictions basically required no reminders: Ma Xiulan was used to getting information from the radio; Ma Mingxuan focused on his studies; Ma Mingzhe and Ma Yuxin often took the initiative to ask their mother to teach them embroidery or play board games with them. During the walk on October 28, Ma Xiulan said to her eldest son, Ma Mingxuan: "Everyone has changed a lot this month." Mingxuan nodded in agreement. No screen-rule violations occurred this week, and the new habits had fully become part of daily life.
subevent.location: Home on Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin, and along the way

subevent.name: Family meeting to summarize the adjustment period.
subevent.description: Friday, October 31, the last day of the adjustment period. After dinner and the evening walk, Ma Xiulan gathered the whole family in the living room for a brief wrap-up meeting. She praised the family's persistence over the past month or more: the walks had never been skipped, screen time had been effectively controlled, and the family atmosphere had become more harmonious. Ma Zhiqiang also praised the children's self-discipline and said he would continue to support them. After discussion, the family all agreed to continue the new habits as a long-term lifestyle. Ma Xiulan also recorded everyone's progress, such as Ma Mingxuan's improved grades, Ma Mingzhe's becoming livelier, and Ma Yuxin learning three embroidery stitches. The meeting ended in a warm atmosphere, marking the successful establishment of the screen-limiting and walking habits.
subevent.location: At home, Jingwen Road, Jinghai District, Tianjin.
